    pool = gcp('nocreate');
    if isempty(pool) || pool.NumWorkers ~= workerCount
        if ~isempty(pool)
            delete(pool);
        end
        parpool('local',workerCount);
    end
end

====================================================================================================
FILE: Algorithms/Multi-objective optimization/CBS-CGAN/Support/run_CBS_CGAN_train_condition_diagnostics.m | bytes=17855
====================================================================================================
function [Summary,outDir,Detail] = run_CBS_CGAN_train_condition_diagnostics( ...
    outDir,problemNames,runIds,targetFE,Options)
%RUN_CBS_CGAN_TRAIN_CONDITION_DIAGNOSTICS Diagnose TrainC -> TrainX fitting.
%
% This diagnostic intentionally does not modify CBS_CGAN. It reproduces the
% CBS_CGAN_FS data flow until targetFE, captures TrainX/TrainC, then tests:
%   1) true TrainX objective/feasibility consistency,
%   2) objective/feasibility sensitivity to small decision perturbations,
%   3) fresh fixed-dataset CGAN overfit at selected training budgets.

    rootDir = fileparts(which('platemo'));
    if isempty(rootDir)
        rootDir = pwd;
    end
    addpath(genpath(rootDir));

    if nargin < 1 || isempty(outDir)
        outDir = fullfile(rootDir,'Data','CBS_CGAN', ...
            ['train_condition_diag_', ...
            char(datetime('now','Format','yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'))]);
    end
    if nargin < 2 || isempty(problemNames)
        problemNames = ["DASCMOP4_BC";"DASCMOP5_BC"; ...
            "LIRCMOP9_BC";"LIRCMOP10_BC"];
    end
    if nargin < 3 || isempty(runIds)
        runIds = 1;
    end
    if nargin < 4 || isempty(targetFE)
        targetFE = 100000;
    end
    if nargin < 5 || isempty(Options)
        Options = struct();
    end
    Options = normalizeOptions(Options);

    if ~isfolder(outDir)
        mkdir(outDir);
    end

    problemNames = string(problemNames(:));
    runIds = double(runIds(:)');
    Tasks = buildTasks(problemNames,runIds);
    Rows = repmat(emptySummaryRow(),height(Tasks),1);
    DetailCells = cell(height(Tasks),1);

    if Options.workerCount > 1
        ensureParallelPool(Options.workerCount);
        parfor task = 1 : height(Tasks)
            [Rows(task),DetailCells{task}] = runOneTask( ...
                Tasks(task,:),outDir,targetFE,Options);
        end
    else
        for task = 1 : height(Tasks)
            [Rows(task),DetailCells{task}] = runOneTask( ...
                Tasks(task,:),outDir,targetFE,Options);
            fprintf('[%d/%d] %s run=%d status=%s\n',task,height(Tasks), ...
                Tasks.problem(task),Tasks.run(task),Rows(task).status);
        end
    end

    Summary = struct2table(Rows);
    writetable(Summary,fullfile(outDir,'train_condition_diag_summary.csv'));
    Detail = vertcatDetailTables(DetailCells);
    writetable(Detail,fullfile(outDir,'train_condition_diag_detail.csv'));
end

function Options = normalizeOptions(Options)
    Options = ensureField(Options,'workerCount',1);
    Options = ensureField(Options,'N',100);
    Options = ensureField(Options,'D',[]);
    Options = ensureField(Options,'algorithmParams', ...
        {1,1,20,2,100,32,1e-4,2e-4,0,1,1,1,2,2,1,0.10,100});
    Options = ensureField(Options,'perturbSigmas',[0.005 0.01 0.02 0.05]);
    Options = ensureField(Options,'perturbRepeats',3);
    Options = ensureField(Options,'overfitIters',[100 300 1000]);
    Options = ensureField(Options,'overfitWeights',[100 500]);
    Options.workerCount = max(1,round(double(Options.workerCount)));
    Options.N = max(1,round(double(Options.N)));
    Options.perturbSigmas = double(Options.perturbSigmas(:)');
    Options.perturbRepeats = max(1,round(double(Options.perturbRepeats)));
    Options.overfitIters = max(0,round(double(Options.overfitIters(:)')));
    Options.overfitWeights = double(Options.overfitWeights(:)');
end

function S = ensureField(S,name,value)
    if ~isfield(S,name) || isempty(S.(name))
        S.(name) = value;
    end
end

function Tasks = buildTasks(problemNames,runIds)
    Rows = repmat(struct('problem',"",'run',NaN), ...
        numel(problemNames)*numel(runIds),1);
    k = 0;
    for p = 1 : numel(problemNames)
        for r = 1 : numel(runIds)
            k = k + 1;
            Rows(k).problem = problemNames(p);
            Rows(k).run = runIds(r);
        end
    end
    Tasks = struct2table(Rows);
end

function [Row,Detail] = runOneTask(Task,outDir,targetFE,Options)
    Row = emptySummaryRow();
    Row.problem = string(Task.problem);
    Row.run = double(Task.run);
    Row.targetFE = double(targetFE);
    Detail = emptyDetailTable();
    try
        rootDir = fileparts(which('platemo'));
        addpath(genpath(rootDir));
        try
            maxNumCompThreads(1);
        catch
        end
        rng(Row.run,'twister');
        ProblemConstructor = str2func(char(Row.problem));
        if isempty(Options.D)
            Problem = ProblemConstructor('N',Options.N,'maxFE',targetFE);
        else
            Problem = ProblemConstructor('N',Options.N,'D',Options.D, ...
                'maxFE',targetFE);
        end
        Row.D = double(Problem.D);
        [Data,LoopDiag] = captureDatasetAtTarget(Problem,targetFE,Options);
        Row.actualFE = double(Problem.FE);
        Row.gen = double(LoopDiag.gen);
        Row.train_count = size(Data.TrainX,1);
        Row.query_count = size(Data.QueryC,1);
        Row.bmem_count = size(Data.BMem.y_b,1);
        Row.chain_count = numel(unique(Data.BMem.chain(:)'));
        if isempty(Data.TrainX)
            Row.status = "empty_train";
            return;
        end

        Detail = [Detail; trueTrainRows(Row,Problem,Data)];
        Detail = [Detail; perturbRows(Row,Problem,Data,Options)];
        Detail = [Detail; overfitRows(Row,Problem,Data,Options)];

        taskFolder = fullfile(outDir,sprintf('%s_run%d', ...
            char(Row.problem),round(Row.run)));
        if ~isfolder(taskFolder)
            mkdir(taskFolder);
        end
        save(fullfile(taskFolder,'captured_dataset.mat'), ...
            'Data','LoopDiag','-v7.3');
        writetable(Detail,fullfile(taskFolder,'train_condition_detail.csv'));
        Row.status = "ok";
    catch err
        Row.status = "failed";
        Row.error_message = string(getReport(err,'extended', ...
            'hyperlinks','off'));
    end
end

function [Data,LoopDiag] = captureDatasetAtTarget(Problem,targetFE,Options)
    [trainGap,archiveGap,nGen,zDim,ganIter,ganMiniBatch, ...
        ganLrD,ganLrG,ganDPretrainIter,ganDSteps,ganGSteps, ...
        pairNeighborRefRadius,maxCandidatePairsPerRef, ...
        minChainLength,queryPerCondition, ...
        reconstructionHuberDelta,reconstructionWeight] = ...
        parseAlgorithmParams(Options.algorithmParams);

    [W,~] = UniformPoint(Problem.N,Problem.M);
    BoundaryOptions = struct( ...
        'pairNeighborRefRadius',pairNeighborRefRadius, ...
        'maxCandidatePairsPerRef',maxCandidatePairsPerRef, ...
        'minChainLength',minChainLength, ...
        'supportPointMode','feasible');
    DatasetOptions = struct( ...
        'pairNeighborRefRadius',pairNeighborRefRadius, ...
        'queryConditionBudget',max(1,ceil(max(nGen,1)/queryPerCondition)), ...
        'supportPointMode','feasible');
    GANOptions = struct( ...
        'zDim',zDim, ...
        'iter',ganIter, ...
        'miniBatch',ganMiniBatch, ...
        'lrD',double(ganLrD), ...
        'lrG',double(ganLrG), ...
        'dPretrainIter',ganDPretrainIter, ...
        'dSteps',ganDSteps, ...
        'gSteps',ganGSteps, ...
        'sigma',0.05, ...
        'reconstructionHuberDelta',double(reconstructionHuberDelta), ...
        'reconstructionWeight',double(reconstructionWeight));

    Population1 = Problem.Initialization();
    Population2 = Problem.Initialization();
    DatasetOptions.conditionScale = initializeConditionScale( ...
        [Population1,Population2],Problem);
    Fitness1 = CalFitness_CBS(Population1.objs,Population1.cons);
    Fitness2 = CalFitness_CBS(Population2.objs);
    BMem = [];
    GAN = [];
    gen = 0;
    Data = emptyCapturedData(Problem);
    LoopDiag = struct('gen',0,'lastFE',double(Problem.FE));

    while Problem.FE < targetFE
        gen = gen + 1;
        MatingPool1 = TournamentSelection(2,2*Problem.N,Fitness1);
        MatingPool2 = TournamentSelection(2,2*Problem.N,Fitness2);
        Offspring1 = OperatorDE(Problem,Population1, ...
            Population1(MatingPool1(1:end/2)), ...
            Population1(MatingPool1(end/2+1:end)));
        Offspring2 = OperatorDE(Problem,Population2, ...
            Population2(MatingPool2(1:end/2)), ...
            Population2(MatingPool2(end/2+1:end)));

        if mod(gen,archiveGap) == 0
            BMem = UpdateBoundaryMemory_CBS(BMem,Population1,Offspring1, ...
                Population2,Offspring2,W,BoundaryOptions);
        end

        OffspringG = Offspring1([]);
        TrainX = zeros(0,Problem.D);
        TrainC = zeros(0,Problem.M);
        QueryC = zeros(0,Problem.M);
        DatasetInfo = emptyDatasetInfo(Problem.M);
        if mod(gen,trainGap) == 0 && ~isempty(BMem) && nGen > 0
            [TrainX,TrainC,QueryC,BMem,DatasetInfo] = ...
                BuildBoundaryDataset_CBS(BMem, ...
                [Population1,Offspring1,Population2,Offspring2], ...
                W,Problem,DatasetOptions);
            if ~isempty(TrainX) && ~isempty(TrainC) && ~isempty(QueryC)
                GAN = BoundaryCGAN_CBS('train',GAN,TrainX,TrainC, ...
                    Problem,GANOptions);
                RawDec = BoundaryCGAN_CBS('samplebycondition',GAN, ...
                    QueryC,queryPerCondition,GANOptions);
                if size(RawDec,1) > nGen
                    RawDec = RawDec(1:nGen,:);
                end
                if ~isempty(RawDec)
                    OffspringG = Problem.Evaluation(RawDec);
                end
            end
        end

        if Problem.FE >= targetFE
            Data = struct( ...
                'TrainX',TrainX, ...
                'TrainC',TrainC, ...
                'QueryC',QueryC, ...
                'BMem',BMem, ...
                'DatasetInfo',DatasetInfo, ...
                'GANOptions',GANOptions);
            LoopDiag = struct('gen',gen,'lastFE',double(Problem.FE));
            return;
        end

        UnionPopulation = [Population1,Population2,Offspring1, ...
            Offspring2,OffspringG];
        [Population1,Fitness1] = EnvironmentalSelection_CBS( ...
            UnionPopulation,Problem.N,true);
        [Population2,Fitness2] = EnvironmentalSelection_CBS( ...
            UnionPopulation,Problem.N,false);
    end
end

function [trainGap,archiveGap,nGen,zDim,ganIter,ganMiniBatch, ...
    ganLrD,ganLrG,ganDPretrainIter,ganDSteps,ganGSteps, ...
    pairNeighborRefRadius,maxCandidatePairsPerRef,minChainLength, ...
    queryPerCondition,reconstructionHuberDelta,reconstructionWeight] = ...
    parseAlgorithmParams(P)
    Defaults = {1,1,20,2,100,32,1e-4,2e-4,0,1,1,1,2,2,1,0.10,100};
    if isempty(P)
        P = Defaults;
    end
    if ~iscell(P)
        P = num2cell(P);
    end
    for i = 1 : numel(Defaults)
        if numel(P) < i || isempty(P{i})
            P{i} = Defaults{i};
        end
    end
    trainGap = max(1,round(double(P{1})));
    archiveGap = max(1,round(double(P{2})));
    nGen = max(0,round(double(P{3})));
    zDim = max(0,round(double(P{4})));
    ganIter = max(0,round(double(P{5})));
    ganMiniBatch = max(1,round(double(P{6})));
    ganLrD = double(P{7});
    ganLrG = double(P{8});
    ganDPretrainIter = max(0,round(double(P{9})));
    ganDSteps = max(1,round(double(P{10})));
    ganGSteps = max(1,round(double(P{11})));
    pairNeighborRefRadius = max(0,round(double(P{12})));
    maxCandidatePairsPerRef = max(1,round(double(P{13})));
    minChainLength = max(1,round(double(P{14})));
    queryPerCondition = max(1,round(double(P{15})));
    reconstructionHuberDelta = double(P{16});
    reconstructionWeight = double(P{17});
end

function Rows = trueTrainRows(TaskRow,Problem,Data)
    [Obj,Con] = evaluateNoFE(Problem,Data.TrainX);
    Dist = conditionObjectiveDistances(Obj,Data.TrainC,Data.DatasetInfo);
    Rows = makeDetailRow(TaskRow,"true_train",0,NaN,NaN, ...
        Data.TrainX,Data.TrainX,Dist,Con);
end

function Rows = perturbRows(TaskRow,Problem,Data,Options)
    Rows = emptyDetailTable();
    lower = double(Problem.lower);
    upper = double(Problem.upper);
    span = upper - lower;
    span(span <= eps) = 1;
    for s = Options.perturbSigmas
        for r = 1 : Options.perturbRepeats
            Noise = randn(size(Data.TrainX)).*span.*s;
            Dec = Data.TrainX + Noise;
            [Obj,Con] = evaluateNoFE(Problem,Dec);
            Dist = conditionObjectiveDistances(Obj,Data.TrainC, ...
                Data.DatasetInfo);
            Rows = [Rows; makeDetailRow(TaskRow,"perturb",s,NaN,r, ...
                Data.TrainX,Dec,Dist,Con)]; %#ok<AGROW>
        end
    end
end

function Rows = overfitRows(TaskRow,Problem,Data,Options)
    Rows = emptyDetailTable();
    BaseOptions = Data.GANOptions;
    cfg = 0;
    for iter = Options.overfitIters
        for weight = Options.overfitWeights
            cfg = cfg + 1;
            TrainOptions = BaseOptions;
            TrainOptions.iter = iter;
            TrainOptions.reconstructionWeight = weight;
            GAN = BoundaryCGAN_CBS('train',[],Data.TrainX,Data.TrainC, ...
                Problem,TrainOptions);
            EvalOptions = TrainOptions;
            EvalOptions.sigma = 0;
            [Dec,Info] = BoundaryCGAN_CBS('samplebycondition',GAN, ...
                Data.TrainC,1,EvalOptions);
            n = min(size(Dec,1),size(Data.TrainX,1));
            Dec = Dec(1:n,:);
            target = Info.query_index(1:n);
            target = max(1,min(size(Data.TrainX,1),target));
            [Obj,Con] = evaluateNoFE(Problem,Dec);
            Dist = conditionObjectiveDistances(Obj,Info.condition(1:n,:), ...
                Data.DatasetInfo);
            Rows = [Rows; makeDetailRow(TaskRow,"overfit",0,iter,cfg, ...
                Data.TrainX(target,:),Dec,Dist,Con,weight)]; %#ok<AGROW>
        end
    end
end

function Row = makeDetailRow(TaskRow,mode,sigma,iter,rep,TargetX,Dec, ...
    ObjDist,Con,weight)
    if nargin < 10
        weight = NaN;
    end
    DecError = Dec - TargetX;
    Row = emptyDetailRow();
    Row.problem = TaskRow.problem;
    Row.run = TaskRow.run;
    Row.mode = string(mode);
    Row.sigma = double(sigma);
    Row.iter = double(iter);
    Row.reconstructionWeight = double(weight);
    Row.repeat = double(rep);
    Row.n = size(Dec,1);
    Row.dec_rmse = sqrt(mean(DecError.^2,'all'));
    Row.obj_dist50 = percentileFinite(ObjDist,50);
    Row.obj_dist90 = percentileFinite(ObjDist,90);
    Row.feasible_rate = feasibleRate(Con);
    Row = struct2table(Row);
end

function [Obj,Con] = evaluateNoFE(Problem,Dec)
    if isempty(Dec)
        Obj = zeros(0,Problem.M);
        Con = zeros(0,0);
        return;
    end
    oldFE = Problem.FE;
    Population = Problem.Evaluation(Dec);
    Obj = Population.objs;
    Con = Population.cons;
    Problem.FE = oldFE;
end

function Dist = conditionObjectiveDistances(Obj,Condition,DatasetInfo)
    if isempty(Obj) || isempty(Condition)
        Dist = NaN(0,1);
        return;
    end
    n = min(size(Obj,1),size(Condition,1));
    ObjN = normalizeWithInfo(Obj(1:n,:),DatasetInfo.objMin, ...
        DatasetInfo.objSpan);
    Condition = Condition(1:n,:);
    Dist = sqrt(sum((ObjN - Condition).^2,2));
end

function Rate = feasibleRate(Con)
    if isempty(Con)
        Rate = 1;
    else
        CV = sum(max(0,Con),2);
        Rate = mean(double(CV <= 0));
    end
end

function q = percentileFinite(X,p)
    X = X(isfinite(X));
    if isempty(X)
        q = NaN;
    else
        q = prctile(X,p);
    end
end

function Xn = normalizeWithInfo(X,MinV,SpanV)
    Xn = (X - MinV)./SpanV;
    Xn(~isfinite(Xn)) = 0;
end

function Scale = initializeConditionScale(Population,Problem)
    if isempty(Population)
        Obj = zeros(0,Problem.M);
    else
        Obj = Population.objs;
    end
    Obj = double(Obj);
    Obj = Obj(all(isfinite(Obj),2),:);
    if isempty(Obj)
        objMin = zeros(1,Problem.M);
        objSpan = ones(1,Problem.M);
    else
        objMin = min(Obj,[],1);
        objMax = max(Obj,[],1);
        objSpan = objMax - objMin;
        objSpan(objSpan <= eps) = 1;
    end
    Scale = struct('objMin',objMin,'objSpan',objSpan);
end

function Info = emptyDatasetInfo(M)
    Info = struct( ...
        'objMin',zeros(1,M), ...
        'objSpan',ones(1,M), ...
        'trainObjs',zeros(0,M));
end

function Data = emptyCapturedData(Problem)
    Data = struct( ...
        'TrainX',zeros(0,Problem.D), ...
        'TrainC',zeros(0,Problem.M), ...
        'QueryC',zeros(0,Problem.M), ...
        'BMem',struct('y_b',zeros(0,Problem.M),'chain',zeros(0,1)), ...
        'DatasetInfo',emptyDatasetInfo(Problem.M), ...
        'GANOptions',struct());
end

    Row = struct( ...
        'problem',"", ...
        'run',NaN, ...
        'targetFE',NaN, ...
        'actualFE',NaN, ...
        'D',NaN, ...
        'gen',NaN, ...
        'train_count',0, ...
        'query_count',0, ...
        'bmem_count',0, ...
        'chain_count',0, ...
        'status',"pending", ...
        'error_message',"");
end

    Row = struct( ...
        'problem',"", ...
        'run',NaN, ...
        'mode',"", ...
        'sigma',NaN, ...
        'iter',NaN, ...
        'reconstructionWeight',NaN, ...
        'repeat',NaN, ...
        'n',0, ...
        'dec_rmse',NaN, ...
        'obj_dist50',NaN, ...
        'obj_dist90',NaN, ...
        'feasible_rate',NaN);
end

function T = emptyDetailTable()
    T = struct2table(repmat(emptyDetailRow(),0,1));
end

function T = vertcatDetailTables(DetailCells)
    nonempty = ~cellfun(@isempty,DetailCells);
    if ~any(nonempty)
        T = emptyDetailTable();
    else
        T = vertcat(DetailCells{nonempty});
    end
end

    Pool = gcp('nocreate');
    if isempty(Pool) || Pool.NumWorkers ~= workerCount
        if ~isempty(Pool)

====================================================================================================
FILE: Algorithms/Multi-objective optimization/CBS-CGAN/UpdateBoundaryMemory_CBS.m | bytes=14812
====================================================================================================
function [BMem,Diag] = UpdateBoundaryMemory_CBS(PrevBMem, ...
    Population1,Offspring1,Population2,Offspring2,W,Options)
%UPDATEBOUNDARYMEMORY_CBS Build the current feasible/infeasible boundary skeleton.

    Samples = [Population1,Offspring1,Population2,Offspring2];
    if isempty(Samples)
        BMem = stripTransientEndpointFields(emptyBMem(0,0,0));
        Diag = makeDiag(BMem);
        return;
    end

    X = Samples.decs;
    Y = Samples.objs;
    C = Samples.cons;
    D = size(X,2);
    M = size(Y,2);
    valid = all(isfinite(X),2) & all(isfinite(Y),2);
    X = X(valid,:);
    Y = Y(valid,:);
    C = C(valid,:);
    if isempty(Y)
        BMem = stripTransientEndpointFields(emptyBMem(0,D,M));
        Diag = makeDiag(BMem);
        return;
    end

    CV = sum(max(0,C),2);
    Feasible = CV <= 0;
    [Yn,ObjMin,ObjSpan] = normalizeRows(Y);
    Ref = assignReferences(Yn,W);

    Candidate = harvestBoundaryCandidates(X,Y,Yn,Feasible,Ref,W,Options, ...
        ObjMin,ObjSpan);
    if isempty(Candidate.y_b)
        BMem = stripTransientEndpointFields(emptyBMem(0,D,M));
        Diag = makeDiag(BMem);
        return;
    end

    Chain = buildBoundaryChains(Candidate,size(Yn,2),ObjMin,ObjSpan,W,Options);
    keep = Chain > 0;
    Candidate = subsetMemory(Candidate,keep);
    Candidate.chain = Chain(keep);
    Candidate = deduplicateRefChain(Candidate);
    Candidate = pruneJaggedBoundaryChains(Candidate,ObjMin,ObjSpan,W,Options);
    Candidate = dropDominatedBoundaryChains(Candidate);
    if isempty(Candidate.y_b)
        BMem = stripTransientEndpointFields(emptyBMem(0,D,M));
        Diag = makeDiag(BMem);
        return;
    end

    BMem = mergeCurrentMemory(PrevBMem,Candidate);
    BMem = dropDominatedBoundaryChains(BMem);
    BMem = stripTransientEndpointFields(BMem);
    Diag = makeDiag(BMem);
end

function Candidate = harvestBoundaryCandidates(X,Y,Yn,Feasible,Ref,W, ...
    Options,ObjMin,ObjSpan)
    D = size(X,2);
    M = size(Y,2);
    Candidate = emptyBMem(0,D,M);
    nRef = size(W,1);
    supportMode = boundarySupportPointMode(Options);
    for r = 1 : nRef
        neigh = neighborRefs(W,r,Options.pairNeighborRefRadius);
        fidx = find(Feasible & ismember(Ref,neigh));
        iidx = find(~Feasible & ismember(Ref,neigh));
        if isempty(fidx) || isempty(iidx)
            continue;
        end
        Dist = pairDistance(Yn(fidx,:),Yn(iidx,:));
        [gapSorted,order] = sort(Dist(:),'ascend');
        appended = 0;
        for t = 1 : numel(order)
            [fi,ii] = ind2sub(size(Dist),order(t));
            f = fidx(fi);
            i = iidx(ii);
            [yb,xb,xf] = boundarySupportPoint(X,Y,f,i,supportMode);
            supportRef = assignReferences( ...
                normalizeWithScale(yb,ObjMin,ObjSpan),W);
            if supportRef ~= r
                continue;
            end
            Candidate.ref(end+1,1) = r;
            Candidate.chain(end+1,1) = 0;
            Candidate.y_b(end+1,:) = yb;
            Candidate.gap(end+1,1) = gapSorted(t);
            Candidate.x_b(end+1,:) = xb;
            Candidate.x_f(end+1,:) = xf;
            appended = appended + 1;
            if appended >= Options.maxCandidatePairsPerRef
                break;
            end
        end
    end
end

function [yb,xb,xf] = boundarySupportPoint(X,Y,f,i,supportMode)
    xf = X(f,:);
    switch supportMode
        case 'feasible'
            yb = Y(f,:);
            xb = xf;
        case 'midpoint'
            yb = (Y(f,:) + Y(i,:))/2;
            xb = nan(1,size(X,2));
        otherwise
            error('CBSCGAN:UnknownSupportPointMode', ...
                'Unknown boundary support point mode: %s',supportMode);
    end
end

function mode = boundarySupportPointMode(Options)
    mode = 'midpoint';
    if isstruct(Options) && isfield(Options,'supportPointMode') && ...
            ~isempty(Options.supportPointMode)
        mode = lower(strrep(char(Options.supportPointMode),'-','_'));
    end
    if strcmp(mode,'feasible_endpoint') || strcmp(mode,'feasible_side')
        mode = 'feasible';
    end
end

function Chain = buildBoundaryChains(Candidate,objDim,ObjMin,ObjSpan,W,Options)
    N = size(Candidate.y_b,1);
    Chain = zeros(N,1);
    if N == 0
        return;
    end
    YbNorm = normalizeWithScale(Candidate.y_b,ObjMin,ObjSpan);
    continuity = boundaryContinuityRadius(Candidate.gap,objDim);

    Adj = false(N);
    for i = 1 : N-1
        for j = i+1 : N
            if Candidate.ref(i) == Candidate.ref(j)
                continue;
            end
            if adjacentRefs(W,Candidate.ref(i),Candidate.ref(j), ...
                    Options.pairNeighborRefRadius) && ...
                    norm(YbNorm(i,:) - YbNorm(j,:)) <= continuity
                Adj(i,j) = true;
                Adj(j,i) = true;
            end
        end
    end

    visited = false(N,1);
    chainId = 0;
    for i = 1 : N
        if visited(i)
            continue;
        end
        queue = i;
        comp = [];
        visited(i) = true;
        while ~isempty(queue)
            q = queue(1);
            queue(1) = [];
            comp(end+1) = q; %#ok<AGROW>
            next = find(Adj(q,:) & ~visited');
            visited(next) = true;
            queue = [queue,next]; %#ok<AGROW>
        end
        if numel(comp) >= Options.minChainLength
            chainId = chainId + 1;
            Chain(comp) = chainId;
        end
    end
end

function BMem = mergeCurrentMemory(PrevBMem,Current)
    if isempty(Current) || isempty(Current.y_b)
        BMem = Current;
        return;
    end
    if isempty(PrevBMem) || ~isfield(PrevBMem,'y_b') || isempty(PrevBMem.y_b)
        BMem = Current;
        return;
    end

    Prev = ensureMemoryFields(PrevBMem,size(Current.x_b,2),size(Current.y_b,2));
    [AllNorm,~,~] = normalizeRows([Current.y_b;Prev.y_b]);
    currNorm = AllNorm(1:size(Current.y_b,1),:);
    prevNorm = AllNorm(size(Current.y_b,1)+1:end,:);
    supportRadius = boundaryContinuityRadius( ...
        Current.gap,size(Current.y_b,2));

    keepPrev = false(size(Prev.y_b,1),1);
    mappedChain = Prev.chain;
    for i = 1 : size(Prev.y_b,1)
        sameRef = find(Current.ref == Prev.ref(i));
        if isempty(sameRef)
            continue;
        end
        d = sqrt(sum((currNorm(sameRef,:) - prevNorm(i,:)).^2,2));
        [best,bestIdx] = min(d);
        if best <= supportRadius
            keepPrev(i) = true;
            mappedChain(i) = Current.chain(sameRef(bestIdx));
        end
    end
    Prev = subsetMemory(Prev,keepPrev);
    Prev.chain = mappedChain(keepPrev);
    Prev.x_f = nan(size(Prev.x_b));

    BMem = concatMemory(Current,Prev);
    BMem = deduplicateRefChain(BMem);
end

function radius = boundaryContinuityRadius(Gap,objDim)
    Gap = Gap(isfinite(Gap) & Gap > 0);
    minRadius = 0.05*sqrt(objDim);
    maxRadius = 0.09*sqrt(objDim);
    if isempty(Gap)
        radius = minRadius;
    else
        radius = min(max(2.5*median(Gap),minRadius),maxRadius);
    end
end

function BMem = pruneJaggedBoundaryChains(BMem,ObjMin,ObjSpan,W,Options)
    if isempty(BMem) || isempty(BMem.y_b)
        return;
    end
    Y = normalizeWithScale(BMem.y_b,ObjMin,ObjSpan);
    objDim = size(Y,2);
    lateralTol = max(0.015*sqrt(objDim), ...
        0.35*boundaryContinuityRadius(BMem.gap,objDim));
    keep = true(size(BMem.ref));
    Chains = unique(BMem.chain(:)');
    for c = Chains
        idx = sortedBoundaryNodes(BMem,W,c);
        if numel(idx) < 3
            continue;
        end
        for p = 2 : numel(idx)-1
            d = pointSegmentDistanceOne(Y(idx(p),:), ...
                Y(idx(p-1),:),Y(idx(p+1),:));
            if d > lateralTol
                keep(idx(p)) = false;
            end
        end
    end
    BMem = subsetMemory(BMem,keep);
    Y = Y(keep,:);
    BMem = rebuildPrunedBoundaryChains(BMem,Y,W,Options);
end

function BMem = rebuildPrunedBoundaryChains(BMem,Y,W,Options)
    if isempty(BMem) || isempty(BMem.y_b)
        return;
    end
    keep = false(size(BMem.ref));
    newChain = zeros(size(BMem.chain));
    nextChain = 0;
    radius = boundaryContinuityRadius(BMem.gap,size(Y,2));
    Chains = unique(BMem.chain(:)');
    for c = Chains
        idx = sortedBoundaryNodes(BMem,W,c);
        comp = zeros(0,1);
        for p = 1 : numel(idx)
            if isempty(comp)
                comp = idx(p);
                continue;
            end
            prev = comp(end);
            connected = adjacentRefs(W,BMem.ref(prev),BMem.ref(idx(p)), ...
                Options.pairNeighborRefRadius) && ...
                norm(Y(prev,:) - Y(idx(p),:)) <= radius;
            if connected
                comp(end+1,1) = idx(p); %#ok<AGROW>
            else
                [keep,newChain,nextChain] = retainPrunedComponent( ...
                    keep,newChain,nextChain,comp,Options.minChainLength);
                comp = idx(p);
            end
        end
        [keep,newChain,nextChain] = retainPrunedComponent( ...
            keep,newChain,nextChain,comp,Options.minChainLength);
    end
    BMem = subsetMemory(BMem,keep);
    BMem.chain = newChain(keep);
end

function [keep,newChain,nextChain] = retainPrunedComponent( ...
    keep,newChain,nextChain,comp,minChainLength)
    if numel(comp) >= minChainLength
        nextChain = nextChain + 1;
        keep(comp) = true;
        newChain(comp) = nextChain;
    end
end

function BMem = dropDominatedBoundaryChains(BMem)
    if isempty(BMem) || isempty(BMem.y_b)
        return;
    end
    Chains = unique(BMem.chain(:)');
    if numel(Chains) <= 1
        return;
    end
    dropChain = false(size(Chains));
    for i = 1 : numel(Chains)
        refsI = refsInChain(BMem,Chains(i));
        gapsI = gapsByRefs(BMem,Chains(i),refsI);
        for j = 1 : numel(Chains)
            if i == j
                continue;
            end
            refsJ = refsInChain(BMem,Chains(j));
            if ~all(ismember(refsI,refsJ))
                continue;
            end
            gapsJ = gapsByRefs(BMem,Chains(j),refsI);
            if all(gapsJ <= gapsI + 1e-12) && any(gapsJ < gapsI - 1e-12)
                dropChain(i) = true;
                break;
            end
        end
    end
    if any(dropChain)
        keep = ~ismember(BMem.chain,Chains(dropChain));
        BMem = subsetMemory(BMem,keep);
    end
end

function refs = refsInChain(BMem,chainId)
    refs = unique(BMem.ref(BMem.chain == chainId));
    refs = refs(:)';
end

function gaps = gapsByRefs(BMem,chainId,refs)
    gaps = inf(size(refs));
    for i = 1 : numel(refs)
        idx = find(BMem.chain == chainId & BMem.ref == refs(i));
        if ~isempty(idx)
            gaps(i) = min(BMem.gap(idx));
        end
    end
end

function idx = sortedBoundaryNodes(BMem,W,chainId)
    idx = find(BMem.chain(:)' == chainId);
    if numel(idx) <= 1
        return;
    end
    RefPoint = W(BMem.ref(idx),:);
    [~,~,coeff] = svd(RefPoint - mean(RefPoint,1),'econ');
    if isempty(coeff)
        [~,ord] = sort(BMem.ref(idx));
    else
        score = RefPoint*coeff(:,1);
        [~,ord] = sortrows([score(:),BMem.ref(idx(:))]);
    end
    idx = idx(ord);
end

function d = pointSegmentDistanceOne(point,a,b)
    v = b - a;
    len2 = sum(v.^2);
    if len2 <= 1e-24
        proj = a;
    else
        t = sum((point - a).*v)./len2;
        proj = a + min(max(t,0),1).*v;
    end
    d = sqrt(sum((point - proj).^2));
end

function BMem = deduplicateRefChain(BMem)
    if isempty(BMem) || isempty(BMem.y_b)
        return;
    end
    keys = [BMem.ref(:),BMem.chain(:)];
    [~,~,ic] = unique(keys,'rows','stable');
    keep = false(size(BMem.ref));
    for i = 1 : max(ic)
        idx = find(ic == i);
        [~,best] = min(BMem.gap(idx));
        keep(idx(best)) = true;
    end
    BMem = subsetMemory(BMem,keep);
end

function Mem = concatMemory(A,B)
    if isempty(B) || isempty(B.y_b)
        Mem = A;
        return;
    end
    Mem = A;
    Mem.ref = [A.ref;B.ref];
    Mem.chain = [A.chain;B.chain];
    Mem.y_b = [A.y_b;B.y_b];
    Mem.gap = [A.gap;B.gap];
    Mem.x_b = [A.x_b;B.x_b];
    Mem.x_f = [A.x_f;B.x_f];
end

function BMem = subsetMemory(BMem,keep)
    keep = keep(:);
    BMem.ref = BMem.ref(keep,:);
    BMem.chain = BMem.chain(keep,:);
    BMem.y_b = BMem.y_b(keep,:);
    BMem.gap = BMem.gap(keep,:);
    BMem.x_b = BMem.x_b(keep,:);
    BMem.x_f = BMem.x_f(keep,:);
end

function BMem = ensureMemoryFields(BMem,D,M)
    if ~isfield(BMem,'ref'); BMem.ref = zeros(0,1); end
    if ~isfield(BMem,'chain'); BMem.chain = zeros(0,1); end
    if ~isfield(BMem,'y_b'); BMem.y_b = zeros(0,M); end
    if ~isfield(BMem,'gap'); BMem.gap = zeros(0,1); end
    if ~isfield(BMem,'x_b'); BMem.x_b = nan(size(BMem.y_b,1),D); end
    if ~isfield(BMem,'x_f'); BMem.x_f = nan(size(BMem.y_b,1),D); end
end

function BMem = emptyBMem(N,D,M)
    BMem = struct( ...
        'ref',zeros(N,1), ...
        'chain',zeros(N,1), ...
        'y_b',zeros(N,M), ...
        'gap',zeros(N,1), ...
        'x_b',nan(N,D), ...
        'x_f',nan(N,D));
end

function BMem = stripTransientEndpointFields(BMem)
    for field = {'x_f','x_i'}
        if isfield(BMem,field{1})
            BMem = rmfield(BMem,field{1});
        end
    end
end

function Diag = makeDiag(BMem)
    if isempty(BMem) || isempty(BMem.y_b)
        Diag = struct('bmem_count',0,'chain_count',0);
    else
        Diag = struct( ...
            'bmem_count',size(BMem.y_b,1), ...
            'chain_count',numel(unique(BMem.chain(:)')));
    end
end

function Ref = assignReferences(Yn,W)
    n = size(Yn,1);
    Wn = W./max(sqrt(sum(W.^2,2)),eps);
    NormY = sqrt(sum(Yn.^2,2));
    Yu = Yn./max(NormY,eps);
    Score = Yu*Wn';
    [~,Ref] = max(Score,[],2);
    zeroRows = NormY <= eps;
    if any(zeroRows)
        D = pairDistance(Yn(zeroRows,:),W);
        [~,Ref(zeroRows)] = min(D,[],2);
    end
    Ref = reshape(Ref,n,1);
end

function neigh = neighborRefs(W,r,radius)
    if radius <= 0
        neigh = r;
        return;
    end
    d = sqrt(sum((W - W(r,:)).^2,2));
    [~,ord] = sort(d,'ascend');
    count = min(numel(ord),1 + 2*radius);
    neigh = ord(1:count);
end

function yes = adjacentRefs(W,a,b,radius)
    neigh = neighborRefs(W,a,max(1,radius));
    yes = any(neigh == b);
end

function [Xn,MinV,SpanV] = normalizeRows(X)
    if isempty(X)
        MinV = zeros(1,0);
        SpanV = ones(1,0);
        Xn = X;
        return;
    end
    MinV = min(X,[],1);
    MaxV = max(X,[],1);
    SpanV = MaxV - MinV;
    SpanV(SpanV <= eps) = 1;
    Xn = (X - MinV)./SpanV;
    Xn(~isfinite(Xn)) = 0;
end

function Xn = normalizeWithScale(X,MinV,SpanV)
    Xn = (X - MinV)./SpanV;
    Xn(~isfinite(Xn)) = 0;
end

function D = pairDistance(A,B)
    D2 = max(sum(A.^2,2) + sum(B.^2,2)' - 2*(A*B'),0);
    D = sqrt(D2);
end

function test_CBS_CGAN_sample_info()
%TEST_CBS_CGAN_SAMPLE_INFO Verify query mapping for generated decisions.

    repoRoot = fileparts(fileparts(fileparts(fileparts(mfilename('fullpath')))));
    addpath(genpath(repoRoot));

    rng(11,'twister');
    Problem = DASCMOP1_BC('N',8,'D',6,'maxFE',100);
    TrainX = repmat(Problem.lower,4,1) + rand(4,Problem.D).* ...
        repmat(Problem.upper - Problem.lower,4,1);
    TrainC = [0.10 0.90;0.30 0.70;0.60 0.40;0.90 0.10];
    QueryC = [0.25 0.75;0.75 0.25];
    Options = struct( ...
        'zDim',2, ...
        'iter',1, ...
        'miniBatch',4, ...
        'lrD',1e-4, ...
        'lrG',2e-4, ...
        'dPretrainIter',0, ...
        'dSteps',1, ...
        'gSteps',1, ...
        'sigma',0.05, ...
        'reconstructionHuberDelta',0.10, ...
        'reconstructionWeight',100);

    GAN = BoundaryCGAN_CBS('train',[],TrainX,TrainC,Problem,Options);
    [RawDec,Info] = BoundaryCGAN_CBS('samplebycondition',GAN, ...
        QueryC,3,Options);

    assert(size(RawDec,1) == 6, ...
        'Expected three generated decisions per query condition.');
    assert(isfield(Info,'query_index'), ...
        'samplebycondition must return query_index for diagnostics.');
    assert(isequal(Info.query_index(:),[1;1;1;2;2;2]), ...
        'query_index must map generated rows back to QueryC rows.');
    assert(isfield(Info,'condition') && isequal(size(Info.condition),[6 2]), ...
        'samplebycondition must return the repeated generation conditions.');

    fprintf('CBS-CGAN sample info regression passed.\n');
end

function test_CBS_CGAN_smoke()
%TEST_CBS_CGAN_SMOKE Minimal executable check for the CBS-CGAN mainline.

    repoRoot = fileparts(fileparts(fileparts(fileparts(mfilename('fullpath')))));
    addpath(genpath(repoRoot));

    rng(7,'twister');
    Algorithm = CBS_CGAN('save',0,'outputFcn',@silentOutput, ...
        'parameter',{1,1,20,2,3,16,1e-4,2e-4,0,1,1,1,2,2,4,0.10,100});
    Problem = DASCMOP1_BC('N',20,'D',30,'maxFE',180);
    Algorithm.Solve(Problem);

    Diag = Algorithm.metric.cbs_cgan_last;
    required = {'bmem_count','chain_count','train_count','query_count', ...
        'raw_generated_count','feasible_generated_count', ...
        'segment_distance_min','segment_distance_mean','segment_distance_max', ...
        'train_dec_rmse','train_obj_dist50','train_feasible_rate', ...
        'query_obj_dist50','query_obj_dist90'};
    for i = 1 : numel(required)
        assert(isfield(Diag,required{i}), ...
            'CBS-CGAN smoke missing diagnostic field: %s',required{i});
    end
    assert(Problem.FE >= Problem.maxFE, ...
        'CBS-CGAN smoke should consume the requested short budget.');

    fprintf('CBS-CGAN smoke diagnostics:\n');
    fprintf('  BMem nodes: %d\n',Diag.bmem_count);
    fprintf('  chains: %d\n',Diag.chain_count);
    fprintf('  TrainX/TrainC: %d\n',Diag.train_count);
    fprintf('  QueryC: %d\n',Diag.query_count);
    fprintf('  raw generated: %d\n',Diag.raw_generated_count);
    fprintf('  feasible generated: %d\n',Diag.feasible_generated_count);
    fprintf('  generated-to-boundary distance min/mean/max: %.6g / %.6g / %.6g\n', ...
        Diag.segment_distance_min,Diag.segment_distance_mean, ...
        Diag.segment_distance_max);
end

function test_CBS_boundary_dataset_review()
%TEST_CBS_BOUNDARY_DATASET_REVIEW Regression tests for CBS-CGAN datasets.

    repoRoot = fileparts(fileparts(fileparts(fileparts(mfilename('fullpath')))));
    addpath(genpath(repoRoot));

    testTrainingSetUsesBoundaryMemoryDirectly();
    testDatasetUsesFixedConditionScale();
    fprintf('CBS boundary dataset review regressions passed.\n');

function testTrainingSetUsesBoundaryMemoryDirectly()
    rng(13,'twister');
    Problem = DASCMOP1_BC('N',8,'D',6,'maxFE',100);
    W = [0.80 0.20;0.70 0.30;0.30 0.70;0.20 0.80];
    BMem = struct( ...
        'ref',[1;2;3;4], ...
        'chain',[1;1;2;2], ...
        'y_b',[0.80 0.20;0.70 0.30;0.30 0.70;0.20 0.80], ...
        'gap',[0.90;0.80;0.10;0.10], ...
        'x_b',makeDecisionRows(Problem,4));
    Samples = SOLUTION(BMem.x_b,BMem.y_b,zeros(4,1));
    Options = struct( ...
        'pairNeighborRefRadius',1, ...
        'queryConditionBudget',1);

    [TrainX,TrainC,QueryC,~,Info] = BuildBoundaryDataset_CBS( ...
        BMem,Samples,W,Problem,Options);

    assert(size(QueryC,1) == 1, ...
        'The test setup should still schedule exactly one query condition.');
    assert(size(TrainX,1) == 4 && size(TrainC,1) == 4, ...
        ['Dataset construction must not thin the training set by query ', ...
        'support; BMem itself is responsible for being a thin skeleton.']);
    assert(isfield(Info,'trainObjs') && size(Info.trainObjs,1) == 4, ...
        'Dataset diagnostics should expose the direct BMem training set.');
end

function testDatasetUsesFixedConditionScale()
    rng(19,'twister');
    Problem = DASCMOP1_BC('N',8,'D',6,'maxFE',100);
    W = [0.80 0.20;0.20 0.80];
    BMem = struct( ...
        'ref',[1;2], ...
        'chain',[1;1], ...
        'y_b',[2.00 8.00;8.00 2.00], ...
        'gap',[0.10;0.20], ...
        'x_b',makeDecisionRows(Problem,2));
    Samples = SOLUTION(BMem.x_b,[100 900;900 100],zeros(2,1));
    Options = struct( ...
        'pairNeighborRefRadius',1, ...
        'queryConditionBudget',1, ...
        'conditionScale',struct('objMin',[0 0],'objSpan',[10 10]));

    [~,TrainC,QueryC,~,Info] = BuildBoundaryDataset_CBS( ...
        BMem,Samples,W,Problem,Options);

    assert(max(abs(TrainC - [0.20 0.80;0.80 0.20]),[],'all') <= 1e-12, ...
        'TrainC must use the fixed run-level condition scale.');
    assert(max(abs(QueryC - [0.50 0.50]),[],'all') <= 1e-12, ...
        'QueryC must use the same fixed run-level condition scale.');
    assert(max(abs(Info.objMin - [0 0]),[],'all') <= 1e-12 && ...
            max(abs(Info.objSpan - [10 10]),[],'all') <= 1e-12, ...
        'Dataset diagnostics must report the fixed condition scale.');
end

function X = makeDecisionRows(Problem,n)
    X = repmat(Problem.lower,n,1) + rand(n,Problem.D).* ...
        repmat(Problem.upper - Problem.lower,n,1);
end

function test_CBS_boundary_memory_review()
%TEST_CBS_BOUNDARY_MEMORY_REVIEW Regression tests for boundary skeleton bugs.

    repoRoot = fileparts(fileparts(fileparts(fileparts(mfilename('fullpath')))));
    addpath(genpath(repoRoot));

    testNoFakeChainFromNeighborOnlyPair();
    testContinuityUsesSampleObjectiveScale();
    testSeparatedAdjacentBoundaryPointsDoNotBecomeSkeleton();
    testJaggedInteriorBoundaryPointDoesNotBecomeSkeleton();
    testDominatedParallelChainDoesNotEnterSkeleton();
    testBoundaryMemoryDoesNotExposeTransientEndpoints();
    fprintf('CBS boundary memory review regressions passed.\n');
end

function testNoFakeChainFromNeighborOnlyPair()
    W = [0 1;0.5 0.5;1 0];
    Options = defaultOptions();

    Pop = makePopulation( ...
        [0.10 0.10;0.20 0.20], ...
        [0.00 1.00;0.02 1.02], ...
        [0;1]);
    Empty = Pop([]);

    [BMem,Diag] = UpdateBoundaryMemory_CBS([],Pop,Empty,Empty,Empty,W,Options);

    assert(isempty(BMem.y_b), ...
        ['A single directly supported reference must not become a ', ...
        'multi-reference chain through duplicated neighbor-only pairs.']);
    assert(Diag.bmem_count == 0 && Diag.chain_count == 0, ...
        'Neighbor-only duplicated pairs must not produce boundary memory.');
end

function testContinuityUsesSampleObjectiveScale()
    W = [0.49 0.51;0.51 0.49];
    Options = defaultOptions();

    Pop = makePopulation( ...
        [0.10 0.10;0.20 0.20;0.30 0.30;0.40 0.40;0.50 0.50;0.60 0.60], ...
        [0.00 0.00;100.00 100.00;49.90 52.00;50.10 52.00;51.90 50.00;52.10 50.00], ...
        [0;0;0;1;0;1]);
    Empty = Pop([]);

    [BMem,Diag] = UpdateBoundaryMemory_CBS([],Pop,Empty,Empty,Empty,W,Options);

    assert(Diag.bmem_count >= 2 && Diag.chain_count >= 1, ...
        ['Adjacent boundary points that are continuous in the all-sample ', ...
        'objective scale must form a current boundary chain.']);
    assert(numel(unique(BMem.ref)) >= 2, ...
        'The retained chain should contain directly supported adjacent references.');
end

function testSeparatedAdjacentBoundaryPointsDoNotBecomeSkeleton()
    W = [0.55 0.45;0.45 0.55];
    Options = defaultOptions();

    Pop = makePopulation( ...
        [0.10 0.10;0.20 0.20;0.30 0.30;0.40 0.40;0.50 0.50;0.60 0.60], ...
        [0.00 0.00;10.00 10.00;5.00 4.00;5.10 4.00;4.00 5.00;4.00 5.10], ...
        [0;0;0;1;0;1]);
    Empty = Pop([]);

    [BMem,Diag] = UpdateBoundaryMemory_CBS([],Pop,Empty,Empty,Empty,W,Options);

    assert(isempty(BMem.y_b), ...
        ['Adjacent references with a large lateral objective gap must not ', ...
        'be connected into a thick boundary skeleton.']);
    assert(Diag.bmem_count == 0 && Diag.chain_count == 0, ...
        'Over-wide adjacent boundary points must be rejected as a chain.');
end

function testJaggedInteriorBoundaryPointDoesNotBecomeSkeleton()
    W = [0.54 0.46;0.50 0.50;0.46 0.54];
    Options = defaultOptions();

    Pop = makePopulation( ...
        [0.10 0.10;0.20 0.20;0.30 0.30;0.40 0.40; ...
         0.50 0.50;0.60 0.60;0.70 0.70;0.80 0.80], ...
        [0.00 0.00;10.00 10.00; ...
         5.39 4.60;5.41 4.60; ...
         5.20 5.19;5.20 5.21; ...
         4.60 5.39;4.60 5.41], ...
        [0;0;0;1;0;1;0;1]);
    Empty = Pop([]);

    [BMem,Diag] = UpdateBoundaryMemory_CBS([],Pop,Empty,Empty,Empty,W,Options);

    assert(isempty(BMem.y_b), ...
        ['A jagged interior boundary point must not turn nearby reference ', ...
        'buckets into a thick point-cloud skeleton.']);
    assert(Diag.bmem_count == 0 && Diag.chain_count == 0, ...
        'Boundary chains must require local backbone consistency.');
end

function testDominatedParallelChainDoesNotEnterSkeleton()
    W = [0.54 0.46;0.50 0.50;0.46 0.54];
    Options = struct( ...
        'pairNeighborRefRadius',1, ...
        'maxCandidatePairsPerRef',2, ...
        'minChainLength',2);

    [Dec,Obj,Con] = makeParallelChainSamples();
    Pop = makePopulation(Dec,Obj,Con);
    Empty = Pop([]);

    [BMem,Diag] = UpdateBoundaryMemory_CBS([],Pop,Empty,Empty,Empty,W,Options);

    assert(Diag.bmem_count == 3 && Diag.chain_count == 1, ...
        ['A chain that covers no additional references and has worse ', ...
        'current F/I gaps must not enter the boundary skeleton.']);
    assert(numel(unique(BMem.ref)) == 3, ...
        'Removing a dominated chain must preserve reference coverage.');
end

function [Dec,Obj,Con] = makeParallelChainSamples()
    Obj = [0.00 0.00;1.00 1.00];
    Con = [0;0];
    Dec = [0.00 0.00;0.01 0.01];
    thin = [0.54 0.46;0.50 0.50;0.46 0.54];
    thick = [0.66 0.58;0.62 0.62;0.58 0.66];
    for i = 1 : size(thin,1)
        [Obj,Con,Dec] = appendPair(Obj,Con,Dec,thin(i,:),0.002);
        [Obj,Con,Dec] = appendPair(Obj,Con,Dec,thick(i,:),0.003);
    end
end

function [Obj,Con,Dec] = appendPair(Obj,Con,Dec,center,epsVal)
    delta = epsVal*[1 -1];
    Obj = [Obj;center - delta;center + delta]; %#ok<AGROW>
    Con = [Con;0;1]; %#ok<AGROW>
    n = size(Dec,1);
    Dec = [Dec;0.10 + 0.01*n,0.20 + 0.01*n; ...
        0.11 + 0.01*n,0.21 + 0.01*n]; %#ok<AGROW>
end

function testBoundaryMemoryDoesNotExposeTransientEndpoints()
    W = [0.49 0.51;0.51 0.49];
    Options = defaultOptions();

    Pop = makePopulation( ...
        [0.10 0.10;0.20 0.20;0.30 0.30;0.40 0.40;0.50 0.50;0.60 0.60], ...
        [0.00 0.00;100.00 100.00;49.90 52.00;50.10 52.00;51.90 50.00;52.10 50.00], ...
        [0;0;0;1;0;1]);
    Empty = Pop([]);

    [BMem,~] = UpdateBoundaryMemory_CBS([],Pop,Empty,Empty,Empty,W,Options);

    assert(~isfield(BMem,'x_f') && ~isfield(BMem,'x_i'), ...
        'Boundary memory must not expose transient feasible/infeasible endpoints.');
    assert(isequal(sort(fieldnames(BMem)), ...
        sort({'ref';'chain';'y_b';'gap';'x_b'})), ...
        'Boundary memory should only contain ref, chain, y_b, gap, and x_b.');
end

function Options = defaultOptions()
    Options = struct( ...
        'pairNeighborRefRadius',1, ...
        'maxCandidatePairsPerRef',1, ...
        'minChainLength',2);
end

function Pop = makePopulation(Dec,Obj,Con)
    Pop = SOLUTION(Dec,Obj,Con);
end

function test_CBS_feasible_support_branch_review()

function testBoundaryMemoryUsesFeasibleEndpointSupport()
    W = [0.51 0.49;0.49 0.51];
    Options = struct( ...
        'pairNeighborRefRadius',1, ...
        'maxCandidatePairsPerRef',1, ...
        'minChainLength',2, ...
        'supportPointMode','feasible');

    feasibleDec = [0.30 0.40;0.50 0.60];
    feasibleObj = [5.08 4.92;4.92 5.08];
    Pop = makePopulation( ...
        [0.00 0.00;0.10 0.10; ...
         feasibleDec(1,:);0.31 0.41; ...
         feasibleDec(2,:);0.51 0.61], ...
        [0.00 0.00;10.00 10.00; ...
         feasibleObj(1,:);5.10 4.92; ...
         feasibleObj(2,:);4.92 5.10], ...
        [0;0;0;1;0;1]);
    Empty = Pop([]);

    [BMem,Diag] = UpdateBoundaryMemory_CBS([],Pop,Empty,Empty,Empty,W,Options);

    assert(Diag.bmem_count == 2 && Diag.chain_count == 1, ...
        'Feasible-side support points should form the current boundary chain.');
    [~,ord] = sort(BMem.ref);
    assert(max(abs(BMem.y_b(ord,:) - feasibleObj),[],'all') <= 1e-12, ...
        'BMem.y_b must be the feasible endpoint objective, not the F/I midpoint.');
    assert(max(abs(BMem.x_b(ord,:) - feasibleDec),[],'all') <= 1e-12, ...
        'BMem.x_b must be the decision vector of the same feasible endpoint.');
    assert(isequal(sort(fieldnames(BMem)), ...
        sort({'ref';'chain';'y_b';'gap';'x_b'})), ...
        'Feasible-side BMem should expose only ref, chain, y_b, gap, and x_b.');
end

function testDatasetTrustsFeasibleSupportMemoryTargets()
    rng(17,'twister');
    Problem = DASCMOP1_BC('N',8,'D',6,'maxFE',100);
    W = [0.51 0.49;0.49 0.51];
    supportX = makeDecisionRows(Problem,2);
    otherX = makeDecisionRows(Problem,2);
    supportY = [5.08 4.92;4.92 5.08];
    BMem = struct( ...
        'ref',[1;2], ...
        'chain',[1;1], ...
        'y_b',supportY, ...
        'gap',[0.01;0.01], ...
        'x_b',supportX);
    Samples = SOLUTION(otherX,supportY,zeros(2,1));
    Options = struct( ...
        'pairNeighborRefRadius',1, ...
        'queryConditionBudget',1, ...
        'supportPointMode','feasible');

    [TrainX,~,~,~,Info] = BuildBoundaryDataset_CBS( ...
        BMem,Samples,W,Problem,Options);

    assert(max(abs(TrainX - supportX),[],'all') <= 1e-12, ...
        'Feasible-side dataset construction must not reselect x_b targets.');
    assert(max(abs(Info.trainObjs - supportY),[],'all') <= 1e-12, ...
        'Feasible-side training diagnostics must expose feasible support objectives.');
end

function X = makeDecisionRows(Problem,n)
    X = repmat(Problem.lower,n,1) + rand(n,Problem.D).* ...
        repmat(Problem.upper - Problem.lower,n,1);
end

function Pop = makePopulation(Dec,Obj,Con)
    Pop = SOLUTION(Dec,Obj,Con);
end

function [keep,spread,k] = BoundaryConditionKNNKeepMask_BDG( ...
        X,C,conditionKNNK,retainRatio,minCount,lower,upper)
%BoundaryConditionKNNKeepMask_BDG Keep low-spread target triples by condition kNN.

    n = size(X,1);
    keep = true(n,1);
    spread = nan(n,1);
    k = min(max(1,round(double(conditionKNNK))),max(0,n-1));
    minCount = max(2,round(double(minCount)));
    retainRatio = min(max(double(retainRatio),0),1);
    if n <= minCount || isempty(C) || k <= 0
        return;
    end
    C = double(C);
    Xn = NormalizeDecision_BDG(double(X),lower,upper);
    dCond = pdist2(C,C);
    dCond(1:n+1:end) = Inf;
    for i = 1 : n
        [~,ord] = sort(dCond(i,:),'ascend');
        ord = ord(1:min(k,numel(ord)));
        d = sqrt(sum((Xn(ord,:) - Xn(i,:)).^2,2));
        spread(i) = MeanFinite_BDG(d);
    end
    if ~any(isfinite(spread))
        return;
    end
    nKeep = max(minCount,ceil(retainRatio * n));
    nKeep = min(n,max(2,nKeep));
    [~,ord] = sort(spread,'ascend','MissingPlacement','last');
    keep = false(n,1);
    keep(ord(1:nKeep)) = true;
end

function Xn = NormalizeDecision_BDG(X,lower,upper)
    D = size(X,2);
    if nargin < 2 || isempty(lower) || numel(lower) ~= D
        lower = zeros(1,D);
    end
    if nargin < 3 || isempty(upper) || numel(upper) ~= D
        upper = ones(1,D);
    end
    lower = double(lower(:)');
    upper = double(upper(:)');
    Xn = (double(X) - lower) ./ (upper - lower + 1e-12);
    Xn = min(max(Xn,0),1);
end

function value = MeanFinite_BDG(x)
    x = double(x(:));
    x = x(isfinite(x));
    if isempty(x)
        value = NaN;
    else
        value = mean(x);
    end
end

====================================================================================================
