function [XBoundary,ConditionData,Diag] = BuildBoundaryTargetTriples_BDG( ...
        AF,AI,Problem,W,Options)
%BuildBoundaryTargetTriples_BDG Build target triples for boundary GAN.
%   Default endpoint mode preserves the original contract:
%   x_b is AFDec and condition is [AFNorm, AI-AF direction, optional ref].
%   fix.md modes add a scalar t and replace the endpoint target only when
%   explicitly requested by Options.targetMode.

    if nargin < 4
        W = [];
    end
    if nargin < 5 || isempty(Options)
        Options = struct();
    end

    D = ProblemDimension_BDG(Problem,AF);
    M = ProblemObjectiveCount_BDG(Problem,AF,AI);
    Options = NormalizeTargetTripleOptions_BDG(Options);
    refDim = TargetRefTokenDim_BDG(W,M,Options.conditionMode);
    hasT = ConditionHasT_BDG(Options.conditionMode);
    XBoundary = zeros(0,D);
    ConditionData = zeros(0,2*M + double(hasT) + refDim,'single');
    Diag = EmptyTargetTripleDiag_BDG(M,refDim,Options.conditionMode, ...
        Options.targetMode);

    [AFDec,AFObj] = ArchiveMatrices_BDG(AF,D,M);
    [AIDec,AIObj] = ArchiveMatrices_BDG(AI,D,M);
    nPair = min([size(AFDec,1),size(AIDec,1),size(AFObj,1),size(AIObj,1)]);
    Diag.target_pair_count = double(nPair);
    Diag.target_condition_dim = double(2*M + double(hasT) + refDim);
    if nPair < 2 || D <= 0 || M <= 0
        return;
    end

    AFDec = AFDec(1:nPair,:);
    AIDec = AIDec(1:nPair,:);
    AFObj = AFObj(1:nPair,:);
    AIObj = AIObj(1:nPair,:);
    finiteRows = all(isfinite(AFDec),2) & all(isfinite(AIDec),2) & ...
        all(isfinite(AFObj),2) & all(isfinite(AIObj),2);
    if ~any(finiteRows)
        return;
    end
    AFDec = AFDec(finiteRows,:);
    AIDec = AIDec(finiteRows,:);
    AFObj = AFObj(finiteRows,:);
    AIObj = AIObj(finiteRows,:);
    keepIndex = find(finiteRows);

    [AFNorm,AINorm,zmin,zmax] = NormalizePairedObjectives_BDG(AFObj,AIObj,M);
    Direction = AINorm - AFNorm;
    finiteTargets = all(isfinite(AFNorm),2) & all(isfinite(Direction),2);
    if ~any(finiteTargets) || sum(finiteTargets) < 2
        return;
    end

    AFDec = AFDec(finiteTargets,:);
    AIDec = AIDec(finiteTargets,:);
    AFNorm = AFNorm(finiteTargets,:);
    Direction = Direction(finiteTargets,:);
    keepIndex = keepIndex(finiteTargets);
    RefToken = TargetRefToken_BDG(AF,keepIndex,W,refDim);

    switch Options.targetMode
        case "endpoint"
            pairRows = (1:size(AFDec,1))';
            t = zeros(size(pairRows));
            XBoundary = AFDec;
            fallback = false(size(pairRows));
            nearSourceCount = 0;
            nearCandidateCount = 0;
            nearKeepCount = 0;
        case "decision_interp"
            [XBoundary,pairRows,t] = DecisionInterpolationTargets_BDG( ...
                AFDec,AIDec,Options.decisionInterpCount);
            fallback = false(size(pairRows));
            nearSourceCount = 0;
            nearCandidateCount = 0;
            nearKeepCount = 0;
        case "near_segment_feasible"
            [XBoundary,pairRows,t,fallback,nearSourceCount, ...
                nearCandidateCount,nearKeepCount] = ...
                NearSegmentFeasibleTargets_BDG(AFDec,AFNorm,Direction, ...
                Options,zmin,zmax,D,M);
        otherwise
            error('BuildBoundaryTargetTriples_BDG:BadTargetMode', ...
                'Unsupported targetMode: %s.',Options.targetMode);
    end

    if isempty(XBoundary) || numel(pairRows) < 2
        return;
    end
    ConditionData = ComposeConditionData_BDG(AFNorm,Direction,RefToken, ...
        pairRows,t,hasT,refDim);
    targetKeepIndex = keepIndex(pairRows);
    [XBoundary,ConditionData,pairRows,t,fallback,targetKeepIndex, ...
        FusedDiag] = ApplyFusedTargetFilter_BDG( ...
        XBoundary,ConditionData,pairRows,t,fallback,targetKeepIndex, ...
        AF,W,Options);
    if isempty(XBoundary) || numel(pairRows) < 2
        return;
    end
    Diag.target_keep_index = targetKeepIndex;
    Diag.target_triple_count = double(size(XBoundary,1));
    Diag.target_condition_dim = double(size(ConditionData,2));
    Diag.target_triple_ready = double(size(XBoundary,1) >= 2);
    Diag.target_y_min = min(AFNorm(pairRows,:),[],1);
    Diag.target_y_max = max(AFNorm(pairRows,:),[],1);
    dirNorm = sqrt(sum(Direction(pairRows,:).^2,2));
    Diag.target_direction_norm_mean = MeanFinite_BDG(dirNorm);
    Diag.target_t_min = MinFinite_BDG(t);
    Diag.target_t_max = MaxFinite_BDG(t);
    Diag.target_t_mean = MeanFinite_BDG(t);
    Diag.target_fallback_count = double(sum(fallback));
    Diag.target_near_segment_source_count = double(nearSourceCount);
    Diag.target_near_segment_candidate_count = double(nearCandidateCount);
    if Options.targetMode == "near_segment_feasible"
        Diag.target_near_segment_keep_count = double(sum(~fallback(:)));
    else
        Diag.target_near_segment_keep_count = double(nearKeepCount);
    end
    Diag = MergeStructFields_BDG(Diag,FusedDiag);
end

function Options = NormalizeTargetTripleOptions_BDG(Options)
    if ~isstruct(Options)
        Options = struct();
    end
    if ~isfield(Options,'conditionMode') || isempty(Options.conditionMode)
        Options.conditionMode = "yt_dt";
    end
    if ~isfield(Options,'targetMode') || isempty(Options.targetMode)
        Options.targetMode = "endpoint";
    end
    if ~isfield(Options,'nearSegmentSource')
        Options.nearSegmentSource = [];
    end
    if ~isfield(Options,'nearSegmentTau') || isempty(Options.nearSegmentTau)
        Options.nearSegmentTau = 0.20;
    end
    if ~isfield(Options,'nearSegmentMaxPerPair') || ...
            isempty(Options.nearSegmentMaxPerPair)
        Options.nearSegmentMaxPerPair = 5;
    end
    if ~isfield(Options,'decisionInterpCount') || ...
            isempty(Options.decisionInterpCount)
        Options.decisionInterpCount = 5;
    end
    if ~isfield(Options,'targetFusionMode') || isempty(Options.targetFusionMode)
        Options.targetFusionMode = "none";
    end
    if ~isfield(Options,'conditionKNNK') || isempty(Options.conditionKNNK)
        Options.conditionKNNK = 5;
    end
    if ~isfield(Options,'conditionKNNRetainRatio') || ...
            isempty(Options.conditionKNNRetainRatio)
        Options.conditionKNNRetainRatio = 0.70;
    end
    if ~isfield(Options,'conditionKNNMinCount') || ...
            isempty(Options.conditionKNNMinCount)
        Options.conditionKNNMinCount = 2;
    end
    if ~isfield(Options,'lower')
        Options.lower = [];
    end
    if ~isfield(Options,'upper')
        Options.upper = [];
    end
    Options.conditionMode = NormalizeConditionMode_BDG( ...
        Options.conditionMode);
    Options.targetMode = NormalizeTargetMode_BDG(Options.targetMode);
    Options.targetFusionMode = NormalizeTargetFusionMode_BDG( ...
        Options.targetFusionMode);
    Options.nearSegmentTau = max(0,double(Options.nearSegmentTau));
    Options.nearSegmentMaxPerPair = max(1,round(double( ...
        Options.nearSegmentMaxPerPair)));
    Options.decisionInterpCount = max(2,round(double( ...
        Options.decisionInterpCount)));
    Options.conditionKNNK = max(1,round(double(Options.conditionKNNK)));
    Options.conditionKNNRetainRatio = min(max( ...
        double(Options.conditionKNNRetainRatio),0),1);
    Options.conditionKNNMinCount = max(2,round(double( ...
        Options.conditionKNNMinCount)));
end

function mode = NormalizeConditionMode_BDG(mode)
    mode = lower(strtrim(string(mode)));
    valid = ["yt_dt","yt_dt_ref","yt_dt_t","yt_dt_t_ref"];
    assert(ismember(mode,valid), ...
        'BuildBoundaryTargetTriples_BDG:BadConditionMode', ...
        'conditionMode must be one of: %s.',strjoin(valid,", "));
end

function mode = NormalizeTargetMode_BDG(mode)
    mode = lower(strtrim(string(mode)));
    valid = ["endpoint","near_segment_feasible","decision_interp"];
    assert(ismember(mode,valid), ...
        'BuildBoundaryTargetTriples_BDG:BadTargetMode', ...
        'targetMode must be one of: %s.',strjoin(valid,", "));
end

function mode = NormalizeTargetFusionMode_BDG(mode)
    mode = lower(strtrim(string(mode)));
    valid = ["none","condition_knn"];
    assert(ismember(mode,valid), ...
        'BuildBoundaryTargetTriples_BDG:BadTargetFusionMode', ...
        'targetFusionMode must be one of: %s.',strjoin(valid,", "));
end

function tf = ConditionHasT_BDG(mode)
    mode = NormalizeConditionMode_BDG(mode);
    tf = mode == "yt_dt_t" || mode == "yt_dt_t_ref";
end

function code = TargetModeCode_BDG(mode)
    mode = NormalizeTargetMode_BDG(mode);
    names = ["endpoint","near_segment_feasible","decision_interp"];
    code = find(names == mode,1,'first') - 1;
end

function dim = TargetRefTokenDim_BDG(W,M,mode)
    mode = NormalizeConditionMode_BDG(mode);
    if mode ~= "yt_dt_ref" && mode ~= "yt_dt_t_ref"
        dim = 0;
        return;
    end
    if ~isempty(W) && isnumeric(W)
        dim = size(W,2);
    else
        dim = M;
    end
    dim = max(0,round(double(dim)));
end

function C = ComposeConditionData_BDG(AFNorm,Direction,RefToken, ...
        pairRows,t,hasT,refDim)
    parts = {AFNorm(pairRows,:),Direction(pairRows,:)};
    if hasT
        parts{end+1} = t(:);
    end
    if refDim > 0
        parts{end+1} = RefToken(pairRows,:);
    end
    C = single([parts{:}]);
end

function RefToken = TargetRefToken_BDG(AF,idx,W,refDim)
    RefToken = zeros(numel(idx),refDim);
    if refDim <= 0 || isempty(idx) || isempty(W) || ...
            ~isstruct(AF) || ~isfield(AF,'ref') || isempty(AF.ref)
        return;
    end
    refs = double(AF.ref(:));
    for i = 1 : numel(idx)
        p = idx(i);
        if p < 1 || p > numel(refs)
            continue;
        end
        r = round(refs(p));
        if ~isfinite(r) || r < 1 || r > size(W,1)
            continue;
        end
        cols = min(refDim,size(W,2));
        RefToken(i,1:cols) = double(W(r,1:cols));
    end
end

function [X,C,pairRows,t,fallback,targetKeepIndex,Diag] = ...
        ApplyFusedTargetFilter_BDG(X,C,pairRows,t,fallback, ...
        targetKeepIndex,AF,W,Options)
    Diag = EmptyFusedTargetFilterDiag_BDG();
    nPre = size(X,1);
    if Options.targetFusionMode == "none"
        return;
    end

    [preRefCount,preRefCov] = TargetRefCoverage_BDG(AF,targetKeepIndex,W);
    switch Options.targetFusionMode
        case "condition_knn"
            [keep,spread,k] = BoundaryConditionKNNKeepMask_BDG( ...
                X,C,Options.conditionKNNK, ...
                Options.conditionKNNRetainRatio, ...
                Options.conditionKNNMinCount,Options.lower,Options.upper);
            Diag.target_filter_mode_code = 5;
            Diag.condition_knn_k = double(k);
            Diag.condition_knn_decision_spread_mean = MeanFinite_BDG(spread);
            Diag.condition_knn_decision_spread_median = ...
                MedianFinite_BDG(spread);
            Diag.condition_knn_decision_spread_p90 = ...
                PercentileFinite_BDG(spread,90);
        otherwise
            keep = true(nPre,1);
    end

    keep = logical(keep(:));
    X = X(keep,:);
    C = C(keep,:);
    pairRows = pairRows(keep);
    t = t(keep);
    fallback = fallback(keep);
    targetKeepIndex = targetKeepIndex(keep);
    nPost = size(X,1);
    [postRefCount,postRefCov] = TargetRefCoverage_BDG(AF,targetKeepIndex,W);

    Diag.target_filter_pre_count = double(nPre);
    Diag.target_filter_post_count = double(nPost);
    Diag.target_filter_retain_ratio = SafeRatio_BDG(nPost,nPre);
    Diag.target_filter_pre_ref_count = double(preRefCount);
    Diag.target_filter_pre_ref_cov = double(preRefCov);
    Diag.target_filter_post_ref_count = double(postRefCount);
    Diag.target_filter_post_ref_cov = double(postRefCov);
end

function Diag = EmptyFusedTargetFilterDiag_BDG()
    Diag = struct();
end

function [count,cov] = TargetRefCoverage_BDG(AF,targetKeepIndex,W)
    refs = zeros(0,1);
    if isstruct(AF) && isfield(AF,'ref') && ~isempty(AF.ref) && ...
            ~isempty(targetKeepIndex)
        allRefs = double(AF.ref(:));
        idx = round(double(targetKeepIndex(:)));
        valid = idx >= 1 & idx <= numel(allRefs);
        refs = allRefs(idx(valid));
    end
    refs = refs(isfinite(refs) & refs > 0);
    count = numel(unique(round(refs)));
    if isempty(W)
        cov = double(count > 0);
    else
        cov = double(count) / max(1,size(W,1));
    end
end

function S = MergeStructFields_BDG(S,Extra)
    if ~isstruct(Extra)
        return;
    end
    names = fieldnames(Extra);
    for i = 1 : numel(names)
        S.(names{i}) = Extra.(names{i});
    end
end

function [X,pairRows,t] = DecisionInterpolationTargets_BDG(AFDec,AIDec,count)
    nPair = size(AFDec,1);
    tGrid = linspace(0,1,count)';
    X = zeros(nPair*numel(tGrid),size(AFDec,2));
    pairRows = zeros(nPair*numel(tGrid),1);
    t = zeros(nPair*numel(tGrid),1);
    row = 0;
    for i = 1 : nPair
        for j = 1 : numel(tGrid)
            row = row + 1;
            pairRows(row) = i;
            t(row) = tGrid(j);
            X(row,:) = AFDec(i,:) + t(row) .* (AIDec(i,:) - AFDec(i,:));
        end
    end
end

function [X,pairRows,t,fallback,sourceCount,candidateCount,keepCount] = ...
        NearSegmentFeasibleTargets_BDG(AFDec,AFNorm,Direction,Options, ...
        zmin,zmax,D,M)
    [SourceDec,SourceObj] = FeasibleSourceMatrices_BDG( ...
        Options.nearSegmentSource,D,M);
    nPair = size(AFDec,1);
    maxPerPair = Options.nearSegmentMaxPerPair;
    tau = Options.nearSegmentTau;
    candidateCount = 0;
    keepCount = 0;

    if ~isempty(SourceDec)
        SourceNorm = NormalizeObjMatNoClip_BDG(SourceObj,zmin,zmax);
        finiteSource = all(isfinite(SourceNorm),2);
        SourceDec = SourceDec(finiteSource,:);
        SourceNorm = SourceNorm(finiteSource,:);
    else
        SourceNorm = zeros(0,M);
    end
    sourceCount = size(SourceDec,1);

    if sourceCount <= 0
        row = nPair;
        X = zeros(row,D);
        pairRows = zeros(row,1);
        t = zeros(row,1);
        fallback = false(row,1);
        X(1:row,:) = AFDec;
        pairRows(1:row) = (1:nPair)';
        t(1:row) = 0;
        fallback(1:row) = true;
    else
        candidateCount = double(nPair) * double(sourceCount);
        if candidateCount < NearSegmentBBoxThreshold_BDG()
            [X,pairRows,t,fallback,keepCount] = ...
                NearSegmentFullScanTargets_BDG(AFDec,AFNorm,Direction, ...
                SourceDec,SourceNorm,maxPerPair,tau,D);
        else
            [X,pairRows,t,fallback,keepCount] = ...
                NearSegmentBBoxTargets_BDG(AFNorm,Direction,SourceDec, ...
                SourceNorm,maxPerPair,tau,D,nPair);
        end
    end
end

function threshold = NearSegmentBBoxThreshold_BDG()
    threshold = 1e6;
end

function [X,pairRows,t,fallback,keepCount] = ...
        NearSegmentFullScanTargets_BDG(AFDec,AFNorm,Direction,SourceDec, ...
        SourceNorm,maxPerPair,tau,D)
    nPair = size(AFDec,1);
    X = zeros(0,D);
    pairRows = zeros(0,1);
    t = zeros(0,1);
    fallback = false(0,1);
    keepCount = 0;
    for i = 1 : nPair
        a = AFNorm(i,:);
        b = a + Direction(i,:);
        [dist,projT] = PointToSegmentDistances_BDG(SourceNorm,a,b);
        valid = isfinite(dist) & isfinite(projT);
        chosen = [];
        chosenT = [];
        if any(valid)
            idx = find(valid & dist <= tau);
            if isempty(idx)
                [~,ord] = sort(dist(valid),'ascend');
                validIdx = find(valid);
                idx = validIdx(ord(1:min(maxPerPair,numel(ord))));
            else
                [~,ord] = sort(dist(idx),'ascend');
                idx = idx(ord(1:min(maxPerPair,numel(ord))));
            end
            chosen = SourceDec(idx,:);
            chosenT = min(max(projT(idx),0),1);
        end
        if isempty(chosen)
            chosen = AFDec(i,:);
            chosenT = 0;
            fb = true;
        else
            fb = false(size(chosenT));
        end
        rowN = size(chosen,1);
        X = [X;chosen]; %#ok<AGROW>
        pairRows = [pairRows;repmat(i,rowN,1)]; %#ok<AGROW>
        t = [t;chosenT(:)]; %#ok<AGROW>
        fallback = [fallback;fb(:)]; %#ok<AGROW>
        keepCount = keepCount + rowN - sum(fb(:));
    end
end

function [X,pairRows,t,fallback,keepCount] = ...
        NearSegmentBBoxTargets_BDG(AFNorm,Direction,SourceDec,SourceNorm, ...
        maxPerPair,tau,D,nPair)
    rowCap = max(1,nPair * maxPerPair);
    X = zeros(rowCap,D);
    pairRows = zeros(rowCap,1);
    t = zeros(rowCap,1);
    fallback = false(rowCap,1);
    row = 0;
    keepCount = 0;
    tau2 = tau .* tau;
    for i = 1 : nPair
        a = AFNorm(i,:);
        v = Direction(i,:);
        b = a + v;
        lo = min(a,b) - tau;
        hi = max(a,b) + tau;
        box = all(SourceNorm >= lo & SourceNorm <= hi,2);
        idx = [];
        chosenT = [];
        if any(box)
            boxIdx = find(box);
            [boxDist2,boxT] = PointToSegmentDistancesSquared_BDG( ...
                SourceNorm(boxIdx,:),a,v);
            nearRows = find(boxDist2 <= tau2);
            if ~isempty(nearRows)
                nearOrd = SmallestKRows_BDG(boxDist2(nearRows), ...
                    maxPerPair);
                localRows = nearRows(nearOrd);
                idx = boxIdx(localRows);
                chosenT = boxT(localRows);
            end
        end
        if isempty(idx)
            [dist2,projT] = PointToSegmentDistancesSquared_BDG( ...
                SourceNorm,a,v);
            idx = SmallestKRows_BDG(dist2,maxPerPair);
            chosenT = projT(idx);
        end
        rowN = numel(idx);
        rows = row + (1:rowN);
        X(rows,:) = SourceDec(idx,:);
        pairRows(rows) = i;
        t(rows) = min(max(chosenT,0),1);
        fallback(rows) = false;
        row = row + rowN;
        keepCount = keepCount + rowN;
    end
    X = X(1:row,:);
    pairRows = pairRows(1:row);
    t = t(1:row);
    fallback = fallback(1:row);
end

function [dist,t] = PointToSegmentDistances_BDG(X,a,b)
    v = b - a;
    len2 = sum(v.^2);
    if len2 <= 1e-24
        t = zeros(size(X,1),1);
        proj = repmat(a,size(X,1),1);
    else
        t = sum((X - a).*v,2) ./ len2;
        proj = a + min(max(t,0),1).*v;
    end
    dist = sqrt(sum((X - proj).^2,2));
end

function [dist2,t] = PointToSegmentDistancesSquared_BDG(X,a,v)
    len2 = sum(v.^2);
    if len2 <= 1e-24
        t = zeros(size(X,1),1);
        proj = a;
    else
        t = sum((X - a).*v,2) ./ len2;
        proj = a + min(max(t,0),1).*v;
    end
    dist2 = sum((X - proj).^2,2);
end

function [Dec,Obj] = FeasibleSourceMatrices_BDG(Source,D,M)
    Dec = zeros(0,D);
    Obj = zeros(0,M);
    if ~isstruct(Source) || ~isfield(Source,'decs') || ...
            ~isfield(Source,'objs') || isempty(Source.decs) || ...
            isempty(Source.objs)
        return;
    end
    decs = double(Source.decs);
    objs = double(Source.objs);
    if size(decs,2) ~= D
        return;
    end
    if size(objs,2) > M
        objs = objs(:,1:M);
    elseif size(objs,2) < M
        objs = [objs,nan(size(objs,1),M-size(objs,2))];
    end
    n = min(size(decs,1),size(objs,1));
    decs = decs(1:n,:);
    objs = objs(1:n,:);
    feasible = true(n,1);
    if isfield(Source,'cons') && ~isempty(Source.cons)
        cons = double(Source.cons);
        cons = cons(1:min(n,size(cons,1)),:);
        feasible = false(n,1);
        feasible(1:size(cons,1)) = all(cons <= 0,2);
    elseif isfield(Source,'feasible') && ~isempty(Source.feasible)
        f = logical(Source.feasible(:));
        feasible = false(n,1);
        feasible(1:min(n,numel(f))) = f(1:min(n,numel(f)));
    end
    finite = all(isfinite(decs),2) & all(isfinite(objs),2);
    keep = feasible & finite;
    Dec = decs(keep,:);
    Obj = objs(keep,:);
end

function idx = SmallestKRows_BDG(values,k)
    values = values(:);
    k = min(k,numel(values));
    if k <= 0
        idx = zeros(0,1);
    elseif k == numel(values)
        [~,idx] = sort(values,'ascend');
    else
        try
            [~,idx] = mink(values,k);
        catch
            [~,idx] = sort(values,'ascend');
            idx = idx(1:k);
        end
    end
end

function Diag = EmptyTargetTripleDiag_BDG(M,refDim,conditionMode,targetMode)
    if nargin < 2
        refDim = 0;
    end
    if nargin < 3
        conditionMode = "yt_dt";
    end
    if nargin < 4
        targetMode = "endpoint";
    end
    conditionMode = NormalizeConditionMode_BDG(conditionMode);
    targetMode = NormalizeTargetMode_BDG(targetMode);
    Diag = struct( ...
        'target_triple_ready',0, ...
        'target_pair_count',0, ...
        'target_triple_count',0, ...
        'target_condition_dim',double(2*M + double(ConditionHasT_BDG(conditionMode)) + refDim), ...
        'target_condition_mode_code',ConditionModeCode_BDG(conditionMode), ...
        'target_ref_token_dim',double(refDim), ...
        'target_mode_code',double(TargetModeCode_BDG(targetMode)), ...
        'target_keep_index',zeros(0,1), ...
        'target_y_min',nan(1,M), ...
        'target_y_max',nan(1,M), ...
        'target_direction_norm_mean',NaN, ...
        'target_t_min',NaN, ...
        'target_t_max',NaN, ...
        'target_t_mean',NaN, ...
        'target_fallback_count',0, ...
        'target_near_segment_source_count',0, ...
        'target_near_segment_candidate_count',0, ...
        'target_near_segment_keep_count',0);
end

function code = ConditionModeCode_BDG(mode)
    mode = NormalizeConditionMode_BDG(mode);
    names = ["yt_dt","yt_dt_ref","yt_dt_t","yt_dt_t_ref"];
    code = double(find(names == mode,1,'first') - 1);
end

function D = ProblemDimension_BDG(Problem,AF)
    D = 0;
    if isfield_safe_BDG(Problem,'D')
        D = double(Problem.D);
    elseif isstruct(AF) && isfield(AF,'decs')
        D = size(AF.decs,2);
    end
    if isempty(D) || ~isscalar(D) || ~isfinite(D)
        D = 0;
    end
    D = max(0,round(D));
end

function M = ProblemObjectiveCount_BDG(Problem,AF,AI)
    M = 0;
    if isfield_safe_BDG(Problem,'M')
        M = double(Problem.M);
    elseif isstruct(AF) && isfield(AF,'objs')
        M = size(AF.objs,2);
    elseif isstruct(AI) && isfield(AI,'objs')
        M = size(AI.objs,2);
    end
    if isempty(M) || ~isscalar(M) || ~isfinite(M)
        M = 0;
    end
    M = max(0,round(M));
end

function flag = isfield_safe_BDG(S,name)
    flag = false;
    try
        flag = isfield(S,name);
    catch
    end
end

function [Dec,Obj] = ArchiveMatrices_BDG(A,D,M)
    Dec = zeros(0,D);
    Obj = zeros(0,M);
    if ~isstruct(A)
        return;
    end
    if isfield(A,'decs') && ~isempty(A.decs)
        Dec = double(A.decs);
        if size(Dec,2) ~= D
            Dec = zeros(0,D);
        end
    end
    if isfield(A,'objs') && ~isempty(A.objs)
        Obj = double(A.objs);
        if size(Obj,2) > M
            Obj = Obj(:,1:M);
        elseif size(Obj,2) < M
            Obj = [Obj,nan(size(Obj,1),M-size(Obj,2))];
        end
    end
end

function [AFNorm,AINorm,zmin,zmax] = NormalizePairedObjectives_BDG(AFObj,AIObj,M)
    allObj = [AFObj;AIObj];
    zmin = zeros(1,M);
    zmax = ones(1,M);
    for j = 1 : M
        values = allObj(:,j);
        values = values(isfinite(values));
        if isempty(values)
            continue;
        end
        zmin(j) = min(values);
        zmax(j) = max(values);
    end
    AFNorm = NormalizeObjMat_BDG(AFObj,zmin,zmax);
    AINorm = NormalizeObjMat_BDG(AIObj,zmin,zmax);
end

function X = NormalizeObjMat_BDG(X,zmin,zmax)
    X = NormalizeObjMatNoClip_BDG(X,zmin,zmax);
    X = min(max(X,0),1);
end

function X = NormalizeObjMatNoClip_BDG(X,zmin,zmax)
    X = (double(X) - double(zmin)) ./ ...
        (double(zmax) - double(zmin) + 1e-12);
end

function value = MeanFinite_BDG(X)
    X = X(isfinite(X));
    if isempty(X)
        value = NaN;
    else
        value = mean(X);
    end
end

function value = MedianFinite_BDG(X)
    X = X(isfinite(X));
    if isempty(X)
        value = NaN;
    else
        value = median(X);
    end
end

function value = PercentileFinite_BDG(X,p)
    X = sort(double(X(isfinite(X))));
    if isempty(X)
        value = NaN;
        return;
    end
    p = min(max(double(p),0),100);
    value = X(max(1,ceil((p/100)*numel(X))));
end

function value = SafeRatio_BDG(num,den)
    if den <= 0
        value = NaN;
    else
        value = double(num) / double(den);
    end
end

function value = MinFinite_BDG(X)
    X = X(isfinite(X));
    if isempty(X)
        value = NaN;
    else
        value = min(X);
    end
end

function value = MaxFinite_BDG(X)
    X = X(isfinite(X));
    if isempty(X)
        value = NaN;
    else
        value = max(X);
    end
end

====================================================================================================
FILE: Algorithms/Multi-objective optimization/CCMO-GAN-BDG/BuildBoundaryTrainBundle_BDG.m | bytes=8137
====================================================================================================
function [Bundle,Diag] = BuildBoundaryTrainBundle_BDG( ...
        AF,AI,W,Problem,mode,Control,EvaluatedSource)
%BuildBoundaryTrainBundle_BDG Build refresh-local BDG GAN training bundle.

    if nargin < 6 || isempty(Control)
        Control = struct();
    end
    if nargin < 7
        EvaluatedSource = [];
    end
    mode = NormalizeGeneratorMode_BDG(mode);
    Control = NormalizeBundleControl_BDG(Control);
    filterMode = Control.trainFilterMode;
    targetFusionMode = "none";
    if filterMode == "condition_knn_fused"
        targetFusionMode = "condition_knn";
        filterMode = "none";
    end

    TripleOptions = struct( ...
        'conditionMode',Control.conditionMode, ...
        'targetMode',Control.targetMode, ...
        'nearSegmentSource',EvaluatedSource, ...
        'nearSegmentTau',Control.nearSegmentTau, ...
        'nearSegmentMaxPerPair',Control.nearSegmentMaxPerPair, ...
        'decisionInterpCount',Control.decisionInterpCount, ...
        'targetFusionMode',targetFusionMode, ...
        'conditionKNNK',5, ...
        'conditionKNNRetainRatio',Control.conditionKNNRetainRatio, ...
        'conditionKNNMinCount',2, ...
        'lower',Problem.lower, ...
        'upper',Problem.upper);

    tTargetBuild = tic;
    [TrainDecs,ConditionData,Diag] = BuildBoundaryTargetTriples_BDG( ...
        AF,AI,Problem,W,TripleOptions);
    Diag.t_target_build = toc(tTargetBuild);
    DiagAI = ArchiveDecisionRows_BDG(AI,Diag.target_keep_index,Problem.D);
    FilterOptions = struct( ...
        'trainFilterMode',filterMode, ...
        'conditionKNNK',5, ...
        'conditionKNNRetainRatio',Control.conditionKNNRetainRatio, ...
        'conditionKNNMinCount',2, ...
        'randomSeed',Control.trainFilterRandomSeed, ...
        'aiDomMinCount',2, ...
        'mutualNDWeight',0.10, ...
        'lower',Problem.lower, ...
        'upper',Problem.upper);
    tTargetFilter = tic;
    [TrainDecs,ConditionData,DiagAI,weights,FilterDiag] = ...
        FilterBoundaryTargetTriples_BDG(TrainDecs,ConditionData, ...
        DiagAI,AF,AI,W,Diag,FilterOptions);
    FilterDiag.t_target_filter = toc(tTargetFilter);
    if targetFusionMode == "condition_knn"
        FilterDiag = RestoreFusedTargetFilterDiag_BDG(FilterDiag,Diag);
    end
    Diag = MergeStructFields_BDG(Diag,FilterDiag);
    realLabels = [];
    if Control.targetRealLabelMode == "boundary_quality_eval"
        error('BuildBoundaryTrainBundle_BDG:UnsupportedRealLabelMode', ...
            'BoundaryTrainBundle currently supports binary real labels only.');
    end
    if mode == "objective_target_unconditioned"
        ConditionData = [];
    end

    Bundle = struct( ...
        'mode',mode, ...
        'decs',TrainDecs, ...
        'aiDecs',DiagAI, ...
        'conditionData',ConditionData, ...
        'sampleWeights',weights, ...
        'realLabels',realLabels, ...
        'pairIndex',double(Diag.target_keep_index(:)), ...
        'conditionDim',size(ConditionData,2));
    Diag = AddBundleEquivalenceDiag_BDG(Bundle,Diag,AI,W);
end

function Control = NormalizeBundleControl_BDG(Control)
    Control = WithDefault_BDG(Control,'conditionMode',"yt_dt_t_ref");
    Control = WithDefault_BDG(Control,'targetMode',"near_segment_feasible");
    Control = WithDefault_BDG(Control,'nearSegmentTau',0.20);
    Control = WithDefault_BDG(Control,'nearSegmentMaxPerPair',5);
    Control = WithDefault_BDG(Control,'decisionInterpCount',5);
    Control = WithDefault_BDG(Control,'trainFilterMode',"condition_knn");
    Control = WithDefault_BDG(Control,'conditionKNNRetainRatio',0.60);
    Control = WithDefault_BDG(Control,'trainFilterRandomSeed',0);
    Control = WithDefault_BDG(Control,'targetRealLabelMode',"binary");
    Control.conditionMode = string(Control.conditionMode);
    Control.targetMode = string(Control.targetMode);
    Control.nearSegmentTau = max(0,double(Control.nearSegmentTau));
    Control.nearSegmentMaxPerPair = max(1,round(double( ...
        Control.nearSegmentMaxPerPair)));
    Control.decisionInterpCount = max(2,round(double( ...
        Control.decisionInterpCount)));
    Control.trainFilterMode = lower(strtrim(string(Control.trainFilterMode)));
    Control.conditionKNNRetainRatio = min(max( ...
        double(Control.conditionKNNRetainRatio),0),1);
    Control.trainFilterRandomSeed = max(0,round(double( ...
        Control.trainFilterRandomSeed)));
    Control.targetRealLabelMode = lower(strtrim(string( ...
        Control.targetRealLabelMode)));
end

function S = WithDefault_BDG(S,fieldName,value)
    if ~isstruct(S)
        S = struct();
    end
    if ~isfield(S,fieldName) || isempty(S.(fieldName))
        S.(fieldName) = value;
    end
end

function mode = NormalizeGeneratorMode_BDG(mode)
    mode = lower(strtrim(string(mode)));
    valid = ["objective_target_conditioned","objective_target_unconditioned"];
    assert(ismember(mode,valid), ...
        'BuildBoundaryTrainBundle_BDG:BadGeneratorMode', ...
        'mode must be one of: %s.',strjoin(valid,", "));
end

function Dec = ArchiveDecisionRows_BDG(A,idx,D)
    Dec = zeros(numel(idx),D);
    if ~isstruct(A) || ~isfield(A,'decs') || isempty(A.decs)
        return;
    end
    allDec = double(A.decs);
    idx = round(double(idx(:)));
    valid = idx >= 1 & idx <= size(allDec,1);
    Dec(valid,:) = allDec(idx(valid),:);
end

function Diag = AddBundleEquivalenceDiag_BDG(Bundle,Diag,AI,W)
    pairIndex = round(double(Bundle.pairIndex(:)));
    pairIndex = pairIndex(isfinite(pairIndex) & pairIndex > 0);
    Diag.train_bundle_mode_code = 1;
    Diag.bundle_condition_dim = double(Bundle.conditionDim);
    Diag.bundle_pair_count = double(numel(unique(pairIndex)));
    Diag.bundle_pair_cov = SafeRatio_BDG(Diag.bundle_pair_count, ...
        max(1,double(Diag.target_pair_count)));
    [Diag.bundle_ref_count,Diag.bundle_ref_cov] = ...
        BundleRefCoverage_BDG(AI,pairIndex,W);
    if isfield(Diag,'target_t_min')
        Diag.bundle_t_min = Diag.target_t_min;
        Diag.bundle_t_max = Diag.target_t_max;
        Diag.bundle_t_mean = Diag.target_t_mean;
    else
        Diag.bundle_t_min = NaN;
        Diag.bundle_t_max = NaN;
        Diag.bundle_t_mean = NaN;
    end
    ExpectedAI = ArchiveDecisionRows_BDG(AI,Bundle.pairIndex, ...
        size(Bundle.aiDecs,2));
    matches = all(abs(double(ExpectedAI) - double(Bundle.aiDecs)) < 1e-12,2);
    Diag.bundle_sample_pair_ai_match_count = double(sum(matches));
    Diag.bundle_sample_pair_ai_match_rate = SafeRatio_BDG( ...
        sum(matches),numel(matches));
end

function [count,cov] = BundleRefCoverage_BDG(AI,pairIndex,W)
    refs = zeros(0,1);
    if isstruct(AI) && isfield(AI,'ref') && ~isempty(AI.ref) && ...
            ~isempty(pairIndex)
        allRefs = double(AI.ref(:));
        valid = pairIndex >= 1 & pairIndex <= numel(allRefs);
        refs = allRefs(pairIndex(valid));
    end
    refs = refs(isfinite(refs) & refs > 0);
    count = numel(unique(round(refs)));
    if isempty(W)
        cov = double(count > 0);
    else
        cov = double(count) / max(1,size(W,1));
    end
end

function FilterDiag = RestoreFusedTargetFilterDiag_BDG(FilterDiag,BuildDiag)
    names = ["target_filter_mode_code", ...
        "target_filter_pre_count", ...
        "target_filter_post_count", ...
        "target_filter_retain_ratio", ...
        "target_filter_pre_ref_count", ...
        "target_filter_pre_ref_cov", ...
        "target_filter_post_ref_count", ...
        "target_filter_post_ref_cov", ...
        "condition_knn_k", ...
        "condition_knn_decision_spread_mean", ...
        "condition_knn_decision_spread_median", ...
        "condition_knn_decision_spread_p90"];
    for i = 1 : numel(names)
        name = char(names(i));
        if isfield(BuildDiag,name)
            FilterDiag.(name) = BuildDiag.(name);
        end
    end
end

function S = MergeStructFields_BDG(S,Extra)
    names = fieldnames(Extra);
    for i = 1 : numel(names)
        S.(names{i}) = Extra.(names{i});
    end
end

function value = SafeRatio_BDG(num,den)
    if den <= 0
        value = NaN;
    else
        value = double(num) / double(den);
    end
end

classdef CCMO_GAN_BDG < ALGORITHM
% <multi> <real> <constrained>
% CCMO + strict direct boundary GAN for binary/unknown constraints
%
% trainGap --- 1 --- GAN retraining interval in generations
% nGen     --- 50 --- Number of raw GAN offspring injected each refresh
% zDim     --- 4  --- Latent dimension of GAN
% perRef   --- 5  --- Max AF samples kept per reference vector
% nearTau  --- 0.20 --- Max normalized objective distance for cross-pop matching
% ganIter  --- 50 --- GAN training iterations/epochs per refresh
% probeRawN --- 0 --- Extra raw GAN diagnostic samples per refresh
% stageProbeN --- 200 --- Raw GAN diagnostic samples at fixed FE stages
% ganDPretrainIter --- 0 --- D-only pretraining iterations before adversarial updates
% ganDSteps --- 1 --- D update steps per GAN iteration
% ganGSteps --- 1 --- G update steps per GAN iteration
% archiveGap --- 1 --- Boundary archive update interval in generations
% ganArchMode --- g2sl --- GAN architecture mode: small, large, or g2sl
% ganMiniBatch --- 64 --- GAN mini-batch size
% ganRealLabel --- 0.9 --- Real label smoothing value in D loss
% ganLrD --- 0.0001 --- Discriminator learning rate
% ganLrG --- 0.0001 --- Generator learning rate
% ganTrainMode --- epoch --- GAN training loop mode: iter or epoch
%
% Mainline:
% 1) keep the CCMO-DE two-population skeleton,
% 2) build AF/AI boundary archives,
% 3) train one direct GAN with AF positives and G(z[,c]) negatives,
% 4) sample complete decisions by raw G(z)->x,
% 5) evaluate raw samples and inject them unchanged into Population1.

    methods
        function main(Algorithm,Problem)
            nGenDefault = 50;
            [trainGap,nGen,zDim,perRef,nearTau, ...
                ganIter,probeRawN,stageProbeN, ...
                ganDPretrainIter,ganDSteps,ganGSteps,archiveGap, ...
                ganArchMode,ganMiniBatch,ganRealLabel,ganLrD,ganLrG, ...
                ganTrainMode] = ...
                Algorithm.ParameterSet( ...
                1,nGenDefault,4,5,0.20,50,0,200, ...
                0,1,1,1,"g2sl",64,0.9,1e-4,1e-4,"epoch");
            trainGap = max(1,round(double(trainGap)));
            archiveGap = max(1,round(double(archiveGap)));
            zDim = max(0,round(double(zDim)));
            stageProbeN = max(0,round(double(stageProbeN)));
            GANTrainOptions = struct( ...
                'dPretrainIter',max(0,round(double(ganDPretrainIter))), ...
                'dSteps',max(1,round(double(ganDSteps))), ...
                'gSteps',max(1,round(double(ganGSteps))), ...
                'sampleWeights',[], ...
                'realLabels',[], ...
                'generatorMode',"objective_target_conditioned", ...
                'conditionData',[], ...
                'generatorLossMode',"adversarial", ...
                'reconstructionWeight',0, ...
                'reconstructionHuberDelta',0.10, ...
                'criticMode',"af_like", ...
                'archMode',ganArchMode, ...
                'miniBatch',ganMiniBatch, ...
                'realLabel',ganRealLabel, ...
                'lrD',ganLrD, ...
                'lrG',ganLrG, ...
                'trainMode',ganTrainMode);
            ExperimentControl = ResolveExperimentControl_BDG(archiveGap);
            archiveGap = ExperimentControl.archiveGap;
            GANTrainOptions.generatorMode = ExperimentControl.generatorMode;
            GANTrainOptions.generatorLossMode = ...
                ExperimentControl.generatorLossMode;
            GANTrainOptions.reconstructionWeight = ...
                ExperimentControl.reconstructionWeight;
            GANTrainOptions.reconstructionHuberDelta = ...
                ExperimentControl.reconstructionHuberDelta;
            GANTrainOptions.criticMode = ExperimentControl.ganCriticMode;

            Params = struct( ...
                'trainGap',trainGap, ...
                'nGen',nGen, ...
                'zDim',zDim, ...
                'perRef',perRef, ...
                'nearTau',nearTau, ...
                'ganIter',ganIter, ...
                'archiveGap',archiveGap, ...
                'probeRawN',probeRawN, ...
                'stageProbeN',stageProbeN, ...
                'ganDPretrainIter',GANTrainOptions.dPretrainIter, ...
                'ganDSteps',GANTrainOptions.dSteps, ...
                'ganGSteps',GANTrainOptions.gSteps, ...
                'ganArchMode',string(GANTrainOptions.archMode), ...
                'ganMiniBatch',double(GANTrainOptions.miniBatch), ...
                'ganRealLabel',double(GANTrainOptions.realLabel), ...
                'ganLrD',double(GANTrainOptions.lrD), ...
                'ganLrG',double(GANTrainOptions.lrG), ...
                'ganTrainMode',string(GANTrainOptions.trainMode), ...
                'generatorMode',GANTrainOptions.generatorMode, ...
                'generatorLossMode',GANTrainOptions.generatorLossMode, ...
                'reconstructionWeight', ...
                double(GANTrainOptions.reconstructionWeight), ...
                'reconstructionHuberDelta', ...
                double(GANTrainOptions.reconstructionHuberDelta), ...
                'ganCriticMode',GANTrainOptions.criticMode, ...
                'variant',ExperimentControl.variant, ...
                'archiveParetoFilterMode',ExperimentControl.archiveParetoFilterMode, ...
                'archivePairDirectionMode',ExperimentControl.archivePairDirectionMode, ...
                'archiveSourceCapMode',ExperimentControl.archiveSourceCapMode, ...
                'archivePairRefMode',ExperimentControl.archivePairRefMode, ...
                'trainFilterMode',ExperimentControl.trainFilterMode, ...
                'conditionKNNRetainRatio', ...
                ExperimentControl.conditionKNNRetainRatio, ...
                'cganTrainMinRefCov', ...
                ExperimentControl.cganTrainMinRefCov, ...
                'cganTrainMinTargetTriples', ...
                ExperimentControl.cganTrainMinTargetTriples, ...
                'trainFilterRandomSeed', ...
                ExperimentControl.trainFilterRandomSeed, ...
                'conditionMode',ExperimentControl.conditionMode, ...
                'targetMode',ExperimentControl.targetMode, ...
                'nearSegmentTau',ExperimentControl.nearSegmentTau, ...
                'nearSegmentMaxPerPair', ...
                ExperimentControl.nearSegmentMaxPerPair, ...
                'decisionInterpCount', ...
                ExperimentControl.decisionInterpCount, ...
                'targetRealLabelMode',ExperimentControl.targetRealLabelMode, ...
                'trainBundleMode',ExperimentControl.trainBundleMode);
            ArchiveOptions = struct( ...
                'scoreGapWeight',1.00, ...
                'scoreRankWeight',0.00, ...
                'sourceCapMode',ExperimentControl.archiveSourceCapMode, ...
                'paretoFilterMode',ExperimentControl.archiveParetoFilterMode, ...
                'pairDirectionMode',ExperimentControl.archivePairDirectionMode, ...
                'pairRefMode',ExperimentControl.archivePairRefMode);

            [W,~] = UniformPoint(Problem.N,Problem.M);
            Observer = InitMetricsObserver_BDG(Algorithm,Problem,Params, ...
                ExperimentControl);
            Algorithm.metric.analysis_folder   = Observer.folder;
            Algorithm.metric.analysis_meta_csv = Observer.meta_file;
            Algorithm.metric.analysis_core_csv = Observer.core_file;
            Algorithm.metric.analysis_stage_csv = Observer.stage_file;

            Population1 = Problem.Initialization();
            Population2 = Problem.Initialization();
            Fitness1    = CalFitness_BDG(Population1.objs,Population1.cons);
            Fitness2    = CalFitness_BDG(Population2.objs);

            AF = InitArchive_BDG(Problem.D,Problem.M);
            AI = InitArchive_BDG(Problem.D,Problem.M);
            GAN = [];
            gen = 0;
            stageTargets = StageTargets_BDG(Problem.maxFE);
            nextStage = 1;
            SnapshotWriter = InitArchiveSnapshotWriter_BDG( ...
                ExperimentControl,Problem,ResolveRunId_BDG(Algorithm));
            Timing = InitProfileTimer_BDG();

            while Algorithm.NotTerminated(Population1)
                gen = gen + 1;

                MatingPool1 = TournamentSelection(2,2*Problem.N,Fitness1);
                MatingPool2 = TournamentSelection(2,2*Problem.N,Fitness2);
                Offspring1  = OperatorDE(Problem,Population1, ...
                    Population1(MatingPool1(1:end/2)), ...
                    Population1(MatingPool1(end/2+1:end)));
                Offspring2  = OperatorDE(Problem,Population2, ...
                    Population2(MatingPool2(1:end/2)), ...
                    Population2(MatingPool2(end/2+1:end)));

                ArchiveDiag = EmptyMainArchiveDiag_BDG(ArchiveOptions);
                if ShouldUpdateBoundaryArchive_BDG(gen,archiveGap)
                    tStart = tic;
                    [AF,AI,ArchiveDiag] = UpdateBoundaryArchive_BDG(Problem,AF,AI, ...
                        Population1,Offspring1,Population2,Offspring2, ...
                        W,perRef,nearTau,ArchiveOptions);
                    Timing = ProfileTimerAdd_BDG(Timing, ...
                        't_archive_update',toc(tStart));
                end

                OffspringG = Offspring1([]);
                writeMetricsRow = false;
                if mod(gen,trainGap) == 0
                    GanDiag = EmptyGanDiag_BDG(Problem.M,Problem.D);
                    [AFTrain,AITrain,~] = SelectGANTrainingArchive_BDG( ...
                        AF,AI);
                    GanDiag.train_af_count = size(AFTrain.decs,1);
                    [GanDiag.train_ref_count,GanDiag.train_ref_cov] = ...
                        TrainingArchiveRefCoverage_BDG(AFTrain,W);
                    trainRefCount = GanDiag.train_ref_count;
                    trainRefCov = GanDiag.train_ref_cov;

                    refreshFlag = false;
                    skipReason = "AF_empty";
                    if ~isempty(AFTrain.decs)
                        previousGAN = GAN;
                        ThisGANTrainOptions = GANTrainOptions;
                        tStart = tic;
                        EvaluatedSource = BuildEvaluatedFeasibleSource_BDG( ...
                            Problem,Population1,Offspring1, ...
                            Population2,Offspring2,AFTrain);
                        Timing = ProfileTimerAdd_BDG(Timing, ...
                            't_source_build',toc(tStart));
                        if ExperimentControl.trainBundleMode == "refresh_local"
                            [TrainBundle,TargetTrainDiag] = ...
                                BuildBoundaryTrainBundle_BDG(AFTrain, ...
                                AITrain,W,Problem, ...
                                GANTrainOptions.generatorMode, ...
                                ExperimentControl,EvaluatedSource);
                            GANTrainDecs = TrainBundle.decs;
                            GANTrainAI = TrainBundle.aiDecs;
                            GANConditionData = TrainBundle.conditionData;
                            GANTrainWeights = TrainBundle.sampleWeights;
                            GANRealLabels = TrainBundle.realLabels;
                        else
                            [GANTrainDecs,GANTrainAI,GANConditionData, ...
                                GANTrainWeights,GANRealLabels,TargetTrainDiag] = ...
                                BuildGANTrainingSet_BDG(AFTrain,AITrain,W, ...
                                Problem,GANTrainOptions.generatorMode, ...
                                ExperimentControl,EvaluatedSource);
                        end
                        Timing = ProfileTimerAdd_BDG(Timing, ...
                            't_target_build', ...
                            DiagScalar_BDG(TargetTrainDiag,'t_target_build',0));
                        Timing = ProfileTimerAdd_BDG(Timing, ...
                            't_target_filter', ...
                            DiagScalar_BDG(TargetTrainDiag,'t_target_filter',0));
                        TargetReady = IsTrainingDataReady_BDG( ...
                            GANTrainDecs,GANConditionData, ...
                            ThisGANTrainOptions.generatorMode);
                        GanDiag = MergeDiagFields_BDG(GanDiag, ...
                            TargetTrainDiag);
                        [GanDiag.train_ref_count,GanDiag.train_ref_cov] = ...
                            TargetTrainingRefCoverage_BDG( ...
                            TargetTrainDiag,AFTrain,W, ...
                            trainRefCount,trainRefCov);
                        [GateReady,~,~] = IsCGANTrainCoverageReady_BDG( ...
                            TargetTrainDiag,GanDiag.train_ref_cov, ...
                            ExperimentControl);
                        if TargetReady && GateReady
                            ThisGANTrainOptions.sampleWeights = GANTrainWeights;
                            ThisGANTrainOptions.realLabels = GANRealLabels;
                            ThisGANTrainOptions.conditionData = GANConditionData;
                            if isfield(TargetTrainDiag,'target_keep_index')
                                ThisGANTrainOptions.conditionPairIndex = ...
                                    TargetTrainDiag.target_keep_index;
                            else
                                ThisGANTrainOptions.conditionPairIndex = [];
                            end
                            tStart = tic;
                            GAN = BoundaryGAN_BDG('traindirectboundary', ...
                                GANTrainDecs,GANTrainAI, ...
                                Problem.lower,Problem.upper, ...
                                zDim,ganIter,previousGAN, ...
                                ThisGANTrainOptions);
                            Timing = ProfileTimerAdd_BDG(Timing, ...
                                't_gan_train',toc(tStart));
                            candidateN = nGen;
                            [OffspringG,GanDiag] = BoundaryGAN_BDG( ...
                                'sample',Problem,GAN,candidateN);
                            [OffspringG,GanDiag] = SelectInjectedCandidates_BDG( ...
                                OffspringG,GanDiag,nGen);
                            GanDiag = EnsureGanDiag_BDG(GanDiag,Problem.M, ...
                                Problem.D);
                            GanDiag = MergeDiagFields_BDG(GanDiag, ...
                                TargetTrainDiag);
                            GanDiag.train_af_count = size(AFTrain.decs,1);
                            [GanDiag.train_ref_count,GanDiag.train_ref_cov] = ...
                                TargetTrainingRefCoverage_BDG( ...
                                TargetTrainDiag,AFTrain,W, ...
                                trainRefCount,trainRefCov);
                            if isfield(GAN,'targetConditionedDiag')
                                GanDiag = MergeDiagFields_BDG(GanDiag, ...
                                    GAN.targetConditionedDiag);
                            end
                            if isfield(GAN,'pretrainDiag')
                                GanDiag = MergeDiagFields_BDG(GanDiag, ...
                                    GAN.pretrainDiag);
                            end
                            trainDiagN = 100;
                            tStart = tic;
                            GanDiag = MergeDiagFields_BDG(GanDiag, ...
                                BoundaryGAN_BDG('traindiagnose',GAN, ...
                                GANTrainDecs,GANTrainAI, ...
                                Problem.lower,Problem.upper,trainDiagN));
                            if probeRawN > 0
                                GanDiag = MergeDiagFields_BDG(GanDiag, ...
                                    ProbeBoundaryGANNoBudget_BDG(Problem,GAN, ...
                                    probeRawN));
                            end
                            Timing = ProfileTimerAdd_BDG(Timing, ...
                                't_gan_diagnose',toc(tStart));
                            refreshFlag = true;
                            skipReason = "trained";
                        elseif TargetReady
                            skipReason = "target_coverage_gate";
                        else
                            skipReason = "target_triples_insufficient";
                        end
                    end
	                    writeMetricsRow = true;
                end

                [Population1,Fitness1] = EnvironmentalSelection_BDG( ...
                    [Population1,Offspring1,Offspring2,OffspringG],Problem.N,true);
                [Population2,Fitness2] = EnvironmentalSelection_BDG( ...
                    [Population2,Offspring1,Offspring2],Problem.N,false);

                [SnapshotWriter,snapshotElapsed] = MaybeWriteArchiveSnapshots_BDG( ...
                    SnapshotWriter,Problem,AF,AI,GAN,gen, ...
                    Population1,Population2);
                Timing = ProfileTimerAdd_BDG(Timing, ...
                    't_snapshot_export',snapshotElapsed);

                while nextStage <= numel(stageTargets) && ...
                        Problem.FE >= stageTargets(nextStage)
                    stageActualFE = Problem.FE;
                    tStart = tic;
                    AppendCsvRow_BDG(Observer.stage_file, ...
                        BuildStageMetricsRow_BDG(stageTargets(nextStage), ...
                        stageActualFE,gen,Problem,AF,AI,W,GAN,stageProbeN));
                    Timing = ProfileTimerAdd_BDG(Timing, ...
                        't_stage_probe',toc(tStart));
                    nextStage = nextStage + 1;
                end

                if writeMetricsRow
                    AppendMetricsRow_BDG(Observer.core_file, ...
                        BuildMetricsRow_BDG(gen,Problem,AF,AI, ...
                        W,GanDiag,ArchiveDiag,refreshFlag, ...
                        skipReason,Timing));
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

end

function Observer = InitMetricsObserver_BDG(Algorithm,Problem,Params,Control)
    rootDir = fileparts(which('platemo'));
    baseDir = fullfile(rootDir,'Data','CCMO_GAN_BDG');
    if nargin >= 4 && isstruct(Control) && ...
            isfield(Control,'analysisRootFolder') && ...
            strlength(string(Control.analysisRootFolder)) > 0
        baseDir = char(string(Control.analysisRootFolder));
    end
    [~,~] = mkdir(baseDir);
    [~,token] = fileparts(tempname(baseDir));
    runId = ResolveRunId_BDG(Algorithm);
    runFolder = fullfile(baseDir,sprintf('%s_%s_run%d_%s', ...
        class(Algorithm),class(Problem),runId,token));
    [~,~] = mkdir(runFolder);

    Observer = struct( ...
        'folder',runFolder, ...
        'meta_file',fullfile(runFolder,'run_meta.csv'), ...
        'core_file',fullfile(runFolder,'core_metrics.csv'), ...
        'stage_file',fullfile(runFolder,'stage_metrics.csv'));

	    WriteCsvHeader_BDG(Observer.meta_file,{ ...
	        'algorithm','problem','family','run','M','D','N','maxFE', ...
	        'trainGap','archiveGap','nGen','zDim','perRef', ...
		        'nearTau','ganIter','probeRawN', ...
		        'stageProbeN', ...
		        'ganDPretrainIter','ganDSteps','ganGSteps', ...
		        'ganArchMode','ganMiniBatch','ganRealLabel', ...
				        'ganLrD','ganLrG','ganTrainMode', ...
				        'generatorMode','generatorLossMode', ...
                        'reconstructionWeight', ...
                        'reconstructionHuberDelta', ...
			        'ganCriticMode', ...
		        'variant', ...
        'archiveParetoFilterMode','archivePairDirectionMode', ...
            'archiveSourceCapMode','archivePairRefMode', ...
            'trainFilterMode','conditionKNNRetainRatio', ...
	            'cganTrainMinRefCov','cganTrainMinTargetTriples', ...
	            'trainFilterRandomSeed','conditionMode','targetMode', ...
        'nearSegmentTau','nearSegmentMaxPerPair', ...
                'decisionInterpCount','targetRealLabelMode', ...
                'trainBundleMode', ...
			        'output_folder'});
    AppendCsvRow_BDG(Observer.meta_file,{ ...
        class(Algorithm),class(Problem),ProblemFamily_BDG(class(Problem)),runId, ...
        Problem.M,Problem.D,Problem.N,Problem.maxFE, ...
        Params.trainGap,Params.archiveGap,Params.nGen, ...
        Params.zDim,Params.perRef,Params.nearTau, ...
	        Params.ganIter,Params.probeRawN, ...
		        Params.stageProbeN, ...
		        Params.ganDPretrainIter,Params.ganDSteps,Params.ganGSteps, ...
		        Params.ganArchMode,Params.ganMiniBatch, ...
		        Params.ganRealLabel,Params.ganLrD,Params.ganLrG, ...
				        Params.ganTrainMode, ...
				        Params.generatorMode,Params.generatorLossMode, ...
                        Params.reconstructionWeight, ...
                        Params.reconstructionHuberDelta, ...
			        Params.ganCriticMode, ...
		        Params.variant, ...
	        Params.archiveParetoFilterMode, ...
	        Params.archivePairDirectionMode, ...
            Params.archiveSourceCapMode, ...
            Params.archivePairRefMode, ...
            Params.trainFilterMode,Params.conditionKNNRetainRatio, ...
            Params.cganTrainMinRefCov, ...
            Params.cganTrainMinTargetTriples, ...
            Params.trainFilterRandomSeed,Params.conditionMode, ...
            Params.targetMode,Params.nearSegmentTau, ...
            Params.nearSegmentMaxPerPair,Params.decisionInterpCount, ...
            Params.targetRealLabelMode, ...
            Params.trainBundleMode, ...
		        runFolder});

    WriteCsvHeader_BDG(Observer.core_file,CoreMetricColumns_BDG());
    WriteCsvHeader_BDG(Observer.stage_file,StageMetricColumns_BDG());
end

function Targets = StageTargets_BDG(maxFE)
    fixedTargets = [10000 30000 50000 70000 100000 125000 150000];
    if maxFE >= 100000
        Targets = fixedTargets(fixedTargets <= maxFE);
    else
        Targets = unique(max(1,round([0.25 0.50 0.75 1.00] .* maxFE)));
    end
end

function Columns = StageMetricColumns_BDG()
    Columns = [{'target_FE','actual_FE','gen','has_GAN', ...
        'AF_size','AI_size'}, GeneratedBoundaryMetricColumns_BDG()];
end

function Row = BuildStageMetricsRow_BDG(targetFE,actualFE,gen,Problem,AF,AI,W,GAN,stageProbeN)
    hasGAN = ~isempty(GAN) && isfield(GAN,'netG') && isfield(GAN,'netD');
    [gapObj,zmin,zmax] = PairObjectiveGap_BDG(AF,AI);
    Generated = EmptyGeneratedBoundaryMetrics_BDG();

    if hasGAN && stageProbeN > 0
        ProbeDiag = ProbeBoundaryGANNoBudget_BDG(Problem,GAN,stageProbeN);
        Generated = GeneratedBoundaryMetrics_BDG(Problem, ...
            ProbeDiag.probe_raw_decs,ProbeDiag.probe_raw_objs, ...
            ProbeDiag.probe_raw_cons,ProbeDiag.probe_raw_feasible, ...
            AF,AI,W,gapObj,zmin,zmax);
        if isfield(ProbeDiag,'probe_raw_var_clip_rate')
            Generated.RawGANVarClipRate = ProbeDiag.probe_raw_var_clip_rate;
        end
    end

    GeneratedRow = GeneratedBoundaryMetricRow_BDG(Generated);
    Row = [{targetFE,actualFE,gen,double(hasGAN), ...
        size(AF.decs,1),size(AI.decs,1)},GeneratedRow];
end

function Diag = ProbeBoundaryGANNoBudget_BDG(Problem,GAN,nProbe)
    oldFE = Problem.FE;
    rngState = rng;
    cleanup = onCleanup(@()RestoreProblemState_BDG(Problem,oldFE,rngState)); %#ok<NASGU>
    Diag = BoundaryGAN_BDG('probe',Problem,GAN,nProbe);
end

function RestoreProblemState_BDG(Problem,oldFE,rngState)
    Problem.FE = oldFE;
    rng(rngState);
end

function Timing = InitProfileTimer_BDG()
    fields = ProfileTimerComponentFields_BDG();
    Timing = struct();
    for i = 1 : numel(fields)
        Timing.(char(fields(i))) = 0;
    end
    Timing.runtime_core_est = 0;
end

function fields = ProfileTimerComponentFields_BDG()
    fields = ["t_archive_update", ...
        "t_source_build", ...
        "t_target_build", ...
        "t_target_filter", ...
        "t_gan_train", ...
        "t_gan_diagnose", ...
        "t_stage_probe", ...
        "t_snapshot_export"];
end

function Columns = ProfileTimerColumns_BDG()
    Columns = cellstr([ProfileTimerComponentFields_BDG(), ...
        "runtime_core_est"]);
    Columns = reshape(Columns,1,[]);
end

function Row = ProfileTimerRow_BDG(Timing)
    Timing = NormalizeProfileTimer_BDG(Timing);
    fields = ProfileTimerComponentFields_BDG();
    Row = cell(1,numel(fields)+1);
    total = 0;
    for i = 1 : numel(fields)
        value = ProfileTimerValue_BDG(Timing,fields(i));
        Row{i} = value;
        total = total + value;
    end
    Row{end} = total;
end

function Timing = ProfileTimerAdd_BDG(Timing,name,elapsed)
    Timing = NormalizeProfileTimer_BDG(Timing);
    name = char(string(name));
    if ~isfield(Timing,name)
        return;
    end
    value = double(elapsed);
    if isempty(value) || ~isscalar(value) || ~isfinite(value) || value < 0
        value = 0;
    end
    Timing.(name) = Timing.(name) + value;
    fields = ProfileTimerComponentFields_BDG();
    Timing.runtime_core_est = 0;
    for i = 1 : numel(fields)
        Timing.runtime_core_est = Timing.runtime_core_est + ...
            ProfileTimerValue_BDG(Timing,fields(i));
    end
end

function Timing = NormalizeProfileTimer_BDG(Timing)
    if ~isstruct(Timing)
        Timing = struct();
    end
    fields = ProfileTimerComponentFields_BDG();
    for i = 1 : numel(fields)
        name = char(fields(i));
        if ~isfield(Timing,name)
            Timing.(name) = 0;
        end
        value = double(Timing.(name));
        if isempty(value) || ~isscalar(value) || ~isfinite(value) || value < 0
            value = 0;
        end
        Timing.(name) = value;
    end
    Timing.runtime_core_est = 0;
    for i = 1 : numel(fields)
        Timing.runtime_core_est = Timing.runtime_core_est + ...
            Timing.(char(fields(i)));
    end
end

function value = ProfileTimerValue_BDG(Timing,name)
    name = char(string(name));
    if isfield(Timing,name)
        value = double(Timing.(name));
    else
        value = 0;
    end
    if isempty(value) || ~isscalar(value) || ~isfinite(value) || value < 0
        value = 0;
    end
end

function Metrics = GeneratedBoundaryMetrics_BDG(Problem,decs,objs,cons, ...
        feasible,AF,AI,W,gapObj,zmin,zmax)
    Metrics = EmptyGeneratedBoundaryMetrics_BDG();
    if isempty(decs)
        return;
    end
    if isempty(feasible) || numel(feasible) ~= size(decs,1)
        feasible = FeasibleMaskFromCons_BDG(cons,size(decs,1));
    else
        feasible = logical(feasible(:));
    end
    Metrics.BoundaryHit_all = BoundaryHitAll_BDG( ...
        objs,AF,AI,gapObj,zmin,zmax);
    Interface = ObjectiveInterfaceMetrics_BDG( ...
        objs,feasible,cons,zmin,zmax,gapObj);
    Metrics.ObjInterfaceScore = Interface.objInterfaceScore;
    Metrics.RefCov = GeneratedRefCoverage_BDG(objs,W);
    Metrics.DuplicateRate = DuplicateRate_BDG(Problem,decs);
    Metrics.RawGANFeasibleRate = mean(double(feasible));
    Metrics.RawGANVarClipRate = DecisionBoundaryClipRate_BDG( ...
        Problem,decs);
    Metrics.RawGANOutsideStandardRangeCount = ...
        RawGANOutsideStandardRangeCount_BDG(Problem,objs);
    Metrics = AddGANToSegmentMetrics_BDG(Metrics,objs,AF,AI,zmin,zmax);
    Metrics = AddGANToDecisionSegmentMetrics_BDG(Metrics,Problem,decs,AF,AI);
    Metrics = AddGANClusterMetrics_BDG(Metrics,objs,zmin,zmax);
    Metrics = AddGANToAFDistanceMetrics_BDG(Metrics,Problem, ...
        decs,objs,AF,zmin,zmax);
end

function feasible = FeasibleMaskFromCons_BDG(cons,n)
    if isempty(cons)
        feasible = true(n,1);
    else
        feasible = all(cons <= 0,2);
        if numel(feasible) ~= n
            feasible = false(n,1);
        end
    end
end

function rate = BoundaryHitAll_BDG(objs,AF,AI,gapObj,zmin,zmax)
    rate = NaN;
    if isempty(objs) || isempty(AF.objs) || isempty(AI.objs) || ...
            ~isfinite(gapObj)
        return;
    end
    sampleObj = NormalizeObjMatMetrics_BDG(objs,zmin,zmax);
    fObj = NormalizeObjMatMetrics_BDG(AF.objs,zmin,zmax);
    iObj = NormalizeObjMatMetrics_BDG(AI.objs,zmin,zmax);
    dist = DistanceToBoundarySegments_BDG(sampleObj,fObj,iObj);
    tau = max(3 .* double(gapObj),1e-12);
    rate = mean(double(dist <= tau));
end

function dist = DistanceToBoundarySegments_BDG(X,A,B)
    dist = inf(size(X,1),1);
    nPair = min(size(A,1),size(B,1));
    for i = 1 : nPair
        a = A(i,:);
        v = B(i,:) - a;
        len2 = sum(v.^2);
        if len2 <= 1e-24
            d = sqrt(sum((X - a).^2,2));
        else
            t = sum((X - a).*v,2) ./ len2;
            t = min(max(t,0),1);
            proj = a + t.*v;
            d = sqrt(sum((X - proj).^2,2));
        end
        dist = min(dist,d);
    end
end

function dist = DistanceFromSegmentsToPoints_BDG(X,A,B)
    nPair = min(size(A,1),size(B,1));
    dist = inf(nPair,1);
    if isempty(X)
        return;
    end
    for i = 1 : nPair
        a = A(i,:);
        v = B(i,:) - a;
        len2 = sum(v.^2);
        if len2 <= 1e-24
            d = sqrt(sum((X - a).^2,2));
        else
            t = sum((X - a).*v,2) ./ len2;
            t = min(max(t,0),1);
            proj = a + t.*v;
            d = sqrt(sum((X - proj).^2,2));
        end
        dist(i) = min(d);
    end
end

function cov = GeneratedRefCoverage_BDG(objs,W)
    cov = NaN;
    if isempty(objs) || isempty(W)
        return;
    end
    ref = AssignRefFromObjMetrics_BDG(objs,W);
    ref = ref(ref > 0);
    cov = numel(unique(ref)) / size(W,1);
end

function Diag = EnsureGanDiag_BDG(Diag,M,D)
    Empty = EmptyGanDiag_BDG(M,D);
    names = fieldnames(Empty);
    for i = 1 : numel(names)
        if ~isfield(Diag,names{i})
            Diag.(names{i}) = Empty.(names{i});
        end
    end
end

function A = MergeDiagFields_BDG(A,B)
    names = fieldnames(B);
    for i = 1 : numel(names)
        A.(names{i}) = B.(names{i});
    end
end

function A = MarkTrainingArchive_BDG(A,isFeasible)
    A.feasible = repmat(logical(isFeasible),size(A.decs,1),1);
end

    if nargin < 1 || isempty(defaultArchiveGap)
        defaultArchiveGap = 1;
    end
    defaultArchiveGap = max(1,round(double(defaultArchiveGap)));

        'variant',"FixMD_GNDk60_nearseg_huber_z0", ...

        'archivePairDirectionMode',"af_not_dominates_ai", ...

        'archivePairRefMode',"neighbor4", ...

        'conditionMode',"yt_dt_t_ref", ...

        'nearSegmentMaxPerPair',5, ...
        'decisionInterpCount',5, ...
        'targetRealLabelMode',"binary", ...
        'trainBundleMode',"none", ...
        'archiveSnapshotTargets',[], ...
        'archiveSnapshotFolder',"", ...
        'archiveSnapshotTag',"", ...
        'archiveSnapshotGanN',100, ...
        'archiveDiagnosticEnabled',false, ...
        'archiveDiagnosticFolder',"", ...
        'archiveDiagnosticConditionCount',30, ...
        'archiveDiagnosticZPerCondition',10, ...
        'archiveDiagnosticNormalN',200, ...
        'archiveDiagnosticSeed',0, ...
        'analysisRootFolder',"", ...
        'generatorMode',"objective_target_conditioned", ...
        'generatorLossMode',"conditional_adversarial_huber", ...
        'reconstructionWeight',250, ...
        'reconstructionHuberDelta',0.10, ...
        'ganCriticMode',"target_conditioned");
    if isappdata(0,'CCMO_GAN_BDG_ExperimentControl')
        UserControl = getappdata(0,'CCMO_GAN_BDG_ExperimentControl');

            names = intersect(fieldnames(UserControl),fieldnames(Control), ...

        double(Control.cganTrainMinRefCov),0),1);

        Control.decisionInterpCount)));

    ValidateRetainedExperimentCombo_BDG(Control);
end

function ValidateRetainedExperimentCombo_BDG(Control)
    Retained = RetainedVariantTable_BDG();
    idx = find(Retained.variant == Control.variant,1,'first');
    ok = ~isempty(idx) && ...
        Control.archiveParetoFilterMode == Retained.archiveParetoFilterMode(idx) && ...
        Control.archivePairDirectionMode == Retained.archivePairDirectionMode(idx) && ...
        Control.archiveSourceCapMode == Retained.archiveSourceCapMode(idx) && ...
        Control.archivePairRefMode == Retained.archivePairRefMode(idx) && ...
        Control.trainFilterMode == Retained.trainFilterMode(idx) && ...
        abs(Control.conditionKNNRetainRatio - ...
            Retained.conditionKNNRetainRatio(idx)) < 1e-12 && ...
        abs(Control.cganTrainMinRefCov - ...
            Retained.cganTrainMinRefCov(idx)) < 1e-12 && ...
        Control.cganTrainMinTargetTriples == ...
            Retained.cganTrainMinTargetTriples(idx) && ...
        Control.conditionMode == Retained.conditionMode(idx) && ...
        Control.targetMode == Retained.targetMode(idx) && ...
        abs(Control.nearSegmentTau - Retained.nearSegmentTau(idx)) < 1e-12 && ...
        Control.nearSegmentMaxPerPair == ...
            Retained.nearSegmentMaxPerPair(idx) && ...
        Control.decisionInterpCount == Retained.decisionInterpCount(idx) && ...
        Control.targetRealLabelMode == Retained.targetRealLabelMode(idx) && ...
        Control.generatorMode == Retained.generatorMode(idx) && ...
        Control.ganCriticMode == Retained.ganCriticMode(idx) && ...
        Control.generatorLossMode == Retained.generatorLossMode(idx) && ...
        abs(Control.reconstructionWeight - ...
            Retained.reconstructionWeight(idx)) < 1e-12 && ...
        abs(Control.reconstructionHuberDelta - ...
            Retained.reconstructionHuberDelta(idx)) < 1e-12;
    assert(ok, ...
        'CCMO_GAN_BDG:UnsupportedExperimentCombo', ...
        'Only retained CCMO-GAN-BDG variants are supported: %s.', ...
        strjoin(Retained.variant,", "));
end

        archivePairDirectionMode,archiveSourceCapMode,archivePairRefMode, ...

        cganTrainMinRefCov = 0.00;
    end

        cganTrainMinTargetTriples = 0;
    end
    if nargin < 15 || isempty(targetMode)
        targetMode = "endpoint";
    end
    if nargin < 16 || isempty(nearSegmentTau)
        nearSegmentTau = 0.20;
    end
    if nargin < 17 || isempty(nearSegmentMaxPerPair)
        nearSegmentMaxPerPair = 5;
    end
    if nargin < 18 || isempty(decisionInterpCount)
        decisionInterpCount = 5;
    end
    if nargin < 19 || isempty(reconstructionWeight)
        reconstructionWeight = 0;
    end
    if nargin < 20 || isempty(reconstructionHuberDelta)
        reconstructionHuberDelta = 0.10;
    end
    Row = struct( ...
        'variant',string(name), ...
        'archiveParetoFilterMode',string(archiveParetoFilterMode), ...
        'archivePairDirectionMode',string(archivePairDirectionMode), ...
        'archiveSourceCapMode',string(archiveSourceCapMode), ...
        'archivePairRefMode',string(archivePairRefMode), ...
        'trainFilterMode',string(trainFilterMode), ...
        'conditionKNNRetainRatio',double(conditionKNNRetainRatio), ...
        'cganTrainMinRefCov',double(cganTrainMinRefCov), ...
        'cganTrainMinTargetTriples',double(cganTrainMinTargetTriples), ...
        'conditionMode',string(conditionMode), ...
        'targetMode',string(targetMode), ...
        'nearSegmentTau',double(nearSegmentTau), ...
        'nearSegmentMaxPerPair',double(nearSegmentMaxPerPair), ...
        'decisionInterpCount',double(decisionInterpCount), ...
        'targetRealLabelMode',string(targetRealLabelMode), ...
        'generatorMode',string(generatorMode), ...
        'ganCriticMode',string(ganCriticMode), ...
        'generatorLossMode',string(generatorLossMode), ...
        'reconstructionWeight',double(reconstructionWeight), ...
        'reconstructionHuberDelta',double(reconstructionHuberDelta));
end

function Writer = InitArchiveSnapshotWriter_BDG(Control,Problem,runId)
    Writer = struct( ...
        'enabled',false, ...
        'targets',zeros(0,1), ...
        'next',1, ...
        'folder',"", ...
        'manifest_file',"", ...
        'diagnosticEnabled',false, ...
        'diagnosticFolder',"", ...
        'diagnosticManifestFile',"", ...
        'diagnosticConditionCount',0, ...
        'diagnosticZPerCondition',0, ...
        'diagnosticNormalN',0, ...
        'diagnosticSeed',0, ...
        'problem',string(class(Problem)), ...
        'run',double(runId), ...
        'tag',string(Control.archiveSnapshotTag), ...
        'ganN',double(Control.archiveSnapshotGanN));
    targets = NormalizeSnapshotTargets_BDG(Control.archiveSnapshotTargets);
    folder = string(Control.archiveSnapshotFolder);
    if isempty(targets) || strlength(folder) == 0
        return;
    end
    if ~isfolder(char(folder))
        mkdir(char(folder));
    end
    Writer.enabled = true;
    Writer.targets = targets(:);
    Writer.folder = folder;
    Writer.manifest_file = string(fullfile(char(folder), ...
        'archive_snapshot_manifest.csv'));
    WriteCsvHeader_BDG(Writer.manifest_file,ArchiveSnapshotManifestColumns_BDG());
    Writer.diagnosticEnabled = logical(Control.archiveDiagnosticEnabled);
    Writer.diagnosticConditionCount = double( ...
        Control.archiveDiagnosticConditionCount);
    Writer.diagnosticZPerCondition = double( ...
        Control.archiveDiagnosticZPerCondition);
    Writer.diagnosticNormalN = double(Control.archiveDiagnosticNormalN);
    Writer.diagnosticSeed = double(Control.archiveDiagnosticSeed);
    if Writer.diagnosticEnabled
        diagFolder = string(Control.archiveDiagnosticFolder);
        if strlength(diagFolder) == 0
            diagFolder = string(fullfile(char(folder),'gan_diagnostics'));
        end
        if ~isfolder(char(diagFolder))
            mkdir(char(diagFolder));
        end
        Writer.diagnosticFolder = diagFolder;
        Writer.diagnosticManifestFile = string(fullfile(char(diagFolder), ...
            'gan_diagnostic_manifest.csv'));
        WriteCsvHeader_BDG(Writer.diagnosticManifestFile, ...
            GANDiagnosticManifestColumns_BDG());
    end
end

function [Writer,elapsed] = MaybeWriteArchiveSnapshots_BDG( ...
        Writer,Problem,AF,AI,GAN,gen,Population1,Population2)
    tStart = tic;
    elapsed = 0;
    if ~Writer.enabled
        return;
    end
    while Writer.next <= numel(Writer.targets) && ...
            Problem.FE >= Writer.targets(Writer.next)
        targetFE = Writer.targets(Writer.next);
        actualFE = Problem.FE;
        [AFTrain,AITrain,~] = SelectGANTrainingArchive_BDG(AF,AI);
        ConstrainedPop = PopulationSnapshotLayer_BDG(Population1,Problem);
        UnconstrainedPop = PopulationSnapshotLayer_BDG(Population2,Problem);
        GSnapshot = SnapshotGANGenerated_BDG(Problem,GAN,Writer.ganN);
        snapshotFile = WriteArchiveSnapshotFile_BDG( ...
            Writer,Problem,AFTrain,AITrain,GSnapshot, ...
            ConstrainedPop,UnconstrainedPop,targetFE,actualFE,gen);
        AppendCsvRow_BDG(Writer.manifest_file,{ ...
            Writer.problem,Writer.run,targetFE,actualFE,gen, ...
            size(AF.decs,1),size(AI.decs,1), ...
            size(AFTrain.decs,1),size(AITrain.decs,1), ...
            size(ConstrainedPop.decs,1),size(UnconstrainedPop.decs,1), ...
            size(GSnapshot.decs,1),Writer.tag,snapshotFile});
        if Writer.diagnosticEnabled
            [diagSampleFile,diagMetricFile,diagStatus] = ...
                WriteGANDiagnosticSnapshot_BDG(Writer,Problem, ...
                AFTrain,AITrain,GAN,targetFE,actualFE,gen);
            AppendCsvRow_BDG(Writer.diagnosticManifestFile,{ ...
                Writer.problem,Writer.run,targetFE,actualFE,gen, ...
                diagStatus,diagSampleFile,diagMetricFile,Writer.tag});
        end
        Writer.next = Writer.next + 1;
    end
    elapsed = toc(tStart);
end

function snapshotFile = WriteArchiveSnapshotFile_BDG( ...
        Writer,Problem,AFTrain,AITrain,GSnapshot, ...
        ConstrainedPop,UnconstrainedPop,targetFE,actualFE,gen)
    safeProblem = regexprep(char(Writer.problem),'[^A-Za-z0-9_]+','_');
    tagText = char(Writer.tag);
    if strlength(Writer.tag) > 0
        tagText = ['_',regexprep(tagText,'[^A-Za-z0-9_]+','_')];
    end
    snapshotFile = string(fullfile(char(Writer.folder), ...
        sprintf('%s_run%d_targetFE%06d%s_archive_training.csv', ...
        safeProblem,round(Writer.run),round(targetFE),tagText)));
    WriteCsvHeader_BDG(snapshotFile,ArchiveSnapshotColumns_BDG(Problem));
    for i = 1 : size(ConstrainedPop.decs,1)
        AppendCsvRow_BDG(snapshotFile,ArchiveSnapshotRow_BDG( ...
            Writer,Problem,ConstrainedPop,i,targetFE,actualFE,gen, ...
            "constrained_population","constrained_population", ...
            ConstrainedPop.feasible(i)));
    end
    for i = 1 : size(UnconstrainedPop.decs,1)
        AppendCsvRow_BDG(snapshotFile,ArchiveSnapshotRow_BDG( ...
            Writer,Problem,UnconstrainedPop,i,targetFE,actualFE,gen, ...
            "unconstrained_population","unconstrained_population", ...
            UnconstrainedPop.feasible(i)));
    end
    pairN = max(size(AFTrain.decs,1),size(AITrain.decs,1));
    for i = 1 : pairN
        if i <= size(AFTrain.decs,1)
            AppendCsvRow_BDG(snapshotFile,ArchiveSnapshotRow_BDG( ...
                Writer,Problem,AFTrain,i,targetFE,actualFE,gen, ...
                "feasible_endpoint","AF_train",true));
        end
        if i <= size(AITrain.decs,1)
            AppendCsvRow_BDG(snapshotFile,ArchiveSnapshotRow_BDG( ...
                Writer,Problem,AITrain,i,targetFE,actualFE,gen, ...
                "infeasible_endpoint","AI_train",false));
        end
    end
    for i = 1 : size(GSnapshot.decs,1)
        AppendCsvRow_BDG(snapshotFile,ArchiveSnapshotRow_BDG( ...
            Writer,Problem,GSnapshot,i,targetFE,actualFE,gen, ...
            "generated","GAN_generated",GSnapshot.feasible(i)));
    end
end

function Columns = ArchiveSnapshotManifestColumns_BDG()
    Columns = {'problem','run','target_FE','actual_FE','gen', ...
        'AF_archive_size','AI_archive_size','Train_AF_count', ...
        'Train_AI_count','Constrained_population_count', ...
        'Unconstrained_population_count','GAN_generated_count','tag', ...
        'snapshot_file'};
end

function Columns = GANDiagnosticManifestColumns_BDG()
    Columns = {'problem','run','target_FE','actual_FE','gen', ...
        'status','sample_file','metric_file','tag'};
end

function [sampleFile,metricFile,status] = WriteGANDiagnosticSnapshot_BDG( ...
        Writer,Problem,AFTrain,AITrain,GAN,targetFE,actualFE,gen)
    safeProblem = regexprep(char(Writer.problem),'[^A-Za-z0-9_]+','_');
    tagText = char(Writer.tag);
    if strlength(Writer.tag) > 0
        tagText = ['_',regexprep(tagText,'[^A-Za-z0-9_]+','_')];
    end
    prefix = sprintf('%s_run%d_targetFE%06d%s_gan_diagnostic', ...
        safeProblem,round(Writer.run),round(targetFE),tagText);
    sampleFile = string(fullfile(char(Writer.diagnosticFolder), ...
        [prefix,'_samples.csv']));
    metricFile = string(fullfile(char(Writer.diagnosticFolder), ...
        [prefix,'_metrics.csv']));
    WriteCsvHeader_BDG(sampleFile,GANDiagnosticSampleColumns_BDG(Problem));
    WriteCsvHeader_BDG(metricFile,GANDiagnosticMetricColumns_BDG());

    selected = SelectGANDiagnosticConditionIndices_BDG( ...
        GAN,Writer.diagnosticConditionCount);
    status = "ok";
    Normal = EmptyGANDiagnosticModeData_BDG(Problem);
    FixedZ = EmptyGANDiagnosticModeData_BDG(Problem);
    ZSweep = EmptyGANDiagnosticModeData_BDG(Problem);
    if isempty(GAN) || ~isfield(GAN,'netG') || ...
            ~isfield(GAN,'conditionData') || isempty(GAN.conditionData)
        status = "empty_gan";
        AppendCsvRow_BDG(metricFile,GANDiagnosticMetricRow_BDG( ...
            Writer,Problem,targetFE,actualFE,gen,status,selected, ...
            AFTrain,AITrain,Normal,FixedZ,ZSweep));
        return;
    end

    oldFE = Problem.FE;
    rngState = rng;
    cleanup = onCleanup(@()RestoreProblemState_BDG( ...
        Problem,oldFE,rngState)); %#ok<NASGU>
    seed = mod(round(Writer.diagnosticSeed) + ...
        1000003*round(Writer.run) + round(targetFE) + 997*round(gen), ...
        2147483646) + 1;
    rng(seed,'twister');

    try
        normalN = max(0,round(double(Writer.diagnosticNormalN)));
        if normalN > 0
            [S,Diag] = BoundaryGAN_BDG('sample',Problem,GAN,normalN);
            Normal = BuildGANDiagnosticModeData_BDG( ...
                Problem,AFTrain,AITrain,S,Diag, ...
                repmat("normal",normalN,1),(1:normalN)');
            WriteGANDiagnosticSampleRows_BDG(sampleFile,Writer, ...
                Problem,targetFE,actualFE,gen,Normal);
        end

        if ~isempty(selected)
            fixedZ = zeros(numel(selected),max(0,round(double(GAN.zDim))));
            [S,Diag] = BoundaryGAN_BDG('diagnosesample', ...
                Problem,GAN,selected(:),fixedZ);
            FixedZ = BuildGANDiagnosticModeData_BDG( ...
                Problem,AFTrain,AITrain,S,Diag, ...
                repmat("fixed_z",numel(selected),1), ...
                ones(numel(selected),1));
            WriteGANDiagnosticSampleRows_BDG(sampleFile,Writer, ...
                Problem,targetFE,actualFE,gen,FixedZ);

            zPerCondition = max(0,round(double( ...
                Writer.diagnosticZPerCondition)));
            if zPerCondition > 0
                sweepCondition = repelem(selected(:),zPerCondition);
                sweepZ = randn(numel(sweepCondition), ...
                    max(0,round(double(GAN.zDim))));
                zId = repmat((1:zPerCondition)',numel(selected),1);
                [S,Diag] = BoundaryGAN_BDG('diagnosesample', ...
                    Problem,GAN,sweepCondition,sweepZ);
                ZSweep = BuildGANDiagnosticModeData_BDG( ...
                    Problem,AFTrain,AITrain,S,Diag, ...
                    repmat("z_sweep",numel(sweepCondition),1),zId);
                WriteGANDiagnosticSampleRows_BDG(sampleFile,Writer, ...
                    Problem,targetFE,actualFE,gen,ZSweep);
            end
        end
    catch err
        status = "failed:" + string(err.identifier);
    end

    AppendCsvRow_BDG(metricFile,GANDiagnosticMetricRow_BDG( ...
        Writer,Problem,targetFE,actualFE,gen,status,selected, ...
        AFTrain,AITrain,Normal,FixedZ,ZSweep));
end

    Columns = {'problem','run','target_FE','actual_FE','gen', ...
        'mode','condition_index','pair_index','z_id','feasible','own_pair_valid', ...
        'own_obj_seg_dist','own_dec_seg_dist','own_obj_proj_t', ...
        'own_dec_proj_t','own_obj_proj_inside','own_dec_proj_inside', ...
        'nearest_obj_pair_index','own_pair_is_nearest', ...
        'nearest_obj_seg_dist'};
