function FigureManifest = plot_CCMO_GAN_BDG_fixmd_pairt_run_figures( ...
        outRoot,suiteName,runId,targetFE)
% Plot one-run matched FixMD pair+t diagnostic objective comparisons.

    rootDir = fileparts(which('platemo'));
    addpath(genpath(rootDir));
    if nargin < 1 || isempty(outRoot)
        error('plot_CCMO_GAN_BDG_fixmd_pairt_run_figures:MissingOutRoot', ...
            'outRoot is required.');
    end
    if nargin < 2 || isempty(suiteName)
        suiteName = "matched_global_ref_goal10";
    end
    if nargin < 3 || isempty(runId)
        runId = 1;
    end
    if nargin < 4 || isempty(targetFE)
        targetFE = 100000;
    end

    suiteName = string(suiteName);
    runId = round(double(runId));
    targetFE = round(double(targetFE));
    manifestFile = fullfile(outRoot,'suite_manifest.csv');
    if ~isfile(manifestFile)
        error('plot_CCMO_GAN_BDG_fixmd_pairt_run_figures:MissingManifest', ...
            'Missing suite_manifest.csv in %s.',outRoot);
    end

    Manifest = readtable(manifestFile,'TextType','string','Delimiter',',', ...
        'VariableNamingRule','preserve');
    Manifest = Manifest(string(Manifest.suite) == suiteName,:);
    if isempty(Manifest)
        error('plot_CCMO_GAN_BDG_fixmd_pairt_run_figures:MissingSuite', ...
            'Suite %s was not found in %s.',suiteName,manifestFile);
    end
    variants = unique(string(Manifest.variant),'stable');
    problems = manifestProblems_BDG(Manifest);
    figureRoot = fullfile(outRoot,'figures', ...
        sprintf('%s_run%d',safeName_BDG(suiteName),runId));
    if ~isfolder(figureRoot)
        mkdir(figureRoot);
    end

    Rows = repmat(emptyFigureRow_BDG(),0,1);
    for p = 1 : numel(problems)
        problemName = problems(p);
        Panel = repmat(emptyPanelData_BDG(),numel(variants),1);
        for v = 1 : numel(variants)
            rowIdx = manifestRowForProblem_BDG(Manifest,variants(v), ...
                problemName);
            Panel(v) = loadPanelData_BDG(Manifest(rowIdx,:), ...
                problemName,runId,targetFE);
        end
        figureFile = fullfile(figureRoot, ...
            sprintf('%s_run%d_FE%06d_ref_vs_global.png', ...
            safeName_BDG(problemName),runId,targetFE));
        plotProblemComparison_BDG(problemName,variants,Panel, ...
            runId,targetFE,figureFile);
        Rows(end+1,1) = emptyFigureRow_BDG(); %#ok<AGROW>
        Rows(end).suite = suiteName;
        Rows(end).problem = problemName;
        Rows(end).run = runId;
        Rows(end).target_FE = targetFE;
        Rows(end).variant_count = numel(variants);
        Rows(end).figure_file = string(figureFile);
    end

    FigureManifest = struct2table(Rows);
    writetable(FigureManifest,fullfile(figureRoot, ...
        'fixmd_pairt_run_figure_manifest.csv'));
end

function rowIdx = manifestRowForProblem_BDG(Manifest,variant,problemName)
    variantHit = find(string(Manifest.variant) == string(variant));
    rowIdx = [];
    for i = reshape(variantHit,1,[])
        if manifestRowHasProblem_BDG(Manifest(i,:),problemName)
            rowIdx = i;
            return;
        end
    end
    if ~isempty(variantHit)
        rowIdx = variantHit(1);
    else
        error('plot_CCMO_GAN_BDG_fixmd_pairt_run_figures:MissingVariant', ...
            'Variant %s was not found in the manifest.',variant);
    end
end

function flag = manifestRowHasProblem_BDG(Row,problemName)
    vars = string(Row.Properties.VariableNames);
    if ~ismember("problems",vars)
        flag = true;
        return;
    end
    parts = string(strsplit(char(string(Row.problems(1))),';'));
    flag = any(parts == string(problemName));
end

function problems = manifestProblems_BDG(Manifest)
    text = string(Manifest.problems(1));
    parts = string(strsplit(char(text),';'));
    problems = parts(strlength(parts) > 0);
end

function Panel = loadPanelData_BDG(ManifestRow,problemName,runId,targetFE)
    Panel = emptyPanelData_BDG();
    Panel.variant = string(ManifestRow.variant);
    Panel.outDir = string(ManifestRow.outDir);
    taskName = sprintf('%s_run%d',char(problemName),runId);
    snapshotManifest = fullfile(char(Panel.outDir),'snapshots', ...
        taskName,'archive_snapshot_manifest.csv');
    diagnosticManifest = fullfile(char(Panel.outDir),'diagnostics', ...
        taskName,'gan_diagnostic_manifest.csv');
    Panel.snapshot_manifest_file = string(snapshotManifest);
    Panel.diagnostic_manifest_file = string(diagnosticManifest);

    if isfile(snapshotManifest)
        S = readtable(snapshotManifest,'TextType','string','Delimiter',',', ...
            'VariableNamingRule','preserve');
        if ~isempty(S)
            idx = selectTargetRow_BDG(S,targetFE);
            Panel.actual_FE = tableNumber_BDG(S,'actual_FE',idx);
            Panel.gen = tableNumber_BDG(S,'gen',idx);
            Panel.snapshot_file = string(S.snapshot_file(idx));
            if isfile(Panel.snapshot_file)
                Panel.Boundary = readtable(Panel.snapshot_file, ...
                    'TextType','string','Delimiter',',', ...
                    'VariableNamingRule','preserve');
            end
        end
    end

    if isfile(diagnosticManifest)
        D = readtable(diagnosticManifest,'TextType','string', ...
            'Delimiter',',','VariableNamingRule','preserve');
        if ~isempty(D)
            idx = selectTargetRow_BDG(D,targetFE);
            Panel.sample_file = string(D.sample_file(idx));
            if isfile(Panel.sample_file)
                Panel.Samples = readtable(Panel.sample_file, ...
                    'TextType','string','Delimiter',',', ...
                    'VariableNamingRule','preserve');
            end
        end
    end
end

function idx = selectTargetRow_BDG(T,targetFE)
    target = numericColumn_BDG(T,'target_FE');
    if isempty(target)
        idx = height(T);
        return;
    end
    exact = find(round(target) == round(targetFE),1,'last');
    if ~isempty(exact)
        idx = exact;
    else
        [~,idx] = min(abs(target - targetFE));
    end
end

function plotProblemComparison_BDG(problemName,variants,Panel,runId, ...
        targetFE,figureFile)
    ProblemConstructor = str2func(char(problemName));
    Problem = ProblemConstructor('N',100,'maxFE',100000);
    [xLimits,yLimits] = objectiveLimits_BDG(Problem,Panel);

    fig = figure('Visible','off','Color','w','Position',[80 80 1480 660]);
    layout = tiledlayout(fig,1,numel(variants), ...
        'Padding','compact','TileSpacing','compact');
    title(layout,sprintf('%s | run=%d | target FE=%d', ...
        char(problemName),runId,targetFE), ...
        'Interpreter','none','FontWeight','normal');
    for v = 1 : numel(variants)
        ax = nexttile(layout);
        drawPanel_BDG(ax,Problem,Panel(v),xLimits,yLimits);
    end
    exportgraphics(fig,figureFile,'Resolution',300);
    close(fig);
end

function drawPanel_BDG(ax,Problem,Panel,xLimits,yLimits)
    hold(ax,'on');
    set(ax,'FontName','Times New Roman','FontSize',10,'Box','on', ...
        'Layer','top','Color',[0.985 0.96 0.93]);
    plotFeasibleRegion_BDG(ax,Problem);
    plotBoundarySnapshot_BDG(ax,Panel.Boundary,xLimits,yLimits);
    plotDiagnosticSamples_BDG(ax,Panel.Samples,xLimits,yLimits);
    grid(ax,'on');
    ax.GridAlpha = 0.14;
    xlim(ax,xLimits);
    ylim(ax,yLimits);
    xlabel(ax,'f_1');
    ylabel(ax,'f_2');
    title(ax,sprintf('%s | FE=%s | gen=%s',char(Panel.variant), ...
        numberText_BDG(Panel.actual_FE),numberText_BDG(Panel.gen)), ...
        'Interpreter','none','FontWeight','normal','FontSize',11);
    legend(ax,'Location','northeastoutside','Box','off');
    hold(ax,'off');
end

function plotFeasibleRegion_BDG(ax,Problem)
    plot(ax,nan,nan,'s','MarkerSize',8,'MarkerFaceColor',[0.985 0.96 0.93], ...
        'MarkerEdgeColor',[0.76 0.60 0.50], ...
        'DisplayName','Infeasible region');
    PF = Problem.PF;
    if iscell(PF) && numel(PF) >= 3
        X = PF{1};
        Y = PF{2};
        Z = PF{3};
        surf(ax,X,Y,Z,'EdgeColor','none','FaceColor',[0.84 0.93 0.86], ...
            'FaceAlpha',0.62,'DisplayName','Feasible region');
        Mask = double(isfinite(Z));
        if min(Mask(:)) < max(Mask(:))
            contour(ax,X,Y,Mask,[0.5 0.5],'Color',[0.04 0.28 0.42], ...
                'LineWidth',1.5,'DisplayName','Boundary');
        end
        view(ax,[0 90]);
    elseif isnumeric(PF) && size(PF,2) >= 2
        plot(ax,PF(:,1),PF(:,2),'-','Color',[0.04 0.28 0.42], ...
            'LineWidth',1.6,'DisplayName','Reference boundary');
    end
end

function plotBoundarySnapshot_BDG(ax,Boundary,xLimits,yLimits)
    if isempty(Boundary) || height(Boundary) == 0 || ...
            ~all(ismember(["obj1","obj2"],string(Boundary.Properties.VariableNames)))
        text(ax,mean(xLimits),mean(yLimits),'missing snapshot', ...
            'HorizontalAlignment','center','Color',[0.45 0.05 0.05]);
        return;
    end
    Obj = [numericColumn_BDG(Boundary,'obj1'), ...
        numericColumn_BDG(Boundary,'obj2')];
    Role = string(Boundary.archive_role);
    Side = string(Boundary.pair_side);
    inside = insideLimits_BDG(Obj,xLimits,yLimits);
    constrained = Role == "constrained_population";
    unconstrained = Role == "unconstrained_population";
    afTrain = Role == "AF_train" & Side == "feasible_endpoint";
    aiTrain = Role == "AI_train" & Side == "infeasible_endpoint";

    scatter(ax,Obj(constrained & inside,1),Obj(constrained & inside,2), ...
        11,'o','MarkerFaceColor',[0.18 0.42 0.86], ...
        'MarkerEdgeColor','none','MarkerFaceAlpha',0.18, ...
        'DisplayName','Constrained pop');
    scatter(ax,Obj(unconstrained & inside,1),Obj(unconstrained & inside,2), ...
        13,'^','MarkerFaceColor',[0.43 0.25 0.62], ...
        'MarkerEdgeColor','none','MarkerFaceAlpha',0.18, ...
        'DisplayName','Unconstrained pop');
    plotBoundaryPairs_BDG(ax,Boundary,Obj,afTrain,aiTrain,inside);
    scatter(ax,Obj(afTrain & inside,1),Obj(afTrain & inside,2), ...
        28,'s','MarkerFaceColor',[1.00 0.70 0.18], ...
        'MarkerEdgeColor',[0.24 0.14 0.02], ...
        'LineWidth',0.6,'DisplayName','AF endpoint');
    scatter(ax,Obj(aiTrain & inside,1),Obj(aiTrain & inside,2), ...
        30,'d','MarkerFaceColor',[1.00 0.88 0.35], ...
        'MarkerEdgeColor',[0.24 0.14 0.02], ...
        'LineWidth',0.6,'DisplayName','AI endpoint');
end

function plotBoundaryPairs_BDG(ax,Boundary,Obj,afTrain,aiTrain,inside)
    pairIndex = numericColumn_BDG(Boundary,'pair_index');
    if isempty(pairIndex)
        return;
    end
    plot(ax,nan,nan,'-','Color',[0.86 0.46 0.02], ...
        'LineWidth',1.0,'DisplayName','AF-AI pair');
    pairs = unique(pairIndex(afTrain | aiTrain),'stable');
    for p = reshape(pairs,1,[])
        af = find(afTrain & pairIndex == p & inside,1,'first');
        ai = find(aiTrain & pairIndex == p & inside,1,'first');
        if ~isempty(af) && ~isempty(ai)
            plot(ax,Obj([af ai],1),Obj([af ai],2),'-', ...
                'Color',[0.86 0.46 0.02], ...
                'LineWidth',0.65,'HandleVisibility','off');
        end
    end
end

function plotDiagnosticSamples_BDG(ax,Samples,xLimits,yLimits)
    if isempty(Samples) || height(Samples) == 0 || ...
            ~all(ismember(["obj1","obj2","mode"], ...
            string(Samples.Properties.VariableNames)))
        return;
    end
    Obj = [numericColumn_BDG(Samples,'obj1'), ...
        numericColumn_BDG(Samples,'obj2')];
    mode = string(Samples.mode);
    feasible = numericColumn_BDG(Samples,'feasible') > 0;
    inside = insideLimits_BDG(Obj,xLimits,yLimits);
    normal = mode == "normal";
    fixedz = mode == "fixedz";
    zsweep = mode == "zsweep";

    scatter(ax,Obj(normal & feasible & inside,1), ...
        Obj(normal & feasible & inside,2),18,'o', ...
        'MarkerFaceColor',[0.88 0.04 0.08], ...
        'MarkerEdgeColor','none','MarkerFaceAlpha',0.52, ...
        'DisplayName','GAN normal feasible');
    scatter(ax,Obj(normal & ~feasible & inside,1), ...
        Obj(normal & ~feasible & inside,2),16,'x', ...
        'MarkerEdgeColor',[0.65 0.04 0.08], ...
        'LineWidth',0.75,'DisplayName','GAN normal infeasible');
    scatter(ax,Obj(fixedz & inside,1),Obj(fixedz & inside,2), ...
        24,'p','MarkerFaceColor',[0.05 0.55 0.42], ...
        'MarkerEdgeColor',[0.01 0.18 0.14], ...
        'MarkerFaceAlpha',0.60,'LineWidth',0.55, ...
        'DisplayName','GAN fixed-z');
    if any(zsweep & inside)
        scatter(ax,Obj(zsweep & inside,1),Obj(zsweep & inside,2), ...
            10,'.','MarkerEdgeColor',[0.08 0.08 0.08], ...
            'DisplayName','GAN z-sweep');
    end
end

function [xLimits,yLimits] = objectiveLimits_BDG(Problem,Panel)
    X = [];
    Y = [];
    PF = Problem.PF;
    if iscell(PF) && numel(PF) >= 2
        X = [X; PF{1}(:)];
        Y = [Y; PF{2}(:)];
    elseif isnumeric(PF) && size(PF,2) >= 2
        X = [X; PF(:,1)];
        Y = [Y; PF(:,2)];
    end
    for i = 1 : numel(Panel)
        if ~isempty(Panel(i).Boundary) && height(Panel(i).Boundary) > 0
            X = [X; numericColumn_BDG(Panel(i).Boundary,'obj1')]; %#ok<AGROW>
            Y = [Y; numericColumn_BDG(Panel(i).Boundary,'obj2')]; %#ok<AGROW>
        end
        if ~isempty(Panel(i).Samples) && height(Panel(i).Samples) > 0
            X = [X; numericColumn_BDG(Panel(i).Samples,'obj1')]; %#ok<AGROW>
            Y = [Y; numericColumn_BDG(Panel(i).Samples,'obj2')]; %#ok<AGROW>
        end
    end
    xLimits = finiteLimits_BDG(X);
    yLimits = finiteLimits_BDG(Y);
end

function limits = finiteLimits_BDG(x)
    x = double(x(:));
    x = x(isfinite(x));
    if isempty(x)
        limits = [0 1];
        return;
    end
    lo = min(x);
    hi = max(x);
    if lo == hi
        pad = max(1,abs(lo)) * 0.05;
    else
        pad = (hi - lo) * 0.06;
    end
    limits = [lo - pad, hi + pad];
end

function inside = insideLimits_BDG(Obj,xLimits,yLimits)
    inside = isfinite(Obj(:,1)) & isfinite(Obj(:,2)) & ...
        Obj(:,1) >= xLimits(1) & Obj(:,1) <= xLimits(2) & ...
        Obj(:,2) >= yLimits(1) & Obj(:,2) <= yLimits(2);
end

function value = tableNumber_BDG(T,name,idx)
    values = numericColumn_BDG(T,name);
    if isempty(values) || idx > numel(values)
        value = NaN;
    else
        value = double(values(idx));
    end
end

function values = numericColumn_BDG(T,name)
    vars = string(T.Properties.VariableNames);
    if isempty(T) || ~ismember(string(name),vars)
        values = zeros(height(T),1);
        return;
    end
    values = T.(char(name));
    if iscell(values)
        values = str2double(string(values));
    elseif isstring(values) || ischar(values)
        values = str2double(string(values));
    else
        values = double(values);
    end
    values = values(:);
end

function text = numberText_BDG(x)
    if ~isfinite(x)
        text = 'NA';
    else
        text = char(string(round(double(x))));
    end
end

function name = safeName_BDG(value)
    name = regexprep(char(string(value)),'[^A-Za-z0-9_=-]+','_');
end

function Row = emptyFigureRow_BDG()
    Row = struct('suite',"",'problem',"",'run',NaN,'target_FE',NaN, ...
        'variant_count',NaN,'figure_file',"");
end

function Panel = emptyPanelData_BDG()
    Panel = struct('variant',"",'outDir',"", ...
        'snapshot_manifest_file',"",'diagnostic_manifest_file',"", ...
        'snapshot_file',"",'sample_file',"", ...
        'actual_FE',NaN,'gen',NaN,'Boundary',table(),'Samples',table());
end

function [Summary,outDir,ImageManifest] = run_CCMO_GAN_BDG_archive_objective_snapshots( ...
        outDir,workerCount,problemNames,N,D,maxFE,runId,targets, ...
        algorithmParams,variantSet)
% Compatibility wrapper: run the unified experiment entry with plotting on.

    rootDir = fileparts(which('platemo'));

            ['archive_objective_snapshots_', ...

    if nargin < 2 || isempty(workerCount)
        workerCount = 6;
    end

        problemNames = [];
    end

    end
    if nargin < 5

        targets = [10000 30000 50000 70000 100000];
    end
    if nargin < 9
        algorithmParams = [];
    end
    if nargin < 10 || isempty(variantSet)
        variantSet = "default";
    end

    plotOptions = struct( ...
        'enable',true, ...
        'targets',targets, ...
        'snapshotOutDir',outDir);
    fullscopeOutDir = fullfile(outDir,'fullscope');
    [Summary,~,ImageManifest] = ...
        run_CCMO_GAN_BDG_archive_pareto_filters_fullscope( ...
        fullscopeOutDir,workerCount,problemNames,N,D,maxFE,runId, ...

====================================================================================================
FILE: Algorithms/Multi-objective optimization/CCMO-GAN-BDG/Support/run_CCMO_GAN_BDG_archive_pareto_filters_fullscope.m | bytes=71183
====================================================================================================
function [Summary,outDir,ImageManifest] = run_CCMO_GAN_BDG_archive_pareto_filters_fullscope( ...
        outDir,workerCount,problemNames,N,D,maxFE,runIds,variantSet, ...
        algorithmParams,plotOptions)
% Run the A1 mainline and the single A2 branch. Plotting is opt-in.

    rootDir = fileparts(which('platemo'));
    if nargin < 1 || isempty(outDir)
        outDir = fullfile(rootDir,'Data','CCMO_GAN_BDG', ...
            ['archive_pareto_filters_fullscope_', ...
            char(datetime('now','Format','yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'))]);
    end
    if nargin < 2 || isempty(workerCount)
        workerCount = 6;
    end
    if nargin < 3 || isempty(problemNames)
        problemNames = defaultProblemList();
    end
    if nargin < 4 || isempty(N)
        N = 100;
    end
    if nargin < 5
        D = [];
    end
    if nargin < 6 || isempty(maxFE)
        maxFE = 100000;
    end
    if nargin < 7 || isempty(runIds)
        runIds = 1 : 3;
    end
    if nargin < 8 || isempty(variantSet)
        variantSet = "default";
    end
    if nargin < 9
        algorithmParams = [];
    end
    if nargin < 10
        plotOptions = [];
    end

    addpath(genpath(rootDir));
    problemNames = cellstr(string(problemNames(:)));
    runIds = double(runIds(:)');
    workerCount = max(1,round(double(workerCount)));
    algorithmParams = normalizeAlgorithmParams(algorithmParams,N);
    plotOptions = normalizePlotOptions(plotOptions,outDir);
    Variants = archiveParetoVariants(variantSet);
    Tasks = buildTasks(problemNames,runIds,Variants);

    if ~isfolder(outDir)
        mkdir(outDir);
    end

    fprintf('archive_pareto_filters_fullscope outDir=%s\n',outDir);
    fprintf('tasks=%d problems x %d runs x %d variants, N=%d, D=%s, maxFE=%d, workers=%d\n', ...
        numel(problemNames),numel(runIds),height(Variants),N, ...
        defaultDText(D),maxFE,workerCount);

    Rows = repmat(emptyRunRow(),height(Tasks),1);
    if workerCount > 1
        ensureParallelPool(workerCount);
        parfor task = 1 : height(Tasks)
            Rows(task) = completeRunRow(runOneTask(Tasks(task,:),N,D, ...
                maxFE,algorithmParams,plotOptions));
        end
    else
        for task = 1 : height(Tasks)
            Rows(task) = completeRunRow(runOneTask(Tasks(task,:),N,D, ...
                maxFE,algorithmParams,plotOptions));
            fprintf('[%d/%d] %s %s run=%g status=%s\n', ...
                task,height(Tasks),Tasks.variant(task), ...
                Tasks.problem(task),Tasks.run(task),Rows(task).status);
        end
    end

    Summary = struct2table(Rows);
    writetable(Summary,fullfile(outDir,'archive_pareto_filter_run_summary.csv'));
    writeSummaries(Summary,outDir);
    writeStageSummaries(Summary,outDir);
    ImageManifest = table();
    if plotOptions.enable
        writetable(Summary,fullfile(plotOptions.outDir, ...
            'archive_snapshot_run_summary.csv'));
        ImageManifest = plotSnapshotImages(Summary,N,D,maxFE, ...
            plotOptions.figureRoot);
        writetable(ImageManifest,fullfile(plotOptions.outDir, ...
            'archive_snapshot_image_manifest.csv'));
    end
end

function Row = completeRunRow(Source)
    Row = emptyRunRow();
    names = intersect(fieldnames(Source),fieldnames(Row),'stable');
    for i = 1 : numel(names)
        Row.(names{i}) = Source.(names{i});
    end
end

function Variants = archiveParetoVariants(variantSet)
    if istable(variantSet)
        Variants = validateRetainedVariants(variantSet);
        return;
    elseif isstruct(variantSet)
        Variants = validateRetainedVariants(struct2table(variantSet));
        return;
    end
    variantSet = lower(strtrim(string(variantSet)));
    switch variantSet
        case {"default","current","fixmd_global", ...
                "fixmd_gndk60_nearseg_huber_z0"}
            specs = {retainedVariantRow("FixMD_GNDk60_nearseg_huber_z0")};
        otherwise
            error('run_CCMO_GAN_BDG_archive_pareto_filters_fullscope:BadVariantSet', ...
                'Unknown variantSet "%s".',variantSet);
    end
    Variants = validateRetainedVariants(struct2table(vertcat(specs{:})));
end

function Variants = validateRetainedVariants(Variants)
    required = ["variant","archiveParetoFilterMode", ...
        "archivePairDirectionMode","generatorMode"];
    missing = setdiff(required,string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames));
    assert(isempty(missing), ...
        'run_CCMO_GAN_BDG_archive_pareto_filters_fullscope:BadVariantTable', ...
        'Variant table missing required columns: %s',strjoin(missing,", "));

    if ~ismember("ganCriticMode",string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.ganCriticMode = repmat("af_like",height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("generatorLossMode",string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.generatorLossMode = repmat("adversarial",height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("archiveSourceCapMode",string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.archiveSourceCapMode = repmat("limited",height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("archivePairRefMode",string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.archivePairRefMode = repmat("none",height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("trainFilterMode",string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.trainFilterMode = repmat("none",height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("conditionKNNRetainRatio", ...
            string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.conditionKNNRetainRatio = repmat(0.70,height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("cganTrainMinRefCov", ...
            string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.cganTrainMinRefCov = repmat(0.00,height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("cganTrainMinTargetTriples", ...
            string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.cganTrainMinTargetTriples = repmat(0,height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("conditionMode",string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.conditionMode = repmat("yt_dt",height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("targetRealLabelMode",string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.targetRealLabelMode = repmat("binary",height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("targetMode",string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.targetMode = repmat("endpoint",height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("nearSegmentTau",string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.nearSegmentTau = repmat(0.20,height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("nearSegmentMaxPerPair",string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.nearSegmentMaxPerPair = repmat(5,height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("decisionInterpCount",string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.decisionInterpCount = repmat(5,height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("reconstructionWeight",string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.reconstructionWeight = repmat(0,height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("reconstructionHuberDelta",string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.reconstructionHuberDelta = repmat(0.10,height(Variants),1);
    end
    Variants = Variants(:,cellstr([required,"archiveSourceCapMode", ...
        "archivePairRefMode","trainFilterMode","conditionKNNRetainRatio", ...
        "cganTrainMinRefCov","cganTrainMinTargetTriples", ...
        "conditionMode","targetMode","nearSegmentTau", ...
        "nearSegmentMaxPerPair","decisionInterpCount", ...
        "targetRealLabelMode","ganCriticMode", ...
        "generatorLossMode","reconstructionWeight", ...
        "reconstructionHuberDelta"]));
    Variants.variant = string(Variants.variant);
    Variants.archiveParetoFilterMode = lower(strtrim( ...
        string(Variants.archiveParetoFilterMode)));
    Variants.archivePairDirectionMode = lower(strtrim( ...
        string(Variants.archivePairDirectionMode)));
    Variants.archiveSourceCapMode = lower(strtrim( ...
        string(Variants.archiveSourceCapMode)));
    Variants.archivePairRefMode = lower(strtrim( ...
        string(Variants.archivePairRefMode)));
    Variants.trainFilterMode = lower(strtrim( ...
        string(Variants.trainFilterMode)));
    Variants.conditionKNNRetainRatio = min(max( ...
        double(Variants.conditionKNNRetainRatio),0),1);
    Variants.cganTrainMinRefCov = min(max( ...
        double(Variants.cganTrainMinRefCov),0),1);
    Variants.cganTrainMinTargetTriples = max(0,round( ...
        double(Variants.cganTrainMinTargetTriples)));
    Variants.conditionMode = lower(strtrim(string(Variants.conditionMode)));
    Variants.targetMode = lower(strtrim(string(Variants.targetMode)));
    Variants.nearSegmentTau = max(0,double(Variants.nearSegmentTau));
    Variants.nearSegmentMaxPerPair = max(1,round(double( ...
        Variants.nearSegmentMaxPerPair)));
    Variants.decisionInterpCount = max(2,round(double( ...
        Variants.decisionInterpCount)));
    Variants.targetRealLabelMode = lower(strtrim( ...
        string(Variants.targetRealLabelMode)));
    Variants.generatorMode = lower(strtrim(string(Variants.generatorMode)));
    Variants.ganCriticMode = lower(strtrim(string(Variants.ganCriticMode)));
    Variants.generatorLossMode = lower(strtrim( ...
        string(Variants.generatorLossMode)));
    Variants.reconstructionWeight = max(0,double( ...
        Variants.reconstructionWeight));
    Variants.reconstructionHuberDelta = max(eps,double( ...
        Variants.reconstructionHuberDelta));

    Retained = retainedVariantSpecs();
    ok = false(height(Variants),1);
    for i = 1 : height(Variants)
        idx = find(Retained.variant == Variants.variant(i),1,'first');
        ok(i) = ~isempty(idx) && ...
            Variants.archiveParetoFilterMode(i) == Retained.archiveParetoFilterMode(idx) && ...
            Variants.archivePairDirectionMode(i) == Retained.archivePairDirectionMode(idx) && ...
            Variants.archiveSourceCapMode(i) == Retained.archiveSourceCapMode(idx) && ...
            Variants.archivePairRefMode(i) == Retained.archivePairRefMode(idx) && ...
            Variants.trainFilterMode(i) == Retained.trainFilterMode(idx) && ...
            abs(Variants.conditionKNNRetainRatio(i) - ...
                Retained.conditionKNNRetainRatio(idx)) < 1e-12 && ...
            abs(Variants.cganTrainMinRefCov(i) - ...
                Retained.cganTrainMinRefCov(idx)) < 1e-12 && ...
            Variants.cganTrainMinTargetTriples(i) == ...
                Retained.cganTrainMinTargetTriples(idx) && ...
            Variants.conditionMode(i) == Retained.conditionMode(idx) && ...
            Variants.targetMode(i) == Retained.targetMode(idx) && ...
            abs(Variants.nearSegmentTau(i) - ...
                Retained.nearSegmentTau(idx)) < 1e-12 && ...
            Variants.nearSegmentMaxPerPair(i) == ...
                Retained.nearSegmentMaxPerPair(idx) && ...
            Variants.decisionInterpCount(i) == ...
                Retained.decisionInterpCount(idx) && ...
            Variants.targetRealLabelMode(i) == Retained.targetRealLabelMode(idx) && ...
            Variants.generatorMode(i) == Retained.generatorMode(idx) && ...
            Variants.ganCriticMode(i) == Retained.ganCriticMode(idx) && ...
            Variants.generatorLossMode(i) == Retained.generatorLossMode(idx) && ...
            abs(Variants.reconstructionWeight(i) - ...
                Retained.reconstructionWeight(idx)) < 1e-12 && ...
            abs(Variants.reconstructionHuberDelta(i) - ...
                Retained.reconstructionHuberDelta(idx)) < 1e-12;
    end
    assert(all(ok), ...
        'run_CCMO_GAN_BDG_archive_pareto_filters_fullscope:UnsupportedVariant', ...
        'Only retained variants are supported: %s.', ...
        strjoin(Retained.variant,", "));
end

function Variants = retainedVariantSpecs()
    Rows = [ ...
        retainedVariantRow("FixMD_GNDk60_nearseg_huber_z0")];
    Variants = struct2table(Rows);
end

function Row = retainedVariantRow(name)
    switch string(name)
        case "FixMD_GNDk60_nearseg_huber_z0"
            Row = variantRow(name,"global_af_nd","af_not_dominates_ai", ...
                "none","neighbor4","objective_target_conditioned", ...
                "target_conditioned","conditional_adversarial_huber", ...
                "condition_knn","yt_dt_t_ref","binary",0.60,0.00,0, ...
                "near_segment_feasible",0.20,5,5,250,0.10);
        otherwise
            error('run_CCMO_GAN_BDG_archive_pareto_filters_fullscope:UnknownRetainedVariant', ...
                'Unknown retained variant "%s".',name);
    end
end

function Row = variantRow(name,archiveParetoFilterMode, ...
        archivePairDirectionMode,archiveSourceCapMode,archivePairRefMode, ...
        generatorMode,ganCriticMode,generatorLossMode,trainFilterMode, ...
        conditionMode,targetRealLabelMode,conditionKNNRetainRatio, ...
        cganTrainMinRefCov,cganTrainMinTargetTriples,targetMode, ...
        nearSegmentTau,nearSegmentMaxPerPair,decisionInterpCount, ...
        reconstructionWeight,reconstructionHuberDelta)
    if nargin < 12 || isempty(conditionKNNRetainRatio)
        conditionKNNRetainRatio = 0.70;
    end
    if nargin < 13 || isempty(cganTrainMinRefCov)
        cganTrainMinRefCov = 0.00;
    end
    if nargin < 14 || isempty(cganTrainMinTargetTriples)
        cganTrainMinTargetTriples = 0;
    end
    if nargin < 15 || isempty(targetMode)
        targetMode = "endpoint";
    end
    if nargin < 16 || isempty(nearSegmentTau)
        nearSegmentTau = 0.20;
    end
    if nargin < 17 || isempty(nearSegmentMaxPerPair)
        nearSegmentMaxPerPair = 5;
    end
    if nargin < 18 || isempty(decisionInterpCount)
        decisionInterpCount = 5;
    end
    if nargin < 19 || isempty(reconstructionWeight)
        reconstructionWeight = 0;
    end
    if nargin < 20 || isempty(reconstructionHuberDelta)
        reconstructionHuberDelta = 0.10;
    end
    Row = struct( ...
        'variant',string(name), ...
        'archiveParetoFilterMode',string(archiveParetoFilterMode), ...
        'archivePairDirectionMode',string(archivePairDirectionMode), ...
        'archiveSourceCapMode',string(archiveSourceCapMode), ...
        'archivePairRefMode',string(archivePairRefMode), ...
        'trainFilterMode',string(trainFilterMode), ...
        'conditionKNNRetainRatio',double(conditionKNNRetainRatio), ...
        'cganTrainMinRefCov',double(cganTrainMinRefCov), ...
        'cganTrainMinTargetTriples',double(cganTrainMinTargetTriples), ...
        'conditionMode',string(conditionMode), ...
        'targetMode',string(targetMode), ...
        'nearSegmentTau',double(nearSegmentTau), ...
        'nearSegmentMaxPerPair',double(nearSegmentMaxPerPair), ...
        'decisionInterpCount',double(decisionInterpCount), ...
        'targetRealLabelMode',string(targetRealLabelMode), ...
        'generatorMode',string(generatorMode), ...
        'ganCriticMode',string(ganCriticMode), ...
        'generatorLossMode',string(generatorLossMode), ...
        'reconstructionWeight',double(reconstructionWeight), ...
        'reconstructionHuberDelta',double(reconstructionHuberDelta));
end

function Tasks = buildTasks(problemNames,runIds,Variants)
    count = numel(problemNames) * numel(runIds) * height(Variants);
    Rows = repmat(emptyTaskRow(),count,1);
    k = 0;
    for v = 1 : height(Variants)
        VariantRow = table2struct(Variants(v,:));
        fields = fieldnames(VariantRow);
        for p = 1 : numel(problemNames)
            for r = 1 : numel(runIds)
                k = k + 1;
                for f = 1 : numel(fields)
                    Rows(k).(fields{f}) = VariantRow.(fields{f});
                end
                Rows(k).variant_index = v;
                Rows(k).problem = string(problemNames{p});
                Rows(k).run = runIds(r);
            end
        end
    end
    Tasks = struct2table(Rows);
end

function Row = runOneTask(Task,N,D,maxFE,algorithmParams,plotOptions)
    Row = emptyRunRow();
    Row.variant = string(Task.variant);
    Row.archiveParetoFilterMode = string(Task.archiveParetoFilterMode);
    Row.archivePairDirectionMode = string(Task.archivePairDirectionMode);
    Row.archiveSourceCapMode = string(Task.archiveSourceCapMode);
    Row.archivePairRefMode = string(Task.archivePairRefMode);
    Row.trainFilterMode = string(Task.trainFilterMode);
    Row.conditionKNNRetainRatio = double(Task.conditionKNNRetainRatio);
    Row.cganTrainMinRefCov = double(Task.cganTrainMinRefCov);
    Row.cganTrainMinTargetTriples = double(Task.cganTrainMinTargetTriples);
    Row.conditionMode = string(Task.conditionMode);
    Row.targetMode = string(Task.targetMode);
    Row.nearSegmentTau = double(Task.nearSegmentTau);
    Row.nearSegmentMaxPerPair = double(Task.nearSegmentMaxPerPair);
    Row.decisionInterpCount = double(Task.decisionInterpCount);
    Row.targetRealLabelMode = string(Task.targetRealLabelMode);
    Row.generatorMode = string(Task.generatorMode);
    Row.ganCriticMode = string(Task.ganCriticMode);
    Row.generatorLossMode = string(Task.generatorLossMode);
    Row.reconstructionWeight = double(Task.reconstructionWeight);
    Row.reconstructionHuberDelta = double(Task.reconstructionHuberDelta);
    Row.problem = string(Task.problem);
    Row.family = problemFamily(Row.problem);
    Row.run = double(Task.run);
    Row.seed = double(Task.run);
    Row.trainFilterRandomSeed = Row.seed;
    Row.N = double(N);
    Row.maxFE = double(maxFE);
    Row = attachAlgorithmParams(Row,algorithmParams);
    Row.target_text = strjoin(string(plotOptions.targets),';');

    try
        rootDir = fileparts(which('platemo'));
        addpath(genpath(rootDir));
        rng(Row.seed,'twister');
        ProblemConstructor = str2func(char(Row.problem));
        if isempty(D)
            Problem = ProblemConstructor('N',N,'maxFE',maxFE);
        else
            Problem = ProblemConstructor('N',N,'D',D,'maxFE',maxFE);
        end
        Row.D = double(Problem.D);

        Control = experimentControl(Row,plotOptions);
        plotThisTask = shouldPlotTask(Row,plotOptions);
        if plotThisTask
            Row.snapshot_folder = string(fullfile(plotOptions.snapshotRoot, ...
                safeName(Row.variant),sprintf('%s_run%d', ...
                char(Row.problem),round(Row.run))));
            Row.snapshot_manifest_file = string(fullfile( ...
                char(Row.snapshot_folder),'archive_snapshot_manifest.csv'));
            Control.archiveSnapshotFolder = Row.snapshot_folder;
            Control.archiveSnapshotTag = Row.variant;
            if ~isfolder(char(Row.snapshot_folder))
                mkdir(char(Row.snapshot_folder));
            end
        end
        setappdata(0,'CCMO_GAN_BDG_ExperimentControl',Control);
        cleanup = onCleanup(@()rmappdataIfPresent()); %#ok<NASGU>

        Algorithm = CCMO_GAN_BDG( ...
            'save',0, ...
            'run',Row.run, ...
            'metName',{'IGD','HV','Feasible_rate'}, ...
            'outputFcn',@(varargin)[], ...
            'parameter',algorithmParams);
        Algorithm.Solve(Problem);

        Row.runtime = double(Algorithm.metric.runtime);
        Row.core_metrics_file = string(Algorithm.metric.analysis_core_csv);
        Row.stage_metrics_file = string(Algorithm.metric.analysis_stage_csv);
        Row.IGD = lastValue(Algorithm.CalMetric('IGD'));
        Row.HV = lastValue(Algorithm.CalMetric('HV'));
        Row.Feasible_rate = lastValue(Algorithm.CalMetric('Feasible_rate'));
        Row.finalFE = double(Algorithm.result{end,1});
        FinalPop = Algorithm.result{end,2};
        [Row.finalPopCount,Row.finalFeasibleCount, ...
            Row.finalFeasibleRateManual,Row.finalBestCount] = ...
            finalPopulationCounts(FinalPop);
        Row = attachArchiveFilterFinalMetrics(Row, ...
            Algorithm.metric.analysis_core_csv);
        if plotThisTask && isfile(Row.snapshot_manifest_file)
            Manifest = readtable(Row.snapshot_manifest_file, ...
                'TextType','string','Delimiter',',');
            Row.snapshot_count = height(Manifest);
        end
        Row.status = "ok";
    catch err
        Row.status = "failed";
        Row.error_message = string(getReport(err,'extended','hyperlinks','off'));
    end
end

function writeStageSummaries(Summary,outDir)
    All = table();
    for i = 1 : height(Summary)
        if string(Summary.status(i)) ~= "ok"
            continue;
        end
        if ~ismember('stage_metrics_file',Summary.Properties.VariableNames)
            continue;
        end
        stageFile = string(Summary.stage_metrics_file(i));
        if strlength(stageFile) == 0 || ~isfile(stageFile)
            continue;
        end
        Stage = readtable(stageFile,'TextType','string');
        if isempty(Stage)
            continue;
        end
        n = height(Stage);
        Meta = table( ...
            repmat(string(Summary.variant(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(string(Summary.archiveParetoFilterMode(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(string(Summary.archivePairDirectionMode(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(string(Summary.archiveSourceCapMode(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(string(Summary.archivePairRefMode(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(string(Summary.trainFilterMode(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(double(Summary.conditionKNNRetainRatio(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(double(Summary.cganTrainMinRefCov(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(double(Summary.cganTrainMinTargetTriples(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(string(Summary.conditionMode(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(string(Summary.targetMode(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(double(Summary.nearSegmentTau(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(double(Summary.nearSegmentMaxPerPair(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(double(Summary.decisionInterpCount(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(string(Summary.targetRealLabelMode(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(string(Summary.generatorMode(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(string(Summary.ganCriticMode(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(string(Summary.generatorLossMode(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(double(Summary.reconstructionWeight(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(double(Summary.reconstructionHuberDelta(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(string(Summary.problem(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(string(Summary.family(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(double(Summary.run(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(double(Summary.seed(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(double(Summary.N(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(double(Summary.D(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(double(Summary.maxFE(i)),n,1), ...
            'VariableNames',{'variant','archiveParetoFilterMode', ...
            'archivePairDirectionMode','archiveSourceCapMode', ...
            'archivePairRefMode','trainFilterMode', ...
            'conditionKNNRetainRatio','cganTrainMinRefCov', ...
            'cganTrainMinTargetTriples','conditionMode', ...
            'targetMode','nearSegmentTau','nearSegmentMaxPerPair', ...
            'decisionInterpCount','targetRealLabelMode','generatorMode', ...
            'ganCriticMode','generatorLossMode', ...
            'reconstructionWeight','reconstructionHuberDelta', ...
            'problem','family','run','seed','N','D','maxFE'});
        All = [All;Meta,Stage]; %#ok<AGROW>
    end

    writetable(All,fullfile(outDir,'stage_raw_gan_metrics.csv'));
    if isempty(All)
        writetable(table(),fullfile(outDir, ...
            'stage_raw_gan_metrics_by_variant_fe.csv'));
        writetable(table(),fullfile(outDir, ...
            'stage_raw_gan_metrics_by_problem_fe.csv'));
        return;
    end

    numericMask = varfun(@isnumeric,All,'OutputFormat','uniform');
    numericVars = All.Properties.VariableNames(numericMask);
    metricVars = setdiff(numericVars, ...
        {'run','seed','N','D','maxFE','conditionKNNRetainRatio', ...
        'cganTrainMinRefCov','cganTrainMinTargetTriples', ...
        'nearSegmentTau','nearSegmentMaxPerPair','decisionInterpCount', ...
        'reconstructionWeight','reconstructionHuberDelta', ...
        'target_FE','actual_FE','gen'}, ...
        'stable');

    ByVariantFE = groupsummary(All, ...
        {'variant','archiveParetoFilterMode','archivePairDirectionMode', ...
        'archiveSourceCapMode','archivePairRefMode', ...
        'trainFilterMode','conditionKNNRetainRatio', ...
        'cganTrainMinRefCov','cganTrainMinTargetTriples', ...
        'conditionMode','targetMode','nearSegmentTau', ...
        'nearSegmentMaxPerPair','decisionInterpCount', ...
        'targetRealLabelMode', ...
        'generatorMode','ganCriticMode','generatorLossMode', ...
        'reconstructionWeight','reconstructionHuberDelta', ...
        'target_FE'}, ...
        'mean',metricVars);
    ByProblemFE = groupsummary(All, ...
        {'variant','archiveParetoFilterMode','archivePairDirectionMode', ...
        'archiveSourceCapMode','archivePairRefMode', ...
        'trainFilterMode','conditionKNNRetainRatio', ...
        'cganTrainMinRefCov','cganTrainMinTargetTriples', ...
        'conditionMode','targetMode','nearSegmentTau', ...
        'nearSegmentMaxPerPair','decisionInterpCount', ...
        'targetRealLabelMode', ...
        'generatorMode','ganCriticMode','generatorLossMode', ...
        'reconstructionWeight','reconstructionHuberDelta', ...
        'problem','target_FE'}, ...
        'mean',metricVars);
    writetable(ByVariantFE,fullfile(outDir, ...
        'stage_raw_gan_metrics_by_variant_fe.csv'));
    writetable(ByProblemFE,fullfile(outDir, ...
        'stage_raw_gan_metrics_by_problem_fe.csv'));
end

function Plot = normalizePlotOptions(Options,outDir)
    Plot = struct( ...
        'enable',false, ...
        'targets',zeros(0,1), ...
        'outDir',"", ...
        'snapshotRoot',"", ...
        'figureRoot',"", ...
        'ganN',100, ...
        'plotRuns',zeros(0,1), ...
        'plotVariants',strings(0,1));
    if isempty(Options)
        return;
    end
    if islogical(Options) || isnumeric(Options)
        Plot.enable = logical(Options);
    elseif isstruct(Options)
        Plot.enable = optionValue(Options, ...
            {'enable','enabled','plotSnapshots'},false);
        Plot.targets = optionValue(Options, ...
            {'targets','snapshotTargets'},zeros(0,1));
        Plot.outDir = string(optionValue(Options, ...
            {'outDir','snapshotOutDir'}, ...
            fullfile(outDir,'archive_objective_snapshots')));
        Plot.figureRoot = string(optionValue(Options, ...
            {'figureRoot','figureOutDir'}, ""));
        Plot.ganN = optionValue(Options,{'ganN','snapshotGanN'},100);
        Plot.plotRuns = optionValue(Options, ...
            {'plotRuns','snapshotRuns'},zeros(0,1));
        Plot.plotVariants = optionValue(Options, ...
            {'plotVariants','snapshotVariants'},strings(0,1));
    else
        error('run_CCMO_GAN_BDG_archive_pareto_filters_fullscope:BadPlotOptions', ...
            'plotOptions must be empty, logical, numeric, or a struct.');
    end
    Plot.targets = unique(round(double(Plot.targets(:)')),'stable');
    Plot.targets = Plot.targets(isfinite(Plot.targets) & Plot.targets > 0);
    if ~isempty(Plot.targets)
        Plot.enable = true;
    elseif Plot.enable
        Plot.targets = [10000 30000 50000 70000 100000];
    end
    Plot.ganN = max(0,round(double(Plot.ganN)));
    Plot.plotRuns = unique(round(double(Plot.plotRuns(:)')),'stable');
    Plot.plotRuns = Plot.plotRuns(isfinite(Plot.plotRuns) & Plot.plotRuns > 0);
    Plot.plotVariants = string(Plot.plotVariants(:));
    Plot.plotVariants = Plot.plotVariants(strlength(Plot.plotVariants) > 0);
    if Plot.enable
        if strlength(Plot.outDir) == 0
            Plot.outDir = string(fullfile(outDir,'archive_objective_snapshots'));
        end
        Plot.snapshotRoot = string(fullfile(char(Plot.outDir),'snapshots'));
        if strlength(Plot.figureRoot) == 0
            Plot.figureRoot = string(fullfile(char(Plot.outDir),'figures'));
        end
        if ~isfolder(char(Plot.snapshotRoot))
            mkdir(char(Plot.snapshotRoot));
        end
        if ~isfolder(char(Plot.figureRoot))
            mkdir(char(Plot.figureRoot));
        end
    end
end

function flag = shouldPlotTask(Row,Plot)
    flag = logical(Plot.enable);
    if ~flag
        return;
    end
    if ~isempty(Plot.plotRuns) && ~ismember(double(Row.run),Plot.plotRuns)
        flag = false;
        return;
    end
    if ~isempty(Plot.plotVariants) && ...
            ~ismember(string(Row.variant),Plot.plotVariants)
        flag = false;
    end
end

function value = optionValue(Options,names,defaultValue)
    value = defaultValue;
    for i = 1 : numel(names)
        name = char(names{i});
        if isfield(Options,name) && ~isempty(Options.(name))
            value = Options.(name);
            return;
        end
    end
end

    Control = struct( ...

        'trainFilterRandomSeed',Row.trainFilterRandomSeed, ...

        'nearSegmentMaxPerPair',Row.nearSegmentMaxPerPair, ...
        'decisionInterpCount',Row.decisionInterpCount, ...
        'targetRealLabelMode',Row.targetRealLabelMode, ...
        'generatorMode',Row.generatorMode, ...
        'ganCriticMode',Row.ganCriticMode, ...
        'generatorLossMode',Row.generatorLossMode, ...

end

function ImageManifest = plotSnapshotImages(Summary,N,D,maxFE,figureRoot)
    Rows = repmat(emptyImageRow(),0,1);
    count = 0;
    for s = 1 : height(Summary)
        if string(Summary.status(s)) ~= "ok" || ...
                ~isfile(string(Summary.snapshot_manifest_file(s)))
            continue;
        end
        variant = string(Summary.variant(s));
        archiveParetoFilterMode = string(Summary.archiveParetoFilterMode(s));
        archivePairDirectionMode = string(Summary.archivePairDirectionMode(s));
        generatorMode = string(Summary.generatorMode(s));
        ganCriticMode = string(Summary.ganCriticMode(s));
        generatorLossMode = string(Summary.generatorLossMode(s));
        problemName = char(Summary.problem(s));
        runId = double(Summary.run(s));
        ProblemConstructor = str2func(problemName);
        if isempty(D)
            Problem = ProblemConstructor('N',N,'maxFE',maxFE);
        else
            Problem = ProblemConstructor('N',N,'D',D,'maxFE',maxFE);
        end
        Manifest = readtable(Summary.snapshot_manifest_file(s), ...
            'TextType','string','Delimiter',',');
        Boundaries = cell(height(Manifest),1);
        for i = 1 : height(Manifest)
            Boundaries{i} = readtable(Manifest.snapshot_file(i), ...
                'TextType','string','Delimiter',',');
        end
        [xLimits,yLimits] = objectiveAxisLimits(Problem,Boundaries);

        problemFigureRoot = fullfile(char(figureRoot),safeName(variant),problemName);
        if ~isfolder(problemFigureRoot)
            mkdir(problemFigureRoot);
        end
        for i = 1 : height(Manifest)
            targetFE = numericColumn(Manifest,'target_FE',i);
            actualFE = numericColumn(Manifest,'actual_FE',i);
            gen = numericColumn(Manifest,'gen',i);
            figureFile = fullfile(problemFigureRoot, ...
                sprintf('%s_%s_run%d_FE%06d_AF_GAN_objective.png', ...
                safeName(variant),problemName,round(runId),round(targetFE)));
            PlotStats = plotSingleSnapshot(Problem,Boundaries{i},problemName,variant, ...
                runId,targetFE,actualFE,gen,figureFile,xLimits,yLimits);
            count = count + 1;
            Rows(count) = emptyImageRow(); %#ok<AGROW>
            Rows(count).variant = variant;
            Rows(count).archiveParetoFilterMode = archiveParetoFilterMode;
            Rows(count).archivePairDirectionMode = archivePairDirectionMode;
            Rows(count).archiveSourceCapMode = string(Summary.archiveSourceCapMode(s));
            Rows(count).archivePairRefMode = string(Summary.archivePairRefMode(s));
            Rows(count).trainFilterMode = string(Summary.trainFilterMode(s));
            Rows(count).conditionKNNRetainRatio = ...
                double(Summary.conditionKNNRetainRatio(s));
            Rows(count).cganTrainMinRefCov = ...
                double(Summary.cganTrainMinRefCov(s));
            Rows(count).cganTrainMinTargetTriples = ...
                double(Summary.cganTrainMinTargetTriples(s));
            Rows(count).trainFilterRandomSeed = ...
                double(Summary.trainFilterRandomSeed(s));
            Rows(count).conditionMode = string(Summary.conditionMode(s));
            Rows(count).targetRealLabelMode = ...
                string(Summary.targetRealLabelMode(s));
            Rows(count).generatorMode = generatorMode;
            Rows(count).ganCriticMode = ganCriticMode;
            Rows(count).generatorLossMode = generatorLossMode;
            Rows(count).problem = string(problemName);
            Rows(count).run = runId;
            Rows(count).target_FE = targetFE;
            Rows(count).actual_FE = actualFE;
            Rows(count).gen = gen;
            Rows(count).Train_AF_count = numericColumn(Manifest, ...
                'Train_AF_count',i);
            Rows(count).Train_AI_count = numericColumn(Manifest, ...
                'Train_AI_count',i);
            Rows(count).Constrained_population_count = ...
                PlotStats.constrained_total;
            Rows(count).Unconstrained_population_count = ...
                PlotStats.unconstrained_total;
            Rows(count).GAN_generated_count = PlotStats.gan_total;
            Rows(count).standard_outside_constrained = ...
                PlotStats.constrained_outside;
            Rows(count).standard_outside_unconstrained = ...
                PlotStats.unconstrained_outside;
            Rows(count).standard_outside_archive_AF = PlotStats.af_outside;
            Rows(count).standard_outside_archive_AI = PlotStats.ai_outside;
            Rows(count).standard_outside_GAN = PlotStats.gan_outside;
            Rows(count).standard_visible_constrained = ...
                PlotStats.constrained_visible;
            Rows(count).standard_visible_unconstrained = ...
                PlotStats.unconstrained_visible;
            Rows(count).standard_visible_archive_AF = PlotStats.af_visible;
            Rows(count).standard_visible_archive_AI = PlotStats.ai_visible;
            Rows(count).standard_visible_GAN = PlotStats.gan_visible;
            Rows(count).snapshot_file = string(Manifest.snapshot_file(i));
            Rows(count).figure_file = string(figureFile);
        end
    end
    ImageManifest = struct2table(Rows);
end

function PlotStats = plotSingleSnapshot(Problem,Boundary,problemName,variant,runId, ...
        targetFE,actualFE,gen,figureFile,xLimits,yLimits)
    fig = figure('Visible','off','Color','w','Position',[100 100 1120 760]);
    ax = axes(fig);
    Draw(ax);
    set(ax,'FontName','Times New Roman','FontSize',11,'NextPlot','add', ...
        'Box','on','Layer','top','View',[0 90], ...
        'Color',[0.98 0.92 0.88]);
    plotFeasibleRegion(ax,Problem);
    PlotStats = plotTrainingArchive(ax,Boundary,xLimits,yLimits);
    grid(ax,'on');
    ax.GridAlpha = 0.15;
    xlabel(ax,'{\it f\rm_1}');
    ylabel(ax,'{\it f\rm_2}');
    title(ax,sprintf('%s | %s | run=%d | FE=%d/%d | gen=%d', ...
        problemName,char(variant),round(runId),round(targetFE), ...
        round(actualFE),round(gen)), ...
        'Interpreter','none','FontWeight','normal','FontSize',13);
    subtitle(ax,{sprintf(['Visible in standard range: PopC=%d/%d, ' ...
        'PopU=%d/%d, AF=%d/%d, AI=%d/%d, GAN=%d/%d'], ...
        PlotStats.constrained_visible,PlotStats.constrained_total, ...
        PlotStats.unconstrained_visible,PlotStats.unconstrained_total, ...
        PlotStats.af_visible,PlotStats.af_total, ...
        PlotStats.ai_visible,PlotStats.ai_total, ...
        PlotStats.gan_visible,PlotStats.gan_total), ...
        sprintf(['Outside standard range: PopC=%d, PopU=%d, AF=%d, ' ...
        'AI=%d, GAN=%d'], ...
        PlotStats.constrained_outside,PlotStats.unconstrained_outside, ...
        PlotStats.af_outside,PlotStats.ai_outside, ...
        PlotStats.gan_outside)}, ...
        'Interpreter','none','FontSize',10);
    xlim(ax,xLimits);
    ylim(ax,yLimits);
    legend(ax,'Location','northeastoutside','Box','off');
    exportgraphics(fig,figureFile,'Resolution',300);
    close(fig);
end

function plotFeasibleRegion(ax,Problem)
    plot(ax,nan,nan,'s','MarkerSize',10,'MarkerFaceColor',[0.98 0.92 0.88], ...
        'MarkerEdgeColor',[0.78 0.55 0.48], ...
        'DisplayName','Infeasible objective region');
    PF = Problem.PF;
    if iscell(PF) && numel(PF) >= 3
        X = PF{1};
        Y = PF{2};
        Z = PF{3};
        surf(ax,X,Y,Z,'EdgeColor','none','FaceColor',[0.83 0.93 0.86], ...
            'FaceAlpha',0.70,'DisplayName','Feasible objective region');
        Mask = double(isfinite(Z));
        if min(Mask(:)) < max(Mask(:))
            contour(ax,X,Y,Mask,[0.5 0.5],'Color',[0.05 0.30 0.45], ...
                'LineWidth',1.8,'DisplayName','Feasible/infeasible boundary');
        end
    elseif isnumeric(PF) && size(PF,2) >= 2
        plot(ax,PF(:,1),PF(:,2),'-','Color',[0.05 0.30 0.45], ...
            'LineWidth',1.8,'DisplayName','Reference boundary');
    end
end

function Stats = plotTrainingArchive(ax,Boundary,xLimits,yLimits)
    Stats = emptyPlotStats();
    Obj = [numericColumn(Boundary,'obj1'),numericColumn(Boundary,'obj2')];
    Side = string(Boundary.pair_side);
    Role = string(Boundary.archive_role);
    AFTrain = Role == "AF_train" & Side == "feasible_endpoint";
    AITrain = Role == "AI_train" & Side == "infeasible_endpoint";
    ConstrainedPop = Role == "constrained_population";
    UnconstrainedPop = Role == "unconstrained_population";
    GANGenerated = Role == "GAN_generated";
    inside = withinObjectiveLimits(Obj,xLimits,yLimits);

    Stats.constrained_total = sum(ConstrainedPop);
    Stats.unconstrained_total = sum(UnconstrainedPop);
    Stats.af_total = sum(AFTrain);
    Stats.ai_total = sum(AITrain);
    Stats.gan_total = sum(GANGenerated);
    Stats.constrained_visible = sum(ConstrainedPop & inside);
    Stats.unconstrained_visible = sum(UnconstrainedPop & inside);
    Stats.af_visible = sum(AFTrain & inside);
    Stats.ai_visible = sum(AITrain & inside);
    Stats.gan_visible = sum(GANGenerated & inside);
    Stats.constrained_outside = Stats.constrained_total - ...
        Stats.constrained_visible;
    Stats.unconstrained_outside = Stats.unconstrained_total - ...
        Stats.unconstrained_visible;
    Stats.af_outside = Stats.af_total - Stats.af_visible;
    Stats.ai_outside = Stats.ai_total - Stats.ai_visible;
    Stats.gan_outside = Stats.gan_total - Stats.gan_visible;

    scatter(ax,Obj(ConstrainedPop & inside,1), ...
        Obj(ConstrainedPop & inside,2),20,'o', ...
        'MarkerFaceColor',[0.12 0.40 0.95], ...
        'MarkerEdgeColor',[0.02 0.10 0.30], ...
        'MarkerFaceAlpha',0.35,'MarkerEdgeAlpha',0.45, ...
        'LineWidth',0.45,'DisplayName','Constrained population');
    scatter(ax,Obj(UnconstrainedPop & inside,1), ...
        Obj(UnconstrainedPop & inside,2),24,'^', ...
        'MarkerFaceColor',[0.50 0.20 0.75], ...
        'MarkerEdgeColor',[0.16 0.04 0.24], ...
        'MarkerFaceAlpha',0.32,'MarkerEdgeAlpha',0.45, ...
        'LineWidth',0.45,'DisplayName','Unconstrained population');

    plotBoundaryPairs(ax,Boundary,Obj,AFTrain,AITrain,inside);

    if any(GANGenerated)
        scatter(ax,Obj(GANGenerated & inside,1), ...
            Obj(GANGenerated & inside,2),84,'p', ...
            'MarkerFaceColor',[0.95 0.05 0.10], ...
            'MarkerEdgeColor',[0.25 0.02 0.02], ...
            'LineWidth',0.95,'DisplayName','GAN generated solution');
    end
end

function plotBoundaryPairs(ax,Boundary,Obj,AFTrain,AITrain,inside)
    pairIndex = numericColumn(Boundary,'pair_index');
    pairHandle = plot(ax,nan,nan,'-','Color',[0.88 0.48 0.02], ...
        'LineWidth',1.2,'DisplayName','Boundary archive pair');
    endpointColor = [1.00 0.72 0.18];
    endpointEdge = [0.20 0.13 0.02];
    pairs = unique(pairIndex(AFTrain | AITrain),'stable');
    for p = reshape(pairs,1,[])
        af = find(AFTrain & pairIndex == p & inside,1,'first');
        ai = find(AITrain & pairIndex == p & inside,1,'first');
        if ~isempty(af) && ~isempty(ai)
            plot(ax,Obj([af ai],1),Obj([af ai],2),'-', ...
                'Color',[0.88 0.48 0.02], ...
                'LineWidth',0.9,'HandleVisibility','off');
        end
    end
    if ~any(AFTrain & inside) && ~any(AITrain & inside)
        set(pairHandle,'Visible','off');
        return;
    end
    scatter(ax,Obj(AFTrain & inside,1),Obj(AFTrain & inside,2),38,'s', ...
        'MarkerFaceColor',endpointColor, ...
        'MarkerEdgeColor',endpointEdge, ...
        'LineWidth',0.70,'HandleVisibility','off');
    scatter(ax,Obj(AITrain & inside,1),Obj(AITrain & inside,2),38,'d', ...
        'MarkerFaceColor',[1.00 0.88 0.36], ...
        'MarkerEdgeColor',endpointEdge, ...
        'LineWidth',0.70,'HandleVisibility','off');
end

function inside = withinObjectiveLimits(Obj,xLimits,yLimits)
    inside = isfinite(Obj(:,1)) & isfinite(Obj(:,2)) & ...
        Obj(:,1) >= xLimits(1) & Obj(:,1) <= xLimits(2) & ...
        Obj(:,2) >= yLimits(1) & Obj(:,2) <= yLimits(2);
end

function Stats = emptyPlotStats()
    Stats = struct( ...
        'constrained_total',0, ...
        'unconstrained_total',0, ...
        'af_total',0, ...
        'ai_total',0, ...
        'gan_total',0, ...
        'constrained_visible',0, ...
        'unconstrained_visible',0, ...
        'af_visible',0, ...
        'ai_visible',0, ...
        'gan_visible',0, ...
        'constrained_outside',0, ...
        'unconstrained_outside',0, ...
        'af_outside',0, ...
        'ai_outside',0, ...
        'gan_outside',0);
end

function [xLimits,yLimits] = objectiveAxisLimits(Problem,Boundaries)
    XParts = cell(numel(Boundaries)+1,1);
    YParts = cell(numel(Boundaries)+1,1);
    part = 0;
    PF = Problem.PF;
    if iscell(PF) && numel(PF) >= 2
        part = part + 1;
        XParts{part} = PF{1}(:);
        YParts{part} = PF{2}(:);
    elseif isnumeric(PF) && size(PF,2) >= 2
        part = part + 1;
        XParts{part} = PF(:,1);
        YParts{part} = PF(:,2);
    end
    if part > 0
        xLimits = paddedLimits(vertcat(XParts{1:part}));
        yLimits = paddedLimits(vertcat(YParts{1:part}));
        return;
    end
    for i = 1 : numel(Boundaries)
        if ~isempty(Boundaries{i}) && ...
                all(ismember({'obj1','obj2'},Boundaries{i}.Properties.VariableNames))
            part = part + 1;
            B = visibleBoundaryRows(Boundaries{i});
            XParts{part} = numericColumn(B,'obj1');
            YParts{part} = numericColumn(B,'obj2');
        end
    end
    if part == 0
        xLimits = [0 1];
        yLimits = [0 1];
        return;
    end
    xLimits = paddedLimits(vertcat(XParts{1:part}));
    yLimits = paddedLimits(vertcat(YParts{1:part}));
end

function B = visibleBoundaryRows(B)
    if ismember('archive_role',B.Properties.VariableNames)
        role = string(B.archive_role);
        B = B(role ~= "AI_train",:);
    end
end

function Limits = paddedLimits(Values)
    Values = double(Values(:));
    Values = Values(isfinite(Values));
    if isempty(Values)
        Limits = [0 1];
        return;
    end
    Limits = [min(Values),max(Values)];
    pad = 0.03*max(diff(Limits),eps);
    Limits = Limits + [-pad,pad];
end

function Values = numericColumn(T,Name,row)
    Values = T.(Name);
    if iscell(Values) || isstring(Values)
        Values = str2double(string(Values));
    elseif islogical(Values)
        Values = double(Values);
    else
        Values = double(Values);
    end
    if nargin >= 3
        Values = Values(row);
    end
end

function Params = normalizeAlgorithmParams(Params,N)
    Defaults = defaultAlgorithmParams(N);
    if isempty(Params)
        Params = Defaults;
        return;
    end
    if isstruct(Params)
        names = algorithmParamNames();
        Out = Defaults;
        for i = 1 : numel(names)
            if isfield(Params,names{i}) && ~isempty(Params.(names{i}))
                Out{i} = Params.(names{i});
            end
        end
        Params = Out;
        return;
    end
    assert(iscell(Params) && numel(Params) <= numel(Defaults), ...
        'run_CCMO_GAN_BDG_archive_pareto_filters_fullscope:BadParams', ...
        'algorithmParams must be a cell array with at most %d elements.', ...
        numel(Defaults));
    if numel(Params) < numel(Defaults)
        Params(end+1:numel(Defaults)) = Defaults(end-numel(Defaults)+numel(Params)+1:end);
    end
end

function Params = defaultAlgorithmParams(N)
    nGen = max(10,ceil(0.2*double(N)));
    Params = {10,nGen,8,5,0.20,256,0,200,400,2,2,1, ...
        "large",64,1.0,1e-4,2e-4,"iter"};
end

function names = algorithmParamNames()
    names = {'trainGap','nGen','zDim','perRef','nearTau', ...
        'ganIter','probeRawN','stageProbeN','ganDPretrainIter', ...
        'ganDSteps','ganGSteps','archiveGap','ganArchMode', ...
        'ganMiniBatch','ganRealLabel','ganLrD','ganLrG', ...
        'ganTrainMode'};
end

function Row = attachAlgorithmParams(Row,Params)
    Row.trainGap = double(Params{1});
    Row.nGen = double(Params{2});
    Row.zDim = double(Params{3});
    Row.perRef = double(Params{4});
    Row.nearTau = double(Params{5});
    Row.ganIter = double(Params{6});
    Row.probeRawN = double(Params{7});
    Row.stageProbeN = double(Params{8});
    Row.ganDPretrainIter = double(Params{9});
    Row.ganDSteps = double(Params{10});
    Row.ganGSteps = double(Params{11});
    Row.archiveGap = double(Params{12});
    Row.ganArchMode = string(Params{13});
    Row.ganMiniBatch = double(Params{14});
    Row.ganRealLabel = double(Params{15});
    Row.ganLrD = double(Params{16});
    Row.ganLrG = double(Params{17});
    Row.ganTrainMode = string(Params{18});
end

function [popCount,feasibleCount,feasibleRate,bestCount] = finalPopulationCounts(Population)
    popCount = numel(Population);
    feasibleCount = 0;
    feasibleRate = NaN;
    bestCount = 0;
    if popCount <= 0
        return;
    end
    feasible = all(Population.cons <= 0,2);
    feasibleCount = sum(feasible);
    feasibleRate = feasibleCount ./ popCount;
    bestCount = numel(Population.best);
end

function value = tableValue(T,name)
    if ~ismember(name,T.Properties.VariableNames)
        value = NaN;
        return;
    end
    value = T.(name);
    if iscell(value) || isstring(value)
        value = str2double(string(value));
    else
        value = double(value);
    end
    value = value(1);
end

function value = lastValue(values)
    values = double(values(:));
    if isempty(values)
        value = NaN;
    else
        value = values(end);
    end
end

function ensureParallelPool(workerCount)
    pool = gcp('nocreate');
    if ~isempty(pool) && pool.NumWorkers ~= workerCount
        delete(pool);
        pool = [];
    end
    if isempty(pool)
        parpool('local',workerCount);
    end
end

    if isappdata(0,'CCMO_GAN_BDG_ExperimentControl')
        rmappdata(0,'CCMO_GAN_BDG_ExperimentControl');
    end
end

====================================================================================================
FILE: Algorithms/Multi-objective optimization/CCMO-GAN-BDG/Support/run_CCMO_GAN_BDG_boundary_diagnostics.m | bytes=16219
====================================================================================================
function [Summary,outDir,MetricsAll] = run_CCMO_GAN_BDG_boundary_diagnostics( ...
        outDir,workerCount,problemNames,N,D,maxFE,runIds,targets,diagOptions)
% Run no-plot CGAN boundary diagnostics for the current FixMD global mainline.

    rootDir = fileparts(which('platemo'));
    if nargin < 1 || isempty(outDir)
        outDir = fullfile(rootDir,'Data','CCMO_GAN_BDG', ...
            ['FixMD_global_diag_', ...
            char(datetime('now','Format','yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'))]);
    end
    if nargin < 2 || isempty(workerCount)
        workerCount = 9;
    end
    if nargin < 3 || isempty(problemNames)
        problemNames = defaultDiagnosticProblemList_BDG();
    end
    if nargin < 4 || isempty(N)
        N = 100;
    end
    if nargin < 5
        D = [];
    end
    if nargin < 6 || isempty(maxFE)
        maxFE = 100000;
    end
    if nargin < 7 || isempty(runIds)
        runIds = 1 : 3;
    end
    if nargin < 8 || isempty(targets)
        targets = [30000 70000 100000];
    end
    if nargin < 9
        diagOptions = struct();
    end

    addpath(genpath(rootDir));
    workerCount = max(1,round(double(workerCount)));
    problemNames = cellstr(string(problemNames(:)));
    runIds = double(runIds(:)');
    targets = normalizeDiagnosticTargets_BDG(targets);
    diagOptions = normalizeDiagnosticOptions_BDG(diagOptions);
    algorithmParams = diagOptions.algorithmParams;

    if ~isfolder(outDir)
        mkdir(outDir);
    end
    fprintf('boundary_diagnostics outDir=%s\n',outDir);
    fprintf('tasks=%d problems x %d runs, N=%d, D=%s, maxFE=%d, workers=%d, targets=%s\n', ...
        numel(problemNames),numel(runIds),N,defaultDText_BDG(D),maxFE, ...
        workerCount,strjoin(string(targets),';'));

    Tasks = buildDiagnosticTasks_BDG(problemNames,runIds);
    Rows = repmat(emptyDiagnosticRunRow_BDG(),height(Tasks),1);
    if workerCount > 1
        ensureDiagnosticParallelPool_BDG(workerCount);
        parfor task = 1 : height(Tasks)
            Rows(task) = completeDiagnosticRunRow_BDG(runOneDiagnosticTask_BDG( ...
                Tasks(task,:),outDir,N,D,maxFE,targets,diagOptions, ...
                algorithmParams));
        end
    else
        for task = 1 : height(Tasks)
            Rows(task) = completeDiagnosticRunRow_BDG(runOneDiagnosticTask_BDG( ...
                Tasks(task,:),outDir,N,D,maxFE,targets,diagOptions, ...
                algorithmParams));
            fprintf('[%d/%d] %s run=%g status=%s\n',task,height(Tasks), ...
                Tasks.problem(task),Tasks.run(task),Rows(task).status);
        end
    end

    Summary = struct2table(Rows);
    writetable(Summary,fullfile(outDir,'boundary_diagnostic_run_summary.csv'));
    MetricsAll = collectDiagnosticMetrics_BDG(Summary);
    writetable(MetricsAll,fullfile(outDir,'gan_diagnostic_metrics_all.csv'));
    writeDiagnosticMetricSummaries_BDG(MetricsAll,outDir);
end

function Tasks = buildDiagnosticTasks_BDG(problemNames,runIds)
    count = numel(problemNames) * numel(runIds);
    Rows = repmat(struct('problem',"",'run',NaN),count,1);
    k = 0;
    for p = 1 : numel(problemNames)
        for r = 1 : numel(runIds)
            k = k + 1;
            Rows(k).problem = string(problemNames{p});
            Rows(k).run = double(runIds(r));
        end
    end
    Tasks = struct2table(Rows);
end

function Row = runOneDiagnosticTask_BDG(Task,outDir,N,D,maxFE,targets, ...
        diagOptions,algorithmParams)
    Row = emptyDiagnosticRunRow_BDG();
    Row.variant = string(diagOptions.variant);
    Row.problem = string(Task.problem);
    Row.family = diagnosticProblemFamily_BDG(Row.problem);
    Row.run = double(Task.run);
    Row.seed = Row.run;
    Row.N = double(N);
    Row.maxFE = double(maxFE);
    Row.target_text = strjoin(string(targets),';');
    Row.diagnostic_condition_count = diagOptions.conditionCount;
    Row.diagnostic_z_per_condition = diagOptions.zPerCondition;
    Row.diagnostic_normal_n = diagOptions.normalN;
    try
        rootDir = fileparts(which('platemo'));
        addpath(genpath(rootDir));
        try
            maxNumCompThreads(1);
        catch
        end
        rng(Row.seed,'twister');
        ProblemConstructor = str2func(char(Row.problem));
        if isempty(D)
            Problem = ProblemConstructor('N',N,'maxFE',maxFE);
        else
            Problem = ProblemConstructor('N',N,'D',D,'maxFE',maxFE);
        end
        Row.D = double(Problem.D);
        taskName = sprintf('%s_run%d',char(Row.problem),round(Row.run));
        snapshotFolder = string(fullfile(outDir,'snapshots',taskName));
        diagnosticFolder = string(fullfile(outDir,'diagnostics',taskName));
        if ~isfolder(char(snapshotFolder))
            mkdir(char(snapshotFolder));
        end
        if ~isfolder(char(diagnosticFolder))
            mkdir(char(diagnosticFolder));
        end
        Row.snapshot_folder = snapshotFolder;
        Row.snapshot_manifest_file = string(fullfile(char(snapshotFolder), ...
            'archive_snapshot_manifest.csv'));
        Row.diagnostic_folder = diagnosticFolder;
        Row.diagnostic_manifest_file = string(fullfile(char(diagnosticFolder), ...
            'gan_diagnostic_manifest.csv'));

        Control = diagnosticExperimentControl_BDG(Row,targets, ...
            snapshotFolder,diagnosticFolder,diagOptions);
        setappdata(0,'CCMO_GAN_BDG_ExperimentControl',Control);
        cleanup = onCleanup(@()removeDiagnosticAppdata_BDG()); %#ok<NASGU>

        Algorithm = CCMO_GAN_BDG( ...
            'save',0, ...
            'run',Row.run, ...
            'metName',{'IGD','HV','Feasible_rate'}, ...
            'outputFcn',@(varargin)[], ...
            'parameter',algorithmParams);
        Algorithm.Solve(Problem);

        Row.runtime = double(Algorithm.metric.runtime);
        Row.core_metrics_file = string(Algorithm.metric.analysis_core_csv);
        Row.stage_metrics_file = string(Algorithm.metric.analysis_stage_csv);
        Row.IGD = lastDiagnosticValue_BDG(Algorithm.CalMetric('IGD'));
        Row.HV = lastDiagnosticValue_BDG(Algorithm.CalMetric('HV'));
        Row.Feasible_rate = lastDiagnosticValue_BDG( ...
            Algorithm.CalMetric('Feasible_rate'));
        Row.finalFE = double(Algorithm.result{end,1});
        if isfile(Row.diagnostic_manifest_file)
            Manifest = readtable(Row.diagnostic_manifest_file, ...
                'TextType','string','Delimiter',',', ...
                'ReadVariableNames',true,'VariableNamingRule','preserve');
            Row.diagnostic_snapshot_count = height(Manifest);
        end
        if isfile(Row.snapshot_manifest_file)
            Manifest = readtable(Row.snapshot_manifest_file, ...
                'TextType','string','Delimiter',',', ...
                'ReadVariableNames',true,'VariableNamingRule','preserve');
            Row.snapshot_count = height(Manifest);
        end
        Row.status = "ok";
    catch err
        Row.status = "failed";
        Row.error_message = string(getReport(err,'extended', ...
            'hyperlinks','off'));
    end
end

function Row = completeDiagnosticRunRow_BDG(Source)
    Row = emptyDiagnosticRunRow_BDG();
    names = intersect(fieldnames(Source),fieldnames(Row),'stable');
    for i = 1 : numel(names)
        Row.(names{i}) = Source.(names{i});
    end
end

function Row = emptyDiagnosticRunRow_BDG()
    Row = struct( ...
        'variant',"", ...
        'problem',"", ...
        'family',"", ...
        'run',NaN, ...
        'seed',NaN, ...
        'N',NaN, ...
        'D',NaN, ...
        'maxFE',NaN, ...
        'target_text',"", ...
        'diagnostic_condition_count',NaN, ...
        'diagnostic_z_per_condition',NaN, ...
        'diagnostic_normal_n',NaN, ...
        'runtime',NaN, ...
        'IGD',NaN, ...
        'HV',NaN, ...
        'Feasible_rate',NaN, ...
        'finalFE',NaN, ...
        'snapshot_count',0, ...
        'diagnostic_snapshot_count',0, ...
        'core_metrics_file',"", ...
        'stage_metrics_file',"", ...
        'snapshot_folder',"", ...
        'snapshot_manifest_file',"", ...
        'diagnostic_folder',"", ...
        'diagnostic_manifest_file',"", ...
        'status',"pending", ...
        'error_message',"");
end

function MetricsAll = collectDiagnosticMetrics_BDG(Summary)
    MetricsAll = table();
    if isempty(Summary)
        return;
    end
    for i = 1 : height(Summary)
        if string(Summary.status(i)) ~= "ok"
            continue;
        end
        manifestFile = string(Summary.diagnostic_manifest_file(i));
        if strlength(manifestFile) == 0 || ~isfile(manifestFile)
            continue;
        end
        Manifest = readtable(manifestFile,'TextType','string', ...
            'Delimiter',',','ReadVariableNames',true, ...
            'VariableNamingRule','preserve');
        for j = 1 : height(Manifest)
            metricFile = string(Manifest.("metric_file")(j));
            if strlength(metricFile) == 0 || ~isfile(metricFile)
                continue;
            end
            T = readtable(metricFile,'TextType','string', ...
                'Delimiter',',','ReadVariableNames',true, ...
                'VariableNamingRule','preserve');
            if isempty(T)
                continue;
            end
            T.variant = repmat(string(Summary.variant(i)),height(T),1);
            T.problem_name = repmat(string(Summary.problem(i)),height(T),1);
            T.family = repmat(string(Summary.family(i)),height(T),1);
            T.run_id = repmat(double(Summary.run(i)),height(T),1);
            T.metric_file = repmat(metricFile,height(T),1);
            MetricsAll = [MetricsAll;T]; %#ok<AGROW>
        end
    end
end

function writeDiagnosticMetricSummaries_BDG(MetricsAll,outDir)
    if isempty(MetricsAll)
        writetable(table(),fullfile(outDir,'gan_diagnostic_metrics_by_fe.csv'));
        writetable(table(),fullfile(outDir, ...
            'gan_diagnostic_metrics_by_problem_fe.csv'));
        return;
    end
    numericMask = varfun(@isnumeric,MetricsAll,'OutputFormat','uniform');
    numericVars = string(MetricsAll.Properties.VariableNames(numericMask));
    metricVars = setdiff(numericVars, ...
        ["run","run_id","target_FE","actual_FE","gen"],'stable');
    ByFE = groupsummary(MetricsAll,{'variant','target_FE'}, ...
        'mean',cellstr(metricVars));
    ByProblemFE = groupsummary(MetricsAll, ...
        {'variant','problem_name','target_FE'},'mean',cellstr(metricVars));
    writetable(ByFE,fullfile(outDir,'gan_diagnostic_metrics_by_fe.csv'));
    writetable(ByProblemFE,fullfile(outDir, ...
        'gan_diagnostic_metrics_by_problem_fe.csv'));
end

function Options = normalizeDiagnosticOptions_BDG(Options)
    Default = struct('conditionCount',30,'zPerCondition',10, ...
        'normalN',200,'seed',20260614, ...
        'variant',"FixMD_GNDk60_nearseg_huber_z0", ...
        'control',[], ...
        'algorithmParams',{defaultDiagnosticAlgorithmParams_BDG()});
    if isempty(Options)
        Options = Default;
    elseif isstruct(Options)
        names = intersect(fieldnames(Options),fieldnames(Default),'stable');
        for i = 1 : numel(names)
            Default.(names{i}) = Options.(names{i});
        end
        Options = Default;
    else
        error('run_CCMO_GAN_BDG_boundary_diagnostics:BadOptions', ...
            'diagOptions must be a struct or empty.');
    end
    Options.conditionCount = max(0,round(double(Options.conditionCount)));
    Options.zPerCondition = max(0,round(double(Options.zPerCondition)));
    Options.normalN = max(0,round(double(Options.normalN)));
    Options.seed = max(0,round(double(Options.seed)));
    Options.variant = string(Options.variant);
    if isempty(Options.algorithmParams)
        Options.algorithmParams = defaultDiagnosticAlgorithmParams_BDG();
    end
end

    Params = {1,20,4,5,0.20,50,0,200,0,1,1,1, ...
        "g2sl",64,0.9,1e-4,1e-4,"epoch"};
end

function Control = diagnosticExperimentControl_BDG(Row,targets, ...
        snapshotFolder,diagnosticFolder,diagOptions)

        'archiveGap',1, ...

        'archivePairDirectionMode',"af_not_dominates_ai", ...
        'archiveSourceCapMode',"none", ...
        'archivePairRefMode',"neighbor4", ...
        'trainFilterMode',"condition_knn", ...
        'conditionKNNRetainRatio',0.60, ...
        'cganTrainMinRefCov',0.00, ...
        'cganTrainMinTargetTriples',0, ...
        'trainFilterRandomSeed',Row.seed, ...
        'conditionMode',"yt_dt_t_ref", ...
        'targetMode',"near_segment_feasible", ...
        'nearSegmentTau',0.20, ...
        'nearSegmentMaxPerPair',5, ...
        'decisionInterpCount',5, ...
        'targetRealLabelMode',"binary", ...
        'archiveSnapshotTargets',targets, ...
        'archiveSnapshotFolder',snapshotFolder, ...
        'archiveSnapshotTag',Row.variant, ...
        'archiveSnapshotGanN',0, ...
        'archiveDiagnosticEnabled',true, ...
        'archiveDiagnosticFolder',diagnosticFolder, ...
        'archiveDiagnosticConditionCount',diagOptions.conditionCount, ...
        'archiveDiagnosticZPerCondition',diagOptions.zPerCondition, ...
        'archiveDiagnosticNormalN',diagOptions.normalN, ...
        'archiveDiagnosticSeed',diagOptions.seed, ...
        'analysisRootFolder',string(fullfile( ...
            diagnosticOutputRoot_BDG(snapshotFolder),'runs')), ...
        'generatorMode',"objective_target_conditioned", ...
        'generatorLossMode',"conditional_adversarial_huber", ...
        'reconstructionWeight',250, ...
        'reconstructionHuberDelta',0.10, ...
        'ganCriticMode',"target_conditioned");
    if isstruct(diagOptions.control)
        names = fieldnames(diagOptions.control);
        for i = 1 : numel(names)
            Control.(names{i}) = diagOptions.control.(names{i});
        end
    end
    Control.variant = Row.variant;
    Control.archiveSnapshotTargets = targets;
    Control.archiveSnapshotFolder = snapshotFolder;
    Control.archiveSnapshotTag = Row.variant;
    Control.archiveDiagnosticEnabled = true;
    Control.archiveDiagnosticFolder = diagnosticFolder;
    Control.archiveDiagnosticConditionCount = diagOptions.conditionCount;
    Control.archiveDiagnosticZPerCondition = diagOptions.zPerCondition;
    Control.archiveDiagnosticNormalN = diagOptions.normalN;
    Control.archiveDiagnosticSeed = diagOptions.seed;
    Control.trainFilterRandomSeed = Row.seed;
end

        parpool('local',workerCount);
    end
end

function family = diagnosticProblemFamily_BDG(problemName)
    if startsWith(string(problemName),"DASCMOP")
        family = "DASCMOP_BC";
    elseif startsWith(string(problemName),"LIRCMOP")
        family = "LIRCMOP_BC";
    else
        family = "Other";
    end
end

    if isempty(D)
        text = 'problem-default';
    else
        text = char(string(D));
    end
end
