====================================================================================================
FILE: Algorithms/Multi-objective optimization/CCMO-GAN-BDG/UpdateBoundaryArchive_BDG.m | bytes=28859
====================================================================================================
function [AF,AI,Diag] = UpdateBoundaryArchive_BDG(Problem,AF,AI,...
    Population1,Offspring1,Population2,Offspring2,...
    W,perRef,nearTau,Options)

    baseMaxPair = max(10,ceil(0.2*Problem.N));
    if nargin < 11 || isempty(Options)
        Options = struct();
    end
    Options = NormalizeArchiveOptions_BDG(Options);
    maxPair = ArchiveSourceMaxPair_BDG(baseMaxPair,Options.sourceCapMode);
    Diag = EmptyArchiveDiag_BDG();
    Diag.score_gap_weight = Options.scoreGapWeight;
    Diag.score_rank_weight = Options.scoreRankWeight;
    Diag.archive_source_cap_mode = Options.sourceCapMode;
    Diag.archive_pareto_filter_mode = Options.paretoFilterMode;
    Diag.archive_pair_direction_mode = Options.pairDirectionMode;
    Diag.archive_pair_ref_mode = Options.pairRefMode;
    PreviousAF = AF;
    PreviousAI = AI;
    hadPreviousArchive = HasBoundaryArchivePairs_BDG(PreviousAF,PreviousAI);

    Fdecs = zeros(0,Problem.D);
    Fobjs = zeros(0,Problem.M);
    Idecs = zeros(0,Problem.D);
    Iobjs = zeros(0,Problem.M);

    if UseUnifiedRefNeighborPairing_BDG(Options)
        [Fdecs,Fobjs,Idecs,Iobjs,SourceDiag] = ...
            CollectUnifiedRefNeighborPairs_BDG(Problem,AF,AI, ...
            Population1,Offspring1,Population2,Offspring2, ...
            W,maxPair,nearTau,Options.pairRefMode);
        Diag.pair_count_flip = SourceDiag.pair_count_flip;
        Diag.pair_count_cross = SourceDiag.pair_count_cross;
        Diag.pair_eval_count = SourceDiag.pair_eval_count;
    else
        % ===== 1) parent-child feasibility flip pairs =====
        [fd,fo,id,io,evalCount] = CollectFlipPairs_BDG(Problem,Population1,Offspring1,maxPair);
        Diag.pair_count_flip = Diag.pair_count_flip + size(fd,1);
        Diag.pair_eval_count = Diag.pair_eval_count + evalCount;
        Fdecs = [Fdecs;fd]; Fobjs = [Fobjs;fo]; Idecs = [Idecs;id]; Iobjs = [Iobjs;io];

        [fd,fo,id,io,evalCount] = CollectFlipPairs_BDG(Problem,Population2,Offspring2,maxPair);
        Diag.pair_count_flip = Diag.pair_count_flip + size(fd,1);
        Diag.pair_eval_count = Diag.pair_eval_count + evalCount;
        Fdecs = [Fdecs;fd]; Fobjs = [Fobjs;fo]; Idecs = [Idecs;id]; Iobjs = [Iobjs;io];

        % ===== 2) cross-pop heterogeneous nearest pairs =====
        CandidatePool = [Population1,Offspring1,Population2,Offspring2];
        [fd,fo,id,io,evalCount] = CollectNearestPairs_BDG(Problem, ...
            CandidatePool,maxPair,nearTau);
        Diag.pair_count_cross = Diag.pair_count_cross + size(fd,1);
        Diag.pair_eval_count = Diag.pair_eval_count + evalCount;
        Fdecs = [Fdecs;fd]; Fobjs = [Fobjs;fo]; Idecs = [Idecs;id]; Iobjs = [Iobjs;io];
    end
    Diag.pair_eval_FE = Diag.pair_eval_count;

    if isempty(Fdecs)
        Diag.AF_candidate_count = size(AF.decs,1);
        if Diag.AF_candidate_count > 0
            Diag.AF_retention_ratio = 1;
        end
        return;
    end

    % merge old archive and new pairs, then rebuild. Unified reference
    % pairing already pools the previous archive before pairing.
    if ~UseUnifiedRefNeighborPairing_BDG(Options) && ~isempty(AF.decs)
        Fdecs = [AF.decs;Fdecs];
        Fobjs = [AF.objs;Fobjs];
        Idecs = [AI.decs;Idecs];
        Iobjs = [AI.objs;Iobjs];
    end

    Diag.AF_candidate_count = size(Fdecs,1);
    [NewAF,NewAI,RebuildDiag] = RebuildArchive_BDG(Problem,Fdecs,Fobjs,Idecs,Iobjs,W,perRef,Options);
    if ShouldRetainPreviousArchive_BDG(NewAF,NewAI,RebuildDiag, ...
            PreviousAF,PreviousAI,hadPreviousArchive)
        AF = PreviousAF;
        AI = PreviousAI;
    else
        AF = NewAF;
        AI = NewAI;
    end
    if Diag.AF_candidate_count > 0
        Diag.AF_retention_ratio = size(AF.decs,1) / Diag.AF_candidate_count;
    end
    Diag = MergeRebuildDiag_BDG(Diag,RebuildDiag);
end

function flag = HasBoundaryArchivePairs_BDG(AF,AI)
    flag = isstruct(AF) && isstruct(AI) && ...
        isfield(AF,'decs') && isfield(AI,'decs') && ...
        ~isempty(AF.decs) && ~isempty(AI.decs) && ...
        size(AF.decs,1) == size(AI.decs,1);
end

function flag = ShouldRetainPreviousArchive_BDG( ...
        AF,AI,Diag,PreviousAF,PreviousAI,hadPreviousArchive)
    flag = false;
    if ~hadPreviousArchive || Diag.archive_pair_direction_candidate_count <= 0
        return;
    end
    newCount = ArchivePairCount_BDG(AF,AI);
    previousCount = ArchivePairCount_BDG(PreviousAF,PreviousAI);
    if newCount == 0 && Diag.archive_pair_direction_keep_count == 0
        flag = true;
        return;
    end
    flag = IsSevereArchiveShrink_BDG(newCount,previousCount);
end

function count = ArchivePairCount_BDG(AF,AI)
    count = 0;
    if ~HasBoundaryArchivePairs_BDG(AF,AI)
        return;
    end
    count = min(size(AF.decs,1),size(AI.decs,1));
end

function flag = IsSevereArchiveShrink_BDG(newCount,previousCount)
    minStablePairs = 6;
    flag = newCount > 0 && previousCount > 0 && ...
        newCount < previousCount && ...
        newCount < minStablePairs;
end

function Diag = EmptyArchiveDiag_BDG()
    Diag = struct( ...
        'pair_count_flip',0, ...
        'pair_count_cross',0, ...
        'pair_eval_count',0, ...
        'pair_eval_FE',0, ...
        'AF_candidate_count',0, ...
        'AF_retention_ratio',NaN, ...
        'AF_front1_count',0, ...
        'AF_front1_ratio',NaN, ...
        'AF_kept_front1_ratio',NaN, ...
        'score_gap_obj_med',NaN, ...
        'score_rank_med',NaN, ...
        'score_gap_weight',0.80, ...
        'score_rank_weight',0.20, ...
        'archive_source_cap_mode',"limited", ...
        'archive_pareto_filter_mode',"none", ...
        'archive_pareto_filter_candidate_count',0, ...
        'archive_pareto_filter_keep_count',0, ...
        'archive_pareto_filter_keep_ratio',NaN, ...
        'archive_pair_direction_mode',"none", ...
        'archive_pair_direction_candidate_count',0, ...
        'archive_pair_direction_keep_count',0, ...
        'archive_pair_direction_keep_ratio',NaN, ...
        'archive_pair_ref_mode',"none", ...
        'archive_pair_ref_candidate_count',0, ...
        'archive_pair_ref_keep_count',0, ...
        'archive_pair_ref_keep_ratio',NaN);
end

function Diag = MergeRebuildDiag_BDG(Diag,RebuildDiag)
    names = fieldnames(RebuildDiag);
    for i = 1 : numel(names)
        Diag.(names{i}) = RebuildDiag.(names{i});
    end
end

function [Fdecs,Fobjs,Idecs,Iobjs,evalCount] = CollectFlipPairs_BDG(Problem,P,O,maxPair)
    Fdecs = zeros(0,Problem.D);
    Fobjs = zeros(0,Problem.M);
    Idecs = zeros(0,Problem.D);
    Iobjs = zeros(0,Problem.M);
    evalCount = 0;

    if isempty(P) || isempty(O)
        return;
    end

    flagP = IsFeasibleSet_BDG(P);
    flagO = IsFeasibleSet_BDG(O);
    idx   = find(flagP ~= flagO);
    if isempty(idx)
        return;
    end

    ObjPair = [P(idx).objs;O(idx).objs];
    Y = NormalizeObjMat_BDG(ObjPair);
    n = numel(idx);
    d = sqrt(sum((Y(1:n,:) - Y(n+1:end,:)).^2,2));
    [~,ord] = sort(d,'ascend');
    idx = idx(ord(1:min(maxPair,numel(ord))));
    nKeep = numel(idx);
    Fdecs = zeros(nKeep,Problem.D);
    Fobjs = zeros(nKeep,Problem.M);
    Idecs = zeros(nKeep,Problem.D);
    Iobjs = zeros(nKeep,Problem.M);

    for k = 1 : nKeep
        i = idx(k);
        if flagP(i)
            sF = P(i); sI = O(i);
        else
            sF = O(i); sI = P(i);
        end
        Fdecs(k,:) = sF.decs;
        Fobjs(k,:) = sF.objs;
        Idecs(k,:) = sI.decs;
        Iobjs(k,:) = sI.objs;
    end
end

function [Fdecs,Fobjs,Idecs,Iobjs,evalCount] = CollectNearestPairs_BDG(Problem,P,maxPair,nearTau)
    Fdecs = zeros(0,Problem.D);
    Fobjs = zeros(0,Problem.M);
    Idecs = zeros(0,Problem.D);
    Iobjs = zeros(0,Problem.M);
    evalCount = 0;

    if isempty(P)
        return;
    end

    flag = IsFeasibleSet_BDG(P);
    FA = P(flag);
    IB = P(~flag);

    if isempty(FA) || isempty(IB)
        return;
    end

    FF = FirstFront_BDG(FA.objs);
    FA = FA(FF);
    if isempty(FA)
        return;
    end

    ObjAll = [FA.objs;IB.objs];
    Y = NormalizeObjMat_BDG(ObjAll);
    nF  = numel(FA);
    YF  = Y(1:nF,:);
    YI  = Y(nF+1:end,:);

    [~,ord] = sort(sum(YF,2),'ascend');
    ord = ord(1:min(maxPair,numel(ord)));
    cap = numel(ord);
    Fdecs = zeros(cap,Problem.D);
    Fobjs = zeros(cap,Problem.M);
    Idecs = zeros(cap,Problem.D);
    Iobjs = zeros(cap,Problem.M);
    cnt = 0;
    for t = 1 : numel(ord)
        d = sqrt(sum((YI - YF(ord(t),:)).^2,2));
        [mind,pos] = min(d);
        if mind <= nearTau
            sF = FA(ord(t));
            sI = IB(pos);

            cnt = cnt + 1;
            Fdecs(cnt,:) = sF.decs;
            Fobjs(cnt,:) = sF.objs;
            Idecs(cnt,:) = sI.decs;
            Iobjs(cnt,:) = sI.objs;
            if cnt >= maxPair
                break;
            end
        end
    end
    Fdecs = Fdecs(1:cnt,:);
    Fobjs = Fobjs(1:cnt,:);
    Idecs = Idecs(1:cnt,:);
    Iobjs = Iobjs(1:cnt,:);
end

function flag = UseUnifiedRefNeighborPairing_BDG(Options)
    flag = isstruct(Options) && isfield(Options,'pairRefMode') && ...
        NormalizeArchivePairRefMode_BDG(Options.pairRefMode) ~= "none";
end

function [Fdecs,Fobjs,Idecs,Iobjs,Diag] = ...
        CollectUnifiedRefNeighborPairs_BDG(Problem,AF,AI, ...
        Population1,Offspring1,Population2,Offspring2, ...
        W,maxPair,nearTau,pairRefMode)
    Diag = struct('pair_count_flip',0,'pair_count_cross',0, ...
        'pair_eval_count',0);
    FPoolDecs = zeros(0,Problem.D);
    FPoolObjs = zeros(0,Problem.M);
    IPoolDecs = zeros(0,Problem.D);
    IPoolObjs = zeros(0,Problem.M);

    [fd,fo,id,io,cnt] = CollectFlipCandidatePools_BDG( ...
        Problem,Population1,Offspring1,maxPair);
    Diag.pair_count_flip = Diag.pair_count_flip + cnt;
    FPoolDecs = [FPoolDecs;fd]; FPoolObjs = [FPoolObjs;fo];
    IPoolDecs = [IPoolDecs;id]; IPoolObjs = [IPoolObjs;io];

    [fd,fo,id,io,cnt] = CollectFlipCandidatePools_BDG( ...
        Problem,Population2,Offspring2,maxPair);
    Diag.pair_count_flip = Diag.pair_count_flip + cnt;
    FPoolDecs = [FPoolDecs;fd]; FPoolObjs = [FPoolObjs;fo];
    IPoolDecs = [IPoolDecs;id]; IPoolObjs = [IPoolObjs;io];

    CandidatePool = [Population1,Offspring1,Population2,Offspring2];
    [fd,fo,id,io] = CollectCrossCandidatePools_BDG( ...
        Problem,CandidatePool,maxPair);
    FPoolDecs = [FPoolDecs;fd]; FPoolObjs = [FPoolObjs;fo];
    IPoolDecs = [IPoolDecs;id]; IPoolObjs = [IPoolObjs;io];

    if HasBoundaryArchivePairs_BDG(AF,AI)
        FPoolDecs = [FPoolDecs;AF.decs];
        FPoolObjs = [FPoolObjs;AF.objs];
        IPoolDecs = [IPoolDecs;AI.decs];
        IPoolObjs = [IPoolObjs;AI.objs];
    end

    [FPoolDecs,FPoolObjs] = UniqueArchiveCandidates_BDG( ...
        FPoolDecs,FPoolObjs,Problem);
    [IPoolDecs,IPoolObjs] = UniqueArchiveCandidates_BDG( ...
        IPoolDecs,IPoolObjs,Problem);

    [Fdecs,Fobjs,Idecs,Iobjs] = PairUnifiedRefNeighborCandidates_BDG( ...
        Problem,FPoolDecs,FPoolObjs,IPoolDecs,IPoolObjs, ...
        W,nearTau,maxPair,pairRefMode);
    Diag.pair_count_cross = size(Fdecs,1);
end

function [Fdecs,Fobjs,Idecs,Iobjs,count] = ...
        CollectFlipCandidatePools_BDG(Problem,P,O,maxPair)
    Fdecs = zeros(0,Problem.D);
    Fobjs = zeros(0,Problem.M);
    Idecs = zeros(0,Problem.D);
    Iobjs = zeros(0,Problem.M);
    count = 0;
    if isempty(P) || isempty(O)
        return;
    end
    flagP = IsFeasibleSet_BDG(P);
    flagO = IsFeasibleSet_BDG(O);
    idx = find(flagP ~= flagO);
    if isempty(idx)
        return;
    end
    ObjPair = [P(idx).objs;O(idx).objs];
    Y = NormalizeObjMat_BDG(ObjPair);
    n = numel(idx);
    d = sqrt(sum((Y(1:n,:) - Y(n+1:end,:)).^2,2));
    [~,ord] = sort(d,'ascend');
    idx = idx(ord(1:min(maxPair,numel(ord))));
    count = numel(idx);
    Fdecs = zeros(count,Problem.D);
    Fobjs = zeros(count,Problem.M);
    Idecs = zeros(count,Problem.D);
    Iobjs = zeros(count,Problem.M);
    for k = 1 : numel(idx)
        i = idx(k);
        if flagP(i)
            sF = P(i); sI = O(i);
        else
            sF = O(i); sI = P(i);
        end
        Fdecs(k,:) = sF.decs;
        Fobjs(k,:) = sF.objs;
        Idecs(k,:) = sI.decs;
        Iobjs(k,:) = sI.objs;
    end
end

function [Fdecs,Fobjs,Idecs,Iobjs] = ...
        CollectCrossCandidatePools_BDG(Problem,P,maxPair)
    Fdecs = zeros(0,Problem.D);
    Fobjs = zeros(0,Problem.M);
    Idecs = zeros(0,Problem.D);
    Iobjs = zeros(0,Problem.M);
    if isempty(P)
        return;
    end
    flag = IsFeasibleSet_BDG(P);
    FA = P(flag);
    IB = P(~flag);
    if isempty(FA) || isempty(IB)
        return;
    end
    FF = FirstFront_BDG(FA.objs);
    FA = FA(FF);
    if isempty(FA)
        return;
    end
    YF = NormalizeObjMat_BDG(FA.objs);
    [~,ord] = sort(sum(YF,2),'ascend');
    ord = ord(1:min(maxPair,numel(ord)));
    FA = FA(ord);
    Fdecs = FA.decs;
    Fobjs = FA.objs;
    Idecs = IB.decs;
    Iobjs = IB.objs;
end

function [Decs,Objs] = UniqueArchiveCandidates_BDG(Decs,Objs,Problem)
    if isempty(Decs)
        Decs = zeros(0,Problem.D);
        Objs = zeros(0,Problem.M);
        return;
    end
    [~,ia] = unique([Decs,Objs],'rows','stable');
    Decs = Decs(ia,:);
    Objs = Objs(ia,:);
end

function [Fdecs,Fobjs,Idecs,Iobjs] = PairUnifiedRefNeighborCandidates_BDG( ...
        Problem,FPoolDecs,FPoolObjs,IPoolDecs,IPoolObjs, ...
        W,nearTau,maxPair,pairRefMode)
    Fdecs = zeros(0,Problem.D);
    Fobjs = zeros(0,Problem.M);
    Idecs = zeros(0,Problem.D);
    Iobjs = zeros(0,Problem.M);
    if isempty(FPoolDecs) || isempty(IPoolDecs) || isempty(W)
        return;
    end

    ObjAll = [FPoolObjs;IPoolObjs];
    [~,zmin,zmax] = NormalizeObjMat_BDG(ObjAll);
    Fn = NormalizeObjMat_BDG(FPoolObjs,zmin,zmax);
    In = NormalizeObjMat_BDG(IPoolObjs,zmin,zmax);
    refF = AssignRefFromObj_BDG(FPoolObjs,W,zmin,zmax);
    refI = AssignRefFromObj_BDG(IPoolObjs,W,zmin,zmax);
    neighborCount = ArchivePairRefNeighborCount_BDG(pairRefMode);
    rowCap = size(FPoolDecs,1);
    Fdecs = zeros(rowCap,Problem.D);
    Fobjs = zeros(rowCap,Problem.M);
    Idecs = zeros(rowCap,Problem.D);
    Iobjs = zeros(rowCap,Problem.M);
    pairDist = zeros(rowCap,1);
    row = 0;

    for i = 1 : size(FPoolDecs,1)
        local = RefNeighborAllowed_BDG(refF(i),refI,W,neighborCount);
        if ~any(local)
            continue;
        end
        d = sqrt(sum((In - Fn(i,:)).^2,2));
        local = local & d <= nearTau;
        if ~any(local)
            continue;
        end
        idx = find(local);
        [bestDist,pos] = min(d(idx));
        j = idx(pos);
        row = row + 1;
        Fdecs(row,:) = FPoolDecs(i,:);
        Fobjs(row,:) = FPoolObjs(i,:);
        Idecs(row,:) = IPoolDecs(j,:);
        Iobjs(row,:) = IPoolObjs(j,:);
        pairDist(row,1) = bestDist;
    end
    Fdecs = Fdecs(1:row,:);
    Fobjs = Fobjs(1:row,:);
    Idecs = Idecs(1:row,:);
    Iobjs = Iobjs(1:row,:);
    pairDist = pairDist(1:row);

    if isfinite(maxPair) && size(Fdecs,1) > maxPair
        [~,ord] = sort(pairDist,'ascend');
        ord = ord(1:maxPair);
        Fdecs = Fdecs(ord,:);
        Fobjs = Fobjs(ord,:);
        Idecs = Idecs(ord,:);
        Iobjs = Iobjs(ord,:);
    end
end

function [AF,AI,Diag] = RebuildArchive_BDG(Problem,Fdecs,Fobjs,Idecs,Iobjs,W,perRef,Options)
    Diag = EmptyRebuildDiag_BDG();
    if nargin < 8 || isempty(Options)
        Options = struct();
    end
    Options = NormalizeArchiveOptions_BDG(Options);
    Diag.archive_source_cap_mode = Options.sourceCapMode;
    rank = ParetoRank_BDG(Fobjs);
    front1 = rank == 1;
    Diag.AF_front1_count = sum(front1);
    Diag.AF_front1_ratio = SafeRatio_BDG(Diag.AF_front1_count,numel(front1));
    ref = AssignRefFromObj_BDG(Fobjs,W);
    paretoKeep = ArchiveParetoFilterMask_BDG(Fobjs,ref, ...
        Options.paretoFilterMode);
    Diag.archive_pareto_filter_mode = Options.paretoFilterMode;
    Diag.archive_pareto_filter_candidate_count = numel(paretoKeep);
    Diag.archive_pareto_filter_keep_count = sum(paretoKeep);
    Diag.archive_pareto_filter_keep_ratio = SafeRatio_BDG( ...
        Diag.archive_pareto_filter_keep_count, ...
        Diag.archive_pareto_filter_candidate_count);
    if ~any(paretoKeep)
        paretoKeep = true(size(paretoKeep));
    end
    Fdecs = Fdecs(paretoKeep,:);
    Fobjs = Fobjs(paretoKeep,:);
    Idecs = Idecs(paretoKeep,:);
    Iobjs = Iobjs(paretoKeep,:);
    rank  = rank(paretoKeep);
    front1 = front1(paretoKeep);
    ref = ref(paretoKeep);

    directionKeep = ArchivePairDirectionMask_BDG( ...
        Fobjs,Iobjs,Options.pairDirectionMode);
    Diag.archive_pair_direction_mode = Options.pairDirectionMode;
    Diag.archive_pair_direction_candidate_count = numel(directionKeep);
    Diag.archive_pair_direction_keep_count = sum(directionKeep);
    Diag.archive_pair_direction_keep_ratio = SafeRatio_BDG( ...
        Diag.archive_pair_direction_keep_count, ...
        Diag.archive_pair_direction_candidate_count);
    Fdecs = Fdecs(directionKeep,:);
    Fobjs = Fobjs(directionKeep,:);
    Idecs = Idecs(directionKeep,:);
    Iobjs = Iobjs(directionKeep,:);
    rank  = rank(directionKeep);
    front1 = front1(directionKeep);
    ref = ref(directionKeep);

    pairRefKeep = ArchivePairRefMask_BDG(Fobjs,Iobjs,W,Options.pairRefMode);
    Diag.archive_pair_ref_mode = Options.pairRefMode;
    Diag.archive_pair_ref_candidate_count = numel(pairRefKeep);
    Diag.archive_pair_ref_keep_count = sum(pairRefKeep);
    Diag.archive_pair_ref_keep_ratio = SafeRatio_BDG( ...
        Diag.archive_pair_ref_keep_count, ...
        Diag.archive_pair_ref_candidate_count);
    Fdecs = Fdecs(pairRefKeep,:);
    Fobjs = Fobjs(pairRefKeep,:);
    Idecs = Idecs(pairRefKeep,:);
    Iobjs = Iobjs(pairRefKeep,:);
    rank  = rank(pairRefKeep);
    front1 = front1(pairRefKeep);
    ref = ref(pairRefKeep);
    if isempty(Fdecs)
        AF = InitArchiveLike_BDG(Problem);
        AI = InitArchiveLike_BDG(Problem);
        Diag.AF_kept_front1_ratio = NaN;
        return;
    end

    [Fn,zmin,zmax] = NormalizeObjMat_BDG(Fobjs);
    In = NormalizeObjMat_BDG(Iobjs,zmin,zmax);

    gapObj = sqrt(sum((Fn - In).^2,2));
    rankPenalty = double(rank(:) - 1);

    score = Options.scoreGapWeight*NormalizeScoreVector_BDG(gapObj) + ...
        Options.scoreRankWeight*NormalizeScoreVector_BDG(rankPenalty);

    keep = false(size(score));
    refs = unique(ref(isfinite(ref) & ref > 0),'stable');
    for j = 1 : numel(refs)
        idx = find(ref == refs(j));
        if isempty(idx)
            continue;
        end
        [~,ord] = sort(score(idx),'ascend');
        idx = idx(ord(1:min(perRef,numel(ord))));
        keep(idx) = true;
    end

    if ~any(keep)
        [~,ord] = sort(score,'ascend');
        keep(ord(1:min(perRef,numel(ord)))) = true;
    end

    AF.decs  = Fdecs(keep,:);
    AF.objs  = Fobjs(keep,:);
    AF.ref   = ref(keep);
    AF.score = score(keep);

    AI.decs  = Idecs(keep,:);
    AI.objs  = Iobjs(keep,:);
    AI.ref   = ref(keep);
    AI.score = score(keep);

    Diag.AF_kept_front1_ratio = SafeRatio_BDG(sum(front1(keep)),sum(keep));
    Diag.score_gap_obj_med = MedianFiniteArchive_BDG(gapObj(keep));
    Diag.score_rank_med = MedianFiniteArchive_BDG(rank(keep));
    Diag.score_gap_weight = Options.scoreGapWeight;
    Diag.score_rank_weight = Options.scoreRankWeight;
end

function Diag = EmptyRebuildDiag_BDG()
    Diag = struct( ...
        'AF_front1_count',0, ...
        'AF_front1_ratio',NaN, ...
        'AF_kept_front1_ratio',NaN, ...
        'score_gap_obj_med',NaN, ...
        'score_rank_med',NaN, ...
        'score_gap_weight',0.80, ...
        'score_rank_weight',0.20, ...
        'archive_source_cap_mode',"limited", ...
        'archive_pareto_filter_mode',"none", ...
        'archive_pareto_filter_candidate_count',0, ...
        'archive_pareto_filter_keep_count',0, ...
        'archive_pareto_filter_keep_ratio',NaN, ...
        'archive_pair_direction_mode',"none", ...
        'archive_pair_direction_candidate_count',0, ...
        'archive_pair_direction_keep_count',0, ...
        'archive_pair_direction_keep_ratio',NaN, ...
        'archive_pair_ref_mode',"none", ...
        'archive_pair_ref_candidate_count',0, ...
        'archive_pair_ref_keep_count',0, ...
        'archive_pair_ref_keep_ratio',NaN);
end

function Options = NormalizeArchiveOptions_BDG(Options)
    if ~isstruct(Options)
        Options = struct();
    end
    if ~isfield(Options,'scoreGapWeight') || isempty(Options.scoreGapWeight)
        Options.scoreGapWeight = 1.00;
    end
    if ~isfield(Options,'scoreRankWeight') || isempty(Options.scoreRankWeight)
        Options.scoreRankWeight = 0.00;
    end
    if ~isfield(Options,'sourceCapMode') || isempty(Options.sourceCapMode)
        Options.sourceCapMode = "limited";
    end
    if ~isfield(Options,'paretoFilterMode') || isempty(Options.paretoFilterMode)
        Options.paretoFilterMode = "global_af_nd";
    end
    if ~isfield(Options,'pairDirectionMode') || isempty(Options.pairDirectionMode)
        Options.pairDirectionMode = "ai_dominates_af";
    end
    if ~isfield(Options,'pairRefMode') || isempty(Options.pairRefMode)
        Options.pairRefMode = "none";
    end
    gapWeight = double(Options.scoreGapWeight);
    rankWeight = double(Options.scoreRankWeight);
    assert(isfinite(gapWeight) && isfinite(rankWeight) && ...
        gapWeight >= 0 && rankWeight >= 0, ...
        'UpdateBoundaryArchive_BDG:BadScoreWeights', ...
        'Archive score weights must be finite nonnegative scalars.');
    total = gapWeight + rankWeight;
    assert(total > 0, ...
        'UpdateBoundaryArchive_BDG:BadScoreWeights', ...
        'At least one archive score weight must be positive.');
    Options.scoreGapWeight = gapWeight / total;
    Options.scoreRankWeight = rankWeight / total;
    Options.sourceCapMode = NormalizeArchiveSourceCapMode_BDG( ...
        Options.sourceCapMode);
    Options.paretoFilterMode = NormalizeArchiveParetoFilterMode_BDG( ...
        Options.paretoFilterMode);
    Options.pairDirectionMode = NormalizeArchivePairDirectionMode_BDG( ...
        Options.pairDirectionMode);
    Options.pairRefMode = NormalizeArchivePairRefMode_BDG( ...
        Options.pairRefMode);
end

function maxPair = ArchiveSourceMaxPair_BDG(baseMaxPair,mode)
    mode = NormalizeArchiveSourceCapMode_BDG(mode);
    switch mode
        case "limited"
            maxPair = baseMaxPair;
        case "none"
            maxPair = Inf;
    end
end

function mode = NormalizeArchiveSourceCapMode_BDG(mode)
    mode = lower(strtrim(string(mode)));
    valid = ["limited","none"];
    assert(ismember(mode,valid), ...
        'UpdateBoundaryArchive_BDG:BadSourceCapMode', ...
        'Archive sourceCapMode must be one of: %s.', ...
        strjoin(valid,", "));
end

function mode = NormalizeArchiveParetoFilterMode_BDG(mode)
    mode = lower(strtrim(string(mode)));
    valid = "global_af_nd";
    assert(ismember(mode,valid), ...
        'UpdateBoundaryArchive_BDG:BadParetoFilterMode', ...
        'Archive paretoFilterMode must be one of: %s.', ...
        strjoin(valid,", "));
end

function keep = ArchiveParetoFilterMask_BDG(PopObj,ref,mode)
    %#ok<INUSD>
    mode = NormalizeArchiveParetoFilterMode_BDG(mode);
    keep = FirstFront_BDG(PopObj);
end

function mode = NormalizeArchivePairDirectionMode_BDG(mode)
    mode = lower(strtrim(string(mode)));
    valid = ["ai_dominates_af","af_not_dominates_ai"];
    assert(ismember(mode,valid), ...
        'UpdateBoundaryArchive_BDG:BadPairDirectionMode', ...
        'Archive pairDirectionMode must be one of: %s.', ...
        strjoin(valid,", "));
end

function mode = NormalizeArchivePairRefMode_BDG(mode)
    mode = lower(strtrim(string(mode)));
    valid = ["none","neighbor4"];
    assert(ismember(mode,valid), ...
        'UpdateBoundaryArchive_BDG:BadPairRefMode', ...
        'Archive pairRefMode must be one of: %s.', ...
        strjoin(valid,", "));
end

function keep = ArchivePairDirectionMask_BDG(Fobjs,Iobjs,mode)
    mode = NormalizeArchivePairDirectionMode_BDG(mode);
    n = size(Fobjs,1);
    keep = true(n,1);
    if isempty(Fobjs) || isempty(Iobjs)
        keep = false(n,1);
        return;
    end
    epsTol = 1e-12;
    switch mode
        case "ai_dominates_af"
            keep = all(Iobjs <= Fobjs + epsTol,2) & ...
                any(Iobjs < Fobjs - epsTol,2);
        case "af_not_dominates_ai"
            afDominatesAI = all(Fobjs <= Iobjs + epsTol,2) & ...
                any(Fobjs < Iobjs - epsTol,2);
            keep = ~afDominatesAI;
    end
end

function keep = ArchivePairRefMask_BDG(Fobjs,Iobjs,W,mode)
    mode = NormalizeArchivePairRefMode_BDG(mode);
    n = size(Fobjs,1);
    keep = true(n,1);
    if mode == "none"
        return;
    end
    if isempty(Fobjs) || isempty(Iobjs) || isempty(W)
        keep = false(n,1);
        return;
    end
    ObjAll = [Fobjs;Iobjs];
    [~,zmin,zmax] = NormalizeObjMat_BDG(ObjAll);
    refF = AssignRefFromObj_BDG(Fobjs,W,zmin,zmax);
    refI = AssignRefFromObj_BDG(Iobjs,W,zmin,zmax);
    neighborCount = ArchivePairRefNeighborCount_BDG(mode);
    keep = RefNeighborAllowed_BDG(refF,refI,W,neighborCount);
end

function neighborCount = ArchivePairRefNeighborCount_BDG(mode)
    mode = NormalizeArchivePairRefMode_BDG(mode);
    if mode == "neighbor4"
        neighborCount = 4;
    else
        neighborCount = 0;
    end
end

function keep = RefNeighborAllowed_BDG(refF,refI,W,neighborCount)
    if size(W,2) == 2
        keep = abs(double(refF(:)) - double(refI(:))) <= neighborCount;
    else
        keep = ReferenceNeighborMask_BDG(refF,refI,W,neighborCount);
    end
end

function keep = ReferenceNeighborMask_BDG(refF,refI,W,neighborCount)
    refF = double(refF(:));
    refI = double(refI(:));
    keep = false(size(refF));
    Wn = W ./ sqrt(sum(W.^2,2) + 1e-12);
    neighborCount = max(0,round(double(neighborCount)));
    for i = 1 : numel(refF)
        if ~isfinite(refF(i)) || ~isfinite(refI(i)) || ...
                refF(i) < 1 || refF(i) > size(W,1) || ...
                refI(i) < 1 || refI(i) > size(W,1)
            continue;
        end
        score = Wn(round(refF(i)),:) * Wn';
        [~,ord] = sort(score,'descend');
        allowed = ord(1:min(neighborCount+1,numel(ord)));
        keep(i) = ismember(round(refI(i)),allowed);
    end
end

function A = InitArchiveLike_BDG(Problem)
    A.decs  = zeros(0,Problem.D);
    A.objs  = zeros(0,Problem.M);
    A.ref   = zeros(0,1);
    A.score = zeros(0,1);
end

function flag = IsFeasibleSet_BDG(P)
    if isempty(P)
        flag = false(0,1);
        return;
    end
    if isempty(P.cons)
        flag = true(numel(P),1);
    else
        flag = all(P.cons <= 0,2);
    end
end

function front = FirstFront_BDG(PopObj)
    N = size(PopObj,1);
    domCount = zeros(N,1);
    for i = 1 : N-1
        for j = i+1 : N
            k = any(PopObj(i,:)<PopObj(j,:)) - any(PopObj(i,:)>PopObj(j,:));
            if k == 1
                domCount(j) = domCount(j) + 1;
            elseif k == -1
                domCount(i) = domCount(i) + 1;
            end
        end
    end
    front = domCount == 0;
end

function rank = ParetoRank_BDG(PopObj)
    N = size(PopObj,1);
    rank = zeros(N,1);
    remain = true(N,1);
    frontNo = 1;
    while any(remain)
        ids = find(remain);
        front = FirstFront_BDG(PopObj(ids,:));
        rank(ids(front)) = frontNo;
        remain(ids(front)) = false;
        frontNo = frontNo + 1;
    end
end

function ref = AssignRefFromObj_BDG(PopObj,W,zmin,zmax)
    if nargin < 3
        Y = NormalizeObjMat_BDG(PopObj);
    else
        Y = NormalizeObjMat_BDG(PopObj,zmin,zmax);
    end
    Wn = W ./ sqrt(sum(W.^2,2) + 1e-12);
    Yn = Y ./ sqrt(sum(Y.^2,2) + 1e-12);
    [~,ref] = max(Yn*Wn',[],2);
end

function [Y,zmin,zmax] = NormalizeObjMat_BDG(Obj,zmin,zmax)
    if isempty(Obj)
        Y = Obj;
        if nargin < 2
            zmin = zeros(1,size(Obj,2));
            zmax = zeros(1,size(Obj,2));
        end
        return;
    end
    if nargin < 2
        zmin = min(Obj,[],1);
        zmax = max(Obj,[],1);
    end
    Y = (Obj - zmin) ./ (zmax - zmin + 1e-12);
    Y = min(max(Y,0),1);
end

function score = NormalizeScoreVector_BDG(x)
    x = double(x(:));
    if isempty(x)
        score = zeros(size(x));
        return;
    end
    xmin = min(x);
    xmax = max(x);
    if xmax <= xmin
        score = zeros(size(x));
    else
        score = (x - xmin) ./ (xmax - xmin + 1e-12);
    end
end

function value = MedianFiniteArchive_BDG(x)
    x = double(x(:));
    x = x(isfinite(x));
    if isempty(x)
        value = NaN;
    else
        value = median(x);
    end
end

function value = SafeRatio_BDG(num,den)
    if den <= 0
        value = NaN;
    else
        value = double(num) / double(den);
    end
end

## B. 问题诊断

### 1. 边界存档和训练集构造

1. **当前 archive 不是“当前边界状态”，而更像“历史小 gap pair 缓存”。**
   `UpdateBoundaryArchive_BDG` 会把新 flip/cross pairs 与 previous archive 混在一起，再统一重建；`RebuildArchive_BDG` 先对 AF 做全局非支配过滤，再按 pair direction / ref 邻域过滤，最后按每个 ref 的小 gap score 选前 `perRef` 个 pair。默认 score 只看 gap，不看 age/currentness。
   **诊断**：这天然会把不同代、不同局部边界、不同可信度的 pair 一起保留下来。
   **证据来源**：源码机制。
2. **`global_af_nd` 的作用是“全局保留 AF 的 first front”，不是“局部当前边界去混合”。**
   它只做 `FirstFront_BDG(PopObj)`。如果两个不相邻的可行边界片段都全局 nondominated，它们会一起留在 archive。
   **证据来源**：源码机制。
3. **`af_not_dominates_ai` 太宽松。**
   它只排除“AF dominates AI”的 pair，保留“AI dominates AF”和“mutual ND”两类。对边界学习而言，这意味着 archive 允许同时含有“很像边界的 pair”和“只是可行/不可行相邻但质量方向差异很大”的 pair。
   **证据来源**：源码机制。
4. **`neighbor4` 只是 reference 邻域约束，不是 branch/cell 去混合。**
   它能阻止特别远的 ref 配对，但不能区分“同一 ref 邻域内的不同断裂边界/不同历史边界层”。
   **证据来源**：源码机制。
5. **`condition_knn` 的作用被高估了。**
   它做的是“在条件相近时，保留决策 spread 小的 triples”；这能降低条件到决策的多值性，但它并不改变 archive，不知道 pair 的代次、分支、可信度，也不知道目标空间边界几何。
   **证据来源**：源码机制 + 实验结果（no-KNN 变差）。
6. **`near_segment_feasible` 当前仍在制造 one-to-many 监督。**
   同一个 AF/AI pair，最多会挂 5 个 near-segment feasible targets；如果找不到还会回退到 AF endpoint。对 mainline 的 `yt_dt_ref` 而言，条件里没有 `t`，所以“同样的条件语义”可能对应多个不同目标决策。
   **这正是厚带的第一结构性来源。**
   **证据来源**：源码机制。
   **合理但未验证推断**：这会逼生成器学习条件均值或混合模态，而不是单值窄边界。
7. **图片与上述混合现象一致。**
   你上传的关键图里，DASCMOP1/2 多次出现两条斜射分支或宽弧带；DASCMOP4/5 的 full-scale 图里有明显远离训练橙线的 detached 红色簇；LIRCMOP 多个问题在局部 zoom 看似贴边，但 full-scale 会暴露大范围离线散点或跨多片边界的混合。
   **证据来源**：图片观察。

**对五个名词的审稿式定义：**

- `AF/AI pair`：当前算法里的目标空间边界代理段，AF 是可行侧 anchor，AI 是不可行侧 counterpart。
- `nearseg target`：把“boundary 学习目标”从 AF endpoint 改成 objective-space AF-AI segment 附近的 feasible evaluated source。
- `condition_knn`：训练集去冲突器，不是 archive 结构器。
- `neighbor4`：粗粒度 ref 邻域局部化器，不是 branch/cell 分离器。
- `global_af_nd`：AF 可行侧全局 first-front 过滤器，不是“当前边界”过滤器。

**我对“当前边界存档”的重定义：**

应改成 **Current Boundary Layer Archive（CBLA）**：
每个条目不是“一个历史 pair”，而是一个**当前、局部、带可信度的边界状态**：
$$
[
b_{r,c}=(x_F,x_I,y_{mid},n,\delta,s,q,age,sourceType)
]
$$
其中 `r` 是 reference direction，`c` 是 local cell/branch，`y_mid` 是 AF-AI 中点，`n` 是局部法向，`\delta` 是 AF-AI gap，`s` 是 cell 内边界坐标，`q` 是可信度。

**是否分层：**

- 按代：**要**，但只保留短窗口，不做永久分层。
- 按参考方向：**要**，这是主索引。
- 按局部 cell/branch：**必须要**，这是你当前最缺的层。
- 按边界层级（gap 大小）：**不要单独成层**，改做可信度/不确定度。
- 按 dominance progress：**不要单独成层**，改做可信度/采样权重。

**如何避免旧边界和新边界混训：**

- 不再把 previous archive 直接并入 raw candidate pool 后再统一配对。
- 先只用“当前代候选”形成 `(ref,cell)` 新边界；再与 previous archive 做**同 cell 对齐和覆盖更新**。
- 同一 `(ref,cell)` 上，新证据覆盖旧证据；旧证据只能以衰减方式保留 1–3 个 refresh，不能与新证据并列成训练样本。
- 每个 `(ref,cell)` 默认保留 1 个 canonical pair；最多 2 个，只允许在同一 cell 内表示局部厚度/不确定度，不能表示多条分支。

------

### 2. CGAN 生成解是否有核心价值

1. **当前更像“带随机性的条件重放/局部插值”，不是“可控外推”。**
   生成时 `GenerateRawDecisions_BDG` 先从 `GAN.conditionData` 里采样 stored conditions，再加随机 z；并不会主动构造“未覆盖 ref 的新 condition”。
   **所以当前 ref token 不能真正强制生成到未探索 ref，只能在已有 condition rows 上重采样。**
   **证据来源**：源码机制。
2. **`z=0` 这个名字现在不能按字面理解。**
   你的当前 run meta 记录的是 `zDim=4`，不是 deterministic zero-noise generator。
   **证据来源**：源码机制。
3. **因此，当前 CGAN 的“新颖性”是无约束的新颖性。**
   它可能生成训练集之外的决策变量，但这种偏移目前主要来自随机 z 和网络泛化误差，不是“按缺失参考方向定向补边界”。
   **证据来源**：源码机制 + 图片观察。
   **合理但未验证推断**：这也是 DASCMOP4/5、LIRCMOP 若干 full-scale 图出现 detached clusters 的原因之一。
4. **是否应提高生成稀缺 ref 的概率：应当，而且必须进入主线。**
   你现在真正缺的是“按 coverage deficit 分配 condition sampling / injection quota”，而不是再调 GAN 迭代次数。
   **证据来源**：尚无直接实验，但和你当前 stored-condition sampling 机制直接对应。
   相关公开工作里，把 unknown-constraint search 视为边界问题、并显式围绕边界分配搜索，是合理的设计方向；helper problem/弱耦合也是可借鉴框架。([Proceedings of Machine Learning Research](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v235/tian24g.html))
5. **如何证明 CGAN 不是训练集复读：当前证据不够。**
   你已有 `GAN_to_Segment_Dist50/90`、`BoundaryHit_all`、`injected_ref_cov/pair_cov`，这些能证明“贴边程度”，但不能证明“未探索 ref 上的有效生成”。
   **证据来源**：源码/结果包。

**必须新增的诊断图和指标：**

- **holdout-ref 图**：训练时故意去掉一组 refs/cells，只在这些 holdout refs 上生成，画 full-scale + zoom。
- **novelty-usefulness 散点**：横轴 = 到最近训练决策的距离，纵轴 = 到边界 segment 的距离或 boundary hit；证明不是最近邻抄写。
- **per-ref before/after injection 覆盖图**：哪些 refs 本来无样本，注入后被补到。
- **condition-out-of-support 诊断**：对 synthetic conditions（未出现在训练 rows 中）单独统计成功率。
- **baseline 对比**：与 kNN decision copy、local linear interpolation、纯 archive replay 三个非-GAN基线比。

------

### 3. CGAN 生成解不够贴边，形成厚点云

1. **当前 generator 真正在学的是“条件一致的目标决策重建”，不是“边界几何反演”。**
   当前损失是 adversarial + reconstruction Huber 到 `XTarget`；没有显式的 boundary width、signed distance、normal/tangent、local consistency 项。
   **证据来源**：源码机制。
2. **当前 `real labels` 和 `sample weights` 没有承担“窄边界”职责。**
   mainline 的 `targetRealLabelMode` 是 `binary`；`BoundaryQualityRealLabels_BDG` 虽然存在，但当前 retained variant 并不用。`condition_knn` 分支下也只是 hard keep，不产生 soft sample weights。
   **证据来源**：源码机制。
3. **厚带的直接机制有三层：**
   第一层：archive 混入不同代/不同 branch/不同 ref 局部。
   第二层：同一条件语义对应多个 target x。
   第三层：随机 z 吸收了“branch identity”，于是 z 不再是微扰，而变成了跨分支开关。
   **证据来源**：源码机制 + 图片观察。
   **合理但未验证推断**：这三层叠加后，最自然的输出就是厚云而不是窄线。
4. **你问的那些约束，要加，但要加在“可反传的 critic head”里，不要直接对黑盒 objective 反传。**
   这是实现层面的关键：`Problem.Evaluation` 不是可微图，不能把真实 objective-space signed distance 直接 backprop 到 generator。
   正确做法是：
   - 先用当前已评估样本离线计算 boundary labels；
   - 再让 critic 学这些 labels；
   - 最后 generator 通过 critic 的 boundary head 得到梯度。
     这点如果忽略，方案会落成不可训练的伪设计。
     **证据来源**：源码机制 + 问题设定。

**如何把训练目标改成“窄边界生成”：**

我建议把当前 `target-conditioned critic` 改成 **多头 critic**：

- `D_adv(x,c)`：保留现有 adversarial 头。
- `D_bnd(x,c)`：回归 boundary quality / segment distance。
- `D_side(x,c)`：分类在边界哪一侧，目标是“靠近边界且偏可行侧”。

其中 boundary labels 可以直接复用你已有 `BoundaryQualityTarget_BDG` 的离线逻辑：它已经能算 `segmentScore / feasibleScore / outsideScore`。只是现在它只停留在诊断/可选 label 层，还没有进入主线学习目标。

**我建议新增的 generator 目标：**
$$
[
L_G=L_{adv}+ \lambda_{rec}L_{rec}+ \lambda_{bnd}L_{bnd}+ \lambda_{cons}L_{cons}
]
$$


- `L_rec`：保留 Huber，但降级成“锚定项”，不再让它支配一切。
- `L_bnd`：最大化 critic 预测的 boundary quality，最小化 predicted segment distance，并偏向可行侧窄带。
- `L_cons`：**同一 condition、不同 z** 的两次生成，在法向方向上的偏差要小；z 只能保留微小残差，不能制造横向厚度。

**你问到的具体几何量：**

- 显式边界带宽：**要**，用 AF-AI gap `δ` 表示当前 boundary uncertainty。
- signed distance：**要**，但作为 critic 监督目标，不直接对真 objective 反传。
- pair segment coordinate：**要**，但不要简单复用旧 `t`；要在 de-mixed cell 内定义新的 `s`。
- normal/tangent 分解：**要**，condition 和 consistency loss 都用。
- 局部边界一致性：**必须要**。
- 参考方向 coverage：**要**，但放在采样/注入策略，不是 loss 主体。

------

### 4. CGAN 起作用的阶段

1. **当前并不存在真正阻止前期训练的 hard gate。**
   retained variant 里 `cganTrainMinRefCov=0`、`cganTrainMinTargetTriples=0`；run meta 里 `trainGap=1`、`archiveGap=1`。
   **也就是说，主线已经在“每代都尝试 archive / train / inject”。**
   **证据来源**：源码机制。
2. **前期无效的真正原因更像“伪边界质量差”，不是“训练门槛太高”。**
   主循环里只有当 `AFTrain` 非空、training data ready 时才会训练；早期最常见隐含门槛是 `AF_empty` 或 pair 稀缺，而不是 ref coverage gate。
   **证据来源**：源码机制。
3. **因此，答案不是“再去掉门槛”，而是“把每代都构造的 boundary 改成带可信度的 pseudo-boundary”。**
   **证据来源**：合理但未验证推断。

**统一规则：**

- 每代都构造 boundary archive。
- boundary entry 分三类：
  - `real`：parent-child feasibility flip；
  - `semi-real`：当前代局部 F/I nearest pair；
  - `pseudo`：只能由前一代同 cell 借位补全。
- 所有 entry 用同一套数据结构，只是 `sourceType` 不同、`q` 不同。
- 训练和注入都按 `q` 加权。
- 当同一 `(ref,cell)` 出现 real flip 时，自动覆盖 pseudo。

**如何避免把早期随机噪声当边界：**

- 必须加 `local consistency`：同 cell 连续 2–3 次出现，才升高权重。
- 必须加 `age decay`：伪边界如果几代内没有新证据，就自动退出训练集。
- 必须加 `one-cell-one-canonical-pair`：前期更不能让一个 cell 同时保留多 pair。

------

## C. 核心算法重构方案

我建议把主线整体重构成一个统一方案：**CBL-CGAN（Current Boundary Layer CGAN）**。它不是再加一个 patch，而是把 archive、condition、loss、sampling 全部围绕“当前边界场”统一。

### 1. 边界存档定义

**Current Boundary Layer Archive（CBLA）**
每个 `(ref,cell)` 只保留当前最可信的 1 个 canonical pair（必要时 2 个），字段为：

- `xF, xI`：可行/不可行决策解
- `y_mid`：目标空间中点
- `n_hat`：局部法向
- `delta`：AF-AI gap，表示边界不确定度
- `s`：cell 内局部边界坐标
- `q`：可信度
- `age`：距当前代的年龄
- `sourceType ∈ {real, semi-real, pseudo}``

**更新规则**
先由当前代候选构造新 pair；再与 previous archive 做同 cell 对齐覆盖；不允许 previous archive 先混入 raw candidate pool。

### 2. 训练集构造方式

- **一个 archive state 对应一个 canonical target decision。**
- `near_segment_feasible` 保留其“从 objective boundary 找 feasible source”的思想，但从“每 pair 取多点”改为“每 `(ref,cell,s)` 只取一个 medoid/canonical target`x*`”。
- 如果同一 condition bin 内存在多个目标决策，先分 cell；分不开时只留 medoid，不把多模态直接塞给 generator。
- fallback 到 AF endpoint 只允许作为低可信度 pseudo sample，不能与 real boundary samples 同权混训。

### 3. condition 构造方式

把当前 `yt_dt_ref` 改成：
$$
[
c=[y_{mid}, n_{\hat{}}, \delta, ref_token, s, q]
]
$$


- `y_mid` 比 AF endpoint 更像真实边界位置。
- `n_hat` 给出可行/不可行方向信息。
- `delta` 表示当前 boundary band 宽度。
- `ref_token` 保留。
- `s` 不是旧的 `t`；它是在**de-mixed local cell** 上定义的局部边界坐标。
- `q` 用于告诉 GAN 当前条件有多可信。

### 4. z 的使用方式

- **保留 GAN/CGAN 的 z，以满足你的硬约束。**
- 但把 z 从“branch selector”降级为“微小残差源”。
- 主线注入时默认 `z=0`，或固定极小噪声集合；
- 训练时加同一 condition 的 consistency loss，迫使不同 z 不得在法向上拉厚边界。

这里特别强调：当前 variant 名虽然带 `z0`，但你当前 run meta 的实际配置是 `zDim=4`，所以现在并不是 deterministic zero-noise generation。

### 5. CGAN loss / discriminator 设计

- **critic 改为多头**：
  - `adv head`：现有 matched/mismatched/fake 对抗判别；
  - `boundary head`：预测 boundary quality / segment distance；
  - `side head`：预测“靠近边界且位于可行侧”的概率。
- **generator loss**：
  - 保留 `adv + Huber`；
  - 新增 `boundary head` 的质量项；
  - 新增同一 condition 多 z 的 thinness consistency 项。
- **boundary labels 的来源**：
  直接复用现有 `BoundaryQualityTarget_BDG` 离线算出的 `segmentScore / feasibleScore / outsideScore`，不要再开一个完全新的 label 体系。

### 6. 每代训练频率

- 保留 **fixed-iter**，默认仍用 `iter30`。
- `archive update / training / injection` 继续每代执行。
- 训练集只用最近 `H` 代的 CBLA 条目，`H` 建议极小（3–5）；不要全历史。

### 7. 每代生成/注入策略

- 不再按“训练 rows 频数”抽条件。
- 改成按 **ref-cell coverage deficit × confidence** 分配 quota。
- 生成两类 conditions：
  1. **observed conditions**：当前 archive 中已有的 `(ref,cell,s)`；
  2. **synthetic missing-ref conditions**：在同一 cell 内，对相邻已覆盖 refs 的 boundary states 线性插值，构造当前未覆盖 ref 的新 condition。

这一步才是真正让 CGAN 具备“向未探索参考方向生成有价值边界解”的机制。
相关公开 GAN-guided search 工作也把 GAN 定位为“把目标空间 guiding points 映回决策空间”的生成器，而不是简单复制训练样本；但训练数据的 convergence/diversity 质量仍是决定性因素。([ResearchGate](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/382842229_Learning_to_Evolve_With_Guiding_Solutions_Generated_by_Generative_Adversarial_Network?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

### 8. 伪边界到真实边界的过渡规则

统一一个规则，不分三套阶段逻辑：

- **早期**：多数条目是 pseudo / semi-real，`q` 低；GAN 主要做方向引导。
- **中期**：real flip pairs 出现，覆盖 pseudo；`q` 提高。
- **后期**：只有稳定 real cells 获得高权重；GAN 输出收缩到窄边界中心线。

也就是说：
**规则不变，只变 `q`。**

### 9. 如何生成窄边界线而不是厚点云

核心只有五条：

1. archive 去混合；
2. one-condition-one-target；
3. branch identity 由 `(ref,cell,s)` 决定，不由 z 决定；
4. critic 显式学习 boundary quality；
5. 注入按 ref-cell deficit，而不是按训练 row 频数。

### 10. 如何证明 CGAN 能生成未探索参考方向上的有价值边界解

必须做一个**holdout-ref / holdout-cell 证明协议**：

- 训练时去掉一部分 refs/cells；
- 用 synthetic missing-ref conditions 生成这些 holdout refs 上的解；
- 与三类基线比：nearest decision copy、kNN interpolation、仅 replay stored conditions。

若 CGAN 在 holdout refs 上仍能取得更低的 `GAN_to_Segment_Dist50/90`、更高的 `BoundaryHit_all` 和更好的最终 IGD/HV 贡献，才算证明它有核心价值。

------

## D. 应删除或避免的方向

以下方向不应继续投入：

1. **CompactCell 全线及其修补猜想。**
   结果包已明确把 CompactCell、small architecture、early-stop、refcov/nGen50 修复猜想全部移出主线；`J_early_only` 甚至出现 Seg50/Seg90 崩溃。
   **证据**：源码包 256-269, 389-392。
2. **把 fused 当成独立创新点。**
   结果包已给出“fused 无独立价值，只是把同一 KNN 逻辑前移”。
   **证据**：源码包 383-385, 403。
3. **endpoint target。**
   已被 nearseg 明确压制，不应再回头。
   **证据**：源码包 246, 401。
4. **no-KNN 主线。**
   去掉 KNN 后 Seg50/Seg90/IGD 明显变差。
   **证据**：源码包 247, 281, 388, 402。
5. **旧 `t` token 主线。**
   现有实验已经说明 `t` 单独会伤害 tail boundary，而 `yt_dt_t_ref` 虽然 Seg50 好，但综合不如 `yt_dt_ref`。
   **证据**：源码包 286-289, 393-396, 405-406。
   这里要强调：我建议的新 `s` 不是把旧 `t` 捡回来；它建立在“先按 cell 去混合”之后，语义不同。
6. **epoch50 作为默认。**
   它只应保留为“慢但可比的旧质量基线”，不应回主线。
   **证据**：源码包 275, 382, 400。
7. **用 RawGANFeasibleRate 代替边界质量。**
   结果包已经明写不能这样做。
   **证据**：源码包 237-240, 410-415。

------

## E. 下一轮实验计划

我建议只做 4 个算法分支 + 1 个证明协议。

### 分支 R1：`recent_cell_archive`

- **验证什么假设**：厚带主要来自 archive 的历史混合与 branch 混合。
- **改了什么**：把 `UpdateBoundaryArchive_BDG` 改成 recent-window + `(ref,cell)` overwrite；取消 previous archive 先入 raw pool。
- **预期图片变化**：DASCMOP1/2 的两条红色斜射分支明显收缩；DASCMOP4/5 的 far-right detached cluster 大幅减少。
- **预期指标变化**：`Seg90` 明显下降，`Seg50` 下降，`core/A` 不劣于主线，`IGD` 下降或持平，`HV` 上升或持平。
- **若失败**：否定“历史混合是主因”。

### 分支 R2：`mid_normal_ref_s`

- **验证什么假设**：same-condition multi-target 与缺失 branch coordinate 是厚带主因。
- **改了什么**：condition 改成 `[y_mid,n_hat,delta,ref,s,q]`；训练集改成 one-condition-one-target。
- **预期图片变化**：DASCMOP2、LIRCMOP5/7 从局部散团变成单条窄线；zoom 与 full-scale 结论一致。
- **预期指标变化**：`Seg50` 会是最敏感的提升项，`Seg90` 继续下降，`IGD/HV` 小幅改善。
- **若失败**：否定“condition 语义不够可辨识”这一判断。

### 分支 R3：`thin_boundary_critic`

- **验证什么假设**：当前 loss 学的是 replay，不是 boundary geometry。
- **改了什么**：多头 critic + boundary quality head + same-condition consistency loss；保留 adversarial + Huber。
- **预期图片变化**：full-scale 图中的离线 outliers 和厚尾显著减少；尤其是 LIRCMOP、DASCMOP4/5 的 tail scatter 收缩。
- **预期指标变化**：`Seg90`、`BoundaryHit_all`、`GAN_to_Segment_Dist90` 改善最明显，`IGD/HV` 稳中有升。
- **若失败**：否定“显式窄边界训练目标”是必要项。

### 分支 R4：`confidence_pseudoboundary`

- **验证什么假设**：前期无效不是因为 gate，而是因为 pseudo-boundary 无可信度管理。
- **改了什么**：每代构造 pseudo/semi-real/real 三类边界条目，统一用 `q` 加权训练与注入。
- **预期图片变化**：早期 FE（例如 10%–30% FE）就能看到红点沿“当前自认为边界”集中，而不是大范围散布。
- **预期指标变化**：早期 snapshot 的 `Seg50/Seg90` 更好，最终 `core/A` 和 `IGD/HV` 不回退。
- **若失败**：否定“前期问题主要是可信度而非训练时机”。

### 证明协议 P1：`holdout_ref_value_proof`

- **验证什么假设**：CGAN 不是训练集复读，而能补未探索 refs/cells。
- **改了什么**：不改算法，只改评估；训练时 mask 一部分 refs/cells，注入只对 holdout refs。
- **预期图片变化**：holdout refs 上出现贴边窄线，而不是复制邻近已训练 ref 的橙点。
- **预期指标变化**：holdout refs 上的 `BoundaryHit_all`、`GAN_to_Segment_Dist50/90` 优于 nearest-copy / kNN interpolation；整体 `IGD/HV` 有正贡献。
- **若失败**：直接否定“CGAN 有超出 replay 的核心价值”。

------

## F. 验收标准

### 1. 图片验收

必须同时看 **full-scale 图** 和 **zoom 图**：

- 红色 `CGAN generated` 应形成**单条窄边界线/窄带**；
- 不允许跨两个边界形成弧形厚带；
- 不允许出现 detached far clusters；
- 不允许局部 zoom 看起来很好，但 full-scale 暴露大尺度离线散点；
- 至少在 DASCMOP1/2/4/5 和 LIRCMOP5/6/7/8/9 中各选代表图通过。

### 2. 指标验收

不能只看 `RawGANFeasibleRate`。
必须同时看：

- `Seg50`
- `Seg90`
- `core/A`
- `IGD`
- `HV`

并辅以：

- `BoundaryHit_all`
- `GAN_to_Segment_Dist50/90`
- `injected_ref_cov`
- `injected_pair_cov`
- `injected_duplicate_rate`

### 3. 价值验收

必须证明：

- 在训练样本不足或缺失的 refs/cells 上，CGAN 仍能生成有价值边界解；
- 且其效果优于 nearest sample replay、kNN interpolation、local linear interpolation 三个非-GAN基线。

否则，CGAN 只是在做“高成本条件重放”。

### 4. 阶段验收

- 前期（10%–30% FE）就应看到 pseudo-boundary 引导效果；
- 中后期再逐步收缩成真实边界窄线；
- 不能只在“已经找到边界之后”才有用。

------

## G. 代码落地建议

优先改这 7 处。

1. **`CCMO-GAN-BDG__UpdateBoundaryArchive_BDG.m`**
   责任改为：
   - 只从当前代构造 candidate pairs；
   - 新增 `AssignBoundaryCell_BDG`；
   - 新增 recent-window / overwrite / decay；
   - 不再把 previous archive 直接并进 raw pairing pool；
   - 输出 `confidence q / age / sourceType / cell / s`。
2. **`CCMO-GAN-BDG__BuildBoundaryTargetTriples_BDG.m`**
   责任改为：
   - 从 pair-triples 生成 **canonical boundary states**；
   - 由多 target 改成 one-condition-one-target；
   - 生成 `y_mid / n_hat / delta / ref / s / q`；
   - fallback 样本单独标记低可信度，不与 real samples 同权。
3. **`CCMO-GAN-BDG__FilterBoundaryTargetTriples_BDG.m`**
   责任改为：
   - 保留 `condition_knn`，但只把它当 cell 内 conflict detector；
   - 新增 medoid 选取 / duplicate merge；
   - 新增按 ref-cell deficit 生成 condition sampling weights。
4. **`CCMO-GAN-BDG__BoundaryConditionKNNKeepMask_BDG.m`**
   责任改为：
   - 从“全局 hard keep”改成“cell 内冲突检测 + 置信度惩罚”；
   - 不再承担全套去混合职责。
5. **`CCMO-GAN-BDG__BoundaryGAN_BDG.m`**
   责任改为：
   - target-conditioned critic 升级为多头；
   - 新增 boundary-quality / side heads；
   - 新增 same-condition consistency loss；
   - 支持 deterministic `z=0` sampling；
   - 支持“外部 synthetic condition batch”输入，而不是只能从 stored conditions 抽样。
6. **`CCMO-GAN-BDG__BoundaryQualityTarget_BDG.m`**
   责任改为：
   - 从“诊断/可选标签”升级为主线监督源；
   - 输出 boundary quality、side、segment coordinate、confidence labels；
   - 给 critic 训练直接使用。
7. **`CCMO-GAN-BDG__CCMO_GAN_BDG.m`**
   责任改为：
   - 每代 recent-window archive/training/injection 总调度；
   - synthetic missing-ref condition 构造；
   - holdout-ref 诊断导出；
   - stage figures 同时导出 full-scale 与 zoom 验收图。

测试文件也要同步扩展，至少新增：

- no-old-new-mixing
- one-condition-one-target
- same-ref-cell overwrite
- z=0 repeatability
- synthetic missing-ref condition generation
- holdout-ref metrics export

------

**总判断**：
你现在最该解决的，不是再调 `iter / nGen / KNN ratio`，而是把系统从“混合 pair 驱动的条件重建 GAN”改成“当前边界场驱动的条件生成 GAN”。unknown-constraint 问题把搜索重点放在 feasible/infeasible boundary 附近，是有公开文献支撑的；但要让它真正变成你这套直接决策生成 CGAN 的核心价值，必须先把 archive 去混合、condition 去歧义、loss 去厚带。([Proceedings of Machine Learning Research](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v235/tian24g.html))

% ganGSteps --- 1 --- G update steps per GAN iteration

                Offspring2  = OperatorDE(Problem,Population2, ...
                    Population2(MatingPool2(1:end/2)), ...
                    Population2(MatingPool2(end/2+1:end)));

                ArchiveDiag = EmptyMainArchiveDiag_BDG(ArchiveOptions);
                if ShouldUpdateBoundaryArchive_BDG(gen,archiveGap)
                    tStart = tic;
                    [AF,AI,ArchiveDiag] = UpdateBoundaryArchive_BDG(Problem,AF,AI, ...
                        Population1,Offspring1,Population2,Offspring2, ...
                        W,perRef,nearTau,ArchiveOptions);
                    Timing = ProfileTimerAdd_BDG(Timing, ...
                        't_archive_update',toc(tStart));
                end

                OffspringG = Offspring1([]);
                writeMetricsRow = false;
                if mod(gen,trainGap) == 0
                    GanDiag = EmptyGanDiag_BDG(Problem.M,Problem.D);
                    [AFTrain,AITrain,~] = SelectGANTrainingArchive_BDG( ...
                        AF,AI);
                    GanDiag.train_af_count = size(AFTrain.decs,1);
                    [GanDiag.train_ref_count,GanDiag.train_ref_cov] = ...
                        TrainingArchiveRefCoverage_BDG(AFTrain,W);
                    trainRefCount = GanDiag.train_ref_count;
                    trainRefCov = GanDiag.train_ref_cov;

                    refreshFlag = false;
                    skipReason = "AF_empty";
                    if ~isempty(AFTrain.decs)
                        previousGAN = GAN;
                        ThisGANTrainOptions = GANTrainOptions;
                        tStart = tic;
                        EvaluatedSource = BuildEvaluatedFeasibleSource_BDG( ...
                            Problem,Population1,Offspring1, ...
                            Population2,Offspring2,AFTrain);
                        Timing = ProfileTimerAdd_BDG(Timing, ...
                            't_source_build',toc(tStart));
                        [GANTrainDecs,GANTrainAI,GANConditionData, ...
                            GANTrainWeights,GANRealLabels,TargetTrainDiag] = ...
                            BuildGANTrainingSet_BDG(AFTrain,AITrain,W, ...
                            Problem,GANTrainOptions.generatorMode, ...
                            ExperimentControl,EvaluatedSource);
                        GANConditionRefIndex = TargetConditionRefIndex_BDG( ...
                            TargetTrainDiag,AFTrain);
                        [GANTrainWeights,holdoutMask,HoldoutDiag] = ...
                            ApplyHoldoutTrainingMask_BDG(GANTrainWeights, ...
                            GANConditionRefIndex,ExperimentControl,W);
                        TargetTrainDiag = MergeDiagFields_BDG( ...
                            TargetTrainDiag,HoldoutDiag);
                        Timing = ProfileTimerAdd_BDG(Timing, ...
                            't_target_build', ...
                            DiagScalar_BDG(TargetTrainDiag,'t_target_build',0));
                        Timing = ProfileTimerAdd_BDG(Timing, ...
                            't_target_filter', ...
                            DiagScalar_BDG(TargetTrainDiag,'t_target_filter',0));
                        TargetReady = IsTrainingDataReady_BDG( ...
                            GANTrainDecs,GANConditionData, ...
                            ThisGANTrainOptions.generatorMode);
                        GanDiag = MergeDiagFields_BDG(GanDiag, ...
                            TargetTrainDiag);
                        [GanDiag.train_ref_count,GanDiag.train_ref_cov] = ...
                            TargetTrainingRefCoverage_BDG( ...
                            TargetTrainDiag,AFTrain,W, ...
                            trainRefCount,trainRefCov);
                        [GateReady,~,~] = IsCGANTrainCoverageReady_BDG( ...
                            TargetTrainDiag,GanDiag.train_ref_cov, ...
                            ExperimentControl);
                        if TargetReady && GateReady
                            ThisGANTrainOptions.sampleWeights = GANTrainWeights;
                            ThisGANTrainOptions.realLabels = GANRealLabels;
                            ThisGANTrainOptions.conditionData = GANConditionData;
                            if isfield(TargetTrainDiag,'target_keep_index')
                                ThisGANTrainOptions.conditionPairIndex = ...
                                    TargetTrainDiag.target_keep_index;
                            else
                                ThisGANTrainOptions.conditionPairIndex = [];
                            end
                            ThisGANTrainOptions.conditionRefIndex = ...
                                GANConditionRefIndex;
                            tStart = tic;
                            GAN = BoundaryGAN_BDG('traindirectboundary', ...
                                GANTrainDecs,GANTrainAI, ...
                                Problem.lower,Problem.upper, ...
                                zDim,ganIter,previousGAN, ...
                                ThisGANTrainOptions);
                            if any(holdoutMask)
                                GAN.conditionSamplingWeights = ...
                                    double(holdoutMask(:));
                            end
                            P1BaselineDiag = BuildP1HoldoutBaselineDiag_BDG( ...
                                Problem,AFTrain,AITrain,W,GANTrainDecs, ...
                                GANConditionData,GANConditionRefIndex, ...
                                holdoutMask,nGen);
                            Timing = ProfileTimerAdd_BDG(Timing, ...
                                't_gan_train',toc(tStart));
                            candidateN = nGen;
                            [OffspringG,GanDiag] = BoundaryGAN_BDG( ...
                                'sample',Problem,GAN,candidateN);
                            [OffspringG,GanDiag] = ...
                                SelectInjectedCandidates_BDG( ...
                                OffspringG,GanDiag,nGen);
                            GanDiag = EnsureGanDiag_BDG(GanDiag,Problem.M, ...
                                Problem.D);
                            GanDiag = MergeDiagFields_BDG(GanDiag, ...
                                TargetTrainDiag);
                            GanDiag = MergeDiagFields_BDG(GanDiag, ...
                                P1BaselineDiag);
                            GanDiag.train_af_count = size(AFTrain.decs,1);
                            [GanDiag.train_ref_count,GanDiag.train_ref_cov] = ...
                                TargetTrainingRefCoverage_BDG( ...
                                TargetTrainDiag,AFTrain,W, ...
                                trainRefCount,trainRefCov);
                            if isfield(GAN,'targetConditionedDiag')
                                GanDiag = MergeDiagFields_BDG(GanDiag, ...
                                    GAN.targetConditionedDiag);
                            end
                            if isfield(GAN,'pretrainDiag')
                                GanDiag = MergeDiagFields_BDG(GanDiag, ...
                                    GAN.pretrainDiag);
                            end
                            trainDiagN = 100;
                            tStart = tic;
                            GanDiag = MergeDiagFields_BDG(GanDiag, ...
                                BoundaryGAN_BDG('traindiagnose',GAN, ...
                                GANTrainDecs,GANTrainAI, ...
                                Problem.lower,Problem.upper,trainDiagN));
                            if probeRawN > 0
                                GanDiag = MergeDiagFields_BDG(GanDiag, ...
                                    ProbeBoundaryGANNoBudget_BDG(Problem,GAN, ...
                                    probeRawN));
                            end
                            Timing = ProfileTimerAdd_BDG(Timing, ...
                                't_gan_diagnose',toc(tStart));
                            refreshFlag = true;
                            skipReason = "trained";
                        elseif TargetReady
                            skipReason = "target_coverage_gate";
                        else
                            skipReason = "target_triples_insufficient";
                        end
                    end
	                    writeMetricsRow = true;
                end

                [Population1,Fitness1] = EnvironmentalSelection_BDG( ...
                    [Population1,Offspring1,Offspring2,OffspringG],Problem.N,true);
                [Population2,Fitness2] = EnvironmentalSelection_BDG( ...
                    [Population2,Offspring1,Offspring2],Problem.N,false);

                [SnapshotWriter,snapshotElapsed] = MaybeWriteArchiveSnapshots_BDG( ...
                    SnapshotWriter,Problem,AF,AI,GAN,gen, ...
                    Population1,Population2);
                Timing = ProfileTimerAdd_BDG(Timing, ...
                    't_snapshot_export',snapshotElapsed);

                while nextStage <= numel(stageTargets) && ...
                        Problem.FE >= stageTargets(nextStage)
                    stageActualFE = Problem.FE;
                    tStart = tic;
                    AppendCsvRow_BDG(Observer.stage_file, ...
                        BuildStageMetricsRow_BDG(stageTargets(nextStage), ...
                        stageActualFE,gen,Problem,AF,AI,W,GAN,stageProbeN));
                    Timing = ProfileTimerAdd_BDG(Timing, ...
                        't_stage_probe',toc(tStart));
                    nextStage = nextStage + 1;
                end

                if writeMetricsRow
                    AppendMetricsRow_BDG(Observer.core_file, ...
                        BuildMetricsRow_BDG(gen,Problem,AF,AI, ...
                        W,GanDiag,ArchiveDiag,refreshFlag, ...
                        skipReason,Timing));
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function A = InitArchive_BDG(D,M)
    A.decs  = zeros(0,D);
    A.objs  = zeros(0,M);
    A.ref   = zeros(0,1);
    A.score = zeros(0,1);
end

function flag = ShouldUpdateBoundaryArchive_BDG(gen,archiveGap)
    archiveGap = max(1,round(double(archiveGap)));
    flag = gen == 1 || mod(gen,archiveGap) == 0;
end

function Observer = InitMetricsObserver_BDG(Algorithm,Problem,Params,Control)
    rootDir = fileparts(which('platemo'));
    baseDir = fullfile(rootDir,'Data','CCMO_GAN_BDG');
    if nargin >= 4 && isstruct(Control) && ...
            isfield(Control,'analysisRootFolder') && ...
            strlength(string(Control.analysisRootFolder)) > 0
        baseDir = char(string(Control.analysisRootFolder));
    end
    [~,~] = mkdir(baseDir);
    [~,token] = fileparts(tempname(baseDir));
    runId = ResolveRunId_BDG(Algorithm);
    runFolder = fullfile(baseDir,sprintf('%s_%s_run%d_%s', ...
        class(Algorithm),class(Problem),runId,token));
    [~,~] = mkdir(runFolder);

    Observer = struct( ...
        'folder',runFolder, ...
        'meta_file',fullfile(runFolder,'run_meta.csv'), ...
        'core_file',fullfile(runFolder,'core_metrics.csv'), ...
        'stage_file',fullfile(runFolder,'stage_metrics.csv'));

	    WriteCsvHeader_BDG(Observer.meta_file,{ ...
	        'algorithm','problem','family','run','M','D','N','maxFE', ...
	        'trainGap','archiveGap','nGen','zDim','perRef', ...
		        'nearTau','ganIter','probeRawN', ...
		        'stageProbeN', ...
		        'ganDPretrainIter','ganDSteps','ganGSteps', ...
		        'ganArchMode','ganMiniBatch','ganRealLabel', ...
				        'ganLrD','ganLrG','ganTrainMode', ...
                        'ganWarmStartEnabled','ganEarlyStopEnabled', ...
                        'ganEarlyStopPatience','ganEarlyStopMinIter', ...
				        'generatorMode','generatorLossMode', ...
                        'reconstructionWeight', ...
                        'reconstructionHuberDelta', ...
			        'ganCriticMode', ...
                        'boundaryQualityWeight','sideWeight', ...
                        'thinConsistencyWeight', ...
		        'variant', ...
        'archiveParetoFilterMode','archivePairDirectionMode', ...
            'archiveSourceCapMode','archivePairRefMode', ...
            'archiveUpdateMode','recentWindow', ...
            'trainFilterMode','conditionKNNRetainRatio', ...
	            'cganTrainMinRefCov','cganTrainMinTargetTriples', ...
	            'trainFilterRandomSeed','conditionMode','targetMode', ...
                'nearSegmentTau','nearSegmentMaxPerPair', ...
                'decisionInterpCount','targetRealLabelMode', ...
                'holdoutProtocol','holdoutRefModulo', ...
                'holdoutRefRemainder', ...
				        'output_folder'});
    AppendCsvRow_BDG(Observer.meta_file,{ ...
        class(Algorithm),class(Problem),ProblemFamily_BDG(class(Problem)),runId, ...
        Problem.M,Problem.D,Problem.N,Problem.maxFE, ...
        Params.trainGap,Params.archiveGap,Params.nGen, ...
        Params.zDim,Params.perRef,Params.nearTau, ...
	        Params.ganIter,Params.probeRawN, ...
		        Params.stageProbeN, ...
		        Params.ganDPretrainIter,Params.ganDSteps,Params.ganGSteps, ...
		        Params.ganArchMode,Params.ganMiniBatch, ...
		        Params.ganRealLabel,Params.ganLrD,Params.ganLrG, ...
				        Params.ganTrainMode, ...
                        Params.ganWarmStartEnabled, ...
                        Params.ganEarlyStopEnabled, ...
                        Params.ganEarlyStopPatience, ...
                        Params.ganEarlyStopMinIter, ...
				        Params.generatorMode,Params.generatorLossMode, ...
                        Params.reconstructionWeight, ...
                        Params.reconstructionHuberDelta, ...
			        Params.ganCriticMode, ...
                        Params.boundaryQualityWeight, ...
                        Params.sideWeight, ...
                        Params.thinConsistencyWeight, ...
		        Params.variant, ...
	        Params.archiveParetoFilterMode, ...
	        Params.archivePairDirectionMode, ...
            Params.archiveSourceCapMode, ...
            Params.archivePairRefMode, ...
            Params.archiveUpdateMode, ...
            Params.recentWindow, ...
            Params.trainFilterMode,Params.conditionKNNRetainRatio, ...
            Params.cganTrainMinRefCov, ...
            Params.cganTrainMinTargetTriples, ...
            Params.trainFilterRandomSeed,Params.conditionMode, ...
            Params.targetMode,Params.nearSegmentTau, ...
            Params.nearSegmentMaxPerPair, ...
            Params.decisionInterpCount, ...
            Params.targetRealLabelMode, ...
            Params.holdoutProtocol, ...
            Params.holdoutRefModulo, ...
            Params.holdoutRefRemainder, ...
			        runFolder});

    WriteCsvHeader_BDG(Observer.core_file,CoreMetricColumns_BDG());
    WriteCsvHeader_BDG(Observer.stage_file,StageMetricColumns_BDG());
end

function Targets = StageTargets_BDG(maxFE)
    fixedTargets = [10000 30000 50000 70000 100000 125000 150000];
    if maxFE >= 100000
        Targets = fixedTargets(fixedTargets <= maxFE);
    else
        Targets = unique(max(1,round([0.25 0.50 0.75 1.00] .* maxFE)));
    end
end

function Columns = StageMetricColumns_BDG()
    Columns = [{'target_FE','actual_FE','gen','has_GAN', ...
        'AF_size','AI_size'}, GeneratedBoundaryMetricColumns_BDG()];
end

function Row = BuildStageMetricsRow_BDG(targetFE,actualFE,gen,Problem,AF,AI,W,GAN,stageProbeN)
    hasGAN = ~isempty(GAN) && isfield(GAN,'netG') && isfield(GAN,'netD');
    [gapObj,zmin,zmax] = PairObjectiveGap_BDG(AF,AI);
    Generated = EmptyGeneratedBoundaryMetrics_BDG();

    if hasGAN && stageProbeN > 0
        ProbeDiag = ProbeBoundaryGANNoBudget_BDG(Problem,GAN,stageProbeN);
        Generated = GeneratedBoundaryMetrics_BDG(Problem, ...
            ProbeDiag.probe_raw_decs,ProbeDiag.probe_raw_objs, ...
            ProbeDiag.probe_raw_cons,ProbeDiag.probe_raw_feasible, ...
            AF,AI,W,gapObj,zmin,zmax);
        if isfield(ProbeDiag,'probe_raw_var_clip_rate')
            Generated.RawGANVarClipRate = ProbeDiag.probe_raw_var_clip_rate;
        end
    end

    GeneratedRow = GeneratedBoundaryMetricRow_BDG(Generated);
    Row = [{targetFE,actualFE,gen,double(hasGAN), ...
        size(AF.decs,1),size(AI.decs,1)},GeneratedRow];
end

function Diag = ProbeBoundaryGANNoBudget_BDG(Problem,GAN,nProbe)
    oldFE = Problem.FE;
    rngState = rng;
    cleanup = onCleanup(@()RestoreProblemState_BDG(Problem,oldFE,rngState)); %#ok<NASGU>
    Diag = BoundaryGAN_BDG('probe',Problem,GAN,nProbe);
end

function RestoreProblemState_BDG(Problem,oldFE,rngState)
    Problem.FE = oldFE;
    rng(rngState);
end

function Row = BuildMetricsRow_BDG(gen,Problem,AF,AI, ...

function Timing = InitProfileTimer_BDG()
    fields = ProfileTimerComponentFields_BDG();
    Timing = struct();
    for i = 1 : numel(fields)
        Timing.(char(fields(i))) = 0;
    end
    Timing.runtime_core_est = 0;
end

function fields = ProfileTimerComponentFields_BDG()
    fields = ["t_archive_update", ...
        "t_source_build", ...
        "t_target_build", ...
        "t_target_filter", ...
        "t_gan_train", ...
        "t_gan_diagnose", ...
        "t_stage_probe", ...
        "t_snapshot_export"];
end

function Columns = ProfileTimerColumns_BDG()
    Columns = cellstr([ProfileTimerComponentFields_BDG(), ...
        "runtime_core_est"]);
    Columns = reshape(Columns,1,[]);
end

function Row = ProfileTimerRow_BDG(Timing)
    Timing = NormalizeProfileTimer_BDG(Timing);
    fields = ProfileTimerComponentFields_BDG();
    Row = cell(1,numel(fields)+1);
    total = 0;
    for i = 1 : numel(fields)
        value = ProfileTimerValue_BDG(Timing,fields(i));
        Row{i} = value;
        total = total + value;
    end
    Row{end} = total;
end

function Timing = ProfileTimerAdd_BDG(Timing,name,elapsed)
    Timing = NormalizeProfileTimer_BDG(Timing);
    name = char(string(name));
    if ~isfield(Timing,name)
        return;
    end
    value = double(elapsed);
    if isempty(value) || ~isscalar(value) || ~isfinite(value) || value < 0
        value = 0;
    end
    Timing.(name) = Timing.(name) + value;
    fields = ProfileTimerComponentFields_BDG();
    Timing.runtime_core_est = 0;
    for i = 1 : numel(fields)
        Timing.runtime_core_est = Timing.runtime_core_est + ...
            ProfileTimerValue_BDG(Timing,fields(i));
    end
end

function Timing = NormalizeProfileTimer_BDG(Timing)
    if ~isstruct(Timing)
        Timing = struct();
    end
    fields = ProfileTimerComponentFields_BDG();
    for i = 1 : numel(fields)
        name = char(fields(i));
        if ~isfield(Timing,name)
            Timing.(name) = 0;
        end
        value = double(Timing.(name));
        if isempty(value) || ~isscalar(value) || ~isfinite(value) || value < 0
            value = 0;
        end
        Timing.(name) = value;
    end
    Timing.runtime_core_est = 0;
    for i = 1 : numel(fields)
        Timing.runtime_core_est = Timing.runtime_core_est + ...
            Timing.(char(fields(i)));
    end
end

function value = ProfileTimerValue_BDG(Timing,name)
    name = char(string(name));
    if isfield(Timing,name)
        value = double(Timing.(name));
    else
        value = 0;
    end
    if isempty(value) || ~isscalar(value) || ~isfinite(value) || value < 0
        value = 0;
    end
end

function Metrics = GeneratedBoundaryMetrics_BDG(Problem,decs,objs,cons, ...
        feasible,AF,AI,W,gapObj,zmin,zmax)
    Metrics = EmptyGeneratedBoundaryMetrics_BDG();
    if isempty(decs)
        return;
    end
    if isempty(feasible) || numel(feasible) ~= size(decs,1)
        feasible = FeasibleMaskFromCons_BDG(cons,size(decs,1));
    else
        feasible = logical(feasible(:));
    end
    Metrics.BoundaryHit_all = BoundaryHitAll_BDG( ...
        objs,AF,AI,gapObj,zmin,zmax);
    Interface = ObjectiveInterfaceMetrics_BDG( ...
        objs,feasible,cons,zmin,zmax,gapObj);
    Metrics.ObjInterfaceScore = Interface.objInterfaceScore;
    Metrics.RefCov = GeneratedRefCoverage_BDG(objs,W);
    Metrics.DuplicateRate = DuplicateRate_BDG(Problem,decs);
    Metrics.RawGANFeasibleRate = mean(double(feasible));
    Metrics.RawGANVarClipRate = DecisionBoundaryClipRate_BDG( ...
        Problem,decs);
    Metrics.RawGANOutsideStandardRangeCount = ...
        RawGANOutsideStandardRangeCount_BDG(Problem,objs);
    Metrics = AddGANToSegmentMetrics_BDG(Metrics,objs,AF,AI,zmin,zmax);
    Metrics = AddGANToDecisionSegmentMetrics_BDG(Metrics,Problem,decs,AF,AI);
    Metrics = AddGANClusterMetrics_BDG(Metrics,objs,zmin,zmax);
    Metrics = AddGANToAFDistanceMetrics_BDG(Metrics,Problem, ...
        decs,objs,AF,zmin,zmax);
end

function feasible = FeasibleMaskFromCons_BDG(cons,n)
    if isempty(cons)
        feasible = true(n,1);
    else
        feasible = all(cons <= 0,2);
        if numel(feasible) ~= n
            feasible = false(n,1);
        end
    end
end

function rate = BoundaryHitAll_BDG(objs,AF,AI,gapObj,zmin,zmax)
    rate = NaN;
    if isempty(objs) || isempty(AF.objs) || isempty(AI.objs) || ...
            ~isfinite(gapObj)
        return;
    end
    sampleObj = NormalizeObjMatMetrics_BDG(objs,zmin,zmax);
    fObj = NormalizeObjMatMetrics_BDG(AF.objs,zmin,zmax);
    iObj = NormalizeObjMatMetrics_BDG(AI.objs,zmin,zmax);
    dist = DistanceToBoundarySegments_BDG(sampleObj,fObj,iObj);
    tau = max(3 .* double(gapObj),1e-12);
    rate = mean(double(dist <= tau));
end

function dist = DistanceToBoundarySegments_BDG(X,A,B)
    dist = inf(size(X,1),1);
    nPair = min(size(A,1),size(B,1));
    for i = 1 : nPair
        a = A(i,:);
        v = B(i,:) - a;
        len2 = sum(v.^2);
        if len2 <= 1e-24
            d = sqrt(sum((X - a).^2,2));
        else
            t = sum((X - a).*v,2) ./ len2;
            t = min(max(t,0),1);
            proj = a + t.*v;
            d = sqrt(sum((X - proj).^2,2));
        end
        dist = min(dist,d);
    end
end

function dist = DistanceFromSegmentsToPoints_BDG(X,A,B)
    nPair = min(size(A,1),size(B,1));
    dist = inf(nPair,1);
    if isempty(X)
        return;
    end
    for i = 1 : nPair
        a = A(i,:);
        v = B(i,:) - a;
        len2 = sum(v.^2);
        if len2 <= 1e-24
            d = sqrt(sum((X - a).^2,2));
        else
            t = sum((X - a).*v,2) ./ len2;
            t = min(max(t,0),1);
            proj = a + t.*v;
            d = sqrt(sum((X - proj).^2,2));
        end
        dist(i) = min(d);
    end
end

function cov = GeneratedRefCoverage_BDG(objs,W)
    cov = NaN;
    if isempty(objs) || isempty(W)
        return;
    end
    ref = AssignRefFromObjMetrics_BDG(objs,W);
    ref = ref(ref > 0);
    cov = numel(unique(ref)) / size(W,1);
end

function Diag = EnsureGanDiag_BDG(Diag,M,D)
    Empty = EmptyGanDiag_BDG(M,D);
    names = fieldnames(Empty);
    for i = 1 : numel(names)
        if ~isfield(Diag,names{i})
            Diag.(names{i}) = Empty.(names{i});
        end
    end
end

function A = MergeDiagFields_BDG(A,B)
    names = fieldnames(B);
    for i = 1 : numel(names)
        A.(names{i}) = B.(names{i});
    end
end

function A = MarkTrainingArchive_BDG(A,isFeasible)
    A.feasible = repmat(logical(isFeasible),size(A.decs,1),1);
end

        'archiveDiagnosticFolder',"", ...
        'archiveDiagnosticConditionCount',30, ...
        'archiveDiagnosticZPerCondition',10, ...
        'archiveDiagnosticNormalN',200, ...
        'archiveDiagnosticSeed',0, ...
        'analysisRootFolder',"", ...
        'generatorMode',"objective_target_conditioned", ...
        'generatorLossMode',"conditional_adversarial_huber", ...
        'reconstructionWeight',250, ...
        'reconstructionHuberDelta',0.10, ...
        'ganCriticMode',"target_conditioned", ...
        'ganWarmStartEnabled',true, ...
        'ganEarlyStopEnabled',false, ...
        'ganEarlyStopPatience',5, ...
        'ganEarlyStopMinIter',10, ...
        'ganEarlyStopMinDelta',1e-4, ...

        'thinConsistencyWeight',0);
    if isappdata(0,'CCMO_GAN_BDG_ExperimentControl')
        UserControl = getappdata(0,'CCMO_GAN_BDG_ExperimentControl');
        if isstruct(UserControl)

    Control.nearSegmentMaxPerPair = max(1,round(double( ...
        Control.nearSegmentMaxPerPair)));
    Control.decisionInterpCount = max(2,round(double( ...
        Control.decisionInterpCount)));
    Control.targetRealLabelMode = NormalizeTargetRealLabelMode_BDG( ...

    Control.archiveDiagnosticFolder = string(Control.archiveDiagnosticFolder);

    Control.generatorLossMode = NormalizeGeneratorLossMode_BDG( ...

    Control.reconstructionWeight = max(0,double( ...

            Control.thinConsistencyWeight = 0.10;
        end
    end
    Control.boundaryQualityWeight = max(0,double( ...
        Control.boundaryQualityWeight));
    Control.sideWeight = max(0,double(Control.sideWeight));
    Control.thinConsistencyWeight = max(0,double( ...
        Control.thinConsistencyWeight));

    Control.ganEarlyStopEnabled = logical(Control.ganEarlyStopEnabled);

        Control.ganEarlyStopMinIter)));
    Control.ganEarlyStopMinDelta = max(0,double( ...
        Control.ganEarlyStopMinDelta));
    ValidateRetainedExperimentCombo_BDG(Control);
end

function ValidateRetainedExperimentCombo_BDG(Control)
    Retained = RetainedVariantTable_BDG();
    idx = find(Retained.variant == Control.variant,1,'first');
    ok = ~isempty(idx) && ...
        Control.archiveParetoFilterMode == Retained.archiveParetoFilterMode(idx) && ...
        Control.archivePairDirectionMode == Retained.archivePairDirectionMode(idx) && ...
        Control.archiveSourceCapMode == Retained.archiveSourceCapMode(idx) && ...
        Control.archivePairRefMode == Retained.archivePairRefMode(idx) && ...
        Control.archiveUpdateMode == Retained.archiveUpdateMode(idx) && ...
        Control.recentWindow == Retained.recentWindow(idx) && ...
        Control.trainFilterMode == Retained.trainFilterMode(idx) && ...
        abs(Control.conditionKNNRetainRatio - ...
            Retained.conditionKNNRetainRatio(idx)) < 1e-12 && ...
        abs(Control.cganTrainMinRefCov - ...
            Retained.cganTrainMinRefCov(idx)) < 1e-12 && ...
        Control.cganTrainMinTargetTriples == ...
            Retained.cganTrainMinTargetTriples(idx) && ...
        Control.conditionMode == Retained.conditionMode(idx) && ...
        Control.targetMode == Retained.targetMode(idx) && ...
        abs(Control.nearSegmentTau - Retained.nearSegmentTau(idx)) < 1e-12 && ...
        Control.nearSegmentMaxPerPair == ...
            Retained.nearSegmentMaxPerPair(idx) && ...
        Control.decisionInterpCount == Retained.decisionInterpCount(idx) && ...
        Control.targetRealLabelMode == Retained.targetRealLabelMode(idx) && ...
        Control.generatorMode == Retained.generatorMode(idx) && ...
        Control.ganCriticMode == Retained.ganCriticMode(idx) && ...
        Control.generatorLossMode == Retained.generatorLossMode(idx) && ...
        abs(Control.reconstructionWeight - ...
            Retained.reconstructionWeight(idx)) < 1e-12 && ...
        abs(Control.reconstructionHuberDelta - ...
            Retained.reconstructionHuberDelta(idx)) < 1e-12 && ...
        logical(Control.ganWarmStartEnabled) && ...
        ~logical(Control.ganEarlyStopEnabled);
    assert(ok, ...
        'CCMO_GAN_BDG:UnsupportedExperimentCombo', ...
        'Only retained CCMO-GAN-BDG variants are supported: %s.', ...
        strjoin(Retained.variant,", "));
end
