function Row = RetainedRow_BDG(name,archiveParetoFilterMode, ...
        archivePairDirectionMode,archiveSourceCapMode,archivePairRefMode, ...
        trainFilterMode,conditionKNNRetainRatio,conditionMode, ...
        targetRealLabelMode,generatorMode,ganCriticMode,generatorLossMode, ...
        cganTrainMinRefCov,cganTrainMinTargetTriples,targetMode, ...
        nearSegmentTau,nearSegmentMaxPerPair,decisionInterpCount, ...
        reconstructionWeight,reconstructionHuberDelta, ...
        archiveUpdateMode,recentWindow)
    if nargin < 13 || isempty(cganTrainMinRefCov)
        cganTrainMinRefCov = 0.00;
    end
    if nargin < 14 || isempty(cganTrainMinTargetTriples)
        cganTrainMinTargetTriples = 0;
    end
    if nargin < 15 || isempty(targetMode)
        targetMode = "endpoint";
    end
    if nargin < 16 || isempty(nearSegmentTau)
        nearSegmentTau = 0.20;
    end
    if nargin < 17 || isempty(nearSegmentMaxPerPair)
        nearSegmentMaxPerPair = 5;
    end
    if nargin < 18 || isempty(decisionInterpCount)
        decisionInterpCount = 5;
    end
    if nargin < 19 || isempty(reconstructionWeight)
        reconstructionWeight = 0;
    end
    if nargin < 20 || isempty(reconstructionHuberDelta)
        reconstructionHuberDelta = 0.10;
    end
    if nargin < 21 || isempty(archiveUpdateMode)
        archiveUpdateMode = "historical_pool";
    end
    if nargin < 22 || isempty(recentWindow)
        recentWindow = 0;
    end
    Row = struct( ...
        'variant',string(name), ...
        'archiveParetoFilterMode',string(archiveParetoFilterMode), ...
        'archivePairDirectionMode',string(archivePairDirectionMode), ...
        'archiveSourceCapMode',string(archiveSourceCapMode), ...
        'archivePairRefMode',string(archivePairRefMode), ...
        'archiveUpdateMode',string(archiveUpdateMode), ...
        'recentWindow',double(recentWindow), ...
        'trainFilterMode',string(trainFilterMode), ...
        'conditionKNNRetainRatio',double(conditionKNNRetainRatio), ...
        'cganTrainMinRefCov',double(cganTrainMinRefCov), ...
        'cganTrainMinTargetTriples',double(cganTrainMinTargetTriples), ...
        'conditionMode',string(conditionMode), ...
        'targetMode',string(targetMode), ...
        'nearSegmentTau',double(nearSegmentTau), ...
        'nearSegmentMaxPerPair',double(nearSegmentMaxPerPair), ...
        'decisionInterpCount',double(decisionInterpCount), ...
        'targetRealLabelMode',string(targetRealLabelMode), ...
        'generatorMode',string(generatorMode), ...
        'ganCriticMode',string(ganCriticMode), ...
        'generatorLossMode',string(generatorLossMode), ...
        'reconstructionWeight',double(reconstructionWeight), ...
        'reconstructionHuberDelta',double(reconstructionHuberDelta));
end

function Writer = InitArchiveSnapshotWriter_BDG(Control,Problem,runId)
    Writer = struct( ...
        'enabled',false, ...
        'targets',zeros(0,1), ...
        'next',1, ...
        'folder',"", ...
        'manifest_file',"", ...
        'diagnosticEnabled',false, ...
        'diagnosticFolder',"", ...
        'diagnosticManifestFile',"", ...
        'diagnosticConditionCount',0, ...
        'diagnosticZPerCondition',0, ...
        'diagnosticNormalN',0, ...
        'diagnosticSeed',0, ...
        'problem',string(class(Problem)), ...
        'run',double(runId), ...
        'tag',string(Control.archiveSnapshotTag), ...
        'ganN',double(Control.archiveSnapshotGanN));
    targets = NormalizeSnapshotTargets_BDG(Control.archiveSnapshotTargets);
    folder = string(Control.archiveSnapshotFolder);
    if isempty(targets) || strlength(folder) == 0
        return;
    end
    if ~isfolder(char(folder))
        mkdir(char(folder));
    end
    Writer.enabled = true;
    Writer.targets = targets(:);
    Writer.folder = folder;
    Writer.manifest_file = string(fullfile(char(folder), ...
        'archive_snapshot_manifest.csv'));
    WriteCsvHeader_BDG(Writer.manifest_file,ArchiveSnapshotManifestColumns_BDG());
    Writer.diagnosticEnabled = logical(Control.archiveDiagnosticEnabled);
    Writer.diagnosticConditionCount = double( ...
        Control.archiveDiagnosticConditionCount);
    Writer.diagnosticZPerCondition = double( ...
        Control.archiveDiagnosticZPerCondition);
    Writer.diagnosticNormalN = double(Control.archiveDiagnosticNormalN);
    Writer.diagnosticSeed = double(Control.archiveDiagnosticSeed);
    if Writer.diagnosticEnabled
        diagFolder = string(Control.archiveDiagnosticFolder);
        if strlength(diagFolder) == 0
            diagFolder = string(fullfile(char(folder),'gan_diagnostics'));
        end
        if ~isfolder(char(diagFolder))
            mkdir(char(diagFolder));
        end
        Writer.diagnosticFolder = diagFolder;
        Writer.diagnosticManifestFile = string(fullfile(char(diagFolder), ...
            'gan_diagnostic_manifest.csv'));
        WriteCsvHeader_BDG(Writer.diagnosticManifestFile, ...
            GANDiagnosticManifestColumns_BDG());
    end
end

function [Writer,elapsed] = MaybeWriteArchiveSnapshots_BDG( ...
        Writer,Problem,AF,AI,GAN,gen,Population1,Population2)
    tStart = tic;
    elapsed = 0;
    if ~Writer.enabled
        return;
    end
    while Writer.next <= numel(Writer.targets) && ...
            Problem.FE >= Writer.targets(Writer.next)
        targetFE = Writer.targets(Writer.next);
        actualFE = Problem.FE;
        [AFTrain,AITrain,~] = SelectGANTrainingArchive_BDG(AF,AI);
        ConstrainedPop = PopulationSnapshotLayer_BDG(Population1,Problem);
        UnconstrainedPop = PopulationSnapshotLayer_BDG(Population2,Problem);
        GSnapshot = SnapshotGANGenerated_BDG(Problem,GAN,Writer.ganN);
        snapshotFile = WriteArchiveSnapshotFile_BDG( ...
            Writer,Problem,AFTrain,AITrain,GSnapshot, ...
            ConstrainedPop,UnconstrainedPop,targetFE,actualFE,gen);
        AppendCsvRow_BDG(Writer.manifest_file,{ ...
            Writer.problem,Writer.run,targetFE,actualFE,gen, ...
            size(AF.decs,1),size(AI.decs,1), ...
            size(AFTrain.decs,1),size(AITrain.decs,1), ...
            size(ConstrainedPop.decs,1),size(UnconstrainedPop.decs,1), ...
            size(GSnapshot.decs,1),Writer.tag,snapshotFile});
        if Writer.diagnosticEnabled
            [diagSampleFile,diagMetricFile,diagStatus] = ...
                WriteGANDiagnosticSnapshot_BDG(Writer,Problem, ...
                AFTrain,AITrain,GAN,targetFE,actualFE,gen);
            AppendCsvRow_BDG(Writer.diagnosticManifestFile,{ ...
                Writer.problem,Writer.run,targetFE,actualFE,gen, ...
                diagStatus,diagSampleFile,diagMetricFile,Writer.tag});
        end
        Writer.next = Writer.next + 1;
    end
    elapsed = toc(tStart);
end

function snapshotFile = WriteArchiveSnapshotFile_BDG( ...
        Writer,Problem,AFTrain,AITrain,GSnapshot, ...
        ConstrainedPop,UnconstrainedPop,targetFE,actualFE,gen)
    safeProblem = regexprep(char(Writer.problem),'[^A-Za-z0-9_]+','_');
    tagText = char(Writer.tag);
    if strlength(Writer.tag) > 0
        tagText = ['_',regexprep(tagText,'[^A-Za-z0-9_]+','_')];
    end
    snapshotFile = string(fullfile(char(Writer.folder), ...
        sprintf('%s_run%d_targetFE%06d%s_archive_training.csv', ...
        safeProblem,round(Writer.run),round(targetFE),tagText)));
    WriteCsvHeader_BDG(snapshotFile,ArchiveSnapshotColumns_BDG(Problem));
    for i = 1 : size(ConstrainedPop.decs,1)
        AppendCsvRow_BDG(snapshotFile,ArchiveSnapshotRow_BDG( ...
            Writer,Problem,ConstrainedPop,i,targetFE,actualFE,gen, ...
            "constrained_population","constrained_population", ...
            ConstrainedPop.feasible(i)));
    end
    for i = 1 : size(UnconstrainedPop.decs,1)
        AppendCsvRow_BDG(snapshotFile,ArchiveSnapshotRow_BDG( ...
            Writer,Problem,UnconstrainedPop,i,targetFE,actualFE,gen, ...
            "unconstrained_population","unconstrained_population", ...
            UnconstrainedPop.feasible(i)));
    end
    pairN = max(size(AFTrain.decs,1),size(AITrain.decs,1));
    for i = 1 : pairN
        if i <= size(AFTrain.decs,1)
            AppendCsvRow_BDG(snapshotFile,ArchiveSnapshotRow_BDG( ...
                Writer,Problem,AFTrain,i,targetFE,actualFE,gen, ...
                "feasible_endpoint","AF_train",true));
        end
        if i <= size(AITrain.decs,1)
            AppendCsvRow_BDG(snapshotFile,ArchiveSnapshotRow_BDG( ...
                Writer,Problem,AITrain,i,targetFE,actualFE,gen, ...
                "infeasible_endpoint","AI_train",false));
        end
    end
    for i = 1 : size(GSnapshot.decs,1)
        AppendCsvRow_BDG(snapshotFile,ArchiveSnapshotRow_BDG( ...
            Writer,Problem,GSnapshot,i,targetFE,actualFE,gen, ...
            "generated","GAN_generated",GSnapshot.feasible(i)));
    end
end

function Columns = ArchiveSnapshotManifestColumns_BDG()
    Columns = {'problem','run','target_FE','actual_FE','gen', ...
        'AF_archive_size','AI_archive_size','Train_AF_count', ...
        'Train_AI_count','Constrained_population_count', ...
        'Unconstrained_population_count','GAN_generated_count','tag', ...
        'snapshot_file'};
end

function Columns = GANDiagnosticManifestColumns_BDG()
    Columns = {'problem','run','target_FE','actual_FE','gen', ...
        'status','sample_file','metric_file','tag'};
end

function [sampleFile,metricFile,status] = WriteGANDiagnosticSnapshot_BDG( ...
        Writer,Problem,AFTrain,AITrain,GAN,targetFE,actualFE,gen)
    safeProblem = regexprep(char(Writer.problem),'[^A-Za-z0-9_]+','_');
    tagText = char(Writer.tag);
    if strlength(Writer.tag) > 0
        tagText = ['_',regexprep(tagText,'[^A-Za-z0-9_]+','_')];
    end
    prefix = sprintf('%s_run%d_targetFE%06d%s_gan_diagnostic', ...
        safeProblem,round(Writer.run),round(targetFE),tagText);
    sampleFile = string(fullfile(char(Writer.diagnosticFolder), ...
        [prefix,'_samples.csv']));
    metricFile = string(fullfile(char(Writer.diagnosticFolder), ...
        [prefix,'_metrics.csv']));
    WriteCsvHeader_BDG(sampleFile,GANDiagnosticSampleColumns_BDG(Problem));
    WriteCsvHeader_BDG(metricFile,GANDiagnosticMetricColumns_BDG());

    selected = SelectGANDiagnosticConditionIndices_BDG( ...
        GAN,Writer.diagnosticConditionCount);
    status = "ok";
    Normal = EmptyGANDiagnosticModeData_BDG(Problem);
    FixedZ = EmptyGANDiagnosticModeData_BDG(Problem);
    ZSweep = EmptyGANDiagnosticModeData_BDG(Problem);
    if isempty(GAN) || ~isfield(GAN,'netG') || ...
            ~isfield(GAN,'conditionData') || isempty(GAN.conditionData)
        status = "empty_gan";
        AppendCsvRow_BDG(metricFile,GANDiagnosticMetricRow_BDG( ...
            Writer,Problem,targetFE,actualFE,gen,status,selected, ...
            AFTrain,AITrain,Normal,FixedZ,ZSweep));
        return;
    end

    oldFE = Problem.FE;
    rngState = rng;
    cleanup = onCleanup(@()RestoreProblemState_BDG( ...
        Problem,oldFE,rngState)); %#ok<NASGU>
    seed = mod(round(Writer.diagnosticSeed) + ...
        1000003*round(Writer.run) + round(targetFE) + 997*round(gen), ...
        2147483646) + 1;
    rng(seed,'twister');

    try
        normalN = max(0,round(double(Writer.diagnosticNormalN)));
        if normalN > 0
            [S,Diag] = BoundaryGAN_BDG('sample',Problem,GAN,normalN);
            Normal = BuildGANDiagnosticModeData_BDG( ...
                Problem,AFTrain,AITrain,S,Diag, ...
                repmat("normal",normalN,1),(1:normalN)');
            WriteGANDiagnosticSampleRows_BDG(sampleFile,Writer, ...
                Problem,targetFE,actualFE,gen,Normal);
        end

        if ~isempty(selected)
            fixedZ = zeros(numel(selected),max(0,round(double(GAN.zDim))));
            [S,Diag] = BoundaryGAN_BDG('diagnosesample', ...
                Problem,GAN,selected(:),fixedZ);
            FixedZ = BuildGANDiagnosticModeData_BDG( ...
                Problem,AFTrain,AITrain,S,Diag, ...
                repmat("fixed_z",numel(selected),1), ...
                ones(numel(selected),1));
            WriteGANDiagnosticSampleRows_BDG(sampleFile,Writer, ...
                Problem,targetFE,actualFE,gen,FixedZ);

            zPerCondition = max(0,round(double( ...
                Writer.diagnosticZPerCondition)));
            if zPerCondition > 0
                sweepCondition = repelem(selected(:),zPerCondition);
                sweepZ = randn(numel(sweepCondition), ...
                    max(0,round(double(GAN.zDim))));
                zId = repmat((1:zPerCondition)',numel(selected),1);
                [S,Diag] = BoundaryGAN_BDG('diagnosesample', ...
                    Problem,GAN,sweepCondition,sweepZ);
                ZSweep = BuildGANDiagnosticModeData_BDG( ...
                    Problem,AFTrain,AITrain,S,Diag, ...
                    repmat("z_sweep",numel(sweepCondition),1),zId);
                WriteGANDiagnosticSampleRows_BDG(sampleFile,Writer, ...
                    Problem,targetFE,actualFE,gen,ZSweep);
            end
        end
    catch err
        status = "failed:" + string(err.identifier);
    end

    AppendCsvRow_BDG(metricFile,GANDiagnosticMetricRow_BDG( ...
        Writer,Problem,targetFE,actualFE,gen,status,selected, ...
        AFTrain,AITrain,Normal,FixedZ,ZSweep));
end

function Columns = GANDiagnosticSampleColumns_BDG(Problem)
    Columns = {'problem','run','target_FE','actual_FE','gen', ...
        'mode','condition_index','pair_index','z_id','feasible','own_pair_valid', ...
        'own_obj_seg_dist','own_dec_seg_dist','own_obj_proj_t', ...
        'own_dec_proj_t','own_obj_proj_inside','own_dec_proj_inside', ...
        'nearest_obj_pair_index','own_pair_is_nearest', ...
        'nearest_obj_seg_dist'};
    ObjColumns = arrayfun(@(i)sprintf('obj%d',i),1:Problem.M, ...
        'UniformOutput',false);
    DecColumns = arrayfun(@(i)sprintf('dec%d',i),1:Problem.D, ...
        'UniformOutput',false);
    Columns = [Columns,ObjColumns,DecColumns];
end

    Columns = {'problem','run','target_FE','actual_FE','gen', ...
        'status','selected_condition_count','train_pair_count'};
    Columns = [Columns,PrefixedGANDiagnosticMetricColumns_BDG('normal'), ...
        PrefixedGANDiagnosticMetricColumns_BDG('fixedz'), ...
        PrefixedGANDiagnosticMetricColumns_BDG('zsweep')];

    names = {'count','unique_condition_count','condition_entropy', ...
        'condition_top10_mass','feasible_rate','obj_seg_dist50', ...
        'obj_seg_dist90','dec_seg_dist50','dec_seg_dist90', ...
        'projection_inside_rate','own_pair_nearest_rate', ...
        'pair_cover_rate','within_obj_width90_median', ...
        'within_obj_width90_mean','within_dec_width90_median', ...
        'within_dec_width90_mean','within_scatter_share', ...
        'between_scatter_share'};
    Columns = cellfun(@(name)[char(prefix),'_',name],names, ...
        'UniformOutput',false);
end

function Row = GANDiagnosticMetricRow_BDG(Writer,Problem,targetFE, ...
        actualFE,gen,status,selected,AFTrain,AITrain,Normal,FixedZ,ZSweep)
    nPair = min(size(AFTrain.decs,1),size(AITrain.decs,1));
    NormalStats = GANDiagnosticModeStats_BDG(Normal);
    FixedStats = GANDiagnosticModeStats_BDG(FixedZ);
    SweepStats = GANDiagnosticModeStats_BDG(ZSweep);
    Row = [{Writer.problem,Writer.run,targetFE,actualFE,gen,status, ...
        numel(selected),nPair}, ...
        GANDiagnosticStatsRow_BDG(NormalStats), ...
        GANDiagnosticStatsRow_BDG(FixedStats), ...
        GANDiagnosticStatsRow_BDG(SweepStats)];
    %#ok<NASGU> keeps Problem in the signature aligned with sample columns.
    Problem = Problem; %#ok<NASGU>
end

function Row = GANDiagnosticStatsRow_BDG(Stats)
    Row = {Stats.count,Stats.unique_condition_count, ...
        Stats.condition_entropy,Stats.condition_top10_mass, ...
        Stats.feasible_rate,Stats.obj_seg_dist50, ...
        Stats.obj_seg_dist90,Stats.dec_seg_dist50, ...
        Stats.dec_seg_dist90,Stats.projection_inside_rate, ...
        Stats.own_pair_nearest_rate,Stats.pair_cover_rate, ...
        Stats.within_obj_width90_median,Stats.within_obj_width90_mean, ...
        Stats.within_dec_width90_median,Stats.within_dec_width90_mean, ...
        Stats.within_scatter_share,Stats.between_scatter_share};
end

function Data = EmptyGANDiagnosticModeData_BDG(Problem)
    Data.mode = strings(0,1);
    Data.conditionIndex = zeros(0,1);
    Data.pairIndex = zeros(0,1);
    Data.zId = zeros(0,1);
    Data.feasible = false(0,1);
    Data.ownPairValid = false(0,1);
    Data.ownObjSegDist = NaN(0,1);
    Data.ownDecSegDist = NaN(0,1);
    Data.ownObjProjT = NaN(0,1);
    Data.ownDecProjT = NaN(0,1);
    Data.ownObjProjInside = false(0,1);
    Data.ownDecProjInside = false(0,1);
    Data.nearestObjPairIndex = NaN(0,1);
    Data.ownPairIsNearest = false(0,1);
    Data.nearestObjSegDist = NaN(0,1);
    Data.objs = zeros(0,Problem.M);
    Data.decs = zeros(0,Problem.D);
    Data.objNorm = zeros(0,Problem.M);
    Data.decNorm = zeros(0,Problem.D);
end

function Data = BuildGANDiagnosticModeData_BDG(Problem,AFTrain,AITrain, ...
        Samples,Diag,mode,zId)
    Data = EmptyGANDiagnosticModeData_BDG(Problem);
    if isempty(Samples)
        return;
    end
    Data.decs = Samples.decs;
    Data.objs = Samples.objs;
    n = size(Data.decs,1);
    Data.mode = string(mode(:));
    if numel(Data.mode) ~= n
        Data.mode = repmat(Data.mode(1),n,1);
    end
    Data.zId = double(zId(:));
    if numel(Data.zId) ~= n
        Data.zId = (1:n)';
    end
    if isempty(Samples.cons)
        Data.feasible = true(n,1);
    else
        Data.feasible = all(Samples.cons <= 0,2);
    end
    if isfield(Diag,'rawgen_condition_index') && ...
            numel(Diag.rawgen_condition_index) >= n
        Data.conditionIndex = double(Diag.rawgen_condition_index(1:n));
    elseif isfield(Diag,'injected_condition_index') && ...
            numel(Diag.injected_condition_index) >= n
        Data.conditionIndex = double(Diag.injected_condition_index(1:n));
    else
        Data.conditionIndex = NaN(n,1);
    end
    if isfield(Diag,'rawgen_pair_index') && ...
            numel(Diag.rawgen_pair_index) >= n
        Data.pairIndex = double(Diag.rawgen_pair_index(1:n));
    elseif isfield(Diag,'injected_pair_index') && ...
            numel(Diag.injected_pair_index) >= n
        Data.pairIndex = double(Diag.injected_pair_index(1:n));
    else
        Data.pairIndex = Data.conditionIndex;
    end

    [Data.ownPairValid,Data.ownObjSegDist,Data.ownDecSegDist, ...
        Data.ownObjProjT,Data.ownDecProjT,Data.ownObjProjInside, ...
        Data.ownDecProjInside,Data.nearestObjPairIndex, ...
        Data.ownPairIsNearest,Data.nearestObjSegDist, ...
        Data.objNorm,Data.decNorm] = GANDiagnosticPointDistances_BDG( ...
        Problem,AFTrain,AITrain,Data.decs,Data.objs, ...
        Data.pairIndex);
end

function [ownValid,ownObjDist,ownDecDist,ownObjT,ownDecT, ...
        ownObjInside,ownDecInside,nearestIdx,ownNearest, ...
        nearestDist,objNorm,decNorm] = GANDiagnosticPointDistances_BDG( ...
        Problem,AFTrain,AITrain,decs,objs,pairIndex)
    n = size(decs,1);
    ownValid = false(n,1);
    ownObjDist = NaN(n,1);
    ownDecDist = NaN(n,1);
    ownObjT = NaN(n,1);
    ownDecT = NaN(n,1);
    ownObjInside = false(n,1);
    ownDecInside = false(n,1);
    nearestIdx = NaN(n,1);
    ownNearest = false(n,1);
    nearestDist = NaN(n,1);
    objNorm = zeros(n,Problem.M);
    decNorm = NormalizeDecMatMetrics_BDG(decs,Problem.lower,Problem.upper);
    nPair = min([size(AFTrain.decs,1),size(AITrain.decs,1), ...
        size(AFTrain.objs,1),size(AITrain.objs,1)]);
    if n == 0 || nPair <= 0 || isempty(objs)
        return;
    end
    pairObjs = [AFTrain.objs(1:nPair,:);AITrain.objs(1:nPair,:)];
    zmin = min(pairObjs,[],1);
    zmax = max(pairObjs,[],1);
    objNorm = NormalizeObjMatDistance_BDG(objs,zmin,zmax);
    AFObj = NormalizeObjMatDistance_BDG(AFTrain.objs(1:nPair,:),zmin,zmax);
    AIObj = NormalizeObjMatDistance_BDG(AITrain.objs(1:nPair,:),zmin,zmax);
    AFDec = NormalizeDecMatMetrics_BDG(AFTrain.decs(1:nPair,:), ...
        Problem.lower,Problem.upper);
    AIDec = NormalizeDecMatMetrics_BDG(AITrain.decs(1:nPair,:), ...
        Problem.lower,Problem.upper);

    for i = 1 : n
        [nearestDist(i),nearestIdx(i)] = NearestSegmentDistance_BDG( ...
            objNorm(i,:),AFObj,AIObj);
        idx = round(pairIndex(i));
        if isfinite(idx) && idx >= 1 && idx <= nPair
            ownValid(i) = true;
            [ownObjDist(i),ownObjT(i)] = PointSegmentDistance_BDG( ...
                objNorm(i,:),AFObj(idx,:),AIObj(idx,:));
            [ownDecDist(i),ownDecT(i)] = PointSegmentDistance_BDG( ...
                decNorm(i,:),AFDec(idx,:),AIDec(idx,:));
            ownDecDist(i) = ownDecDist(i) ./ sqrt(max(1,Problem.D));
            ownObjInside(i) = ownObjT(i) >= 0 && ownObjT(i) <= 1;
            ownDecInside(i) = ownDecT(i) >= 0 && ownDecT(i) <= 1;
            ownNearest(i) = nearestIdx(i) == idx;
        end
    end
end

function [dist,idx] = NearestSegmentDistance_BDG(point,A,B)
    nPair = min(size(A,1),size(B,1));
    dist = NaN;
    idx = NaN;
    for i = 1 : nPair
        d = PointSegmentDistance_BDG(point,A(i,:),B(i,:));
        if ~isfinite(dist) || d < dist
            dist = d;
            idx = i;
        end
    end
end

function [dist,t] = PointSegmentDistance_BDG(point,a,b)
    v = b - a;
    len2 = sum(v.^2);
    if len2 <= 1e-24
        t = 0;
        proj = a;
    else
        t = sum((point - a).*v) ./ len2;
        proj = a + min(max(t,0),1).*v;
    end
    dist = sqrt(sum((point - proj).^2));
end

function WriteGANDiagnosticSampleRows_BDG(filePath,Writer,Problem, ...
        targetFE,actualFE,gen,Data)
    for i = 1 : numel(Data.conditionIndex)
        objs = NaN(1,Problem.M);
        decs = NaN(1,Problem.D);
        if size(Data.objs,1) >= i
            objs(1,1:min(Problem.M,size(Data.objs,2))) = ...
                Data.objs(i,1:min(Problem.M,size(Data.objs,2)));
        end
        if size(Data.decs,1) >= i
            decs(1,1:min(Problem.D,size(Data.decs,2))) = ...
                Data.decs(i,1:min(Problem.D,size(Data.decs,2)));
        end
        row = [{Writer.problem,Writer.run,targetFE,actualFE,gen, ...
            Data.mode(i),Data.conditionIndex(i),Data.pairIndex(i), ...
            Data.zId(i), ...
            double(Data.feasible(i)),double(Data.ownPairValid(i)), ...
            Data.ownObjSegDist(i),Data.ownDecSegDist(i), ...
            Data.ownObjProjT(i),Data.ownDecProjT(i), ...
            double(Data.ownObjProjInside(i)), ...
            double(Data.ownDecProjInside(i)), ...
            Data.nearestObjPairIndex(i), ...
            double(Data.ownPairIsNearest(i)), ...
            Data.nearestObjSegDist(i)}, ...
            num2cell(objs),num2cell(decs)];
        AppendCsvRow_BDG(filePath,row);
    end
end

function Stats = GANDiagnosticModeStats_BDG(Data)
    Stats = EmptyGANDiagnosticStats_BDG();
    n = numel(Data.conditionIndex);
    Stats.count = n;
    if n <= 0
        return;
    end
    validCondition = isfinite(Data.conditionIndex) & Data.conditionIndex > 0;
    uniqueCondition = unique(Data.conditionIndex(validCondition));
    Stats.unique_condition_count = numel(uniqueCondition);
    Stats.condition_entropy = ConditionEntropy_BDG( ...
        Data.conditionIndex(validCondition));
    Stats.condition_top10_mass = ConditionTopKMass_BDG( ...
        Data.conditionIndex(validCondition),10);
    Stats.feasible_rate = mean(double(Data.feasible));
    Stats.obj_seg_dist50 = PercentileFinite_BDG(Data.ownObjSegDist,50);
    Stats.obj_seg_dist90 = PercentileFinite_BDG(Data.ownObjSegDist,90);
    Stats.dec_seg_dist50 = PercentileFinite_BDG(Data.ownDecSegDist,50);
    Stats.dec_seg_dist90 = PercentileFinite_BDG(Data.ownDecSegDist,90);
    validOwn = Data.ownPairValid(:);
    if any(validOwn)
        Stats.projection_inside_rate = mean(double( ...
            Data.ownObjProjInside(validOwn)));
        Stats.own_pair_nearest_rate = mean(double( ...
            Data.ownPairIsNearest(validOwn)));
        Stats.pair_cover_rate = mean(double( ...
            Data.ownObjSegDist(validOwn) <= 0.05));
    end
    [Stats.within_obj_width90_median, ...
        Stats.within_obj_width90_mean] = GroupedWidth90_BDG( ...
        Data.objNorm,Data.conditionIndex);
    [Stats.within_dec_width90_median, ...
        Stats.within_dec_width90_mean] = GroupedWidth90_BDG( ...
        Data.decNorm,Data.conditionIndex);
    [Stats.within_scatter_share,Stats.between_scatter_share] = ...
        ScatterShareByCondition_BDG(Data.objNorm,Data.conditionIndex);
end

function Stats = EmptyGANDiagnosticStats_BDG()
    Stats = struct( ...
        'count',0, ...
        'unique_condition_count',0, ...
        'condition_entropy',NaN, ...
        'condition_top10_mass',NaN, ...
        'feasible_rate',NaN, ...
        'obj_seg_dist50',NaN, ...
        'obj_seg_dist90',NaN, ...
        'dec_seg_dist50',NaN, ...
        'dec_seg_dist90',NaN, ...
        'projection_inside_rate',NaN, ...
        'own_pair_nearest_rate',NaN, ...
        'pair_cover_rate',NaN, ...
        'within_obj_width90_median',NaN, ...
        'within_obj_width90_mean',NaN, ...
        'within_dec_width90_median',NaN, ...
        'within_dec_width90_mean',NaN, ...
        'within_scatter_share',NaN, ...
        'between_scatter_share',NaN);
end

function entropy = ConditionEntropy_BDG(conditionIndex)
    entropy = NaN;
    conditionIndex = conditionIndex(isfinite(conditionIndex));
    if isempty(conditionIndex)
        return;
    end
    [~,~,g] = unique(conditionIndex(:));
    counts = accumarray(g,1);
    p = counts ./ sum(counts);
    if numel(p) <= 1
        entropy = 0;
    else
        entropy = -sum(p .* log(p + 1e-12)) ./ log(numel(p));
    end
end

function mass = ConditionTopKMass_BDG(conditionIndex,k)
    mass = NaN;
    conditionIndex = conditionIndex(isfinite(conditionIndex));
    if isempty(conditionIndex)
        return;
    end
    [~,~,g] = unique(conditionIndex(:));
    counts = sort(accumarray(g,1),'descend');
    k = min(max(1,round(double(k))),numel(counts));
    mass = sum(counts(1:k)) ./ sum(counts);
end

function [medianWidth,meanWidth] = GroupedWidth90_BDG(X,conditionIndex)
    medianWidth = NaN;
    meanWidth = NaN;
    if isempty(X) || isempty(conditionIndex)
        return;
    end
    valid = isfinite(conditionIndex) & conditionIndex > 0 & ...
        all(isfinite(X),2);
    X = X(valid,:);
    conditionIndex = conditionIndex(valid);
    groups = unique(conditionIndex(:));
    widths = NaN(numel(groups),1);
    for i = 1 : numel(groups)
        rows = conditionIndex == groups(i);
        if ~any(rows)
            continue;
        end
        center = mean(X(rows,:),1);
        dist = sqrt(sum((X(rows,:) - center).^2,2));
        widths(i) = PercentileFinite_BDG(dist,90);
    end
    widths = widths(isfinite(widths));
    if ~isempty(widths)
        medianWidth = median(widths);
        meanWidth = mean(widths);
    end
end

function [withinShare,betweenShare] = ScatterShareByCondition_BDG( ...
        X,conditionIndex)
    withinShare = NaN;
    betweenShare = NaN;
    if isempty(X) || isempty(conditionIndex)
        return;
    end
    valid = isfinite(conditionIndex) & conditionIndex > 0 & ...
        all(isfinite(X),2);
    X = X(valid,:);
    conditionIndex = conditionIndex(valid);
    if size(X,1) <= 1
        return;
    end
    globalCenter = mean(X,1);
    total = sum(sum((X - globalCenter).^2,2));
    if total <= 1e-24
        withinShare = 0;
        betweenShare = 1;
        return;
    end
    groups = unique(conditionIndex(:));
    within = 0;
    for i = 1 : numel(groups)
        rows = conditionIndex == groups(i);
        center = mean(X(rows,:),1);
        within = within + sum(sum((X(rows,:) - center).^2,2));
    end
    withinShare = within ./ total;
    betweenShare = max(0,1 - withinShare);
end

function selected = SelectGANDiagnosticConditionIndices_BDG(GAN,maxCount)
    selected = zeros(0,1);
    if isempty(GAN) || ~isfield(GAN,'conditionData') || ...
            isempty(GAN.conditionData)
        return;
    end
    n = size(GAN.conditionData,1);
    maxCount = min(max(0,round(double(maxCount))),n);
    if maxCount <= 0
        return;
    end
    spanIdx = unique(round(linspace(1,n,maxCount)),'stable');
    weightIdx = zeros(0,1);
    if isfield(GAN,'conditionSamplingWeights') && ...
            numel(GAN.conditionSamplingWeights) == n
        w = double(GAN.conditionSamplingWeights(:));
        positive = find(isfinite(w) & w > 0);
        k = max(1,ceil(maxCount / 3));
        if ~isempty(positive)
            [~,hiOrder] = sort(w(positive),'descend');
            high = positive(hiOrder(1:min(k,numel(hiOrder))));
            [~,loOrder] = sort(w(positive),'ascend');
            low = positive(loOrder(1:min(k,numel(loOrder))));
            weightIdx = [high(:);low(:)];
        end
    end
    selected = unique([weightIdx(:);spanIdx(:)],'stable');
    if numel(selected) > maxCount
        selected = selected(1:maxCount);
    end
    selected = selected(:);
end

function A = PopulationSnapshotLayer_BDG(Population,Problem)
    A.decs = zeros(0,Problem.D);
    A.objs = zeros(0,Problem.M);
    A.ref = zeros(0,1);
    A.score = zeros(0,1);
    A.feasible = false(0,1);
    if isempty(Population)
        return;
    end
    A.decs = Population.decs;
    A.objs = Population.objs;
    n = size(A.decs,1);
    A.ref = NaN(n,1);
    A.score = NaN(n,1);
    A.feasible = IsFeasiblePopulation_BDG(Population);
end

function G = SnapshotGANGenerated_BDG(Problem,GAN,n)
    G.decs = zeros(0,Problem.D);
    G.objs = zeros(0,Problem.M);
    G.ref = zeros(0,1);
    G.score = zeros(0,1);
    G.feasible = false(0,1);
    n = max(0,round(double(n)));
    if n <= 0 || isempty(GAN) || ~isfield(GAN,'netG') || ...
            ~isfield(GAN,'zDim') || ~isfield(GAN,'D')
        return;
    end
    oldFE = Problem.FE;
    rngState = rng;
    try
        S = BoundaryGAN_BDG('sample',Problem,GAN,n);
        if ~isempty(S)
            G.decs = S.decs;
            G.objs = S.objs;
            G.ref = zeros(numel(S),1);
            G.score = NaN(numel(S),1);
            if isempty(S.cons)
                G.feasible = true(numel(S),1);
            else
                G.feasible = all(S.cons <= 0,2);
            end
        end
    catch
        G.decs = zeros(0,Problem.D);
        G.objs = zeros(0,Problem.M);
        G.ref = zeros(0,1);
        G.score = zeros(0,1);
        G.feasible = false(0,1);
    end
    Problem.FE = oldFE;
    rng(rngState);
end

function Columns = ArchiveSnapshotColumns_BDG(Problem)
    Columns = {'problem','run','target_FE','actual_FE','gen', ...
        'pair_index','pair_side','archive_role','intended_feasible', ...
        'ref','score'};
    ObjColumns = arrayfun(@(i)sprintf('obj%d',i),1:Problem.M, ...
        'UniformOutput',false);
    DecColumns = arrayfun(@(i)sprintf('dec%d',i),1:Problem.D, ...
        'UniformOutput',false);
    Columns = [Columns,ObjColumns,DecColumns];
end

function Row = ArchiveSnapshotRow_BDG( ...
        Writer,Problem,A,index,targetFE,actualFE,gen,pairSide,role,feasible)
    ref = NaN;
    score = NaN;
    if isfield(A,'ref') && numel(A.ref) >= index
        ref = A.ref(index);
    end
    if isfield(A,'score') && numel(A.score) >= index
        score = A.score(index);
    end
    objs = NaN(1,Problem.M);
    decs = NaN(1,Problem.D);
    if size(A.objs,1) >= index
        objs(1,1:min(Problem.M,size(A.objs,2))) = ...
            A.objs(index,1:min(Problem.M,size(A.objs,2)));
    end
    if size(A.decs,1) >= index
        decs(1,1:min(Problem.D,size(A.decs,2))) = ...
            A.decs(index,1:min(Problem.D,size(A.decs,2)));
    end
    Row = [{Writer.problem,Writer.run,targetFE,actualFE,gen, ...
        index,pairSide,role,double(feasible),ref,score}, ...
        num2cell(objs),num2cell(decs)];
end

function Targets = NormalizeSnapshotTargets_BDG(Targets)
    if isempty(Targets)
        Targets = zeros(0,1);
        return;
    end
    Targets = double(Targets(:));
    Targets = Targets(isfinite(Targets) & Targets > 0);
    Targets = unique(round(Targets),'stable');
end

function [Injected,GanDiag] = SelectInjectedCandidates_BDG( ...
        Candidates,GanDiag,nInject)
    nInject = max(0,round(double(nInject)));
    nCandidate = numel(Candidates);
    if nCandidate <= 0 || nInject <= 0
        Injected = Candidates([]);
        GanDiag = SetInjectedLayerFromRaw_BDG(GanDiag,zeros(0,1));
        return;
    end

    if isempty(Candidates.cons)
        feasible = true(nCandidate,1);
    else
        feasible = all(Candidates.cons <= 0,2);
    end
    keep = find(feasible);
    keep = keep(1:min(nInject,numel(keep)));
    Injected = Candidates(keep);
    GanDiag = SetInjectedLayerFromRaw_BDG(GanDiag,keep);
end

function Diag = SetInjectedLayerFromRaw_BDG(Diag,idx)
    idx = idx(:);
    Diag.injected_count = numel(idx);
    Diag.injected_decs = SubsetRawRows_BDG(Diag.rawgen_decs,idx);
    Diag.injected_objs = SubsetRawRows_BDG(Diag.rawgen_objs,idx);
    Diag.injected_cons = SubsetRawRows_BDG(SolutionLayerCons_BDG( ...
        Diag,'rawgen'),idx);
    feasible = false(Diag.injected_count,1);
    if isfield(Diag,'rawgen_feasible') && ...
            ~isempty(idx) && max(idx) <= numel(Diag.rawgen_feasible)
        feasible = logical(Diag.rawgen_feasible(idx));
    end
    Diag.injected_feasible = feasible(:);
    if isfield(Diag,'rawgen_condition_index')
        Diag.injected_condition_index = SubsetRawRows_BDG( ...
            Diag.rawgen_condition_index,idx);
    end
    if isfield(Diag,'rawgen_pair_index')
        Diag.injected_pair_index = SubsetRawRows_BDG( ...
            Diag.rawgen_pair_index,idx);
    end
    if isfield(Diag,'rawgen_ref_index')
        Diag.injected_ref_index = SubsetRawRows_BDG( ...
            Diag.rawgen_ref_index,idx);
    end
    if isfield(Diag,'rawgen_cell_index')
        Diag.injected_cell_index = SubsetRawRows_BDG( ...
            Diag.rawgen_cell_index,idx);
    end
    Diag.injected_ref_cov = MetadataCoverage_BDG( ...
        GetDiagVector_BDG(Diag,'injected_ref_index'), ...
        GetDiagVector_BDG(Diag,'rawgen_ref_index'));
    Diag.injected_pair_cov = MetadataCoverage_BDG( ...
        GetDiagVector_BDG(Diag,'injected_pair_index'), ...
        GetDiagVector_BDG(Diag,'rawgen_pair_index'));
    Diag.injected_cell_cov = MetadataCoverage_BDG( ...
        GetDiagVector_BDG(Diag,'injected_cell_index'), ...
        GetDiagVector_BDG(Diag,'rawgen_cell_index'));
    Diag.injected_duplicate_rate = DuplicateDecisionRate_BDG( ...
        Diag.injected_decs,1e-10);
end

function X = SubsetRawRows_BDG(X,idx)
    idx = idx(:);
    if isempty(X)
        X = zeros(numel(idx),0);
    else
        X = X(idx,:);
    end
end

function x = GetDiagVector_BDG(Diag,name)
    if isfield(Diag,name)
        x = Diag.(name);
    else
        x = [];
    end
end

function cov = MetadataCoverage_BDG(selected,allValues)
    selected = double(selected(:));
    allValues = double(allValues(:));
    selected = selected(isfinite(selected) & selected > 0);
    allValues = allValues(isfinite(allValues) & allValues > 0);
    den = numel(unique(allValues));
    if den == 0
        cov = NaN;
    else
        cov = numel(unique(selected)) ./ den;
    end
end

function rate = DuplicateDecisionRate_BDG(decs,tol)
    if isempty(decs)
        rate = NaN;
        return;
    end
    scale = max(tol,eps);
    key = round(double(decs) ./ scale);
    rate = 1 - size(unique(key,'rows'),1) ./ size(decs,1);
end

function [A,AINeg,weights] = SelectGANTrainingArchive_BDG(AF,AI)
    A = MarkTrainingArchive_BDG(AF,true);
    AINeg = MarkTrainingArchive_BDG(AI,false);
    weights = [];
end

function Source = BuildEvaluatedFeasibleSource_BDG(Problem,varargin)
    Source = struct('decs',zeros(0,Problem.D), ...
        'objs',zeros(0,Problem.M),'cons',zeros(0,0));
    decParts = cell(numel(varargin),1);
    objParts = cell(numel(varargin),1);
    conParts = cell(numel(varargin),1);
    rowCounts = zeros(numel(varargin),1);
    conCols = 0;
    partCount = 0;
    for i = 1 : numel(varargin)
        [DPart,OPart,CPart] = SolutionMatrices_BDG(varargin{i}, ...
            Problem.D,Problem.M);
        if isempty(DPart)
            continue;
        end
        partCount = partCount + 1;
        decParts{partCount} = DPart;
        objParts{partCount} = OPart;
        conParts{partCount} = CPart;
        rowCounts(partCount) = size(DPart,1);
        conCols = max(conCols,size(CPart,2));
    end
    if partCount <= 0
        return;
    end
    decs = vertcat(decParts{1:partCount});
    objs = vertcat(objParts{1:partCount});
    conWidths = cellfun(@(x)size(x,2),conParts(1:partCount));
    if all(conWidths == conCols)
        cons = vertcat(conParts{1:partCount});
    else
        totalRows = sum(rowCounts(1:partCount));
        cons = zeros(totalRows,conCols);
        rowStart = 1;
        for i = 1 : partCount
            rowEnd = rowStart + rowCounts(i) - 1;
            if ~isempty(conParts{i})
                cons(rowStart:rowEnd,1:size(conParts{i},2)) = conParts{i};
            end
            rowStart = rowEnd + 1;
        end
    end
    Source.decs = decs;
    Source.objs = objs;
    Source.cons = cons;
end

function [decs,objs,cons] = SolutionMatrices_BDG(S,D,M)
    decs = zeros(0,D);
    objs = zeros(0,M);
    cons = zeros(0,0);
    if isempty(S)
        return;
    end
    try
        decs = double(S.decs);
        objs = double(S.objs);
    catch
        return;
    end
    try
        cons = double(S.cons);
    catch
        cons = zeros(size(decs,1),0);
    end
    if size(decs,2) ~= D || isempty(objs)
        decs = zeros(0,D);
        objs = zeros(0,M);
        cons = zeros(0,0);
        return;
    end
    if size(objs,2) > M
        objs = objs(:,1:M);
    elseif size(objs,2) < M
        objs = [objs,nan(size(objs,1),M-size(objs,2))];
    end
    n = min(size(decs,1),size(objs,1));
    decs = decs(1:n,:);
    objs = objs(1:n,:);
    if ~isempty(cons)
        cons = cons(1:min(n,size(cons,1)),:);
    end
end

function [count,coverage] = TrainingArchiveRefCoverage_BDG(AF,W)
    count = 0;
    coverage = 0;
    if ~isstruct(AF) || ~isfield(AF,'decs') || isempty(AF.decs)
        return;
    end
    if isempty(W)
        count = 1;
        coverage = 1;
        return;
    end
    refs = zeros(0,1);
    if isfield(AF,'ref') && ~isempty(AF.ref)
        refs = double(AF.ref(:));
    end
    refs = refs(isfinite(refs) & refs > 0 & refs <= size(W,1));
    count = numel(unique(round(refs)));
    coverage = double(count) / max(1,size(W,1));
end

function [count,coverage] = ArchiveRefCoverage_BDG(AF,W)
    [count,coverage] = TrainingArchiveRefCoverage_BDG(AF,W);
end

function [TrainDecs,DiagAI,ConditionData,weights,realLabels,Diag] = ...
        BuildGANTrainingSet_BDG(AF,AI,W,Problem,mode,Control,EvaluatedSource)
    mode = NormalizeGeneratorMode_BDG(mode);
    if nargin < 6 || isempty(Control)
        Control = struct();
    end
    Control = NormalizeTrainingControl_BDG(Control);
    realLabels = [];
    if nargin < 7
        EvaluatedSource = [];
    end
    filterMode = Control.trainFilterMode;
    TripleOptions = struct( ...
        'conditionMode',Control.conditionMode, ...
        'targetMode',Control.targetMode, ...
        'nearSegmentSource',EvaluatedSource, ...
        'nearSegmentTau',Control.nearSegmentTau, ...
        'nearSegmentMaxPerPair',Control.nearSegmentMaxPerPair, ...
        'decisionInterpCount',Control.decisionInterpCount, ...
        'conditionKNNK',5, ...
        'conditionKNNRetainRatio',Control.conditionKNNRetainRatio, ...
        'conditionKNNMinCount',2, ...
        'lower',Problem.lower, ...
        'upper',Problem.upper);
    tTargetBuild = tic;
    switch mode
        case "objective_target_conditioned"
            [TrainDecs,ConditionData,Diag] = ...
                BuildBoundaryTargetTriples_BDG(AF,AI,Problem,W, ...
                TripleOptions);
        case "objective_target_unconditioned"
            [TrainDecs,~,Diag] = BuildBoundaryTargetTriples_BDG( ...
                AF,AI,Problem,W,TripleOptions);
            ConditionData = [];
    end
    Diag.t_target_build = toc(tTargetBuild);
    DiagAI = ArchiveDecisionRows_BDG(AI,Diag.target_keep_index,Problem.D);
    FilterOptions = struct( ...
        'trainFilterMode',filterMode, ...
        'conditionKNNK',5, ...
        'conditionKNNRetainRatio',Control.conditionKNNRetainRatio, ...
        'conditionKNNMinCount',2, ...
        'randomSeed',Control.trainFilterRandomSeed, ...
        'aiDomMinCount',2, ...
        'mutualNDWeight',0.10, ...
        'lower',Problem.lower, ...
        'upper',Problem.upper);
    tTargetFilter = tic;
    [TrainDecs,ConditionData,DiagAI,weights,FilterDiag] = ...
        FilterBoundaryTargetTriples_BDG(TrainDecs,ConditionData, ...
        DiagAI,AF,AI,W,Diag,FilterOptions);
    FilterDiag.t_target_filter = toc(tTargetFilter);
    Diag = MergeDiagFields_BDG(Diag,FilterDiag);
    [weights,QDiag] = ApplyBoundaryConfidenceWeights_BDG( ...
        weights,ConditionData,Control);
    Diag = MergeDiagFields_BDG(Diag,QDiag);
    if mode == "objective_target_unconditioned"
        ConditionData = [];
    end
    if Control.targetRealLabelMode == "boundary_quality_eval"
        [realLabels,LabelDiag] = BoundaryQualityRealLabels_BDG( ...
            AF,AI,Problem,Diag.target_keep_index);
        Diag = MergeDiagFields_BDG(Diag,LabelDiag);
    end
end

function [weights,Diag] = ApplyBoundaryConfidenceWeights_BDG( ...
        weights,ConditionData,Control)
    Diag = struct( ...
        'train_q_weight_count',0, ...
        'train_q_weight_min',NaN, ...
        'train_q_weight_mean',NaN, ...
        'train_q_weight_max',NaN);
    if isempty(ConditionData) || ~isstruct(Control) || ...
            ~isfield(Control,'conditionMode') || ...
            NormalizeConditionMode_BDG(Control.conditionMode) ~= ...
            "mid_normal_ref_s"
        return;
    end
    q = double(ConditionData(:,end));
    q(~isfinite(q) | q < 0) = 0;
    if isempty(q) || sum(q) <= 0
        return;
    end
    if isempty(weights)
        weights = ones(numel(q),1);
    else
        weights = double(weights(:));
        if numel(weights) ~= numel(q)
            weights = ones(numel(q),1);
        end
    end
    weights = max(0,weights) .* q(:);
    if sum(weights) <= 0
        weights = [];
        return;
    end
    weights = weights ./ sum(weights);
    Diag.train_q_weight_count = double(numel(q));
    Diag.train_q_weight_min = MinFiniteLocal_BDG(q);
    Diag.train_q_weight_mean = MeanFiniteLocal_BDG(q);
    Diag.train_q_weight_max = MaxFiniteLocal_BDG(q);
end

function flag = IsTrainingDataReady_BDG(TrainDecs,ConditionData,mode)
    mode = NormalizeGeneratorMode_BDG(mode);
    flag = ~isempty(TrainDecs);
    if mode == "objective_target_conditioned"
        flag = flag && ~isempty(ConditionData) && ...
            size(ConditionData,1) == size(TrainDecs,1) && ...
            size(TrainDecs,1) >= 2;
    elseif mode == "objective_target_unconditioned"
        flag = flag && size(TrainDecs,1) >= 2;
    end
end

function [flag,tripleCount,refCov] = IsCGANTrainCoverageReady_BDG( ...
        Diag,refCov,Control)
    tripleCount = DiagScalar_BDG(Diag,'target_triple_count',0);
    refCov = double(refCov);
    if ~isscalar(refCov) || ~isfinite(refCov)
        refCov = 0;
    end
    flag = refCov >= Control.cganTrainMinRefCov && ...
        tripleCount >= Control.cganTrainMinTargetTriples;
end

function value = DiagScalar_BDG(Diag,name,defaultValue)
    value = defaultValue;
    if isstruct(Diag) && isfield(Diag,name) && ~isempty(Diag.(name))
        candidate = double(Diag.(name));
        candidate = candidate(:);
        if ~isempty(candidate) && isfinite(candidate(1))
            value = candidate(1);
        end
    end
end

function Control = NormalizeTrainingControl_BDG(Control)
    if ~isstruct(Control)
        Control = struct();
    end
    if ~isfield(Control,'trainFilterMode') || isempty(Control.trainFilterMode)
        Control.trainFilterMode = "none";
    end
    if ~isfield(Control,'conditionKNNRetainRatio') || ...
            isempty(Control.conditionKNNRetainRatio)
        Control.conditionKNNRetainRatio = 0.70;
    end
    if ~isfield(Control,'cganTrainMinRefCov') || ...
            isempty(Control.cganTrainMinRefCov)
        Control.cganTrainMinRefCov = 0.00;
    end
    if ~isfield(Control,'cganTrainMinTargetTriples') || ...
            isempty(Control.cganTrainMinTargetTriples)
        Control.cganTrainMinTargetTriples = 0;
    end
    if ~isfield(Control,'trainFilterRandomSeed') || ...
            isempty(Control.trainFilterRandomSeed)
        Control.trainFilterRandomSeed = 0;
    end
    if ~isfield(Control,'conditionMode') || isempty(Control.conditionMode)
        Control.conditionMode = "yt_dt";
    end
    if ~isfield(Control,'targetMode') || isempty(Control.targetMode)
        Control.targetMode = "endpoint";
    end
    if ~isfield(Control,'nearSegmentTau') || isempty(Control.nearSegmentTau)
        Control.nearSegmentTau = 0.20;
    end
    if ~isfield(Control,'nearSegmentMaxPerPair') || ...
            isempty(Control.nearSegmentMaxPerPair)
        Control.nearSegmentMaxPerPair = 5;
    end
    if ~isfield(Control,'decisionInterpCount') || ...
            isempty(Control.decisionInterpCount)
        Control.decisionInterpCount = 5;
    end
    if ~isfield(Control,'targetRealLabelMode') || ...
            isempty(Control.targetRealLabelMode)
        Control.targetRealLabelMode = "binary";
    end
    Control.trainFilterMode = NormalizeTrainFilterMode_BDG( ...
        Control.trainFilterMode);
    Control.conditionKNNRetainRatio = min(max( ...
        double(Control.conditionKNNRetainRatio),0),1);
    Control.cganTrainMinRefCov = min(max( ...
        double(Control.cganTrainMinRefCov),0),1);
    Control.cganTrainMinTargetTriples = max(0,round( ...
        double(Control.cganTrainMinTargetTriples)));
    Control.trainFilterRandomSeed = NormalizeRandomSeed_BDG( ...
        Control.trainFilterRandomSeed);
    Control.conditionMode = NormalizeConditionMode_BDG(Control.conditionMode);
    Control.targetMode = NormalizeTargetMode_BDG(Control.targetMode);
    Control.nearSegmentTau = max(0,double(Control.nearSegmentTau));
    Control.nearSegmentMaxPerPair = max(1,round(double( ...
        Control.nearSegmentMaxPerPair)));
    Control.decisionInterpCount = max(2,round(double( ...
        Control.decisionInterpCount)));
    Control.targetRealLabelMode = NormalizeTargetRealLabelMode_BDG( ...
        Control.targetRealLabelMode);
end

function X = ArchiveDecisionRows_BDG(A,idx,D)
    X = zeros(0,D);
    if isempty(idx) || ~isstruct(A) || ~isfield(A,'decs') || isempty(A.decs)
        return;
    end
    allX = double(A.decs);
    idx = round(double(idx(:)));
    valid = idx >= 1 & idx <= size(allX,1);
    X = zeros(numel(idx),D);
    if any(valid)
        cols = min(D,size(allX,2));
        X(valid,1:cols) = allX(idx(valid),1:cols);
    end
end

function [labels,Diag] = BoundaryQualityRealLabels_BDG(AF,AI,Problem,idx)
    labels = [];
    Diag = BoundaryQualityLabelDiag_BDG(labels);
    if isempty(idx) || ~isstruct(AF) || ~isfield(AF,'objs') || ...
            isempty(AF.objs)
        return;
    end
    Obj = ArchiveObjectiveRowsForLabels_BDG(AF,idx,Problem.M);
    if isempty(Obj)
        return;
    end
    try
        Data = BoundaryQualityTarget_BDG('builddata',AF,AI,Problem,0.20);
        if ~isfield(Data,'ready') || ~Data.ready
            return;
        end
        labels = BoundaryQualityTarget_BDG('evaluatedlabels', ...
            Obj,zeros(size(Obj,1),0),Data);
        labels = double(labels(:));
    catch
        labels = [];
    end
    Diag = BoundaryQualityLabelDiag_BDG(labels);
end

function Obj = ArchiveObjectiveRowsForLabels_BDG(AF,idx,M)
    Obj = zeros(0,M);
    if ~isstruct(AF) || ~isfield(AF,'objs') || isempty(AF.objs)
        return;
    end
    allObj = double(AF.objs);
    idx = round(double(idx(:)));
    valid = idx >= 1 & idx <= size(allObj,1);
    Obj = nan(numel(idx),M);
    if any(valid)
        cols = min(M,size(allObj,2));
        Obj(valid,1:cols) = allObj(idx(valid),1:cols);
    end
end

function Diag = BoundaryQualityLabelDiag_BDG(labels)
    labels = double(labels(:));
    labels = labels(isfinite(labels));
    Diag = struct( ...
        'boundary_quality_label_count',double(numel(labels)), ...
        'boundary_quality_label_mean',MeanFiniteLocal_BDG(labels), ...
        'boundary_quality_label_median',MedianFiniteLocal_BDG(labels), ...
        'boundary_quality_label_p10',PercentileFiniteLocal_BDG(labels,10), ...
        'boundary_quality_label_p90',PercentileFiniteLocal_BDG(labels,90), ...
        'boundary_quality_label_min',MinFiniteLocal_BDG(labels), ...
        'boundary_quality_label_max',MaxFiniteLocal_BDG(labels));
end

function [count,cov] = TargetTrainingRefCoverage_BDG( ...
        Diag,AF,W,defaultCount,defaultCov)
    count = defaultCount;
    cov = defaultCov;
    if ~isstruct(Diag) || ~isfield(Diag,'target_keep_index') || ...
            isempty(Diag.target_keep_index) || ~isstruct(AF) || ...
            ~isfield(AF,'ref') || isempty(AF.ref)
        return;
    end
    idx = round(double(Diag.target_keep_index(:)));
    refsAll = double(AF.ref(:));
    valid = idx >= 1 & idx <= numel(refsAll);
    refs = refsAll(idx(valid));
    refs = refs(isfinite(refs) & refs > 0);
    count = numel(unique(round(refs)));
    if isempty(W)
        cov = double(count > 0);
    else
        cov = double(count) ./ max(1,size(W,1));
    end
end

function refs = TargetConditionRefIndex_BDG(Diag,AF)
    refs = zeros(0,1);
    if ~isstruct(Diag) || ~isfield(Diag,'target_keep_index') || ...
            isempty(Diag.target_keep_index) || ~isstruct(AF) || ...
            ~isfield(AF,'ref') || isempty(AF.ref)
        return;
    end
    idx = round(double(Diag.target_keep_index(:)));
    refsAll = double(AF.ref(:));
    valid = idx >= 1 & idx <= numel(refsAll);
    refs = zeros(numel(idx),1);
    refs(valid) = refsAll(idx(valid));
end

function [weights,holdoutMask,Diag] = ApplyHoldoutTrainingMask_BDG( ...
        weights,refs,Control,W)
    n = numel(refs);
    holdoutMask = false(n,1);
    Diag = struct( ...
        'holdout_protocol_code',0, ...
        'holdout_condition_count',0, ...
        'holdout_train_condition_count',n, ...
        'holdout_ref_count',0, ...
        'holdout_ref_cov',0, ...
        'holdout_generation_condition_count',0);
    if n <= 0 || ~isstruct(Control) || ...
            ~isfield(Control,'holdoutProtocol') || ...
            NormalizeHoldoutProtocol_BDG(Control.holdoutProtocol) == "none"
        return;
    end
    protocol = NormalizeHoldoutProtocol_BDG(Control.holdoutProtocol);
    switch protocol
        case "ref_modulo"
            modulo = max(2,round(double(Control.holdoutRefModulo)));
            remainder = mod(round(double(Control.holdoutRefRemainder)),modulo);
            ref = round(double(refs(:)));
            holdoutMask = isfinite(ref) & ref > 0 & ...
                mod(ref - 1,modulo) == remainder;
            Diag.holdout_protocol_code = 1;
    end
    holdoutMask = RepairHoldoutMask_BDG(holdoutMask,refs);
    if ~any(holdoutMask) || all(holdoutMask)
        holdoutMask(:) = false;
        return;
    end
    if isempty(weights)
        weights = ones(n,1);
    else
        weights = double(weights(:));
        if numel(weights) ~= n
            weights = ones(n,1);
        end
    end
    weights(holdoutMask) = 0;
    if sum(weights) <= 0
        holdoutMask(:) = false;
        weights = [];
        return;
    end
    uniqueRefs = unique(round(double(refs(holdoutMask))));
    uniqueRefs = uniqueRefs(isfinite(uniqueRefs) & uniqueRefs > 0);
    Diag.holdout_condition_count = double(sum(holdoutMask));
    Diag.holdout_train_condition_count = double(sum(~holdoutMask));
    Diag.holdout_ref_count = double(numel(uniqueRefs));
    if isempty(W)
        Diag.holdout_ref_cov = double(~isempty(uniqueRefs));
    else
        Diag.holdout_ref_cov = double(numel(uniqueRefs)) ./ max(1,size(W,1));
    end
    Diag.holdout_generation_condition_count = Diag.holdout_condition_count;
end

function holdoutMask = RepairHoldoutMask_BDG(holdoutMask,refs)
    holdoutMask = logical(holdoutMask(:));
    n = numel(holdoutMask);
    if n <= 1 || (any(holdoutMask) && ~all(holdoutMask))
        return;
    end
    ref = round(double(refs(:)));
    ref = ref(1:min(numel(ref),n));
    if numel(ref) < n
        ref(end+1:n,1) = NaN;
    end
    validRefs = unique(ref(isfinite(ref) & ref > 0),'stable');
    for i = numel(validRefs) : -1 : 1
        candidate = ref == validRefs(i);
        if any(candidate) && ~all(candidate)
            holdoutMask = candidate;
            return;
        end
    end
    holdoutMask = false(n,1);
    holdoutMask(n) = true;
end

function Diag = BuildP1HoldoutBaselineDiag_BDG(Problem,AF,AI,W, ...
        XTrain,CTrain,refIndex,holdoutMask,nGen)
    Diag = EmptyP1HoldoutBaselineDiag_BDG();
    holdoutMask = logical(holdoutMask(:));
    n = size(XTrain,1);
    if n <= 1 || numel(holdoutMask) ~= n || ~any(holdoutMask) || ...
            all(holdoutMask) || isempty(CTrain)
        return;
    end
    trainMask = ~holdoutMask;
    nOut = min(max(1,round(double(nGen))),sum(holdoutMask));
    holdIdx = find(holdoutMask);
    holdIdx = holdIdx(1:nOut);
    trainIdx = find(trainMask);
    CTrainD = double(CTrain);
    XTrainD = double(XTrain);
    XHold = XTrainD(holdIdx,:);
    CHold = CTrainD(holdIdx,:);
    CAvail = CTrainD(trainIdx,:);
    XAvail = XTrainD(trainIdx,:);
    k = min(3,size(XAvail,1));
    dist = pdist2(CHold,CAvail);
    [~,ord] = sort(dist,2,'ascend');
    nn = ord(:,1);
    copyDec = XAvail(nn,:);
    replayDec = XAvail(mod((1:nOut)'-1,size(XAvail,1)) + 1,:);
    knnDec = zeros(size(copyDec));
    linearDec = zeros(size(copyDec));
    for i = 1 : nOut
        local = ord(i,1:k);
        knnDec(i,:) = mean(XAvail(local,:),1);
        d = dist(i,local)';
        w = 1 ./ (d + 1e-12);
        w = w ./ sum(w);
        linearDec(i,:) = w' * XAvail(local,:);
    end
    copyDec = ClipDecisionRows_BDG(copyDec,Problem);
    replayDec = ClipDecisionRows_BDG(replayDec,Problem);
    knnDec = ClipDecisionRows_BDG(knnDec,Problem);
    linearDec = ClipDecisionRows_BDG(linearDec,Problem);
    [gapObj,zmin,zmax] = PairObjectiveGap_BDG(AF,AI);
    Diag = MergeDiagFields_BDG(Diag, ...
        PrefixP1Metrics_BDG("P1_copy",EvaluateP1Baseline_BDG( ...
        Problem,copyDec,AF,AI,W,gapObj,zmin,zmax)));
    Diag = MergeDiagFields_BDG(Diag, ...
        PrefixP1Metrics_BDG("P1_knn",EvaluateP1Baseline_BDG( ...
        Problem,knnDec,AF,AI,W,gapObj,zmin,zmax)));
    Diag = MergeDiagFields_BDG(Diag, ...
        PrefixP1Metrics_BDG("P1_linear",EvaluateP1Baseline_BDG( ...
        Problem,linearDec,AF,AI,W,gapObj,zmin,zmax)));
    Diag = MergeDiagFields_BDG(Diag, ...
        PrefixP1Metrics_BDG("P1_replay",EvaluateP1Baseline_BDG( ...
        Problem,replayDec,AF,AI,W,gapObj,zmin,zmax)));
    if nargin >= 7 && ~isempty(refIndex)
        holdRefs = unique(round(double(refIndex(holdIdx))));
        holdRefs = holdRefs(isfinite(holdRefs) & holdRefs > 0);
        Diag.P1_holdout_eval_ref_count = double(numel(holdRefs));
    end
    Diag.P1_holdout_eval_count = double(nOut);
    Diag.P1_holdout_train_count = double(sum(trainMask));
end

function Diag = EmptyP1HoldoutBaselineDiag_BDG()
    names = ["P1_copy","P1_knn","P1_linear","P1_replay"];
    Diag = struct('P1_holdout_eval_count',0, ...
        'P1_holdout_train_count',0, ...
        'P1_holdout_eval_ref_count',0);
    for i = 1 : numel(names)
        prefix = char(names(i));
        Diag.([prefix,'_BoundaryHit_all']) = NaN;
        Diag.([prefix,'_GAN_to_Segment_Dist50']) = NaN;
        Diag.([prefix,'_GAN_to_Segment_Dist90']) = NaN;
    end
end

function X = ClipDecisionRows_BDG(X,Problem)
    X = double(X);
    if isempty(X)
        return;
    end
    X = min(max(X,double(Problem.lower)),double(Problem.upper));
end

function Metrics = EvaluateP1Baseline_BDG(Problem,decs,AF,AI,W, ...
        gapObj,zmin,zmax)
    oldFE = Problem.FE;
    rngState = rng;
    cleanup = onCleanup(@()RestoreProblemState_BDG( ...
        Problem,oldFE,rngState)); %#ok<NASGU>
    S = Problem.Evaluation(decs);
    feasible = FeasibleMaskFromCons_BDG(S.cons,numel(S));
    Metrics = GeneratedBoundaryMetrics_BDG(Problem,S.decs,S.objs,S.cons, ...
        feasible,AF,AI,W,gapObj,zmin,zmax);
end

function Diag = PrefixP1Metrics_BDG(prefix,Metrics)
    prefix = char(string(prefix));
    Diag = struct();
    Diag.([prefix,'_BoundaryHit_all']) = Metrics.BoundaryHit_all;
    Diag.([prefix,'_GAN_to_Segment_Dist50']) = ...
        Metrics.GAN_to_Segment_Dist50;
    Diag.([prefix,'_GAN_to_Segment_Dist90']) = ...
        Metrics.GAN_to_Segment_Dist90;
end

function value = MeanFiniteLocal_BDG(x)
    x = double(x(:));
    x = x(isfinite(x));
    if isempty(x)
        value = NaN;
    else
        value = mean(x);
    end
end

function value = MedianFiniteLocal_BDG(x)
    x = double(x(:));
    x = x(isfinite(x));
    if isempty(x)
        value = NaN;
    else
        value = median(x);
    end
end

function value = PercentileFiniteLocal_BDG(x,p)
    x = sort(double(x(isfinite(x))));
    if isempty(x)
        value = NaN;
        return;
    end
    p = min(max(double(p),0),100);
    value = x(max(1,ceil((p/100)*numel(x))));
end

function value = MinFiniteLocal_BDG(x)
    x = double(x(:));
    x = x(isfinite(x));
    if isempty(x)
        value = NaN;
    else
        value = min(x);
    end
end

function value = MaxFiniteLocal_BDG(x)
    x = double(x(:));
    x = x(isfinite(x));
    if isempty(x)
        value = NaN;
    else
        value = max(x);
    end
end

function Diag = EmptyTargetTrainDiag_BDG(M)
    Diag = struct( ...
        'target_triple_ready',0, ...
        'target_pair_count',0, ...
        'target_triple_count',0, ...
        'target_condition_dim',double(2*M), ...
        'target_direction_norm_mean',NaN);
end

function ref = AssignRefFromObjMetrics_BDG(PopObj,W)
    if isempty(PopObj)
        ref = zeros(0,1);
        return;
    end
    if isempty(W)
        ref = ones(size(PopObj,1),1);
        return;
    end
    Y = NormalizeObjMatMetrics_BDG(PopObj,min(PopObj,[],1),max(PopObj,[],1));
    Wn = W ./ sqrt(sum(W.^2,2) + 1e-12);
    Yn = Y ./ sqrt(sum(Y.^2,2) + 1e-12);
    [~,ref] = max(Yn*Wn',[],2);
end

function cons = SolutionLayerCons_BDG(GanDiag,prefix)
    fieldName = [prefix,'_cons'];
    if isfield(GanDiag,fieldName)
        cons = GanDiag.(fieldName);
    else
        cons = [];
    end
end

function Metrics = ObjectiveInterfaceMetrics_BDG(objs,feasible,cons,zmin,zmax,gapObj)
    Metrics = struct( ...
        'crossSideObjMed',NaN, ...
        'objSideBalance',0, ...
        'objInterfaceScore',0);
    if isempty(objs)
        return;
    end
    n = size(objs,1);
    feasible = logical(feasible(:));
    if numel(feasible) ~= n
        feasible = false(n,1);
    end
    nF = sum(feasible);
    nI = n - nF;
    if n <= 0
        return;
    end
    Metrics.objSideBalance = 2 * min(nF,nI) / n;
    if nF == 0 || nI == 0
        Metrics.objInterfaceScore = 0;
        return;
    end

    objN = NormalizeObjMatMetrics_BDG(objs,zmin,zmax);
    distObj = pdist2(objN(feasible,:),objN(~feasible,:));
    nearest = [min(distObj,[],2);min(distObj,[],1)'];
    Metrics.crossSideObjMed = MedianFinite_BDG(nearest);
    if ~isfinite(Metrics.crossSideObjMed)
        Metrics.objInterfaceScore = 0;
        return;
    end

    tauObj = ObjectiveInterfaceTau_BDG(gapObj,Metrics.crossSideObjMed);
    marginFactor = ObjectiveInterfaceMarginFactor_BDG(cons,n);
    Metrics.objInterfaceScore = Metrics.objSideBalance .* ...
        exp(-Metrics.crossSideObjMed ./ tauObj) .* marginFactor;
    Metrics.objInterfaceScore = min(max(Metrics.objInterfaceScore,0),1);
end

function tauObj = ObjectiveInterfaceTau_BDG(gapObj,crossSideObjMed)
    if isfinite(gapObj) && gapObj > 0
        tauObj = 3 * gapObj;
    elseif isfinite(crossSideObjMed) && crossSideObjMed > 0
        tauObj = crossSideObjMed;
    else
        tauObj = 1;
    end
    tauObj = max(tauObj,1e-12);
end

function marginFactor = ObjectiveInterfaceMarginFactor_BDG(cons,n)
    marginFactor = 1;
    if isempty(cons)
        return;
    end
    margin = ConstraintMarginVector_BDG(cons);
    if numel(margin) ~= n
        return;
    end
    marginMed = MedianFinite_BDG(margin);
    if isfinite(marginMed)
        marginFactor = exp(-marginMed);
    end
end

function rate = DuplicateRate_BDG(Problem,decs)
    if isempty(decs)
        rate = NaN;
        return;
    end
    Xn = NormalizeDecMatMetrics_BDG(decs,Problem.lower,Problem.upper);
    tol = 1e-10;
    Xkey = round(Xn ./ tol) .* tol;
    uniqueCount = size(unique(Xkey,'rows'),1);
    rate = 1 - uniqueCount / size(Xn,1);
    rate = min(max(rate,0),1);
end

function Metrics = AddGANToAFDistanceMetrics_BDG(Metrics,Problem, ...
        decs,objs,AF,zmin,zmax)
    if isempty(decs) || isempty(AF.decs)
        return;
    end

    epsilon = 0.05;
    Metrics.AF_CoverEpsilon = epsilon;

    if ~isempty(objs) && ~isempty(AF.objs)
        GObj = NormalizeObjMatDistance_BDG(objs,zmin,zmax);
        AFObj = NormalizeObjMatDistance_BDG(AF.objs,zmin,zmax);
        distObj = min(pdist2(GObj,AFObj),[],2);
        Metrics.GAN_to_AF_ObjNN_mean = MeanFiniteMetrics_BDG(distObj);
        Metrics.GAN_to_AF_ObjNN_median = MedianFinite_BDG(distObj);
        Metrics.GAN_to_AF_ObjNN_p90 = PercentileFinite_BDG(distObj,90);
        Metrics.GAN_to_AF_Dist90 = Metrics.GAN_to_AF_ObjNN_p90;

        afCoverDist = min(pdist2(AFObj,GObj),[],2);
        valid = afCoverDist(isfinite(afCoverDist));
        if ~isempty(valid)
            Metrics.AF_Cover_epsilon = mean(double(valid <= epsilon));
        end
    end

    GDec = NormalizeDecMatMetrics_BDG(decs,Problem.lower,Problem.upper);
    AFDec = NormalizeDecMatMetrics_BDG(AF.decs,Problem.lower,Problem.upper);
    if ~isempty(GDec) && ~isempty(AFDec)
        distDec = min(pdist2(GDec,AFDec),[],2);
        distDec = distDec ./ sqrt(max(1,size(GDec,2)));
        Metrics.GAN_to_AF_DecNN_mean = MeanFiniteMetrics_BDG(distDec);
        Metrics.GAN_to_AF_DecNN_median = MedianFinite_BDG(distDec);
        Metrics.GAN_to_AF_DecNN_p90 = PercentileFinite_BDG(distDec,90);
    end
end

function Metrics = AddGANToSegmentMetrics_BDG(Metrics,objs,AF,AI,zmin,zmax)
    epsilon = 0.05;
    Metrics.PairCoverEpsilon = epsilon;
    if isempty(objs) || isempty(AF.objs) || isempty(AI.objs)
        return;
    end
    nPair = min(size(AF.objs,1),size(AI.objs,1));
    if nPair <= 0
        return;
    end
    GObj = NormalizeObjMatDistance_BDG(objs,zmin,zmax);
    AFObj = NormalizeObjMatDistance_BDG(AF.objs(1:nPair,:),zmin,zmax);
    AIObj = NormalizeObjMatDistance_BDG(AI.objs(1:nPair,:),zmin,zmax);

    dist = DistanceToBoundarySegments_BDG(GObj,AFObj,AIObj);
    Metrics.GAN_to_Segment_Dist50 = PercentileFinite_BDG(dist,50);
    Metrics.GAN_to_Segment_Dist90 = PercentileFinite_BDG(dist,90);
    Metrics.GAN_to_Segment_Dist95 = PercentileFinite_BDG(dist,95);
    Metrics.GAN_to_Segment_Dist99 = PercentileFinite_BDG(dist,99);
    Metrics.GAN_to_Segment_DistMax = MaxFinite_BDG(dist);

    pairDist = DistanceFromSegmentsToPoints_BDG(GObj,AFObj,AIObj);
    pairDist = pairDist(isfinite(pairDist));
    if ~isempty(pairDist)
        Metrics.PairCover_epsilon = mean(double(pairDist <= epsilon));
    end
end

function Metrics = AddGANToDecisionSegmentMetrics_BDG( ...
        Metrics,Problem,decs,AF,AI)
    if isempty(decs) || isempty(AF.decs) || isempty(AI.decs)
        return;
    end
    nPair = min(size(AF.decs,1),size(AI.decs,1));
    if nPair <= 0
        return;
    end
    GDec = NormalizeDecMatMetrics_BDG(decs,Problem.lower,Problem.upper);
    AFDec = NormalizeDecMatMetrics_BDG(AF.decs(1:nPair,:), ...
        Problem.lower,Problem.upper);
    AIDec = NormalizeDecMatMetrics_BDG(AI.decs(1:nPair,:), ...
        Problem.lower,Problem.upper);
    dist = DistanceToBoundarySegments_BDG(GDec,AFDec,AIDec);
    dist = dist ./ sqrt(max(1,size(GDec,2)));
    Metrics.GAN_to_Decision_Segment_Dist50 = ...
        PercentileFinite_BDG(dist,50);
    Metrics.GAN_to_Decision_Segment_Dist90 = ...
        PercentileFinite_BDG(dist,90);
end

function Metrics = AddGANClusterMetrics_BDG(Metrics,objs,zmin,zmax)
    epsilon = 0.05;
    Metrics.ClusterEpsilon = epsilon;
    if isempty(objs)
        return;
    end
    GObj = NormalizeObjMatDistance_BDG(objs,zmin,zmax);
    finite = all(isfinite(GObj),2);
    GObj = GObj(finite,:);
    n = size(GObj,1);
    if n <= 0
        return;
    end
    if n == 1
        Metrics.LargestClusterRate_epsilon = 1;
        Metrics.EffectiveClusterCount_epsilon = 1;
        return;
    end

    D = pdist2(GObj,GObj);
    linked = D <= epsilon;
    sizes = ConnectedComponentSizes_BDG(linked);
    if isempty(sizes)
        return;
    end
    p = sizes ./ n;
    Metrics.LargestClusterRate_epsilon = max(p);
    Metrics.EffectiveClusterCount_epsilon = 1 ./ sum(p.^2);
end

function sizes = ConnectedComponentSizes_BDG(linked)
    n = size(linked,1);
    seen = false(n,1);
    sizes = zeros(0,1);
    for start = 1 : n
        if seen(start)
            continue;
        end
        queue = start;
        seen(start) = true;
        count = 0;
        while ~isempty(queue)
            node = queue(1);
            queue(1) = [];
            count = count + 1;
            next = find(linked(node,:) & ~seen');
            if ~isempty(next)
                seen(next) = true;
                queue = [queue,next]; %#ok<AGROW>
            end
        end
        sizes(end+1,1) = count; %#ok<AGROW>
    end
end

function count = RawGANOutsideStandardRangeCount_BDG(Problem,objs)
    count = NaN;
    if isempty(objs)
        return;
    end
    [lower,upper,ok] = ObjectiveStandardBounds_BDG(Problem,size(objs,2));
    if ~ok
        return;
    end
    outside = ~all(isfinite(objs),2) | ...
        any(objs < lower | objs > upper,2);
    count = sum(outside);
end

function [lower,upper,ok] = ObjectiveStandardBounds_BDG(Problem,M)
    lower = nan(1,M);
    upper = nan(1,M);
    ok = false;
    try
        PF = Problem.PF;
    catch
        return;
    end
    if isnumeric(PF) && size(PF,2) >= M
        for j = 1 : M
            values = PF(:,j);
            values = values(isfinite(values));
            if isempty(values)
                return;
            end
            lower(j) = min(values);
            upper(j) = max(values);
        end
    elseif iscell(PF) && numel(PF) >= M
        for j = 1 : M
            values = PF{j}(:);
            values = values(isfinite(values));
            if isempty(values)
                return;
            end
            lower(j) = min(values);
            upper(j) = max(values);
        end
    else
        return;
    end
    ok = all(isfinite(lower)) && all(isfinite(upper));
end

function X = NormalizeObjMatDistance_BDG(X,zmin,zmax)
    if isempty(X)
        return;
    end
    X = (X - zmin) ./ (zmax - zmin + 1e-12);
end

function rate = DecisionBoundaryClipRate_BDG(Problem,decs)
    if isempty(decs)
        rate = NaN;
        return;
    end
    X = (double(decs) - Problem.lower) ./ ...
        (Problem.upper - Problem.lower + 1e-12);
    tol = 1e-12;
    clipped = X <= tol | X >= 1 - tol;
    rate = mean(double(clipped(:)));
end

function value = MeanFiniteMetrics_BDG(X)
    X = X(isfinite(X));
    if isempty(X)
        value = NaN;
    else
        value = mean(X);
    end
end

function value = PercentileFinite_BDG(X,p)
    X = sort(X(isfinite(X)));
    if isempty(X)
        value = NaN;
        return;
    end
    p = min(max(double(p),0),100);
    idx = max(1,ceil((p/100) * numel(X)));
    value = X(idx);
end

function value = MaxFinite_BDG(X)
    X = X(isfinite(X));
    if isempty(X)
        value = NaN;
    else
        value = max(X);
    end
end

function margin = ConstraintMarginVector_BDG(cons)
    margin = [];
    if isempty(cons)
        return;
    end
    c = double(cons);
    if isempty(c)
        return;
    end
    margin = abs(max(c,[],2));
    margin(~isfinite(margin)) = NaN;
end

function flag = IsFeasiblePopulation_BDG(Population)
    if isempty(Population)
        flag = false(0,1);
    elseif isempty(Population.cons)
        flag = true(numel(Population),1);
    else
        flag = all(Population.cons <= 0,2);
    end
end

function [gap,zmin,zmax] = PairObjectiveGap_BDG(AF,AI)
    gap = NaN;
    zmin = zeros(1,size(AF.objs,2));
    zmax = ones(1,size(AF.objs,2));
    if isempty(AF.decs) || isempty(AI.decs)
        return;
    end
    allObj = [AF.objs;AI.objs];
    zmin = min(allObj,[],1);
    zmax = max(allObj,[],1);
    fObj = NormalizeObjMatMetrics_BDG(AF.objs,zmin,zmax);
    iObj = NormalizeObjMatMetrics_BDG(AI.objs,zmin,zmax);
    gap = MedianFinite_BDG(sqrt(sum((fObj - iObj).^2,2)));
end

function gap = PairDecisionGap_BDG(Problem,AF,AI)
    gap = NaN;
    if isempty(AF.decs) || isempty(AI.decs)
        return;
    end
    fDec = NormalizeDecMatMetrics_BDG(AF.decs,Problem.lower,Problem.upper);
    iDec = NormalizeDecMatMetrics_BDG(AI.decs,Problem.lower,Problem.upper);
    gap = MedianFinite_BDG(sqrt(sum((fDec - iDec).^2,2)) / sqrt(size(fDec,2)));
end

function refCov = ReferenceCoverage_BDG(AF,W)
    if isempty(AF.decs) || isempty(W)
        refCov = 0;
    else
        ref = AF.ref(:);
        ref = ref(ref > 0);
        refCov = numel(unique(ref)) / size(W,1);
    end
end

function X = NormalizeObjMatMetrics_BDG(X,zmin,zmax)
    if isempty(X)
        return;
    end
    X = (X - zmin) ./ (zmax - zmin + 1e-12);
    X = min(max(X,0),1);
end

function X = NormalizeDecMatMetrics_BDG(X,lower,upper)
    X = (X - lower) ./ (upper - lower + 1e-12);
    X = min(max(X,0),1);
end

function Value = MedianFinite_BDG(X)
    X = X(isfinite(X));
    if isempty(X)
        Value = NaN;
    else
        Value = median(X);
    end
end

function RunId = ResolveRunId_BDG(Algorithm)
    if isempty(Algorithm.run)
        RunId = 1;
    else
        RunId = Algorithm.run;
    end
end

function Family = ProblemFamily_BDG(problemName)
    if startsWith(string(problemName),"DASCMOP")
        Family = "DASCMOP_BC";
    elseif startsWith(string(problemName),"LIRCMOP")
        Family = "LIRCMOP_BC";
    else
        Family = "Other";
    end
end

function WriteCsvHeader_BDG(filePath,names)
    fid = fopen(filePath,'w');
    cleaner = onCleanup(@()fclose(fid)); %#ok<NASGU>
    fprintf(fid,'%s\n',strjoin(names,','));
end

function AppendMetricsRow_BDG(filePath,row)
    AppendCsvRow_BDG(filePath,row);
end

function AppendCsvRow_BDG(filePath,row)
    fid = fopen(filePath,'a');
    cleaner = onCleanup(@()fclose(fid)); %#ok<NASGU>
    text = cellfun(@FormatCsvValue_BDG,row,'UniformOutput',false);
    fprintf(fid,'%s\n',strjoin(text,','));
end

function text = FormatCsvValue_BDG(value)
    if isstring(value) || ischar(value)
        text = char(string(value));
        text = ['"',strrep(text,'"','""'),'"'];
    elseif isnumeric(value) || islogical(value)
        if isempty(value)
            text = 'NaN';
        else
            text = sprintf('%.17g',double(value(1)));
        end
    else
        text = char(string(value));
        text = ['"',strrep(text,'"','""'),'"'];
    end
end

function [Population,Fitness] = EnvironmentalSelection_BDG(Population,N,isOrigin)
    if isOrigin
        Fitness = CalFitness_BDG(Population.objs,Population.cons);
    else
        Fitness = CalFitness_BDG(Population.objs);
    end
    Next = Fitness < 1;
    if sum(Next) < N
        [~,Rank] = sort(Fitness);
        Next(Rank(1:N)) = true;
    elseif sum(Next) > N
        Del = Truncation_BDG(Population(Next).objs,sum(Next)-N);
        Temp = find(Next);
        Next(Temp(Del)) = false;
    end
    Population = Population(Next);
    Fitness    = Fitness(Next);
    [Fitness,rank] = sort(Fitness);
    Population = Population(rank);
end

function Fitness = CalFitness_BDG(PopObj,PopCon)
    N = size(PopObj,1);
    if nargin == 1
        CV = zeros(N,1);
    else
        CV = sum(max(0,PopCon),2);
    end
    Dominate = false(N);
    for i = 1 : N-1
        for j = i+1 : N
            if CV(i) < CV(j)
                Dominate(i,j) = true;
            elseif CV(i) > CV(j)
                Dominate(j,i) = true;
            else
                k = any(PopObj(i,:)<PopObj(j,:)) - any(PopObj(i,:)>PopObj(j,:));
                if k == 1
                    Dominate(i,j) = true;
                elseif k == -1
                    Dominate(j,i) = true;
                end
            end
        end
    end
    S = sum(Dominate,2);
    R = zeros(1,N);
    for i = 1 : N
        R(i) = sum(S(Dominate(:,i)));
    end
    Distance = pdist2(PopObj,PopObj);
    Distance(logical(eye(length(Distance)))) = inf;
    Distance = sort(Distance,2);
    D = 1./(Distance(:,floor(sqrt(N)))+2);
    Fitness = R + D';
end

function Del = Truncation_BDG(PopObj,K)
    Distance = pdist2(PopObj,PopObj);
    Distance(logical(eye(length(Distance)))) = inf;
    Del = false(1,size(PopObj,1));
    while sum(Del) < K
        Remain = find(~Del);
        Temp   = sort(Distance(Remain,Remain),2);
        [~,Rank] = sortrows(Temp);
        Del(Remain(Rank(1))) = true;
    end
end

function varargout = BoundaryGAN_BDG(action,varargin)
% BoundaryGAN_BDG - Direct complete-decision boundary GAN dispatcher.
%
% Current experiment-2 contract:
%   target-conditioned boundary:   G(z,y_t,d_t) -> x, D(x,y_t,d_t)
%   target-unconditioned boundary: G(z) -> x, D(x)
%
% Only the target-conditioned discriminator sees three batch types:
%   matched real, mismatched real, and fake matched.

    switch lower(action)
        case 'traindirectboundary'
            varargout{1} = TrainDirectBoundaryGAN_BDG(varargin{:});
        case 'sample'
            [varargout{1:nargout}] = SampleBoundaryGAN_BDG(varargin{:});
        case 'probe'
            varargout{1} = ProbeBoundaryGAN_BDG(varargin{:});
        case 'diagnosesample'
            [varargout{1:nargout}] = DiagnosticSampleBoundaryGAN_BDG(varargin{:});
        case 'traindiagnose'
            varargout{1} = TrainDiagnostic_BDG(varargin{:});
        otherwise
            error('BoundaryGAN_BDG:UnknownAction','Unknown action "%s".',action);
    end
end

function [Offspring,Diag] = DiagnosticSampleBoundaryGAN_BDG( ...
        Problem,GAN,conditionIndex,ZRows)
    Diag = EmptySampleDiag_BDG(Problem.M,Problem.D);
    if nargin < 4
        ZRows = [];
    end
    if isempty(GAN)
        Offspring = [];
        return;
    end
    n = DiagnosticSampleCount_BDG(GAN,conditionIndex,ZRows);
    if n <= 0
        Offspring = [];
        return;
    end
    [X,Info] = GenerateRawDecisionsByConditionIndex_BDG( ...
        GAN,conditionIndex,ZRows,n);
    S = Problem.Evaluation(X);
    feasible = IsFeasibleSet_BDG(S);
    Diag = SetSolutionLayer_BDG(Diag,'rawgen',S,feasible);
    Diag = SetSolutionLayer_BDG(Diag,'injected',S,feasible);
    Diag.rawgen_condition_index = Info.conditionIndex(:);
    Diag.injected_condition_index = Info.conditionIndex(:);
    Diag.rawgen_pair_index = Info.pairIndex(:);
    Diag.injected_pair_index = Info.pairIndex(:);
    Diag.rawgen_ref_index = Info.refIndex(:);
    Diag.injected_ref_index = Info.refIndex(:);
    Diag.rawgen_cell_index = Info.cellIndex(:);
    Diag.injected_cell_index = Info.cellIndex(:);
    Diag.rawgen_var_clip_rate = Info.varClipRate;
    Diag.rawgen_var_clip_count = Info.varClipCount;
    Diag.rawgen_var_value_count = Info.varValueCount;
    Offspring = S;
end

function n = DiagnosticSampleCount_BDG(GAN,conditionIndex,ZRows)
    n = 0;
    if ~isempty(conditionIndex)
        n = numel(conditionIndex);
    end
    if ~isempty(ZRows)
        zRows = double(ZRows);
        if isvector(zRows) && numel(zRows) == GAN.zDim
            zCount = 1;
        else
            zCount = size(zRows,1);
        end
        if n == 0
            n = zCount;
        else
            assert(zCount == n, ...
                'BoundaryGAN_BDG:BadDiagnosticZRows', ...
                'Diagnostic Z rows must match requested condition count.');
        end
    end
end

function GAN = TrainDirectBoundaryGAN_BDG(XTrain,XAI,lower,upper,zDim,maxIter,GAN,Options)
    if nargin < 7
        GAN = [];
    end
    if nargin < 8 || isempty(Options)
        Options = struct();
    end

    D = numel(lower);
    zDim = max(0,round(double(zDim)));
    Options = NormalizeDirectGANOptions_BDG(Options);
    XTrain = PrepareTrainingDecs_BDG(XTrain,D);
    XAI = PrepareTrainingDecs_BDG(XAI,D);
    assert(~isempty(XTrain), ...
        'BoundaryGAN_BDG:EmptyTrainingSet', ...
        'Direct boundary GAN requires non-empty AF decisions.');

    XPositive = single(ScaleToTanh_BDG(XTrain,lower,upper));
    XAI = single(ScaleToTanh_BDG(XAI,lower,upper));
    CTrain = PrepareConditionData_BDG(Options.conditionData, ...
        size(XPositive,1),Options.generatorMode);
    condDim = size(CTrain,2);
    ValidateModeCombo_BDG(Options,condDim,size(XPositive,1));
    conditionPairIndex = NormalizeConditionPairIndex_BDG( ...
        Options.conditionPairIndex,size(CTrain,1));
    conditionRefIndex = NormalizeOptionalConditionIndex_BDG( ...
        Options.conditionRefIndex,size(CTrain,1),'conditionRefIndex');
    conditionCellIndex = NormalizeOptionalConditionIndex_BDG( ...
        Options.conditionCellIndex,size(CTrain,1),'conditionCellIndex');
    generatorCondDim = GeneratorConditionDim_BDG(Options.generatorMode,condDim);
    sampleWeights = NormalizeSampleWeights_BDG(Options.sampleWeights, ...
        size(XPositive,1));
    realLabels = NormalizeRealLabels_BDG(Options.realLabels, ...
        size(XPositive,1),Options.realLabel);
    Options.realLabels = realLabels;

    reinit = isempty(GAN) || ~Options.warmStartEnabled || ...
        ReinitializeDirectBoundaryGAN_BDG( ...
            GAN,zDim,D,Options.archMode,Options.generatorMode, ...
            condDim,generatorCondDim,Options.criticMode, ...
            Options.generatorLossMode);
    warmStartUsed = ~reinit;
    if reinit
        netG = CreateGenerator_BDG(zDim,D,Options.archMode,generatorCondDim);
        netD = CreateDirectBoundaryDiscriminator_BDG( ...
            D,Options.archMode,condDim,Options.criticMode);
    else
        netG = GAN.netG;
        netD = GAN.netD;
    end

    miniBatch = min(Options.miniBatch,max(1,size(XPositive,1)));
    trailingAvgG   = [];
    trailingAvgSqG = [];
    trailingAvgD   = [];
    trailingAvgSqD = [];
    lrG = Options.lrG;
    lrD = Options.lrD;
    beta1 = 0.5;
    beta2 = 0.999;
    dUpdate = 0;
    gUpdate = 0;
    targetDiag = EmptyTargetConditionedTrainDiag_BDG();
    earlyState = InitEarlyStopState_BDG(Options);

    for iter = 1 : Options.dPretrainIter
        dUpdate = dUpdate + 1;
        [netD,trailingAvgD,trailingAvgSqD,targetDiag] = ...
            UpdateDiscriminator_BDG(netG,netD,XPositive,CTrain, ...
            sampleWeights,zDim,miniBatch,Options,targetDiag, ...
            trailingAvgD,trailingAvgSqD,dUpdate,lrD,beta1,beta2, ...
            generatorCondDim);
    end
    pretrainDiag = PrefixTrainDiagnostic_BDG( ...
        EvaluateTrainDiagnostic_BDG(netG,netD,XPositive,XAI, ...
        lower,upper,zDim,100,CTrain,generatorCondDim), ...
        'gan_pretrain_d_');

    trainCount = max(0,round(double(maxIter)));
    if Options.trainMode == "epoch" && isempty(sampleWeights)
        for epoch = 1 : trainCount
            order = randperm(size(XPositive,1));
            for startIdx = 1 : miniBatch : numel(order)
