    Options.pairRefMode = NormalizeArchivePairRefMode_BDG( ...
        Options.pairRefMode);
    Options.archiveUpdateMode = NormalizeArchiveUpdateMode_BDG( ...
        Options.archiveUpdateMode);
    Options.recentWindow = max(0,round(double(Options.recentWindow)));
end

function mode = NormalizeArchiveUpdateMode_BDG(mode)
    mode = lower(strtrim(string(mode)));
    valid = ["historical_pool","recent_cell_archive"];
    assert(ismember(mode,valid), ...
        'UpdateBoundaryArchive_BDG:BadArchiveUpdateMode', ...
        'archiveUpdateMode must be one of: %s.',strjoin(valid,", "));
end

function [AF,AI,Diag] = ApplyRecentCellArchive_BDG( ...
        Problem,CurrentAF,CurrentAI,PreviousAF,PreviousAI,W,Options)
    Diag = struct( ...
        'archive_update_mode',"recent_cell_archive", ...
        'archive_previous_pool_count',0, ...
        'archive_cell_count',0, ...
        'archive_real_count',0, ...
        'archive_semi_real_count',0, ...
        'archive_pseudo_count',0, ...
        'archive_q_mean',NaN, ...
        'archive_age_max',NaN);

    [CurrentAF,CurrentAI] = EnsureBoundaryMetadata_BDG( ...
        Problem,CurrentAF,CurrentAI,W,0,"real");
    [CurrentAF,CurrentAI] = KeepUniqueBoundaryCells_BDG( ...
        CurrentAF,CurrentAI,Problem);
    AF = CurrentAF;
    AI = CurrentAI;

    if Options.recentWindow > 0 && HasBoundaryArchivePairs_BDG( ...
            PreviousAF,PreviousAI)
        [PreviousAF,PreviousAI] = EnsureBoundaryMetadata_BDG( ...
            Problem,PreviousAF,PreviousAI,W,1,"pseudo");
        PreviousAF.age = PreviousAF.age + 1;
        PreviousAI.age = PreviousAI.age + 1;
        PreviousAF.q = max(0,PreviousAF.q .* 0.70);
        PreviousAI.q = max(0,PreviousAI.q .* 0.70);
        keepPrevious = PreviousAF.age <= Options.recentWindow;
        if any(keepPrevious)
            PreviousAF = SubsetArchiveRows_BDG(PreviousAF,keepPrevious,Problem);
            PreviousAI = SubsetArchiveRows_BDG(PreviousAI,keepPrevious,Problem);
            [AF,AI] = MergeRecentCurrentPrevious_BDG( ...
                CurrentAF,CurrentAI,PreviousAF,PreviousAI,Problem);
        end
    end

    Diag.archive_cell_count = UniqueCellCount_BDG(AF);
    if isfield(AF,'sourceType') && ~isempty(AF.sourceType)
        src = string(AF.sourceType(:));
        Diag.archive_real_count = sum(src == "real");
        Diag.archive_semi_real_count = sum(src == "semi-real");
        Diag.archive_pseudo_count = sum(src == "pseudo");
    end
    if isfield(AF,'q') && ~isempty(AF.q)
        Diag.archive_q_mean = MedianFiniteArchive_BDG(AF.q);
    end
    if isfield(AF,'age') && ~isempty(AF.age)
        ages = double(AF.age(:));
        ages = ages(isfinite(ages));
        if ~isempty(ages)
            Diag.archive_age_max = max(ages);
        end
    end
end

function [AF,AI] = KeepUniqueBoundaryCells_BDG(AF,AI,Problem)
    n = ArchivePairCount_BDG(AF,AI);
    if n <= 1 || ~isfield(AF,'cell') || ~isfield(AF,'ref')
        return;
    end
    keep = CanonicalCellKeepMask_BDG(AF,n);
    AF = SubsetArchiveRows_BDG(AF,keep,Problem);
    AI = SubsetArchiveRows_BDG(AI,keep,Problem);
end

function [AF,AI] = EnsureBoundaryMetadata_BDG( ...
        Problem,AF,AI,W,defaultAge,defaultSourceType)
    n = ArchivePairCount_BDG(AF,AI);
    if n <= 0
        AF = InitArchiveLike_BDG(Problem);
        AI = InitArchiveLike_BDG(Problem);
        AF.cell = zeros(0,1);
        AF.s = zeros(0,1);
        AF.q = zeros(0,1);
        AF.age = zeros(0,1);
        AF.sourceType = strings(0,1);
        AI.cell = zeros(0,1);
        AI.s = zeros(0,1);
        AI.q = zeros(0,1);
        AI.age = zeros(0,1);
        AI.sourceType = strings(0,1);
        return;
    end
    AF = TrimArchiveRows_BDG(AF,n,Problem);
    AI = TrimArchiveRows_BDG(AI,n,Problem);
    if ~isfield(AF,'ref') || numel(AF.ref) < n || any(~isfinite(AF.ref(1:n)))
        AF.ref = AssignRefFromObj_BDG(AF.objs,W);
    end
    if ~isfield(AI,'ref') || numel(AI.ref) < n || any(~isfinite(AI.ref(1:n)))
        AI.ref = AF.ref;
    end
    sourceType = MetadataStringVector_BDG(AF,'sourceType',n,defaultSourceType);
    cellIndex = MetadataVector_BDG(AF,'cell',n,AF.ref(:));
    sCoord = MetadataVector_BDG(AF,'s',n,PairSCoordinate_BDG(AF.objs,AI.objs));
    qDefault = DefaultQForSource_BDG(sourceType);
    q = MetadataVector_BDG(AF,'q',n,qDefault);
    age = MetadataVector_BDG(AF,'age',n,defaultAge);
    AF.cell = cellIndex(:);
    AI.cell = cellIndex(:);
    AF.s = sCoord(:);
    AI.s = sCoord(:);
    AF.q = q(:);
    AI.q = q(:);
    AF.age = age(:);
    AI.age = age(:);
    AF.sourceType = sourceType(:);
    AI.sourceType = sourceType(:);
end

function value = DefaultQForSource_BDG(sourceType)
    src = string(sourceType);
    value = 0.30 .* ones(size(src));
    value(src == "semi-real") = 0.70;
    value(src == "real") = 1.00;
    value = double(value);
end

function sourceType = PairSourceTypeFromCandidates_BDG( ...
        fSource,iSource,fPairId,iPairId)
    fSource = NormalizePairSourceTypes_BDG(fSource,1,"semi-real");
    iSource = NormalizePairSourceTypes_BDG(iSource,1,"semi-real");
    fPairId = round(double(fPairId));
    iPairId = round(double(iPairId));
    if fPairId > 0 && fPairId == iPairId && ...
            fSource == "real" && iSource == "real"
        sourceType = "real";
    elseif fSource == "pseudo" || iSource == "pseudo"
        sourceType = "pseudo";
    else
        sourceType = "semi-real";
    end
end

function sourceType = NormalizePairSourceTypes_BDG( ...
        sourceType,n,defaultSourceType)
    if nargin < 3 || strlength(string(defaultSourceType)) == 0
        defaultSourceType = "semi-real";
    end
    n = max(0,round(double(n)));
    defaultSourceType = string(defaultSourceType);
    sourceType = string(sourceType(:));
    if isempty(sourceType)
        sourceType = repmat(defaultSourceType,n,1);
    elseif numel(sourceType) < n
        sourceType(end+1:n,1) = defaultSourceType;
    else
        sourceType = sourceType(1:n);
    end
    valid = sourceType == "real" | sourceType == "semi-real" | ...
        sourceType == "pseudo";
    sourceType(~valid) = defaultSourceType;
end

function keep = CanonicalCellKeepMask_BDG(AF,n)
    n = max(0,round(double(n)));
    keep = false(n,1);
    if n <= 0
        return;
    end
    key = ArchiveCellKey_BDG(AF,n);
    [~,~,group] = unique(key,'rows','stable');
    priority = CanonicalCellPriority_BDG(AF,n);
    for g = 1 : max(group)
        idx = find(group == g);
        [~,pos] = max(priority(idx));
        keep(idx(pos)) = true;
    end
end

function priority = CanonicalCellPriority_BDG(AF,n)
    sourceType = MetadataStringVector_BDG(AF,'sourceType',n,"pseudo");
    q = MetadataVector_BDG(AF,'q',n,DefaultQForSource_BDG(sourceType));
    age = MetadataVector_BDG(AF,'age',n,0);
    priority = q(:) + SourceTypePriority_BDG(sourceType) - ...
        1e-3 .* max(0,age(:));
end

function priority = SourceTypePriority_BDG(sourceType)
    sourceType = NormalizePairSourceTypes_BDG( ...
        sourceType,numel(sourceType),"pseudo");
    priority = zeros(size(sourceType));
    priority(sourceType == "semi-real") = 0.05;
    priority(sourceType == "real") = 0.10;
    priority = double(priority);
end

function key = ArchiveCellKey_BDG(AF,n)
    ref = MetadataVector_BDG(AF,'ref',n,zeros(n,1));
    cellIndex = MetadataVector_BDG(AF,'cell',n,ref(:));
    key = [round(double(ref(:))),round(double(cellIndex(:)))];
end

function [CurrentAF,CurrentAI] = BoostCurrentConfidenceFromPrevious_BDG( ...
        CurrentAF,CurrentAI,PreviousAF,PreviousAI)
    nCurrent = ArchivePairCount_BDG(CurrentAF,CurrentAI);
    nPrevious = ArchivePairCount_BDG(PreviousAF,PreviousAI);
    if nCurrent <= 0 || nPrevious <= 0
        return;
    end
    currentKey = ArchiveCellKey_BDG(CurrentAF,nCurrent);
    previousKey = ArchiveCellKey_BDG(PreviousAF,nPrevious);
    matched = ismember(currentKey,previousKey,'rows');
    if ~any(matched)
        return;
    end
    qAF = MetadataVector_BDG(CurrentAF,'q',nCurrent, ...
        DefaultQForSource_BDG(MetadataStringVector_BDG( ...
        CurrentAF,'sourceType',nCurrent,"semi-real")));
    qAI = MetadataVector_BDG(CurrentAI,'q',nCurrent,qAF);
    qAF(matched) = min(1,qAF(matched) + 0.15);
    qAI(matched) = min(1,qAI(matched) + 0.15);
    CurrentAF.q = qAF(:);
    CurrentAI.q = qAI(:);
    CurrentAF.age = MetadataVector_BDG(CurrentAF,'age',nCurrent,0);
    CurrentAI.age = MetadataVector_BDG(CurrentAI,'age',nCurrent,0);
    CurrentAF.age(matched) = 0;
    CurrentAI.age(matched) = 0;
end

function A = TrimArchiveRows_BDG(A,n,Problem)
    fields = fieldnames(A);
    for i = 1 : numel(fields)
        value = A.(fields{i});
        if size(value,1) >= n
            A.(fields{i}) = value(1:n,:);
        end
    end
    if ~isfield(A,'decs')
        A.decs = zeros(n,Problem.D);
    end
    if ~isfield(A,'objs')
        A.objs = zeros(n,Problem.M);
    end
end

function v = MetadataVector_BDG(A,field,n,defaultValue)
    if isscalar(defaultValue)
        v = repmat(double(defaultValue),n,1);
    else
        v = double(defaultValue(:));
        if numel(v) < n
            v(end+1:n,1) = v(end);
        end
        v = v(1:n);
    end
    if isstruct(A) && isfield(A,field) && ~isempty(A.(field))
        candidate = double(A.(field)(:));
        m = min(n,numel(candidate));
        valid = isfinite(candidate(1:m));
        tmp = v(1:m);
        tmp(valid) = candidate(valid);
        v(1:m) = tmp;
    end
end

function v = MetadataStringVector_BDG(A,field,n,defaultValue)
    v = repmat(string(defaultValue),n,1);
    if isstruct(A) && isfield(A,field) && ~isempty(A.(field))
        candidate = string(A.(field)(:));
        m = min(n,numel(candidate));
        valid = strlength(candidate(1:m)) > 0;
        tmp = v(1:m);
        tmp(valid) = candidate(valid);
        v(1:m) = tmp;
    end
end

function s = PairSCoordinate_BDG(Fobjs,Iobjs)
    n = min(size(Fobjs,1),size(Iobjs,1));
    if n <= 0
        s = zeros(0,1);
        return;
    end
    mid = 0.5 .* (double(Fobjs(1:n,:)) + double(Iobjs(1:n,:)));
    denom = sum(abs(mid),2) + 1e-12;
    s = min(max(mid(:,1) ./ denom,0),1);
end

function [AF,AI] = MergeRecentCurrentPrevious_BDG( ...
        CurrentAF,CurrentAI,PreviousAF,PreviousAI,Problem)
    [CurrentAF,CurrentAI] = BoostCurrentConfidenceFromPrevious_BDG( ...
        CurrentAF,CurrentAI,PreviousAF,PreviousAI);
    AF = ConcatArchives_BDG(CurrentAF,PreviousAF,Problem);
    AI = ConcatArchives_BDG(CurrentAI,PreviousAI,Problem);
    if ArchivePairCount_BDG(AF,AI) <= 1
        return;
    end
    keep = CanonicalCellKeepMask_BDG(AF,ArchivePairCount_BDG(AF,AI));
    AF = SubsetArchiveRows_BDG(AF,keep,Problem);
    AI = SubsetArchiveRows_BDG(AI,keep,Problem);
end

function A = ConcatArchives_BDG(A,B,Problem)
    if ArchivePairCount_BDG(A,A) <= 0
        A = B;
        return;
    end
    if ArchivePairCount_BDG(B,B) <= 0
        return;
    end
    fields = unique([fieldnames(A);fieldnames(B)],'stable');
    nA = size(A.decs,1);
    nB = size(B.decs,1);
    for i = 1 : numel(fields)
        name = fields{i};
        if isfield(A,name)
            av = A.(name);
        else
            av = DefaultArchiveField_BDG(name,nA,Problem);
        end
        if isfield(B,name)
            bv = B.(name);
        else
            bv = DefaultArchiveField_BDG(name,nB,Problem);
        end
        A.(name) = [av;bv];
    end
end

function value = DefaultArchiveField_BDG(name,n,Problem)
    switch name
        case 'decs'
            value = zeros(n,Problem.D);
        case 'objs'
            value = zeros(n,Problem.M);
        case 'sourceType'
            value = strings(n,1);
        otherwise
            value = zeros(n,1);
    end
end

function A = SubsetArchiveRows_BDG(A,keep,Problem)
    keep = logical(keep(:));
    fields = fieldnames(A);
    for i = 1 : numel(fields)
        value = A.(fields{i});
        if size(value,1) == numel(keep)
            A.(fields{i}) = value(keep,:);
        end
    end
    if ~isfield(A,'decs')
        A.decs = zeros(0,Problem.D);
    end
    if ~isfield(A,'objs')
        A.objs = zeros(0,Problem.M);
    end
end

function count = UniqueCellCount_BDG(AF)
    count = 0;
    if ~isstruct(AF) || ~isfield(AF,'cell') || isempty(AF.cell)
        return;
    end
    key = [round(double(AF.ref(:))),round(double(AF.cell(:)))];
    count = size(unique(key,'rows'),1);
end

function maxPair = ArchiveSourceMaxPair_BDG(baseMaxPair,mode)
    mode = NormalizeArchiveSourceCapMode_BDG(mode);
    switch mode
        case "limited"
            maxPair = baseMaxPair;
        case "none"
            maxPair = Inf;
    end
end

function mode = NormalizeArchiveSourceCapMode_BDG(mode)
    mode = lower(strtrim(string(mode)));
    valid = ["limited","none"];
    assert(ismember(mode,valid), ...
        'UpdateBoundaryArchive_BDG:BadSourceCapMode', ...
        'Archive sourceCapMode must be one of: %s.', ...
        strjoin(valid,", "));
end

function mode = NormalizeArchiveParetoFilterMode_BDG(mode)
    mode = lower(strtrim(string(mode)));
    valid = "global_af_nd";
    assert(ismember(mode,valid), ...
        'UpdateBoundaryArchive_BDG:BadParetoFilterMode', ...
        'Archive paretoFilterMode must be one of: %s.', ...
        strjoin(valid,", "));
end

function keep = ArchiveParetoFilterMask_BDG(PopObj,ref,mode)
    %#ok<INUSD>
    mode = NormalizeArchiveParetoFilterMode_BDG(mode);
    keep = FirstFront_BDG(PopObj);
end

function mode = NormalizeArchivePairDirectionMode_BDG(mode)
    mode = lower(strtrim(string(mode)));
    valid = ["ai_dominates_af","af_not_dominates_ai"];
    assert(ismember(mode,valid), ...
        'UpdateBoundaryArchive_BDG:BadPairDirectionMode', ...
        'Archive pairDirectionMode must be one of: %s.', ...
        strjoin(valid,", "));
end

function mode = NormalizeArchivePairRefMode_BDG(mode)
    mode = lower(strtrim(string(mode)));
    valid = ["none","neighbor4"];
    assert(ismember(mode,valid), ...
        'UpdateBoundaryArchive_BDG:BadPairRefMode', ...
        'Archive pairRefMode must be one of: %s.', ...
        strjoin(valid,", "));
end

function keep = ArchivePairDirectionMask_BDG(Fobjs,Iobjs,mode)
    mode = NormalizeArchivePairDirectionMode_BDG(mode);
    n = size(Fobjs,1);
    keep = true(n,1);
    if isempty(Fobjs) || isempty(Iobjs)
        keep = false(n,1);
        return;
    end
    epsTol = 1e-12;
    switch mode
        case "ai_dominates_af"
            keep = all(Iobjs <= Fobjs + epsTol,2) & ...
                any(Iobjs < Fobjs - epsTol,2);
        case "af_not_dominates_ai"
            afDominatesAI = all(Fobjs <= Iobjs + epsTol,2) & ...
                any(Fobjs < Iobjs - epsTol,2);
            keep = ~afDominatesAI;
    end
end

function keep = ArchivePairRefMask_BDG(Fobjs,Iobjs,W,mode)
    mode = NormalizeArchivePairRefMode_BDG(mode);
    n = size(Fobjs,1);
    keep = true(n,1);
    if mode == "none"
        return;
    end
    if isempty(Fobjs) || isempty(Iobjs) || isempty(W)
        keep = false(n,1);
        return;
    end
    ObjAll = [Fobjs;Iobjs];
    [~,zmin,zmax] = NormalizeObjMat_BDG(ObjAll);
    refF = AssignRefFromObj_BDG(Fobjs,W,zmin,zmax);
    refI = AssignRefFromObj_BDG(Iobjs,W,zmin,zmax);
    neighborCount = ArchivePairRefNeighborCount_BDG(mode);
    keep = RefNeighborAllowed_BDG(refF,refI,W,neighborCount);
end

function neighborCount = ArchivePairRefNeighborCount_BDG(mode)
    mode = NormalizeArchivePairRefMode_BDG(mode);
    if mode == "neighbor4"
        neighborCount = 4;
    else
        neighborCount = 0;
    end
end

function keep = RefNeighborAllowed_BDG(refF,refI,W,neighborCount)
    if size(W,2) == 2
        keep = abs(double(refF(:)) - double(refI(:))) <= neighborCount;
    else
        keep = ReferenceNeighborMask_BDG(refF,refI,W,neighborCount);
    end
end

function keep = ReferenceNeighborMask_BDG(refF,refI,W,neighborCount)
    refF = double(refF(:));
    refI = double(refI(:));
    keep = false(size(refF));
    Wn = W ./ sqrt(sum(W.^2,2) + 1e-12);
    neighborCount = max(0,round(double(neighborCount)));
    for i = 1 : numel(refF)
        if ~isfinite(refF(i)) || ~isfinite(refI(i)) || ...
                refF(i) < 1 || refF(i) > size(W,1) || ...
                refI(i) < 1 || refI(i) > size(W,1)
            continue;
        end
        score = Wn(round(refF(i)),:) * Wn';
        [~,ord] = sort(score,'descend');
        allowed = ord(1:min(neighborCount+1,numel(ord)));
        keep(i) = ismember(round(refI(i)),allowed);
    end
end

function A = InitArchiveLike_BDG(Problem)
    A.decs  = zeros(0,Problem.D);
    A.objs  = zeros(0,Problem.M);
    A.ref   = zeros(0,1);
    A.score = zeros(0,1);
end

function flag = IsFeasibleSet_BDG(P)
    if isempty(P)
        flag = false(0,1);
        return;
    end
    if isempty(P.cons)
        flag = true(numel(P),1);
    else
        flag = all(P.cons <= 0,2);
    end
end

function front = FirstFront_BDG(PopObj)
    N = size(PopObj,1);
    domCount = zeros(N,1);
    for i = 1 : N-1
        for j = i+1 : N
            k = any(PopObj(i,:)<PopObj(j,:)) - any(PopObj(i,:)>PopObj(j,:));
            if k == 1
                domCount(j) = domCount(j) + 1;
            elseif k == -1
                domCount(i) = domCount(i) + 1;
            end
        end
    end
    front = domCount == 0;
end

function rank = ParetoRank_BDG(PopObj)
    N = size(PopObj,1);
    rank = zeros(N,1);
    remain = true(N,1);
    frontNo = 1;
    while any(remain)
        ids = find(remain);
        front = FirstFront_BDG(PopObj(ids,:));
        rank(ids(front)) = frontNo;
        remain(ids(front)) = false;
        frontNo = frontNo + 1;
    end
end

function ref = AssignRefFromObj_BDG(PopObj,W,zmin,zmax)
    if nargin < 3
        Y = NormalizeObjMat_BDG(PopObj);
    else
        Y = NormalizeObjMat_BDG(PopObj,zmin,zmax);
    end
    Wn = W ./ sqrt(sum(W.^2,2) + 1e-12);
    Yn = Y ./ sqrt(sum(Y.^2,2) + 1e-12);
    [~,ref] = max(Yn*Wn',[],2);
end

function [Y,zmin,zmax] = NormalizeObjMat_BDG(Obj,zmin,zmax)
    if isempty(Obj)
        Y = Obj;
        if nargin < 2
            zmin = zeros(1,size(Obj,2));
            zmax = zeros(1,size(Obj,2));
        end
        return;
    end
    if nargin < 2
        zmin = min(Obj,[],1);
        zmax = max(Obj,[],1);
    end
    Y = (Obj - zmin) ./ (zmax - zmin + 1e-12);
    Y = min(max(Y,0),1);
end

function score = NormalizeScoreVector_BDG(x)
    x = double(x(:));
    if isempty(x)
        score = zeros(size(x));
        return;
    end
    xmin = min(x);
    xmax = max(x);
    if xmax <= xmin
        score = zeros(size(x));
    else
        score = (x - xmin) ./ (xmax - xmin + 1e-12);
    end
end

function value = MedianFiniteArchive_BDG(x)
    x = double(x(:));
    x = x(isfinite(x));
    if isempty(x)
        value = NaN;
    else
        value = median(x);
    end
end

function value = SafeRatio_BDG(num,den)
    if den <= 0
        value = NaN;
    else
        value = double(num) / double(den);
    end
end



====================================================================================================
## FILE: Algorithms/Multi-objective optimization/CCMO-GAN-BDG/BuildBoundaryTargetTriples_BDG.m (24260 bytes)
====================================================================================================

function [XBoundary,ConditionData,Diag] = BuildBoundaryTargetTriples_BDG( ...
        AF,AI,Problem,W,Options)
%BuildBoundaryTargetTriples_BDG Build target triples for boundary GAN.
%   Default endpoint mode preserves the original contract:
%   x_b is AFDec and condition is [AFNorm, AI-AF direction, optional ref].
%   fix.md modes add a scalar t and replace the endpoint target only when
%   explicitly requested by Options.targetMode.

    if nargin < 4
        W = [];
    end
    if nargin < 5 || isempty(Options)
        Options = struct();
    end

    D = ProblemDimension_BDG(Problem,AF);
    M = ProblemObjectiveCount_BDG(Problem,AF,AI);
    Options = NormalizeTargetTripleOptions_BDG(Options);
    refDim = TargetRefTokenDim_BDG(W,M,Options.conditionMode);
    hasT = ConditionHasT_BDG(Options.conditionMode);
    usesMidNormal = ConditionUsesMidNormal_BDG(Options.conditionMode);
    XBoundary = zeros(0,D);
    conditionDim = TargetConditionDim_BDG(M,refDim,Options.conditionMode);
    ConditionData = zeros(0,conditionDim,'single');
    Diag = EmptyTargetTripleDiag_BDG(M,refDim,Options.conditionMode, ...
        Options.targetMode);

    [AFDec,AFObj] = ArchiveMatrices_BDG(AF,D,M);
    [AIDec,AIObj] = ArchiveMatrices_BDG(AI,D,M);
    nPair = min([size(AFDec,1),size(AIDec,1),size(AFObj,1),size(AIObj,1)]);
    Diag.target_pair_count = double(nPair);
    Diag.target_condition_dim = double(conditionDim);
    if nPair < 2 || D <= 0 || M <= 0
        return;
    end

    AFDec = AFDec(1:nPair,:);
    AIDec = AIDec(1:nPair,:);
    AFObj = AFObj(1:nPair,:);
    AIObj = AIObj(1:nPair,:);
    finiteRows = all(isfinite(AFDec),2) & all(isfinite(AIDec),2) & ...
        all(isfinite(AFObj),2) & all(isfinite(AIObj),2);
    if ~any(finiteRows)
        return;
    end
    AFDec = AFDec(finiteRows,:);
    AIDec = AIDec(finiteRows,:);
    AFObj = AFObj(finiteRows,:);
    AIObj = AIObj(finiteRows,:);
    keepIndex = find(finiteRows);

    [AFNorm,AINorm,zmin,zmax] = NormalizePairedObjectives_BDG(AFObj,AIObj,M);
    Direction = AINorm - AFNorm;
    finiteTargets = all(isfinite(AFNorm),2) & all(isfinite(Direction),2);
    if ~any(finiteTargets) || sum(finiteTargets) < 2
        return;
    end

    AFDec = AFDec(finiteTargets,:);
    AIDec = AIDec(finiteTargets,:);
    AFNorm = AFNorm(finiteTargets,:);
    AINorm = AINorm(finiteTargets,:);
    Direction = Direction(finiteTargets,:);
    keepIndex = keepIndex(finiteTargets);
    RefToken = TargetRefToken_BDG(AF,keepIndex,W,refDim);

    switch Options.targetMode
        case "endpoint"
            pairRows = (1:size(AFDec,1))';
            t = zeros(size(pairRows));
            XBoundary = AFDec;
            fallback = false(size(pairRows));
            nearSourceCount = 0;
            nearCandidateCount = 0;
            nearKeepCount = 0;
        case "decision_interp"
            [XBoundary,pairRows,t] = DecisionInterpolationTargets_BDG( ...
                AFDec,AIDec,Options.decisionInterpCount);
            fallback = false(size(pairRows));
            nearSourceCount = 0;
            nearCandidateCount = 0;
            nearKeepCount = 0;
        case "near_segment_feasible"
            [XBoundary,pairRows,t,fallback,nearSourceCount, ...
                nearCandidateCount,nearKeepCount] = ...
                NearSegmentFeasibleTargets_BDG(AFDec,AFNorm,Direction, ...
                Options,zmin,zmax,D,M);
        otherwise
            error('BuildBoundaryTargetTriples_BDG:BadTargetMode', ...
                'Unsupported targetMode: %s.',Options.targetMode);
    end

    if isempty(XBoundary) || numel(pairRows) < 2
        return;
    end
    if usesMidNormal
        [XBoundary,pairRows,t,fallback] = CanonicalizeTargetsByPair_BDG( ...
            XBoundary,pairRows,t,fallback);
    end
    ConditionData = ComposeConditionData_BDG(AF,AFNorm,AINorm,Direction, ...
        RefToken,pairRows,t,hasT,refDim,Options.conditionMode);
    targetKeepIndex = keepIndex(pairRows);
    Diag.target_keep_index = targetKeepIndex;
    Diag.target_triple_count = double(size(XBoundary,1));
    Diag.target_condition_dim = double(size(ConditionData,2));
    Diag.target_triple_ready = double(size(XBoundary,1) >= 2);
    Diag.target_y_min = min(AFNorm(pairRows,:),[],1);
    Diag.target_y_max = max(AFNorm(pairRows,:),[],1);
    dirNorm = sqrt(sum(Direction(pairRows,:).^2,2));
    Diag.target_direction_norm_mean = MeanFinite_BDG(dirNorm);
    Diag.target_t_min = MinFinite_BDG(t);
    Diag.target_t_max = MaxFinite_BDG(t);
    Diag.target_t_mean = MeanFinite_BDG(t);
    Diag.target_fallback_count = double(sum(fallback));
    Diag.target_near_segment_source_count = double(nearSourceCount);
    Diag.target_near_segment_candidate_count = double(nearCandidateCount);
    if Options.targetMode == "near_segment_feasible"
        Diag.target_near_segment_keep_count = double(sum(~fallback(:)));
    else
        Diag.target_near_segment_keep_count = double(nearKeepCount);
    end
end

function Options = NormalizeTargetTripleOptions_BDG(Options)
    if ~isstruct(Options)
        Options = struct();
    end
    if ~isfield(Options,'conditionMode') || isempty(Options.conditionMode)
        Options.conditionMode = "yt_dt";
    end
    if ~isfield(Options,'targetMode') || isempty(Options.targetMode)
        Options.targetMode = "endpoint";
    end
    if ~isfield(Options,'nearSegmentSource')
        Options.nearSegmentSource = [];
    end
    if ~isfield(Options,'nearSegmentTau') || isempty(Options.nearSegmentTau)
        Options.nearSegmentTau = 0.20;
    end
    if ~isfield(Options,'nearSegmentMaxPerPair') || ...
            isempty(Options.nearSegmentMaxPerPair)
        Options.nearSegmentMaxPerPair = 5;
    end
    if ~isfield(Options,'decisionInterpCount') || ...
            isempty(Options.decisionInterpCount)
        Options.decisionInterpCount = 5;
    end
    if ~isfield(Options,'conditionKNNK') || isempty(Options.conditionKNNK)
        Options.conditionKNNK = 5;
    end
    if ~isfield(Options,'conditionKNNRetainRatio') || ...
            isempty(Options.conditionKNNRetainRatio)
        Options.conditionKNNRetainRatio = 0.70;
    end
    if ~isfield(Options,'conditionKNNMinCount') || ...
            isempty(Options.conditionKNNMinCount)
        Options.conditionKNNMinCount = 2;
    end
    if ~isfield(Options,'lower')
        Options.lower = [];
    end
    if ~isfield(Options,'upper')
        Options.upper = [];
    end
    Options.conditionMode = NormalizeConditionMode_BDG( ...
        Options.conditionMode);
    Options.targetMode = NormalizeTargetMode_BDG(Options.targetMode);
    Options.nearSegmentTau = max(0,double(Options.nearSegmentTau));
    Options.nearSegmentMaxPerPair = max(1,round(double( ...
        Options.nearSegmentMaxPerPair)));
    Options.decisionInterpCount = max(2,round(double( ...
        Options.decisionInterpCount)));
    Options.conditionKNNK = max(1,round(double(Options.conditionKNNK)));
    Options.conditionKNNRetainRatio = min(max( ...
        double(Options.conditionKNNRetainRatio),0),1);
    Options.conditionKNNMinCount = max(2,round(double( ...
        Options.conditionKNNMinCount)));
end

function mode = NormalizeConditionMode_BDG(mode)
    mode = lower(strtrim(string(mode)));
    valid = ["yt_dt","yt_dt_ref","yt_dt_t","yt_dt_t_ref", ...
        "mid_normal_ref_s"];
    assert(ismember(mode,valid), ...
        'BuildBoundaryTargetTriples_BDG:BadConditionMode', ...
        'conditionMode must be one of: %s.',strjoin(valid,", "));
end

function mode = NormalizeTargetMode_BDG(mode)
    mode = lower(strtrim(string(mode)));
    valid = ["endpoint","near_segment_feasible","decision_interp"];
    assert(ismember(mode,valid), ...
        'BuildBoundaryTargetTriples_BDG:BadTargetMode', ...
        'targetMode must be one of: %s.',strjoin(valid,", "));
end

function tf = ConditionHasT_BDG(mode)
    mode = NormalizeConditionMode_BDG(mode);
    tf = mode == "yt_dt_t" || mode == "yt_dt_t_ref";
end

function tf = ConditionUsesMidNormal_BDG(mode)
    mode = NormalizeConditionMode_BDG(mode);
    tf = mode == "mid_normal_ref_s";
end

function code = TargetModeCode_BDG(mode)
    mode = NormalizeTargetMode_BDG(mode);
    names = ["endpoint","near_segment_feasible","decision_interp"];
    code = find(names == mode,1,'first') - 1;
end

function dim = TargetRefTokenDim_BDG(W,M,mode)
    mode = NormalizeConditionMode_BDG(mode);
    if mode ~= "yt_dt_ref" && mode ~= "yt_dt_t_ref" && ...
            mode ~= "mid_normal_ref_s"
        dim = 0;
        return;
    end
    if ~isempty(W) && isnumeric(W)
        dim = size(W,2);
    else
        dim = M;
    end
    dim = max(0,round(double(dim)));
end

function dim = TargetConditionDim_BDG(M,refDim,mode)
    mode = NormalizeConditionMode_BDG(mode);
    if ConditionUsesMidNormal_BDG(mode)
        dim = 2*M + 1 + refDim + 2;
    else
        dim = 2*M + double(ConditionHasT_BDG(mode)) + refDim;
    end
end

function C = ComposeConditionData_BDG(AF,AFNorm,AINorm,Direction, ...
        RefToken,pairRows,t,hasT,refDim,conditionMode)
    if ConditionUsesMidNormal_BDG(conditionMode)
        dir = Direction(pairRows,:);
        dirNorm = sqrt(sum(dir.^2,2));
        nHat = dir ./ max(dirNorm,1e-12);
        yMid = 0.5 .* (AFNorm(pairRows,:) + AINorm(pairRows,:));
        sCoord = ArchiveMetadataRows_BDG(AF,'s',pairRows, ...
            min(max(t(:),0),1));
        q = ArchiveMetadataRows_BDG(AF,'q',pairRows,ones(numel(pairRows),1));
        parts = {yMid,nHat,dirNorm,RefToken(pairRows,:),sCoord,q};
        C = single([parts{:}]);
        return;
    end
    parts = {AFNorm(pairRows,:),Direction(pairRows,:)};
    if hasT
        parts{end+1} = t(:);
    end
    if refDim > 0
        parts{end+1} = RefToken(pairRows,:);
    end
    C = single([parts{:}]);
end

function values = ArchiveMetadataRows_BDG(AF,field,pairRows,defaultValues)
    values = double(defaultValues(:));
    if isempty(values)
        values = zeros(numel(pairRows),1);
    end
    if numel(values) < numel(pairRows)
        values(end+1:numel(pairRows),1) = values(end);
    end
    values = values(1:numel(pairRows));
    if ~isstruct(AF) || ~isfield(AF,field) || isempty(AF.(field))
        return;
    end
    source = double(AF.(field)(:));
    idx = max(1,min(numel(source),round(double(pairRows(:)))));
    candidate = source(idx);
    valid = isfinite(candidate);
    values(valid) = candidate(valid);
end

function [X,pairRows,t,fallback] = CanonicalizeTargetsByPair_BDG( ...
        X,pairRows,t,fallback)
    pairRows = pairRows(:);
    t = t(:);
    fallback = logical(fallback(:));
    groups = unique(pairRows,'stable');
    keep = false(numel(pairRows),1);
    for i = 1 : numel(groups)
        idx = find(pairRows == groups(i));
        realIdx = idx(~fallback(idx));
        if isempty(realIdx)
            candidate = idx;
        else
            candidate = realIdx;
        end
        if numel(candidate) == 1
            keep(candidate) = true;
            continue;
        end
        center = median(double(X(candidate,:)),1);
        dist = sqrt(sum((double(X(candidate,:)) - center).^2,2));
        [~,pos] = min(dist);
        keep(candidate(pos)) = true;
    end
    X = X(keep,:);
    pairRows = pairRows(keep);
    t = t(keep);
    fallback = fallback(keep);
end

function RefToken = TargetRefToken_BDG(AF,idx,W,refDim)
    RefToken = zeros(numel(idx),refDim);
    if refDim <= 0 || isempty(idx) || isempty(W) || ...
            ~isstruct(AF) || ~isfield(AF,'ref') || isempty(AF.ref)
        return;
    end
    refs = double(AF.ref(:));
    for i = 1 : numel(idx)
        p = idx(i);
        if p < 1 || p > numel(refs)
            continue;
        end
        r = round(refs(p));
        if ~isfinite(r) || r < 1 || r > size(W,1)
            continue;
        end
        cols = min(refDim,size(W,2));
        RefToken(i,1:cols) = double(W(r,1:cols));
    end
end

function S = MergeStructFields_BDG(S,Extra)
    if ~isstruct(Extra)
        return;
    end
    names = fieldnames(Extra);
    for i = 1 : numel(names)
        S.(names{i}) = Extra.(names{i});
    end
end

function [X,pairRows,t] = DecisionInterpolationTargets_BDG(AFDec,AIDec,count)
    nPair = size(AFDec,1);
    tGrid = linspace(0,1,count)';
    X = zeros(nPair*numel(tGrid),size(AFDec,2));
    pairRows = zeros(nPair*numel(tGrid),1);
    t = zeros(nPair*numel(tGrid),1);
    row = 0;
    for i = 1 : nPair
        for j = 1 : numel(tGrid)
            row = row + 1;
            pairRows(row) = i;
            t(row) = tGrid(j);
            X(row,:) = AFDec(i,:) + t(row) .* (AIDec(i,:) - AFDec(i,:));
        end
    end
end

function [X,pairRows,t,fallback,sourceCount,candidateCount,keepCount] = ...
        NearSegmentFeasibleTargets_BDG(AFDec,AFNorm,Direction,Options, ...
        zmin,zmax,D,M)
    [SourceDec,SourceObj] = FeasibleSourceMatrices_BDG( ...
        Options.nearSegmentSource,D,M);
    nPair = size(AFDec,1);
    maxPerPair = Options.nearSegmentMaxPerPair;
    tau = Options.nearSegmentTau;
    candidateCount = 0;
    keepCount = 0;

    if ~isempty(SourceDec)
        SourceNorm = NormalizeObjMatNoClip_BDG(SourceObj,zmin,zmax);
        finiteSource = all(isfinite(SourceNorm),2);
        SourceDec = SourceDec(finiteSource,:);
        SourceNorm = SourceNorm(finiteSource,:);
    else
        SourceNorm = zeros(0,M);
    end
    sourceCount = size(SourceDec,1);

    if sourceCount <= 0
        row = nPair;
        X = zeros(row,D);
        pairRows = zeros(row,1);
        t = zeros(row,1);
        fallback = false(row,1);
        X(1:row,:) = AFDec;
        pairRows(1:row) = (1:nPair)';
        t(1:row) = 0;
        fallback(1:row) = true;
    else
        candidateCount = double(nPair) * double(sourceCount);
        if candidateCount < NearSegmentBBoxThreshold_BDG()
            [X,pairRows,t,fallback,keepCount] = ...
                NearSegmentFullScanTargets_BDG(AFDec,AFNorm,Direction, ...
                SourceDec,SourceNorm,maxPerPair,tau,D);
        else
            [X,pairRows,t,fallback,keepCount] = ...
                NearSegmentBBoxTargets_BDG(AFNorm,Direction,SourceDec, ...
                SourceNorm,maxPerPair,tau,D,nPair);
        end
    end
end

function threshold = NearSegmentBBoxThreshold_BDG()
    threshold = 1e6;
end

function [X,pairRows,t,fallback,keepCount] = ...
        NearSegmentFullScanTargets_BDG(AFDec,AFNorm,Direction,SourceDec, ...
        SourceNorm,maxPerPair,tau,D)
    nPair = size(AFDec,1);
    X = zeros(0,D);
    pairRows = zeros(0,1);
    t = zeros(0,1);
    fallback = false(0,1);
    keepCount = 0;
    for i = 1 : nPair
        a = AFNorm(i,:);
        b = a + Direction(i,:);
        [dist,projT] = PointToSegmentDistances_BDG(SourceNorm,a,b);
        valid = isfinite(dist) & isfinite(projT);
        chosen = [];
        chosenT = [];
        if any(valid)
            idx = find(valid & dist <= tau);
            if isempty(idx)
                [~,ord] = sort(dist(valid),'ascend');
                validIdx = find(valid);
                idx = validIdx(ord(1:min(maxPerPair,numel(ord))));
            else
                [~,ord] = sort(dist(idx),'ascend');
                idx = idx(ord(1:min(maxPerPair,numel(ord))));
            end
            chosen = SourceDec(idx,:);
            chosenT = min(max(projT(idx),0),1);
        end
        if isempty(chosen)
            chosen = AFDec(i,:);
            chosenT = 0;
            fb = true;
        else
            fb = false(size(chosenT));
        end
        rowN = size(chosen,1);
        X = [X;chosen]; %#ok<AGROW>
        pairRows = [pairRows;repmat(i,rowN,1)]; %#ok<AGROW>
        t = [t;chosenT(:)]; %#ok<AGROW>
        fallback = [fallback;fb(:)]; %#ok<AGROW>
        keepCount = keepCount + rowN - sum(fb(:));
    end
end

function [X,pairRows,t,fallback,keepCount] = ...
        NearSegmentBBoxTargets_BDG(AFNorm,Direction,SourceDec,SourceNorm, ...
        maxPerPair,tau,D,nPair)
    rowCap = max(1,nPair * maxPerPair);
    X = zeros(rowCap,D);
    pairRows = zeros(rowCap,1);
    t = zeros(rowCap,1);
    fallback = false(rowCap,1);
    row = 0;
    keepCount = 0;
    tau2 = tau .* tau;
    for i = 1 : nPair
        a = AFNorm(i,:);
        v = Direction(i,:);
        b = a + v;
        lo = min(a,b) - tau;
        hi = max(a,b) + tau;
        box = all(SourceNorm >= lo & SourceNorm <= hi,2);
        idx = [];
        chosenT = [];
        if any(box)
            boxIdx = find(box);
            [boxDist2,boxT] = PointToSegmentDistancesSquared_BDG( ...
                SourceNorm(boxIdx,:),a,v);
            nearRows = find(boxDist2 <= tau2);
            if ~isempty(nearRows)
                nearOrd = SmallestKRows_BDG(boxDist2(nearRows), ...
                    maxPerPair);
                localRows = nearRows(nearOrd);
                idx = boxIdx(localRows);
                chosenT = boxT(localRows);
            end
        end
        if isempty(idx)
            [dist2,projT] = PointToSegmentDistancesSquared_BDG( ...
                SourceNorm,a,v);
            idx = SmallestKRows_BDG(dist2,maxPerPair);
            chosenT = projT(idx);
        end
        rowN = numel(idx);
        rows = row + (1:rowN);
        X(rows,:) = SourceDec(idx,:);
        pairRows(rows) = i;
        t(rows) = min(max(chosenT,0),1);
        fallback(rows) = false;
        row = row + rowN;
        keepCount = keepCount + rowN;
    end
    X = X(1:row,:);
    pairRows = pairRows(1:row);
    t = t(1:row);
    fallback = fallback(1:row);
end

function [dist,t] = PointToSegmentDistances_BDG(X,a,b)
    v = b - a;
    len2 = sum(v.^2);
    if len2 <= 1e-24
        t = zeros(size(X,1),1);
        proj = repmat(a,size(X,1),1);
    else
        t = sum((X - a).*v,2) ./ len2;
        proj = a + min(max(t,0),1).*v;
    end
    dist = sqrt(sum((X - proj).^2,2));
end

function [dist2,t] = PointToSegmentDistancesSquared_BDG(X,a,v)
    len2 = sum(v.^2);
    if len2 <= 1e-24
        t = zeros(size(X,1),1);
        proj = a;
    else
        t = sum((X - a).*v,2) ./ len2;
        proj = a + min(max(t,0),1).*v;
    end
    dist2 = sum((X - proj).^2,2);
end

function [Dec,Obj] = FeasibleSourceMatrices_BDG(Source,D,M)
    Dec = zeros(0,D);
    Obj = zeros(0,M);
    if ~isstruct(Source) || ~isfield(Source,'decs') || ...
            ~isfield(Source,'objs') || isempty(Source.decs) || ...
            isempty(Source.objs)
        return;
    end
    decs = double(Source.decs);
    objs = double(Source.objs);
    if size(decs,2) ~= D
        return;
    end
    if size(objs,2) > M
        objs = objs(:,1:M);
    elseif size(objs,2) < M
        objs = [objs,nan(size(objs,1),M-size(objs,2))];
    end
    n = min(size(decs,1),size(objs,1));
    decs = decs(1:n,:);
    objs = objs(1:n,:);
    feasible = true(n,1);
    if isfield(Source,'cons') && ~isempty(Source.cons)
        cons = double(Source.cons);
        cons = cons(1:min(n,size(cons,1)),:);
        feasible = false(n,1);
        feasible(1:size(cons,1)) = all(cons <= 0,2);
    elseif isfield(Source,'feasible') && ~isempty(Source.feasible)
        f = logical(Source.feasible(:));
        feasible = false(n,1);
        feasible(1:min(n,numel(f))) = f(1:min(n,numel(f)));
    end
    finite = all(isfinite(decs),2) & all(isfinite(objs),2);
    keep = feasible & finite;
    Dec = decs(keep,:);
    Obj = objs(keep,:);
end

function idx = SmallestKRows_BDG(values,k)
    values = values(:);
    k = min(k,numel(values));
    if k <= 0
        idx = zeros(0,1);
    elseif k == numel(values)
        [~,idx] = sort(values,'ascend');
    else
        try
            [~,idx] = mink(values,k);
        catch
            [~,idx] = sort(values,'ascend');
            idx = idx(1:k);
        end
    end
end

function Diag = EmptyTargetTripleDiag_BDG(M,refDim,conditionMode,targetMode)
    if nargin < 2
        refDim = 0;
    end
    if nargin < 3
        conditionMode = "yt_dt";
    end
    if nargin < 4
        targetMode = "endpoint";
    end
    conditionMode = NormalizeConditionMode_BDG(conditionMode);
    targetMode = NormalizeTargetMode_BDG(targetMode);
    Diag = struct( ...
        'target_triple_ready',0, ...
        'target_pair_count',0, ...
        'target_triple_count',0, ...
        'target_condition_dim',double(TargetConditionDim_BDG(M,refDim,conditionMode)), ...
        'target_condition_mode_code',ConditionModeCode_BDG(conditionMode), ...
        'target_ref_token_dim',double(refDim), ...
        'target_mode_code',double(TargetModeCode_BDG(targetMode)), ...
        'target_keep_index',zeros(0,1), ...
        'target_y_min',nan(1,M), ...
        'target_y_max',nan(1,M), ...
        'target_direction_norm_mean',NaN, ...
        'target_t_min',NaN, ...
        'target_t_max',NaN, ...
        'target_t_mean',NaN, ...
        'target_fallback_count',0, ...
        'target_near_segment_source_count',0, ...
        'target_near_segment_candidate_count',0, ...
        'target_near_segment_keep_count',0);
end

function code = ConditionModeCode_BDG(mode)
    mode = NormalizeConditionMode_BDG(mode);
    names = ["yt_dt","yt_dt_ref","yt_dt_t","yt_dt_t_ref", ...
        "mid_normal_ref_s"];
    code = double(find(names == mode,1,'first') - 1);
end

function D = ProblemDimension_BDG(Problem,AF)
    D = 0;
    if isfield_safe_BDG(Problem,'D')
        D = double(Problem.D);
    elseif isstruct(AF) && isfield(AF,'decs')
        D = size(AF.decs,2);
    end
    if isempty(D) || ~isscalar(D) || ~isfinite(D)
        D = 0;
    end
    D = max(0,round(D));
end

function M = ProblemObjectiveCount_BDG(Problem,AF,AI)
    M = 0;
    if isfield_safe_BDG(Problem,'M')
        M = double(Problem.M);
    elseif isstruct(AF) && isfield(AF,'objs')
        M = size(AF.objs,2);
    elseif isstruct(AI) && isfield(AI,'objs')
        M = size(AI.objs,2);
    end
    if isempty(M) || ~isscalar(M) || ~isfinite(M)
        M = 0;
    end
    M = max(0,round(M));
end

function flag = isfield_safe_BDG(S,name)
    flag = false;
    try
        flag = isfield(S,name);
    catch
    end
end

function [Dec,Obj] = ArchiveMatrices_BDG(A,D,M)
    Dec = zeros(0,D);
    Obj = zeros(0,M);
    if ~isstruct(A)
        return;
    end
    if isfield(A,'decs') && ~isempty(A.decs)
        Dec = double(A.decs);
        if size(Dec,2) ~= D
            Dec = zeros(0,D);
        end
    end
    if isfield(A,'objs') && ~isempty(A.objs)
        Obj = double(A.objs);
        if size(Obj,2) > M
            Obj = Obj(:,1:M);
        elseif size(Obj,2) < M
            Obj = [Obj,nan(size(Obj,1),M-size(Obj,2))];
        end
    end
end

function [AFNorm,AINorm,zmin,zmax] = NormalizePairedObjectives_BDG(AFObj,AIObj,M)
    allObj = [AFObj;AIObj];
    zmin = zeros(1,M);
    zmax = ones(1,M);
    for j = 1 : M
        values = allObj(:,j);
        values = values(isfinite(values));
        if isempty(values)
            continue;
        end
        zmin(j) = min(values);
        zmax(j) = max(values);
    end
    AFNorm = NormalizeObjMat_BDG(AFObj,zmin,zmax);
    AINorm = NormalizeObjMat_BDG(AIObj,zmin,zmax);
end

function X = NormalizeObjMat_BDG(X,zmin,zmax)
    X = NormalizeObjMatNoClip_BDG(X,zmin,zmax);
    X = min(max(X,0),1);
end

function X = NormalizeObjMatNoClip_BDG(X,zmin,zmax)
    X = (double(X) - double(zmin)) ./ ...
        (double(zmax) - double(zmin) + 1e-12);
end

function value = MeanFinite_BDG(X)
    X = X(isfinite(X));
    if isempty(X)
        value = NaN;
    else
        value = mean(X);
    end
end

function value = MedianFinite_BDG(X)
    X = X(isfinite(X));
    if isempty(X)
        value = NaN;
    else
        value = median(X);
    end
end

function value = PercentileFinite_BDG(X,p)
    X = sort(double(X(isfinite(X))));
    if isempty(X)
        value = NaN;
        return;
    end
    p = min(max(double(p),0),100);
    value = X(max(1,ceil((p/100)*numel(X))));
end

function value = SafeRatio_BDG(num,den)
    if den <= 0
        value = NaN;
    else
        value = double(num) / double(den);
    end
end

function value = MinFinite_BDG(X)
    X = X(isfinite(X));
    if isempty(X)
        value = NaN;
    else
        value = min(X);
    end
end

function value = MaxFinite_BDG(X)
    X = X(isfinite(X));
    if isempty(X)
        value = NaN;
    else
        value = max(X);
    end
end

function [Summary,outDir,ImageManifest] = run_CCMO_GAN_BDG_archive_pareto_filters_fullscope( ...
        outDir,workerCount,problemNames,N,D,maxFE,runIds,variantSet, ...
        algorithmParams,plotOptions)
% Run the A1 mainline and the single A2 branch. Plotting is opt-in.

    rootDir = fileparts(which('platemo'));
    if nargin < 1 || isempty(outDir)
        outDir = fullfile(rootDir,'Data','CCMO_GAN_BDG', ...
            ['archive_pareto_filters_fullscope_', ...
            char(datetime('now','Format','yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'))]);
    end
    if nargin < 2 || isempty(workerCount)
        workerCount = 6;
    end
    if nargin < 3 || isempty(problemNames)
        problemNames = defaultProblemList();
    end
    if nargin < 4 || isempty(N)
        N = 100;
    end
    if nargin < 5
        D = [];
    end
    if nargin < 6 || isempty(maxFE)
        maxFE = 100000;
    end
    if nargin < 7 || isempty(runIds)
        runIds = 1 : 3;
    end
    if nargin < 8 || isempty(variantSet)
        variantSet = "default";
    end
    if nargin < 9
        algorithmParams = [];
    end
    if nargin < 10
        plotOptions = [];
    end

    addpath(genpath(rootDir));
    problemNames = cellstr(string(problemNames(:)));
    runIds = double(runIds(:)');
    workerCount = max(1,round(double(workerCount)));
    algorithmParams = normalizeAlgorithmParams(algorithmParams,N);
    plotOptions = normalizePlotOptions(plotOptions,outDir);
    Variants = archiveParetoVariants(variantSet);
    Tasks = buildTasks(problemNames,runIds,Variants);

    if ~isfolder(outDir)
        mkdir(outDir);
    end
    writetable(Variants,fullfile(outDir,'variant_config.csv'));

    fprintf('archive_pareto_filters_fullscope outDir=%s\n',outDir);
    fprintf('tasks=%d problems x %d runs x %d variants, N=%d, D=%s, maxFE=%d, workers=%d\n', ...
        numel(problemNames),numel(runIds),height(Variants),N, ...
        defaultDText(D),maxFE,workerCount);

    Rows = repmat(emptyRunRow(),height(Tasks),1);
    if workerCount > 1
        ensureParallelPool(workerCount);
        parfor task = 1 : height(Tasks)
            Rows(task) = completeRunRow(runOneTask(Tasks(task,:),N,D, ...
                maxFE,algorithmParams,plotOptions));
        end
    else
        for task = 1 : height(Tasks)
            Rows(task) = completeRunRow(runOneTask(Tasks(task,:),N,D, ...
                maxFE,algorithmParams,plotOptions));
            fprintf('[%d/%d] %s %s run=%g status=%s\n', ...
                task,height(Tasks),Tasks.variant(task), ...
                Tasks.problem(task),Tasks.run(task),Rows(task).status);
        end
    end

    Summary = struct2table(Rows);
    writetable(Summary,fullfile(outDir,'archive_pareto_filter_run_summary.csv'));
    writeSummaries(Summary,outDir);
    writeStageSummaries(Summary,outDir);
    ImageManifest = table();
    if plotOptions.enable
        writetable(Summary,fullfile(plotOptions.outDir, ...
            'archive_snapshot_run_summary.csv'));
        ImageManifest = plotSnapshotImages(Summary,N,D,maxFE, ...
            plotOptions.figureRoot);
        writetable(ImageManifest,fullfile(plotOptions.outDir, ...
            'archive_snapshot_image_manifest.csv'));
    end
end

function Row = completeRunRow(Source)
    Row = emptyRunRow();
    names = intersect(fieldnames(Source),fieldnames(Row),'stable');
    for i = 1 : numel(names)
        Row.(names{i}) = Source.(names{i});
    end
end

function Variants = archiveParetoVariants(variantSet)
    if istable(variantSet)
        Variants = validateRetainedVariants(variantSet);
        return;
    elseif isstruct(variantSet)
        Variants = validateRetainedVariants(struct2table(variantSet));
        return;
    end
    variantSet = lower(strtrim(string(variantSet)));
    switch variantSet
        case {"default","current","fixmd_global", ...
                "fixmd_gndk60_nearseg_huber_z0"}
            specs = {retainedVariantRow("FixMD_GNDk60_nearseg_huber_z0")};
        case {"fixmd_validation","fixmd_chain","cbl_cgan_validation"}
            specs = { ...
                retainedVariantRow("FixMD_GNDk60_nearseg_huber_z0"), ...
                retainedVariantRow("R1_recent_cell_archive"), ...
                retainedVariantRow("R1_R2_mid_normal_ref_s"), ...
                retainedVariantRow("R1_R2_R3_thin_boundary_critic"), ...
                retainedVariantRow("R1_R2_R3_R4_confidence_pseudoboundary"), ...
                retainedVariantRow("P1_holdout_ref_value_proof")};
        otherwise
            error('run_CCMO_GAN_BDG_archive_pareto_filters_fullscope:BadVariantSet', ...
                'Unknown variantSet "%s".',variantSet);
    end
    Variants = validateRetainedVariants(struct2table(vertcat(specs{:})));
end

function Variants = validateRetainedVariants(Variants)
    required = ["variant","archiveParetoFilterMode", ...
        "archivePairDirectionMode","generatorMode"];
    missing = setdiff(required,string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames));
    assert(isempty(missing), ...
        'run_CCMO_GAN_BDG_archive_pareto_filters_fullscope:BadVariantTable', ...
        'Variant table missing required columns: %s',strjoin(missing,", "));

    if ~ismember("ganCriticMode",string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.ganCriticMode = repmat("af_like",height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("generatorLossMode",string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.generatorLossMode = repmat("adversarial",height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("archiveSourceCapMode",string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.archiveSourceCapMode = repmat("limited",height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("archivePairRefMode",string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.archivePairRefMode = repmat("none",height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("archiveUpdateMode",string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.archiveUpdateMode = repmat("historical_pool",height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("recentWindow",string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.recentWindow = repmat(0,height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("holdoutProtocol",string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.holdoutProtocol = repmat("none",height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("holdoutRefModulo",string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.holdoutRefModulo = repmat(5,height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("holdoutRefRemainder",string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.holdoutRefRemainder = repmat(0,height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("trainFilterMode",string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.trainFilterMode = repmat("none",height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("conditionKNNRetainRatio", ...
            string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.conditionKNNRetainRatio = repmat(0.70,height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("cganTrainMinRefCov", ...
            string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.cganTrainMinRefCov = repmat(0.00,height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("cganTrainMinTargetTriples", ...
            string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.cganTrainMinTargetTriples = repmat(0,height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("conditionMode",string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.conditionMode = repmat("yt_dt",height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("targetRealLabelMode",string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.targetRealLabelMode = repmat("binary",height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("targetMode",string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.targetMode = repmat("endpoint",height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("nearSegmentTau",string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.nearSegmentTau = repmat(0.20,height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("nearSegmentMaxPerPair",string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.nearSegmentMaxPerPair = repmat(5,height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("decisionInterpCount",string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.decisionInterpCount = repmat(5,height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("reconstructionWeight",string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.reconstructionWeight = repmat(0,height(Variants),1);
    end
    if ~ismember("reconstructionHuberDelta",string(Variants.Properties.VariableNames))
        Variants.reconstructionHuberDelta = repmat(0.10,height(Variants),1);
    end
    Variants = Variants(:,cellstr([required,"archiveSourceCapMode", ...
        "archivePairRefMode","archiveUpdateMode","recentWindow", ...
        "holdoutProtocol","holdoutRefModulo","holdoutRefRemainder", ...
        "trainFilterMode","conditionKNNRetainRatio", ...
        "cganTrainMinRefCov","cganTrainMinTargetTriples", ...
        "conditionMode","targetMode","nearSegmentTau", ...
        "nearSegmentMaxPerPair","decisionInterpCount", ...
        "targetRealLabelMode","ganCriticMode", ...
        "generatorLossMode","reconstructionWeight", ...
        "reconstructionHuberDelta"]));
    Variants.variant = string(Variants.variant);
    Variants.archiveParetoFilterMode = lower(strtrim( ...
        string(Variants.archiveParetoFilterMode)));
    Variants.archivePairDirectionMode = lower(strtrim( ...
        string(Variants.archivePairDirectionMode)));
    Variants.archiveSourceCapMode = lower(strtrim( ...
        string(Variants.archiveSourceCapMode)));
    Variants.archivePairRefMode = lower(strtrim( ...
        string(Variants.archivePairRefMode)));
    Variants.archiveUpdateMode = lower(strtrim( ...
        string(Variants.archiveUpdateMode)));
    Variants.recentWindow = max(0,round(double(Variants.recentWindow)));
    Variants.holdoutProtocol = lower(strtrim( ...
        string(Variants.holdoutProtocol)));
    Variants.holdoutRefModulo = max(2,round(double( ...
        Variants.holdoutRefModulo)));
    Variants.holdoutRefRemainder = mod(round(double( ...
        Variants.holdoutRefRemainder)),Variants.holdoutRefModulo);
    Variants.trainFilterMode = lower(strtrim( ...
        string(Variants.trainFilterMode)));
    Variants.conditionKNNRetainRatio = min(max( ...
        double(Variants.conditionKNNRetainRatio),0),1);
    Variants.cganTrainMinRefCov = min(max( ...
        double(Variants.cganTrainMinRefCov),0),1);
    Variants.cganTrainMinTargetTriples = max(0,round( ...
        double(Variants.cganTrainMinTargetTriples)));
    Variants.conditionMode = lower(strtrim(string(Variants.conditionMode)));
    Variants.targetMode = lower(strtrim(string(Variants.targetMode)));
    Variants.nearSegmentTau = max(0,double(Variants.nearSegmentTau));
    Variants.nearSegmentMaxPerPair = max(1,round(double( ...
        Variants.nearSegmentMaxPerPair)));
    Variants.decisionInterpCount = max(2,round(double( ...
        Variants.decisionInterpCount)));
    Variants.targetRealLabelMode = lower(strtrim( ...
        string(Variants.targetRealLabelMode)));
    Variants.generatorMode = lower(strtrim(string(Variants.generatorMode)));
    Variants.ganCriticMode = lower(strtrim(string(Variants.ganCriticMode)));
    Variants.generatorLossMode = lower(strtrim( ...
        string(Variants.generatorLossMode)));
    Variants.reconstructionWeight = max(0,double( ...
        Variants.reconstructionWeight));
    Variants.reconstructionHuberDelta = max(eps,double( ...
        Variants.reconstructionHuberDelta));

    Retained = retainedVariantSpecs();
    ok = false(height(Variants),1);
    for i = 1 : height(Variants)
        idx = find(Retained.variant == Variants.variant(i),1,'first');
        ok(i) = ~isempty(idx) && ...
            Variants.archiveParetoFilterMode(i) == Retained.archiveParetoFilterMode(idx) && ...
            Variants.archivePairDirectionMode(i) == Retained.archivePairDirectionMode(idx) && ...
            Variants.archiveSourceCapMode(i) == Retained.archiveSourceCapMode(idx) && ...
            Variants.archivePairRefMode(i) == Retained.archivePairRefMode(idx) && ...
            Variants.archiveUpdateMode(i) == Retained.archiveUpdateMode(idx) && ...
            Variants.recentWindow(i) == Retained.recentWindow(idx) && ...
            Variants.holdoutProtocol(i) == Retained.holdoutProtocol(idx) && ...
            Variants.holdoutRefModulo(i) == Retained.holdoutRefModulo(idx) && ...
            Variants.holdoutRefRemainder(i) == Retained.holdoutRefRemainder(idx) && ...
            Variants.trainFilterMode(i) == Retained.trainFilterMode(idx) && ...
            abs(Variants.conditionKNNRetainRatio(i) - ...
                Retained.conditionKNNRetainRatio(idx)) < 1e-12 && ...
            abs(Variants.cganTrainMinRefCov(i) - ...
                Retained.cganTrainMinRefCov(idx)) < 1e-12 && ...
            Variants.cganTrainMinTargetTriples(i) == ...
                Retained.cganTrainMinTargetTriples(idx) && ...
            Variants.conditionMode(i) == Retained.conditionMode(idx) && ...
            Variants.targetMode(i) == Retained.targetMode(idx) && ...
            abs(Variants.nearSegmentTau(i) - ...
                Retained.nearSegmentTau(idx)) < 1e-12 && ...
            Variants.nearSegmentMaxPerPair(i) == ...
                Retained.nearSegmentMaxPerPair(idx) && ...
            Variants.decisionInterpCount(i) == ...
                Retained.decisionInterpCount(idx) && ...
            Variants.targetRealLabelMode(i) == Retained.targetRealLabelMode(idx) && ...
            Variants.generatorMode(i) == Retained.generatorMode(idx) && ...
            Variants.ganCriticMode(i) == Retained.ganCriticMode(idx) && ...
            Variants.generatorLossMode(i) == Retained.generatorLossMode(idx) && ...
            abs(Variants.reconstructionWeight(i) - ...
                Retained.reconstructionWeight(idx)) < 1e-12 && ...
            abs(Variants.reconstructionHuberDelta(i) - ...
                Retained.reconstructionHuberDelta(idx)) < 1e-12;
    end
    assert(all(ok), ...
        'run_CCMO_GAN_BDG_archive_pareto_filters_fullscope:UnsupportedVariant', ...
        'Only retained variants are supported: %s.', ...
        strjoin(Retained.variant,", "));
end

function Row = variantRow(name,archiveParetoFilterMode, ...
        archivePairDirectionMode,archiveSourceCapMode,archivePairRefMode, ...
        generatorMode,ganCriticMode,generatorLossMode,trainFilterMode, ...
        conditionMode,targetRealLabelMode,conditionKNNRetainRatio, ...
        cganTrainMinRefCov,cganTrainMinTargetTriples,targetMode, ...
        nearSegmentTau,nearSegmentMaxPerPair,decisionInterpCount, ...
        reconstructionWeight,reconstructionHuberDelta, ...
        archiveUpdateMode,recentWindow,holdoutProtocol, ...
        holdoutRefModulo,holdoutRefRemainder)
    if nargin < 12 || isempty(conditionKNNRetainRatio)
        conditionKNNRetainRatio = 0.70;
    end
    if nargin < 13 || isempty(cganTrainMinRefCov)
        cganTrainMinRefCov = 0.00;
    end
    if nargin < 14 || isempty(cganTrainMinTargetTriples)
        cganTrainMinTargetTriples = 0;
    end
    if nargin < 15 || isempty(targetMode)
        targetMode = "endpoint";
    end
    if nargin < 16 || isempty(nearSegmentTau)
        nearSegmentTau = 0.20;
    end
    if nargin < 17 || isempty(nearSegmentMaxPerPair)
        nearSegmentMaxPerPair = 5;
    end
    if nargin < 18 || isempty(decisionInterpCount)
        decisionInterpCount = 5;
    end
    if nargin < 19 || isempty(reconstructionWeight)
        reconstructionWeight = 0;
    end
    if nargin < 20 || isempty(reconstructionHuberDelta)
        reconstructionHuberDelta = 0.10;
    end
    if nargin < 21 || isempty(archiveUpdateMode)
        archiveUpdateMode = "historical_pool";
    end
    if nargin < 22 || isempty(recentWindow)
        recentWindow = 0;
    end
    if nargin < 23 || isempty(holdoutProtocol)
        holdoutProtocol = "none";
    end
    if nargin < 24 || isempty(holdoutRefModulo)
        holdoutRefModulo = 5;
    end
    if nargin < 25 || isempty(holdoutRefRemainder)
        holdoutRefRemainder = 0;
    end
    Row = struct( ...
        'variant',string(name), ...
        'archiveParetoFilterMode',string(archiveParetoFilterMode), ...
        'archivePairDirectionMode',string(archivePairDirectionMode), ...
        'archiveSourceCapMode',string(archiveSourceCapMode), ...
        'archivePairRefMode',string(archivePairRefMode), ...
        'archiveUpdateMode',string(archiveUpdateMode), ...
        'recentWindow',double(recentWindow), ...
        'holdoutProtocol',string(holdoutProtocol), ...
        'holdoutRefModulo',double(holdoutRefModulo), ...
        'holdoutRefRemainder',double(holdoutRefRemainder), ...
        'trainFilterMode',string(trainFilterMode), ...
        'conditionKNNRetainRatio',double(conditionKNNRetainRatio), ...
        'cganTrainMinRefCov',double(cganTrainMinRefCov), ...
        'cganTrainMinTargetTriples',double(cganTrainMinTargetTriples), ...
        'conditionMode',string(conditionMode), ...
        'targetMode',string(targetMode), ...
        'nearSegmentTau',double(nearSegmentTau), ...
        'nearSegmentMaxPerPair',double(nearSegmentMaxPerPair), ...
        'decisionInterpCount',double(decisionInterpCount), ...
        'targetRealLabelMode',string(targetRealLabelMode), ...
        'generatorMode',string(generatorMode), ...
        'ganCriticMode',string(ganCriticMode), ...
        'generatorLossMode',string(generatorLossMode), ...
        'reconstructionWeight',double(reconstructionWeight), ...
        'reconstructionHuberDelta',double(reconstructionHuberDelta));
end

function Tasks = buildTasks(problemNames,runIds,Variants)
    count = numel(problemNames) * numel(runIds) * height(Variants);
    Rows = repmat(emptyTaskRow(),count,1);
    k = 0;
    for v = 1 : height(Variants)
        VariantRow = table2struct(Variants(v,:));
        fields = fieldnames(VariantRow);
        for p = 1 : numel(problemNames)
            for r = 1 : numel(runIds)
                k = k + 1;
                for f = 1 : numel(fields)
                    Rows(k).(fields{f}) = VariantRow.(fields{f});
                end
                Rows(k).variant_index = v;
                Rows(k).problem = string(problemNames{p});
                Rows(k).run = runIds(r);
            end
        end
    end
    Tasks = struct2table(Rows);
end

function Row = runOneTask(Task,N,D,maxFE,algorithmParams,plotOptions)
    Row = emptyRunRow();
    Row.variant = string(Task.variant);
    Row.archiveParetoFilterMode = string(Task.archiveParetoFilterMode);
    Row.archivePairDirectionMode = string(Task.archivePairDirectionMode);
    Row.archiveSourceCapMode = string(Task.archiveSourceCapMode);
    Row.archivePairRefMode = string(Task.archivePairRefMode);
    Row.archiveUpdateMode = string(Task.archiveUpdateMode);
    Row.recentWindow = double(Task.recentWindow);
    Row.holdoutProtocol = string(Task.holdoutProtocol);
    Row.holdoutRefModulo = double(Task.holdoutRefModulo);
    Row.holdoutRefRemainder = double(Task.holdoutRefRemainder);
    Row.trainFilterMode = string(Task.trainFilterMode);
    Row.conditionKNNRetainRatio = double(Task.conditionKNNRetainRatio);
    Row.cganTrainMinRefCov = double(Task.cganTrainMinRefCov);
    Row.cganTrainMinTargetTriples = double(Task.cganTrainMinTargetTriples);
    Row.conditionMode = string(Task.conditionMode);
    Row.targetMode = string(Task.targetMode);
    Row.nearSegmentTau = double(Task.nearSegmentTau);
    Row.nearSegmentMaxPerPair = double(Task.nearSegmentMaxPerPair);
    Row.decisionInterpCount = double(Task.decisionInterpCount);
    Row.targetRealLabelMode = string(Task.targetRealLabelMode);
    Row.generatorMode = string(Task.generatorMode);
    Row.ganCriticMode = string(Task.ganCriticMode);
    Row.generatorLossMode = string(Task.generatorLossMode);
    Row.reconstructionWeight = double(Task.reconstructionWeight);
    Row.reconstructionHuberDelta = double(Task.reconstructionHuberDelta);
    Row.problem = string(Task.problem);
    Row.family = problemFamily(Row.problem);
    Row.run = double(Task.run);
    Row.seed = double(Task.run);
    Row.trainFilterRandomSeed = Row.seed;
    Row.N = double(N);
    Row.maxFE = double(maxFE);
    Row = attachAlgorithmParams(Row,algorithmParams);
    Row.target_text = strjoin(string(plotOptions.targets),';');

    try
        rootDir = fileparts(which('platemo'));
        addpath(genpath(rootDir));
        rng(Row.seed,'twister');
        ProblemConstructor = str2func(char(Row.problem));
        if isempty(D)
            Problem = ProblemConstructor('N',N,'maxFE',maxFE);
        else
            Problem = ProblemConstructor('N',N,'D',D,'maxFE',maxFE);
        end
        Row.D = double(Problem.D);

        Control = experimentControl(Row,plotOptions);
        plotThisTask = shouldPlotTask(Row,plotOptions);
        if plotThisTask
            Row.snapshot_folder = string(fullfile(plotOptions.snapshotRoot, ...
                safeName(Row.variant),sprintf('%s_run%d', ...
                char(Row.problem),round(Row.run))));
            Row.snapshot_manifest_file = string(fullfile( ...
                char(Row.snapshot_folder),'archive_snapshot_manifest.csv'));
            Control.archiveSnapshotFolder = Row.snapshot_folder;
            Control.archiveSnapshotTag = Row.variant;
            if ~isfolder(char(Row.snapshot_folder))
                mkdir(char(Row.snapshot_folder));
            end
        end
        setappdata(0,'CCMO_GAN_BDG_ExperimentControl',Control);
        cleanup = onCleanup(@()rmappdataIfPresent()); %#ok<NASGU>

        Algorithm = CCMO_GAN_BDG( ...
            'save',0, ...
            'run',Row.run, ...
            'metName',{'IGD','HV','Feasible_rate'}, ...
            'outputFcn',@(varargin)[], ...
            'parameter',algorithmParams);
        Algorithm.Solve(Problem);

        Row.runtime = double(Algorithm.metric.runtime);
        Row.core_metrics_file = string(Algorithm.metric.analysis_core_csv);
        Row.stage_metrics_file = string(Algorithm.metric.analysis_stage_csv);
        Row.IGD = lastValue(Algorithm.CalMetric('IGD'));
        Row.HV = lastValue(Algorithm.CalMetric('HV'));
        Row.Feasible_rate = lastValue(Algorithm.CalMetric('Feasible_rate'));
        Row.finalFE = double(Algorithm.result{end,1});
        FinalPop = Algorithm.result{end,2};
        [Row.finalPopCount,Row.finalFeasibleCount, ...
            Row.finalFeasibleRateManual,Row.finalBestCount] = ...
            finalPopulationCounts(FinalPop);
        Row = attachArchiveFilterFinalMetrics(Row, ...
            Algorithm.metric.analysis_core_csv);
        if plotThisTask && isfile(Row.snapshot_manifest_file)
            Manifest = readtable(Row.snapshot_manifest_file, ...
                'TextType','string','Delimiter',',');
            Row.snapshot_count = height(Manifest);
        end
        Row.status = "ok";
    catch err
        Row.status = "failed";
        Row.error_message = string(getReport(err,'extended','hyperlinks','off'));
    end
end

function writeStageSummaries(Summary,outDir)
    All = table();
    for i = 1 : height(Summary)
        if string(Summary.status(i)) ~= "ok"
            continue;
        end
        if ~ismember('stage_metrics_file',Summary.Properties.VariableNames)
            continue;
        end
        stageFile = string(Summary.stage_metrics_file(i));
        if strlength(stageFile) == 0 || ~isfile(stageFile)
            continue;
        end
        Stage = readtable(stageFile,'TextType','string');
        if isempty(Stage)
            continue;
        end
        n = height(Stage);
        Meta = table( ...
            repmat(string(Summary.variant(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(string(Summary.archiveParetoFilterMode(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(string(Summary.archivePairDirectionMode(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(string(Summary.archiveSourceCapMode(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(string(Summary.archivePairRefMode(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(string(Summary.archiveUpdateMode(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(double(Summary.recentWindow(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(string(Summary.holdoutProtocol(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(double(Summary.holdoutRefModulo(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(double(Summary.holdoutRefRemainder(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(string(Summary.trainFilterMode(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(double(Summary.conditionKNNRetainRatio(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(double(Summary.cganTrainMinRefCov(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(double(Summary.cganTrainMinTargetTriples(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(string(Summary.conditionMode(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(string(Summary.targetMode(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(double(Summary.nearSegmentTau(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(double(Summary.nearSegmentMaxPerPair(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(double(Summary.decisionInterpCount(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(string(Summary.targetRealLabelMode(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(string(Summary.generatorMode(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(string(Summary.ganCriticMode(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(string(Summary.generatorLossMode(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(double(Summary.reconstructionWeight(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(double(Summary.reconstructionHuberDelta(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(string(Summary.problem(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(string(Summary.family(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(double(Summary.run(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(double(Summary.seed(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(double(Summary.N(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(double(Summary.D(i)),n,1), ...
            repmat(double(Summary.maxFE(i)),n,1), ...
            'VariableNames',{'variant','archiveParetoFilterMode', ...
            'archivePairDirectionMode','archiveSourceCapMode', ...
            'archivePairRefMode','archiveUpdateMode','recentWindow', ...
            'holdoutProtocol','holdoutRefModulo','holdoutRefRemainder', ...
            'trainFilterMode', ...
            'conditionKNNRetainRatio','cganTrainMinRefCov', ...
            'cganTrainMinTargetTriples','conditionMode', ...
            'targetMode','nearSegmentTau','nearSegmentMaxPerPair', ...
            'decisionInterpCount','targetRealLabelMode','generatorMode', ...
            'ganCriticMode','generatorLossMode', ...
            'reconstructionWeight','reconstructionHuberDelta', ...
            'problem','family','run','seed','N','D','maxFE'});
        All = [All;Meta,Stage]; %#ok<AGROW>
    end

    writetable(All,fullfile(outDir,'stage_raw_gan_metrics.csv'));
    if isempty(All)
        writetable(table(),fullfile(outDir, ...
            'stage_raw_gan_metrics_by_variant_fe.csv'));
        writetable(table(),fullfile(outDir, ...
            'stage_raw_gan_metrics_by_problem_fe.csv'));
        return;
    end

    numericMask = varfun(@isnumeric,All,'OutputFormat','uniform');
    numericVars = All.Properties.VariableNames(numericMask);
    metricVars = setdiff(numericVars, ...
        {'run','seed','N','D','maxFE','conditionKNNRetainRatio', ...
        'cganTrainMinRefCov','cganTrainMinTargetTriples', ...
        'recentWindow','holdoutRefModulo','holdoutRefRemainder', ...
        'nearSegmentTau','nearSegmentMaxPerPair','decisionInterpCount', ...
        'reconstructionWeight','reconstructionHuberDelta', ...
        'target_FE','actual_FE','gen'}, ...
        'stable');

    ByVariantFE = groupsummary(All, ...
        {'variant','archiveParetoFilterMode','archivePairDirectionMode', ...
        'archiveSourceCapMode','archivePairRefMode', ...
        'archiveUpdateMode','recentWindow', ...
        'holdoutProtocol','holdoutRefModulo','holdoutRefRemainder', ...
        'trainFilterMode','conditionKNNRetainRatio', ...
        'cganTrainMinRefCov','cganTrainMinTargetTriples', ...
        'conditionMode','targetMode','nearSegmentTau', ...
        'nearSegmentMaxPerPair','decisionInterpCount', ...
        'targetRealLabelMode', ...
        'generatorMode','ganCriticMode','generatorLossMode', ...
        'reconstructionWeight','reconstructionHuberDelta', ...
        'target_FE'}, ...
        'mean',metricVars);
    ByProblemFE = groupsummary(All, ...
        {'variant','archiveParetoFilterMode','archivePairDirectionMode', ...
        'archiveSourceCapMode','archivePairRefMode', ...
        'archiveUpdateMode','recentWindow', ...
        'holdoutProtocol','holdoutRefModulo','holdoutRefRemainder', ...
        'trainFilterMode','conditionKNNRetainRatio', ...
        'cganTrainMinRefCov','cganTrainMinTargetTriples', ...
        'conditionMode','targetMode','nearSegmentTau', ...
        'nearSegmentMaxPerPair','decisionInterpCount', ...
        'targetRealLabelMode', ...
        'generatorMode','ganCriticMode','generatorLossMode', ...
        'reconstructionWeight','reconstructionHuberDelta', ...
        'problem','target_FE'}, ...
        'mean',metricVars);
    writetable(ByVariantFE,fullfile(outDir, ...
        'stage_raw_gan_metrics_by_variant_fe.csv'));
    writetable(ByProblemFE,fullfile(outDir, ...
        'stage_raw_gan_metrics_by_problem_fe.csv'));
end

function Plot = normalizePlotOptions(Options,outDir)
    Plot = struct( ...
        'enable',false, ...
        'targets',zeros(0,1), ...
        'outDir',"", ...
        'snapshotRoot',"", ...
        'figureRoot',"", ...
        'ganN',100, ...
        'plotRuns',zeros(0,1), ...
        'plotVariants',strings(0,1));
    if isempty(Options)
        return;
    end
    if islogical(Options) || isnumeric(Options)
        Plot.enable = logical(Options);
    elseif isstruct(Options)
        Plot.enable = optionValue(Options, ...
            {'enable','enabled','plotSnapshots'},false);
        Plot.targets = optionValue(Options, ...
            {'targets','snapshotTargets'},zeros(0,1));
        Plot.outDir = string(optionValue(Options, ...
            {'outDir','snapshotOutDir'}, ...
            fullfile(outDir,'archive_objective_snapshots')));
        Plot.figureRoot = string(optionValue(Options, ...
            {'figureRoot','figureOutDir'}, ""));
        Plot.ganN = optionValue(Options,{'ganN','snapshotGanN'},100);
        Plot.plotRuns = optionValue(Options, ...
            {'plotRuns','snapshotRuns'},zeros(0,1));
        Plot.plotVariants = optionValue(Options, ...
            {'plotVariants','snapshotVariants'},strings(0,1));
    else
        error('run_CCMO_GAN_BDG_archive_pareto_filters_fullscope:BadPlotOptions', ...
            'plotOptions must be empty, logical, numeric, or a struct.');
    end
    Plot.targets = unique(round(double(Plot.targets(:)')),'stable');
    Plot.targets = Plot.targets(isfinite(Plot.targets) & Plot.targets > 0);
    if ~isempty(Plot.targets)
        Plot.enable = true;
    elseif Plot.enable
        Plot.targets = [10000 30000 50000 70000 100000];
    end
    Plot.ganN = max(0,round(double(Plot.ganN)));
    Plot.plotRuns = unique(round(double(Plot.plotRuns(:)')),'stable');
    Plot.plotRuns = Plot.plotRuns(isfinite(Plot.plotRuns) & Plot.plotRuns > 0);
    Plot.plotVariants = string(Plot.plotVariants(:));
    Plot.plotVariants = Plot.plotVariants(strlength(Plot.plotVariants) > 0);
    if Plot.enable
        if strlength(Plot.outDir) == 0
            Plot.outDir = string(fullfile(outDir,'archive_objective_snapshots'));
        end
        Plot.snapshotRoot = string(fullfile(char(Plot.outDir),'snapshots'));
        if strlength(Plot.figureRoot) == 0
            Plot.figureRoot = string(fullfile(char(Plot.outDir),'figures'));
        end
        if ~isfolder(char(Plot.snapshotRoot))
            mkdir(char(Plot.snapshotRoot));
        end
        if ~isfolder(char(Plot.figureRoot))
            mkdir(char(Plot.figureRoot));
        end
    end
end

function flag = shouldPlotTask(Row,Plot)
    flag = logical(Plot.enable);
    if ~flag
        return;
    end
    if ~isempty(Plot.plotRuns) && ~ismember(double(Row.run),Plot.plotRuns)
        flag = false;
        return;
    end
    if ~isempty(Plot.plotVariants) && ...
            ~ismember(string(Row.variant),Plot.plotVariants)
        flag = false;
    end
end

function value = optionValue(Options,names,defaultValue)
    value = defaultValue;
    for i = 1 : numel(names)
        name = char(names{i});
        if isfield(Options,name) && ~isempty(Options.(name))
            value = Options.(name);
            return;
        end
    end
end
