            abs(GAN.trainRealLabelMean - mean(double(realLabels))) < 1e-12, ...
        'test_CCMO_GAN_BDG_target_conditioned:MissingRealLabelVectorDiag', ...
        'Target-conditioned GAN must accept and report evaluated real-label vectors.');
end

function assertTargetConditionedMultiheadGANSmoke()
    X = [0.20 0.30;0.25 0.35;0.70 0.80;0.75 0.85];
    XAI = min(X + 0.05,1);
    C = single([0.1 0.2 1 0;0.2 0.3 1 0;0.7 0.8 0 1;0.8 0.9 0 1]);
    labels = [0.95;0.85;0.75;0.65];
    Options = struct( ...
        'generatorMode',"objective_target_conditioned", ...
        'conditionData',C, ...
        'criticMode',"target_conditioned_multihead", ...
        'generatorLossMode',"conditional_adversarial_huber_boundary", ...
        'reconstructionWeight',1, ...
        'boundaryQualityWeight',0.50, ...
        'sideWeight',0.25, ...
        'thinConsistencyWeight',0.10, ...
        'realLabels',labels, ...
        'archMode',"small", ...
        'miniBatch',4, ...
        'warmStartEnabled',false);

    GAN = BoundaryGAN_BDG('traindirectboundary',X,XAI,[0 0],[1 1], ...
        2,2,[],Options);
    Y = predict(GAN.netD,dlarray(single([X(1,:)';C(1,:)']),"CB"));

    assert(size(extractdata(Y),1) == 3, ...
        'test_CCMO_GAN_BDG_target_conditioned:BadMultiheadCriticOutput', ...
        'target_conditioned_multihead critic must output adv, boundary quality, and side heads.');
    assert(isfield(GAN.targetConditionedDiag,'gan_g_bnd_loss_mean') && ...
            isfield(GAN.targetConditionedDiag,'gan_g_cons_loss_mean'), ...
        'test_CCMO_GAN_BDG_target_conditioned:MissingMultiheadGeneratorDiag', ...
        'Boundary/thinness generator losses must be reported in targetConditionedDiag.');
    assert(isfinite(GAN.targetConditionedDiag.gan_g_bnd_loss_mean) && ...
            isfinite(GAN.targetConditionedDiag.gan_g_cons_loss_mean), ...
        'test_CCMO_GAN_BDG_target_conditioned:BadMultiheadGeneratorDiag', ...
        'Boundary/thinness generator diagnostics must be finite after multihead training.');
end

function assertTargetConditionedGANSmoke()
    Problem = DASCMOP1_BC('N',20,'D',30,'maxFE',1000);
    XAF = repmat(0.20,4,Problem.D);
    XAI = repmat(0.10,4,Problem.D);
    PAF = Problem.Evaluation(XAF);
    PAI = Problem.Evaluation(XAI);
    AF = struct('decs',PAF.decs,'objs',PAF.objs);
    AI = struct('decs',PAI.decs,'objs',PIAObjsDominating(PAF.objs,PAI.objs));
    [XTrain,CTrain] = BuildBoundaryTargetTriples_BDG(AF,AI,Problem);
    Options = struct( ...
        'generatorMode',"objective_target_conditioned", ...
        'criticMode',"target_conditioned", ...
        'generatorLossMode',"conditional_adversarial", ...
        'conditionData',CTrain, ...
        'conditionPairIndex',[1;1;2;2], ...
        'miniBatch',4, ...
        'dPretrainIter',1, ...
        'dSteps',1, ...
        'gSteps',1, ...
        'archMode',"small");

    GAN = BoundaryGAN_BDG('traindirectboundary',XTrain,AI.decs, ...
        Problem.lower,Problem.upper,2,1,[],Options);
    [Offspring,Diag] = BoundaryGAN_BDG('sample',Problem,GAN,3);

    assert(GAN.conditionDim == 2*Problem.M, ...
        'test_CCMO_GAN_BDG_target_conditioned:BadGANConditionDim', ...
        'Target-conditioned GAN must store conditionDim=2*M.');
    assert(numel(Offspring) == 3 && Diag.rawgen_count == 3, ...
        'test_CCMO_GAN_BDG_target_conditioned:BadTargetGANSample', ...
        'Target-conditioned GAN must sample complete decision offspring.');
    assert(isfield(GAN,'targetConditionedDiag') && ...
            GAN.targetConditionedDiag.target_mismatch_count > 0, ...
        'test_CCMO_GAN_BDG_target_conditioned:MissingMismatchDiag', ...
        'Target-conditioned GAN must train with mismatched real conditions.');
end

function assertTargetConditionedGANSamplesStoredConditionsByWeight()
    Problem = DASCMOP1_BC('N',20,'D',30,'maxFE',1000);
    XAF = repmat(0.20,4,Problem.D);
    XAI = repmat(0.10,4,Problem.D);
    PAF = Problem.Evaluation(XAF);
    PAI = Problem.Evaluation(XAI);
    AF = struct('decs',PAF.decs,'objs',PAF.objs);
    AI = struct('decs',PAI.decs,'objs',PIAObjsDominating(PAF.objs,PAI.objs));
    [XTrain,CTrain] = BuildBoundaryTargetTriples_BDG(AF,AI,Problem);
    sampleWeights = [0;0;1;0];
    Options = struct( ...
        'generatorMode',"objective_target_conditioned", ...
        'criticMode',"target_conditioned", ...
        'generatorLossMode',"conditional_adversarial", ...
        'conditionData',CTrain, ...
        'sampleWeights',sampleWeights, ...
        'miniBatch',4, ...
        'dPretrainIter',0, ...
        'dSteps',1, ...
        'gSteps',1, ...
        'archMode',"small");

    rng(42,'twister');
    GAN = BoundaryGAN_BDG('traindirectboundary',XTrain,AI.decs, ...
        Problem.lower,Problem.upper,2,0,[],Options);
    [~,Diag] = BoundaryGAN_BDG('sample',Problem,GAN,8);

    assert(isfield(GAN,'conditionSamplingWeights') && ...
            abs(GAN.conditionSamplingWeights(3) - 1) < 1e-12, ...
        'test_CCMO_GAN_BDG_target_conditioned:MissingConditionSamplingWeights', ...
        'Target-conditioned GAN must retain normalized condition sampling weights.');
    assert(isfield(Diag,'rawgen_condition_index') && ...
            all(Diag.rawgen_condition_index(:) == 3), ...
        'test_CCMO_GAN_BDG_target_conditioned:UnweightedGeneratedConditionSampling', ...
        'Generated target-conditioned samples must draw stored conditions according to sampleWeights.');
end

function assertTargetConditionedGANDiagnosticSampleAcceptsFixedConditionsAndZ()
    Problem = DASCMOP1_BC('N',20,'D',30,'maxFE',1000);
    XAF = repmat(0.20,4,Problem.D);
    XAI = repmat(0.10,4,Problem.D);
    PAF = Problem.Evaluation(XAF);
    PAI = Problem.Evaluation(XAI);
    AF = struct('decs',PAF.decs,'objs',PAF.objs);
    AI = struct('decs',PAI.decs,'objs',PIAObjsDominating(PAF.objs,PAI.objs));
    [XTrain,CTrain] = BuildBoundaryTargetTriples_BDG(AF,AI,Problem);
    Options = struct( ...
        'generatorMode',"objective_target_conditioned", ...
        'criticMode',"target_conditioned", ...
        'generatorLossMode',"conditional_adversarial", ...
        'conditionData',CTrain, ...
        'conditionPairIndex',[1;1;2;2], ...
        'miniBatch',4, ...
        'dPretrainIter',0, ...
        'dSteps',1, ...
        'gSteps',1, ...
        'archMode',"small");

    GAN = BoundaryGAN_BDG('traindirectboundary',XTrain,AI.decs, ...
        Problem.lower,Problem.upper,2,0,[],Options);
    conditionIndex = [2;2;3];
    fixedZ = zeros(numel(conditionIndex),GAN.zDim);
    [Offspring,Diag] = BoundaryGAN_BDG('diagnosesample',Problem,GAN, ...
        conditionIndex,fixedZ);

    assert(numel(Offspring) == 3 && Diag.rawgen_count == 3, ...
        'test_CCMO_GAN_BDG_target_conditioned:BadDiagnosticSampleCount', ...
        'Diagnostic GAN sampling must evaluate one solution per requested condition/Z row.');
    assert(isequal(Diag.rawgen_condition_index(:),conditionIndex(:)), ...
        'test_CCMO_GAN_BDG_target_conditioned:BadDiagnosticConditionIndex', ...
        'Diagnostic GAN sampling must preserve requested condition indices.');
    assert(isequal(Diag.rawgen_pair_index(:),[1;1;2]), ...
        'test_CCMO_GAN_BDG_target_conditioned:BadDiagnosticPairIndex', ...
        'Diagnostic GAN sampling must map expanded condition rows to source boundary-pair indices.');
    Decs = Offspring.decs;
    assert(max(abs(Decs(1,:) - Decs(2,:)),[],'all') < 1e-12, ...
        'test_CCMO_GAN_BDG_target_conditioned:FixedConditionZNotDeterministic', ...
        'The same condition and the same z must produce the same generated decision.');
end

function assertTargetConditionedGANReportsWarmStartAndEarlyStopSupport()
    Problem = DASCMOP1_BC('N',20,'D',30,'maxFE',1000);
    XAF = repmat(0.20,4,Problem.D);
    XAI = repmat(0.10,4,Problem.D);
    PAF = Problem.Evaluation(XAF);
    PAI = Problem.Evaluation(XAI);
    AF = struct('decs',PAF.decs,'objs',PAF.objs);
    AI = struct('decs',PAI.decs,'objs',PIAObjsDominating(PAF.objs,PAI.objs));
    [XTrain,CTrain] = BuildBoundaryTargetTriples_BDG(AF,AI,Problem);
    Options = struct( ...
        'generatorMode',"objective_target_conditioned", ...
        'criticMode',"target_conditioned", ...
        'generatorLossMode',"conditional_adversarial_huber", ...
        'conditionData',CTrain, ...
        'miniBatch',4, ...
        'dPretrainIter',0, ...
        'dSteps',1, ...
        'gSteps',1, ...
        'archMode',"small", ...
        'trainMode',"iter", ...
        'warmStartEnabled',true, ...
        'earlyStopEnabled',true, ...
        'earlyStopPatience',1, ...
        'earlyStopMinIter',0);

    GAN1 = BoundaryGAN_BDG('traindirectboundary',XTrain,AI.decs, ...
        Problem.lower,Problem.upper,2,0,[],Options);
    GAN2 = BoundaryGAN_BDG('traindirectboundary',XTrain,AI.decs, ...
        Problem.lower,Problem.upper,2,0,GAN1,Options);

    assert(isfield(GAN2,'warmStartUsed') && GAN2.warmStartUsed == 1, ...
        'test_CCMO_GAN_BDG_target_conditioned:MissingWarmStartDiag', ...
        'Target-conditioned GAN must report when compatible previous nets are reused.');
    assert(isfield(GAN2,'earlyStopEnabled') && GAN2.earlyStopEnabled == 1 && ...
            isfield(GAN2,'earlyStopPatience') && GAN2.earlyStopPatience == 1, ...
        'test_CCMO_GAN_BDG_target_conditioned:MissingEarlyStopDiag', ...
        'Target-conditioned GAN must report early-stop configuration.');
end

function assertTargetUnconditionedGANSmoke()
    Problem = DASCMOP1_BC('N',20,'D',30,'maxFE',1000);
    XAF = repmat(0.20,4,Problem.D);
    XAI = repmat(0.10,4,Problem.D);
    PAF = Problem.Evaluation(XAF);
    PAI = Problem.Evaluation(XAI);
    AF = struct('decs',PAF.decs,'objs',PAF.objs);
    AI = struct('decs',PAI.decs,'objs',PIAObjsDominating(PAF.objs,PAI.objs));
    [XTrain,~,TripleDiag] = BuildBoundaryTargetTriples_BDG(AF,AI,Problem);
    Options = struct( ...
        'generatorMode',"objective_target_unconditioned", ...
        'criticMode',"af_like", ...
        'generatorLossMode',"adversarial", ...
        'conditionData',[], ...
        'miniBatch',4, ...
        'dPretrainIter',1, ...
        'dSteps',1, ...
        'gSteps',1, ...
        'archMode',"small");

    GAN = BoundaryGAN_BDG('traindirectboundary',XTrain,AI.decs, ...
        Problem.lower,Problem.upper,2,1,[],Options);
    [Offspring,Diag] = BoundaryGAN_BDG('sample',Problem,GAN,3);

    assert(TripleDiag.target_triple_ready == 1, ...
        'test_CCMO_GAN_BDG_target_conditioned:BadUnconditionedTargetTriples', ...
        'Target-unconditioned smoke must still train from boundary target decisions.');
    assert(string(GAN.criticMode) == "af_like" && ...
            string(GAN.generatorLossMode) == "adversarial", ...
        'test_CCMO_GAN_BDG_target_conditioned:BadUnconditionedGANModes', ...
        'Target-unconditioned GAN must use D(x) with adversarial loss.');
    assert(GAN.conditionDim == 0 && isempty(GAN.conditionData), ...
        'test_CCMO_GAN_BDG_target_conditioned:BadUnconditionedConditionData', ...
        'Target-unconditioned GAN must not store conditionData.');
    assert(isfield(GAN,'generatorConditionDim') && ...
            GAN.generatorConditionDim == 0, ...
        'test_CCMO_GAN_BDG_target_conditioned:BadUnconditionedGeneratorConditionDim', ...
        'Target-unconditioned branch must feed only z to the generator.');
    assert(numel(Offspring) == 3 && Diag.rawgen_count == 3, ...
        'test_CCMO_GAN_BDG_target_conditioned:BadTargetUnconditionedSample', ...
        'Target-unconditioned GAN must sample complete decision offspring.');
    assert(isfield(GAN,'targetConditionedDiag') && ...
            GAN.targetConditionedDiag.target_mismatch_count == 0 && ...
            GAN.targetConditionedDiag.target_mismatch_batch_count == 0, ...
        'test_CCMO_GAN_BDG_target_conditioned:UnexpectedUnconditionedMismatchDiag', ...
        'Target-unconditioned GAN must not train mismatched real conditions.');
end

function assertG2SLUnconditionedGANOptionsSmoke()
    Problem = DASCMOP1_BC('N',20,'D',30,'maxFE',1000);
    XAF = repmat(0.20,4,Problem.D);
    XAI = repmat(0.10,4,Problem.D);
    PAF = Problem.Evaluation(XAF);
    PAI = Problem.Evaluation(XAI);
    AF = struct('decs',PAF.decs,'objs',PAF.objs);
    AI = struct('decs',PAI.decs,'objs',PIAObjsDominating(PAF.objs,PAI.objs));
    [XTrain,~,TripleDiag] = BuildBoundaryTargetTriples_BDG(AF,AI,Problem);
    Options = struct( ...
        'generatorMode',"objective_target_unconditioned", ...
        'criticMode',"af_like", ...
        'generatorLossMode',"adversarial", ...
        'conditionData',[], ...
        'miniBatch',4, ...
        'dPretrainIter',0, ...
        'dSteps',1, ...
        'gSteps',1, ...
        'archMode',"g2sl", ...
        'realLabel',0.9, ...
        'lrD',1e-4, ...
        'lrG',1e-4, ...
        'trainMode',"epoch");

    GAN = BoundaryGAN_BDG('traindirectboundary',XTrain,AI.decs, ...
        Problem.lower,Problem.upper,8,1,[],Options);

    assert(TripleDiag.target_triple_ready == 1, ...
        'test_CCMO_GAN_BDG_target_conditioned:BadG2SLTriples', ...
        'G2SL smoke must train from ready target-unconditioned AF decisions.');
    assert(string(GAN.archMode) == "g2sl" && ...
            string(GAN.trainMode) == "epoch", ...
        'test_CCMO_GAN_BDG_target_conditioned:MissingG2SLGANModes', ...
        'G2SL smoke must retain archMode=g2sl and trainMode=epoch.');
    assert(abs(double(GAN.realLabel) - 0.9) < 1e-12 && ...
            abs(double(GAN.lrD) - 1e-4) < 1e-12 && ...
            abs(double(GAN.lrG) - 1e-4) < 1e-12, ...
        'test_CCMO_GAN_BDG_target_conditioned:MissingG2SLGANScalars', ...
        'G2SL smoke must retain realLabel and learning-rate options.');
end

function Obj = PIAObjsDominating(AFObj,AIObj)
    Obj = min(double(AIObj),double(AFObj) - 1e-3);
end

function restoreExperimentControl(controlName,hadOldControl,oldControl)
    if hadOldControl
        setappdata(0,controlName,oldControl);
    elseif isappdata(0,controlName)
        rmappdata(0,controlName);
    end
end

function assertFullscopeRunnerAllowsOnlyCurrentTargetModes(rootDir)
    mainFile = fullfile(rootDir,'Algorithms', ...
        'Multi-objective optimization','CCMO-GAN-BDG','CCMO_GAN_BDG.m');
    ganFile = fullfile(rootDir,'Algorithms', ...
        'Multi-objective optimization','CCMO-GAN-BDG','BoundaryGAN_BDG.m');
    runnerFile = fullfile(rootDir,'Algorithms', ...
        'Multi-objective optimization','CCMO-GAN-BDG','Support', ...
        'run_CCMO_GAN_BDG_archive_pareto_filters_fullscope.m');
    joined = string(fileread(mainFile)) + newline + ...
        string(fileread(ganFile)) + newline + string(fileread(runnerFile));

    required = ["FixMD_GNDk60_nearseg_huber_z0", ...
        "global_af_nd", ...
        "af_not_dominates_ai", ...
        "objective_target_conditioned", ...
        "target_conditioned", ...
        "conditional_adversarial_huber", ...
        "condition_knn", ...
        "Control.conditionKNNRetainRatio", ...
        "yt_dt_ref", ...
        "near_segment_feasible", ...
        "logical(Control.ganWarmStartEnabled)", ...
        "~logical(Control.ganEarlyStopEnabled)"];
    for i = 1 : numel(required)
        assert(contains(joined,required(i)), ...
            'test_CCMO_GAN_BDG_target_conditioned:MissingTargetModeToken', ...
            'Target-conditioned mode token "%s" must be wired.',required(i));
    end

    forbidden = ["pair_boundary_generated_labeled", ...
        "pair_boundary_generated_outside_penalty", ...
        "pair_boundary_quality", ...
        "pair_boundary_quality_generated", ...
        "critic_regression", ...
        "decision_segment", ...
        "decisionSegmentWeight", ...
        "criticGeneratedLabelData", ...
        "condition_knn_fused", ...
        "FixMD_GNDk60_nearseg_fused", ...
        "FixMD_GNDk60_nearseg_noknn", ...
        "FixMD_GNDk60_nearseg_compact", ...
        "FixMD_GNDk60_endpoint", ...
        "FixMD_GNDk60_nearseg_bundle", ...
        "targetMode == ""compact_cell""", ...
        "trainBundleMode", ...
        "BuildBoundaryTrainBundle_BDG", ...
        "CompactBoundaryTrainingSet_BDG", ...
        "SelectBoundaryCellSamples_BDG", ...
        "SelectCellBalancedInjection_BDG", ...
        "BoundaryCellCoverageDiag_BDG"];
    for i = 1 : numel(forbidden)
        assert(~contains(joined,forbidden(i)), ...
            'test_CCMO_GAN_BDG_target_conditioned:DeprecatedScalarBranchStillReachable', ...
            'Deprecated scalar target branch token "%s" must be removed.', ...
            forbidden(i));
    end
end

function [AllSummary,FigureManifest,outRoot] = run_fixmd_validation_cropped_stage_figures(outRoot,workerCount)
%RUN_FIXMD_VALIDATION_CROPPED_STAGE_FIGURES Generate cropped FixMD validation stage figures.
% The figures intentionally match the domain/training/GAN-only diagnostic
% style and crop axes from actual training + normal CGAN points.

    rootDir = fileparts(which('platemo'));
    addpath(genpath(rootDir));
    if nargin < 1 || isempty(outRoot)
        outRoot = fullfile(rootDir,'Data','CCMO_GAN_BDG', ...
            ['fixmd_validation_R1_R4_P1_run1_cropped_stagefig_', ...
            char(datetime('now','Format','yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'))]);
    end
    if nargin < 2 || isempty(workerCount)
        workerCount = 8;
    end

    problems = {'DASCMOP1_BC','DASCMOP2_BC','DASCMOP4_BC','DASCMOP5_BC', ...
        'LIRCMOP5_BC','LIRCMOP6_BC','LIRCMOP7_BC','LIRCMOP8_BC', ...
        'LIRCMOP9_BC','LIRCMOP10_BC'};
    targets = [10000 20000 30000 50000 70000 100000];
    configFile = fullfile(rootDir,'Data','CCMO_GAN_BDG', ...
        'fixmd_validation_fullscope_active','variant_config.csv');
    Variants = readtable(configFile,'TextType','string');
    Variants = Variants(Variants.variant ~= "FixMD_GNDk60_nearseg_huber_z0",:);

    if ~isfolder(outRoot)
        mkdir(outRoot);
    end
    writetable(Variants,fullfile(outRoot,'variant_config.csv'));

    AllSummary = table();
    FigureManifest = table();
    for i = 1 : height(Variants)
        variant = string(Variants.variant(i));
        variantName = safeName_BDG(variant);
        variantOut = fullfile(outRoot,'runs',variantName);
        control = table2struct(Variants(i,:));
        diagOptions = struct( ...
            'conditionCount',30, ...
            'zPerCondition',10, ...
            'normalN',200, ...
            'seed',20260619, ...
            'variant',variant, ...
            'control',control);
        fprintf('cropped stage figures variant=%s out=%s\n', ...
            variant,variantOut);
        [Summary,~] = run_CCMO_GAN_BDG_boundary_diagnostics( ...
            variantOut,workerCount,problems,100,[],100000,1, ...
            targets,diagOptions);
        Summary.figure_variant_root = repmat(string(fullfile(outRoot, ...
            'figures_cropped_domain_gan_train_only',variantName)), ...
            height(Summary),1);
        AllSummary = [AllSummary;Summary]; %#ok<AGROW>
        Figures = drawCroppedStageFigures_BDG(Summary,outRoot,targets);
        FigureManifest = [FigureManifest;Figures]; %#ok<AGROW>
    end

    writetable(AllSummary,fullfile(outRoot, ...
        'cropped_stage_run_summary.csv'));
    writetable(FigureManifest,fullfile(outRoot, ...
        'cropped_stage_figure_manifest.csv'));
end

function FigureManifest = drawCroppedStageFigures_BDG(Summary,outRoot,targets)
    Rows = repmat(emptyFigureRow_BDG(),0,1);
    for i = 1 : height(Summary)
        if string(Summary.status(i)) ~= "ok"
            continue;
        end
        variant = string(Summary.variant(i));
        variantName = safeName_BDG(variant);
        problemName = string(Summary.problem(i));
        problemSafe = safeName_BDG(problemName);
        runId = round(double(Summary.run(i)));
        ProblemConstructor = str2func(char(problemName));
        Problem = ProblemConstructor('N',100,'maxFE',100000);
        Snap = readManifestIfExists_BDG(string(Summary.snapshot_manifest_file(i)));
        Diag = readManifestIfExists_BDG(string(Summary.diagnostic_manifest_file(i)));
        figureDir = fullfile(outRoot,'figures_cropped_domain_gan_train_only', ...
            variantName,problemSafe);
        if ~isfolder(figureDir)
            mkdir(figureDir);
        end
        for t = reshape(targets,1,[])
            [Boundary,Sample,actualFE,gen] = loadStageTables_BDG(Snap,Diag,t);
            figFile = fullfile(figureDir,sprintf( ...
                '%s_%s_run%d_FE%06d_cropped_domain_gan_train.png', ...
                variantName,problemSafe,runId,round(t)));
            plotSingleCroppedStage_BDG(Problem,problemName,variant,runId,t, ...
                actualFE,gen,Boundary,Sample,figFile);
            Rows(end+1,1) = emptyFigureRow_BDG(); %#ok<AGROW>
            Rows(end).variant = variant;
            Rows(end).problem = problemName;
            Rows(end).run = runId;
            Rows(end).target_FE = double(t);
            Rows(end).actual_FE = actualFE;
            Rows(end).gen = gen;
            Rows(end).figure_file = string(figFile);
        end
    end
    FigureManifest = struct2table(Rows);
end

function [Boundary,Sample,actualFE,gen] = loadStageTables_BDG(Snap,Diag,targetFE)
    Boundary = table();
    Sample = table();
    actualFE = NaN;
    gen = NaN;
    if ~isempty(Snap) && height(Snap) > 0
        idx = selectTargetRow_BDG(Snap,targetFE);
        actualFE = numericAt_BDG(Snap,'actual_FE',idx);
        gen = numericAt_BDG(Snap,'gen',idx);
        snapshotFile = string(Snap.snapshot_file(idx));
        if isfile(snapshotFile)
            Boundary = readtable(snapshotFile,'TextType','string', ...
                'Delimiter',',','VariableNamingRule','preserve');
        end
    end
    if ~isempty(Diag) && height(Diag) > 0
        idx = selectTargetRow_BDG(Diag,targetFE);
        sampleFile = string(Diag.sample_file(idx));
        if isfile(sampleFile)
            Sample = readtable(sampleFile,'TextType','string', ...
                'Delimiter',',','VariableNamingRule','preserve');
        end
    end
end

function idx = selectTargetRow_BDG(T,targetFE)
    target = numericColumn_BDG(T,'target_FE');
    exact = find(round(target) == round(double(targetFE)),1,'last');
    if ~isempty(exact)
        idx = exact;
    elseif isempty(target)
        idx = 1;
    else
        [~,idx] = min(abs(target - double(targetFE)));
    end
end

function plotSingleCroppedStage_BDG(Problem,problemName,variant,runId, ...
        targetFE,actualFE,gen,Boundary,Sample,figFile)
    [xLimits,yLimits] = croppedObjectiveLimits_BDG(Boundary,Sample,Problem);
    fig = figure('Visible','off','Color','w','Position',[100 100 900 900]);
    ax = axes(fig);
    hold(ax,'on');
    set(ax,'Box','on','Color',[0.94 0.91 0.86], ...
        'FontName','Times New Roman','FontSize',10);
    plotFeasibleDomain_BDG(ax,Problem);
    plotTrainingSet_BDG(ax,Boundary,xLimits,yLimits);
    plotNormalCGAN_BDG(ax,Sample,xLimits,yLimits);
    axis(ax,'equal');
    daspect(ax,[1 1 1]);
    pbaspect(ax,[1 1 1]);
    xlim(ax,xLimits);
    ylim(ax,yLimits);
    ax.XLimMode = 'manual';
    ax.YLimMode = 'manual';
    xlabel(ax,'f_1');
    ylabel(ax,'f_2');
    title(ax,sprintf('%s | %s | run=%d targetFE=%d actualFE=%s gen=%s', ...
        char(problemName),char(variant),runId,round(targetFE), ...
        numberText_BDG(actualFE),numberText_BDG(gen)), ...
        'Interpreter','none','FontWeight','normal');
    legend(ax,'Location','bestoutside','Box','off');
    hold(ax,'off');
    exportgraphics(fig,figFile,'Resolution',300);
    close(fig);
end

function plotFeasibleDomain_BDG(ax,Problem)
    plot(ax,nan,nan,'s','MarkerSize',8, ...
        'MarkerFaceColor',[0.94 0.91 0.86], ...
        'MarkerEdgeColor',[0.72 0.64 0.54], ...
        'DisplayName','Infeasible domain');
    PF = Problem.PF;
    if iscell(PF) && numel(PF) >= 3
        X = PF{1};
        Y = PF{2};
        Z = PF{3};
        mask = isfinite(Z);
        ZPlot = zeros(size(X));
        ZPlot(~mask) = NaN;
        surf(ax,X,Y,ZPlot,'EdgeColor','none', ...
            'FaceColor',[0.73 0.88 0.74], ...
            'FaceAlpha',0.58,'DisplayName','Feasible domain');
        view(ax,[0 90]);
    elseif isnumeric(PF) && size(PF,2) >= 2
        plot(ax,PF(:,1),PF(:,2),'.','Color',[0.25 0.62 0.32], ...
            'MarkerSize',7,'DisplayName','Feasible domain');
    else
        plot(ax,nan,nan,'.','Color',[0.25 0.62 0.32], ...
            'DisplayName','Feasible domain');
    end
end

function plotTrainingSet_BDG(ax,Boundary,xLimits,yLimits)
    if isempty(Boundary) || height(Boundary) == 0 || ...
            ~all(ismember(["obj1","obj2","archive_role"], ...
            string(Boundary.Properties.VariableNames)))
        scatter(ax,nan,nan,30,'s','MarkerFaceColor',[1.0 0.68 0.16], ...
            'MarkerEdgeColor',[0.25 0.14 0.03], ...
            'DisplayName','Training set');
        return;
    end
    Obj = [numericColumn_BDG(Boundary,'obj1'), ...
        numericColumn_BDG(Boundary,'obj2')];
    role = string(Boundary.archive_role);
    train = role == "AF_train" | role == "AI_train";
    inside = insideLimits_BDG(Obj,xLimits,yLimits);
    scatter(ax,Obj(train & inside,1),Obj(train & inside,2),34,'s', ...
        'MarkerFaceColor',[1.0 0.68 0.16], ...
        'MarkerEdgeColor',[0.25 0.14 0.03], ...
        'LineWidth',0.55,'MarkerFaceAlpha',0.78, ...
        'DisplayName','Training set');
end

function plotNormalCGAN_BDG(ax,Sample,xLimits,yLimits)
    if isempty(Sample) || height(Sample) == 0 || ...
            ~all(ismember(["obj1","obj2","mode"], ...
            string(Sample.Properties.VariableNames)))
        scatter(ax,nan,nan,20,'o','MarkerFaceColor',[0.84 0.06 0.10], ...
            'MarkerEdgeColor','none','DisplayName','CGAN generated');
        return;
    end
    Obj = [numericColumn_BDG(Sample,'obj1'), ...
        numericColumn_BDG(Sample,'obj2')];
    mode = string(Sample.mode);
    normal = mode == "normal";
    inside = insideLimits_BDG(Obj,xLimits,yLimits);
    scatter(ax,Obj(normal & inside,1),Obj(normal & inside,2),22,'o', ...
        'MarkerFaceColor',[0.84 0.06 0.10], ...
        'MarkerEdgeColor','none','MarkerFaceAlpha',0.58, ...
        'DisplayName','CGAN generated');
end

function [xLimits,yLimits] = croppedObjectiveLimits_BDG(Boundary,Sample,Problem)
    Obj = collectVisibleData_BDG(Boundary,Sample);
    if isempty(Obj)
        Obj = fallbackPFData_BDG(Problem);
    end
    xLimits = paddedLimits_BDG(Obj(:,1));
    yLimits = paddedLimits_BDG(Obj(:,2));
end

function Obj = collectVisibleData_BDG(Boundary,Sample)
    Obj = zeros(0,2);
    if ~isempty(Boundary) && height(Boundary) > 0 && ...
            all(ismember(["obj1","obj2","archive_role"], ...
            string(Boundary.Properties.VariableNames)))
        BObj = [numericColumn_BDG(Boundary,'obj1'), ...
            numericColumn_BDG(Boundary,'obj2')];
        role = string(Boundary.archive_role);
        train = role == "AF_train" | role == "AI_train";
        Obj = [Obj;BObj(train,:)]; %#ok<AGROW>
    end
    if ~isempty(Sample) && height(Sample) > 0 && ...
            all(ismember(["obj1","obj2","mode"], ...
            string(Sample.Properties.VariableNames)))
        SObj = [numericColumn_BDG(Sample,'obj1'), ...
            numericColumn_BDG(Sample,'obj2')];
        normal = string(Sample.mode) == "normal";
        Obj = [Obj;SObj(normal,:)]; %#ok<AGROW>
    end
    Obj = Obj(all(isfinite(Obj),2),:);
end

function Obj = fallbackPFData_BDG(Problem)
    PF = Problem.PF;
    if iscell(PF) && numel(PF) >= 2
        Obj = [PF{1}(:),PF{2}(:)];
    elseif isnumeric(PF) && size(PF,2) >= 2
        Obj = PF(:,1:2);
    else
        Obj = [0 0;1 1];
    end
    Obj = Obj(all(isfinite(Obj),2),:);
    if isempty(Obj)
        Obj = [0 0;1 1];
    end
end

function limits = paddedLimits_BDG(x)
    x = double(x(:));
    x = x(isfinite(x));
    if isempty(x)
        limits = [0 1];
        return;
    end
    lo = min(x);
    hi = max(x);
    if lo == hi
        pad = max(1,abs(lo)) * 0.25;
    else
        pad = (hi - lo) * 0.12;
    end
    limits = [lo - pad, hi + pad];
end

function inside = insideLimits_BDG(Obj,xLimits,yLimits)
    inside = isfinite(Obj(:,1)) & isfinite(Obj(:,2)) & ...
        Obj(:,1) >= xLimits(1) & Obj(:,1) <= xLimits(2) & ...
        Obj(:,2) >= yLimits(1) & Obj(:,2) <= yLimits(2);
end

function T = readManifestIfExists_BDG(fileName)
    if strlength(fileName) == 0 || ~isfile(fileName)
        T = table();
    else
        T = readtable(fileName,'TextType','string','Delimiter',',', ...
            'VariableNamingRule','preserve');
    end
end

function value = numericAt_BDG(T,name,idx)
    values = numericColumn_BDG(T,name);
    if isempty(values) || idx > numel(values)
        value = NaN;
    else
        value = double(values(idx));
    end
end

function values = numericColumn_BDG(T,name)
    vars = string(T.Properties.VariableNames);
    if isempty(T) || ~ismember(string(name),vars)
        values = zeros(height(T),1);
        return;
    end
    values = T.(char(name));
    if iscell(values)
        values = str2double(string(values));
    elseif isstring(values) || ischar(values)
        values = str2double(string(values));
    else
        values = double(values);
    end
    values = values(:);
end

function text = numberText_BDG(x)
    if ~isfinite(x)
        text = 'NA';
    else
        text = char(string(round(double(x))));
    end
end

function name = safeName_BDG(value)
    name = regexprep(char(string(value)),'[^A-Za-z0-9_=-]+','_');
end

function Row = emptyFigureRow_BDG()
    Row = struct('variant',"",'problem',"",'run',NaN, ...
        'target_FE',NaN,'actual_FE',NaN,'gen',NaN,'figure_file',"");
end
